<file path="app/api/activity/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { getManagerSession } from "@/lib/auth-session"
import { formatActivity } from "@/lib/activity-format"

export const runtime = "nodejs"
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  const requestedLeagueId = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("leagueId")
  const team = session ? await prisma.team.findFirst({ where: { id: session.teamId, managerId: session.managerId }, select: { leagueId: true } }) : null
  const leagueId = requestedLeagueId ?? team?.leagueId
  if (!leagueId || !team || (requestedLeagueId !== null && requestedLeagueId !== team.leagueId)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication required for this league." }, { status: 401 })
  }
  const records = await prisma.activityLog.findMany({
    where: { leagueId },
    include: { team: { select: { name: true, manager: { select: { name: true, handle: true } } } } },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    take: 50,
  })
  return NextResponse.json({ activities: records.map(formatActivity) })
}

<file path="app/api/draft/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { getManagerSession } from "@/lib/auth-session"
import { makeDraftPick, pauseDraft, readDraft, resumeDraft, setDraftTimer, startDraft, updateDraftQueue } from "@/lib/services/draft"

export const runtime = "nodejs"

async function leagueIdForSession(teamId: string) {
  const team = await prisma.team.findUnique({ where: { id: teamId }, select: { leagueId: true } })
  return team?.leagueId ?? null
}

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication required" }, { status: 401 })
  const leagueId = await leagueIdForSession(session.teamId)
  if (!leagueId) return NextResponse.json({ error: "League not found." }, { status: 404 })
  const draft = await readDraft(leagueId, session.teamId, request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("ensure") === "1")
  return NextResponse.json(draft)
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication required" }, { status: 401 })
  const leagueId = await leagueIdForSession(session.teamId)
  if (!leagueId) return NextResponse.json({ error: "League not found." }, { status: 404 })
  const body = await request.json().catch(() => null) as { action?: string; playerId?: number; timerSeconds?: number } | null
  if (!body?.action) return NextResponse.json({ error: "action is required" }, { status: 400 })
  const commissionerAction = body.action === "start" || body.action === "pause" || body.action === "resume" || body.action === "timer"
  if (commissionerAction && !session.isCommissioner) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 })
  try {
    if (body.action === "start") return NextResponse.json({ draft: await startDraft(leagueId, session.teamId) })
    if (body.action === "pause") return NextResponse.json({ draft: await pauseDraft(leagueId, session.teamId) })
    if (body.action === "resume") return NextResponse.json({ draft: await resumeDraft(leagueId, session.teamId) })
    if (body.action === "timer") {
      if (!Number.isInteger(body.timerSeconds)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "timerSeconds is required" }, { status: 400 })
      return NextResponse.json({ draft: await setDraftTimer(leagueId, session.teamId, body.timerSeconds as number) })
    }
    if (body.action === "pick") {
      if (!Number.isInteger(body.playerId)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "playerId is required" }, { status: 400 })
      return NextResponse.json({ draft: await makeDraftPick(leagueId, session.teamId, body.playerId as number, session.isCommissioner) })
    }
    if (body.action === "queue-add" || body.action === "queue-remove") {
      if (!Number.isInteger(body.playerId)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "playerId is required" }, { status: 400 })
      return NextResponse.json({ draft: await updateDraftQueue(leagueId, session.teamId, body.playerId as number, body.action === "queue-add") })
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unknown action" }, { status: 400 })
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Draft action failed" }, { status: 400 })
  }
}

<file path="app/api/news/route.ts">
import { NextResponse } from "next/server"

type EspnArticle = {
  id: number
  headline?: string
  description?: string
  published?: string
  links?: { web?: { href?: string } }
}

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const player = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get("player")?.trim().toLowerCase()
  const response = await fetch("https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/hockey/nhl/news?limit=50", {
    headers: { Accept: "application/json", "User-Agent": "JohnScottDynasty/1.0" },
    next: { revalidate: 300 },
  })
  if (!response.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "ESPN news feed unavailable" }, { status: 502 })
  }
  const data = await response.json() as { articles?: EspnArticle[] }
  const articles = (data.articles ?? [])
    .filter((article) => !player || `${article.headline ?? ""} ${article.description ?? ""}`.toLowerCase().includes(player))
    .map((article) => ({
      id: String(article.id),
      headline: article.headline ?? "NHL update",
      description: article.description ?? "",
      published: article.published ?? null,
      url: article.links?.web?.href ?? null,
    }))
  return NextResponse.json({ source: "ESPN", articles })
}

<file path="app/api/roster/week/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { getManagerSession } from "@/lib/auth-session"
import { weekLineupForLeague } from "@/lib/services/week-lineups"

export const runtime = "nodejs"

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication required" }, { status: 401 })
  const week = Number(request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("week"))
  if (!Number.isInteger(week) || week < 1) return NextResponse.json({ error: "week is required" }, { status: 400 })
  const team = await prisma.team.findUnique({ where: { id: session.teamId }, select: { leagueId: true, league: { select: { currentSeason: true } } } })
  if (!team) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Team not found" }, { status: 404 })
  const lineup = await weekLineupForLeague(team.leagueId, team.league.currentSeason, week)
  return NextResponse.json(lineup)
}

<file path="e2e/09-mobile-layout.spec.ts">
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test"

const TABS = ["TEAM", "MATCH", "PLAYERS", "LEAGUE"] as const

test.describe("mobile layout and stability", () => {
  for (const tab of TABS) {
    test(`${tab} tab: fits 430px, no horizontal scroll, no console errors`, async ({ page }) => {
      const errors: string[] = []
      page.on("pageerror", (error) => errors.push(error.message))
      page.on("console", (message) => { if (message.type() === "error" && !/favicon|Failed to load resource/.test(message.text())) errors.push(message.text()) })

      await page.goto("/")
      const button = page.getByRole("button", { name: tab, exact: true })
      if (await button.count()) await button.click()
      await page.waitForTimeout(400)

      const metrics = await page.evaluate(() => ({
        scrollWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,
        clientWidth: document.documentElement.clientWidth,
        bodyScroll: document.body.scrollWidth,
      }))
      expect(metrics.scrollWidth).toBeLessThanOrEqual(metrics.clientWidth + 1)
      expect(metrics.bodyScroll).toBeLessThanOrEqual(430 + 1)
      expect(errors).toEqual([])
    })
  }

  test("the app shell is capped at 430px wide even on a desktop viewport", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 900 })
    await page.goto("/")
    const widest = await page.evaluate(() => Math.max(...Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("main, [class*='max-w-[430px]']")).map((el) => el.getBoundingClientRect().width)))
    expect(widest).toBeLessThanOrEqual(431)
  })

  test("the schedule API returns the real current week's games with dates inside that week", async ({ request }) => {
    const response = await request.get("/api/schedule")
    expect(response.status()).toBe(200)
    const body = await response.json()
    const games = (body.games ?? body.schedule ?? []) as Array<{ date?: string; gameDate?: string }>
    expect(games.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
  })

  test("the schedule API accepts an explicit past week", async ({ request }) => {
    const response = await request.get("/api/schedule?week=2")
    expect(response.status()).toBe(200)
  })
})

<file path="lib/db/picks.ts">
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"

export async function getTeamDraftPickInventory(teamId: string) {
  const [owned, tradedAway] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.draftPick.findMany({
      where: { currentTeamId: teamId },
      orderBy: [{ season: "asc" }, { round: "asc" }],
      include: { originalTeam: { select: { id: true, name: true } } },
    }),
    prisma.draftPick.findMany({
      where: { originalTeamId: teamId, NOT: { currentTeamId: teamId } },
      orderBy: [{ season: "asc" }, { round: "asc" }],
      include: { currentTeam: { select: { id: true, name: true } } },
    }),
  ])
  return { owned, tradedAway }
}

export async function getLeagueDraftPicks(leagueId: string, season?: number) {
  return prisma.draftPick.findMany({
    where: { leagueId, ...(season === undefined ? {} : { season }) },
    include: {
      originalTeam: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
      currentTeam: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
    },
    orderBy: [{ season: "asc" }, { round: "asc" }],
  })
}

<file path="lib/lineup-lock.ts">
export type LineupLockMode = "WEEKLY" | "DAILY"

export const LINEUP_LOCK_MODES: readonly LineupLockMode[] = ["WEEKLY", "DAILY"]
export const STARTER_SLOTS = ["C", "W", "F", "D", "G"] as const

export function normalizeLockMode(value: unknown): LineupLockMode {
  return value === "DAILY" ? "DAILY" : "WEEKLY"
}

export function isStarterSlot(slot: string): boolean {
  return (STARTER_SLOTS as readonly string[]).includes(slot)
}

export interface LockContext {
  mode: LineupLockMode
  /** WEEKLY: the first NHL game of the current fantasy week has started. */
  weekStarted: boolean
  /** DAILY: NHL team abbreviations whose game today has already started. */
  startedTeams: ReadonlySet<string>
}

/**
 * WEEKLY: starters (C/W/F/D/G) are frozen from the first puck drop of the fantasy week until the week rolls over.
 *         Bench, IR and taxi stay movable.
 * DAILY:  a player is frozen while his own team's game today has started (any slot).
 */
export function isSlotLocked(ctx: LockContext, slot: string, teamAbbrev: string): boolean {
  if (ctx.mode === "WEEKLY") return ctx.weekStarted && isStarterSlot(slot)
  return ctx.startedTeams.has(teamAbbrev)
}

/** First game of the week has started, given every game's start time in the week. */
export function hasWeekStarted(gameStartTimes: Date[], now: Date = new Date()): boolean {
  return gameStartTimes.some((start) => start.getTime() <= now.getTime())
}

<file path="lib/matchup-scoring.ts">
import { scoreGameStat, type LeagueScoring, type RawGameStat } from "@/lib/scoring"
import { isStarterSlot } from "@/lib/lineup-lock"

export interface ScoringSlot { teamId: string; playerId: number; slot: string }
export interface ScoringStat extends RawGameStat { playerId: number }

/** Sums league-scored game stats for starters only (bench, taxi and IR never score). */
export function scoreTeams(slots: ScoringSlot[], stats: ScoringStat[], scoring: LeagueScoring | null | undefined): Map<string, number> {
  const teamByPlayer = new Map<number, string>()
  for (const slot of slots) if (isStarterSlot(slot.slot)) teamByPlayer.set(slot.playerId, slot.teamId)
  const totals = new Map<string, number>()
  for (const stat of stats) {
    const teamId = teamByPlayer.get(stat.playerId)
    if (!teamId) continue
    totals.set(teamId, (totals.get(teamId) ?? 0) + scoreGameStat(stat, scoring))
  }
  for (const [teamId, total] of totals) totals.set(teamId, Math.round(total * 100) / 100)
  return totals
}

/** A week is final once it has ended in US/Eastern and every NHL game in it is finished. */
export function isWeekFinal(endDate: string, today: string, gameStates: string[]): boolean {
  if (gameStates.length === 0 || endDate >= today) return false
  return gameStates.every((state) => state === "FINAL" || state === "OFF")
}

<file path="lib/roster-eligibility.ts">
/** Position groups that may occupy a starting slot. Bench, taxi, and IR are not position-gated. */
const STARTER_ELIGIBILITY: Record<string, readonly string[]> = {
  C: ["C"],
  W: ["LW", "RW"],
  F: ["C", "LW", "RW"],
  D: ["D"],
  G: ["G"],
}

export const DEFAULT_BENCH_CAPACITY = 7

export function positionFitsSlot(slot: string, position: string): boolean {
  const allowed = STARTER_ELIGIBILITY[slot]
  return !allowed || allowed.includes(position)
}

/**
 * Where the player leaving a full slot should land.
 * They take the vacated slot only when their position can play it.
 * Otherwise they go to the bench when there is room.
 * A full bench and an illegal vacated slot means the swap is not allowed.
 */
export function displacedLandingSlot(vacatedSlot: string, position: string, benchHasRoom: boolean): string | null {
  if (positionFitsSlot(vacatedSlot, position)) return vacatedSlot
  if (benchHasRoom && vacatedSlot !== "BN") return "BN"
  return null
}

<file path="lib/standings.ts">
export interface StandingMatchup {
  week: number
  homeTeamId: string
  awayTeamId: string
  homeScore: { toString(): string } | number | null
  awayScore: { toString(): string } | number | null
  isFinal: boolean
}

export interface StandingRecord {
  teamId: string
  wins: number
  losses: number
  ties: number
  pointsFor: number
  pointsAgainst: number
  streak: string | null
}

/** A matchup counts toward standings once it is final (or an earlier week that already has recorded scores). */
export function isCompletedMatchup(matchup: StandingMatchup, currentWeek: number): boolean {
  if (matchup.homeScore === null || matchup.awayScore === null) return false
  return matchup.isFinal || matchup.week < currentWeek
}

export function computeStandings(teamIds: string[], matchups: StandingMatchup[], currentWeek: number): StandingRecord[] {
  const completed = matchups
    .filter((matchup) => isCompletedMatchup(matchup, currentWeek))
    .sort((a, b) => b.week - a.week)

  const records = teamIds.map((teamId) => {
    let wins = 0, losses = 0, ties = 0, pointsFor = 0, pointsAgainst = 0
    const results: Array<"W" | "L" | "T"> = []
    for (const matchup of completed) {
      if (matchup.homeTeamId !== teamId && matchup.awayTeamId !== teamId) continue
      const home = matchup.homeTeamId === teamId
      const score = Number(home ? matchup.homeScore : matchup.awayScore)
      const opponent = Number(home ? matchup.awayScore : matchup.homeScore)
      pointsFor += score
      pointsAgainst += opponent
      const result = score > opponent ? "W" : score < opponent ? "L" : "T"
      if (result === "W") wins += 1
      else if (result === "L") losses += 1
      else ties += 1
      results.push(result)
    }
    const latest = results[0]
    let count = 0
    while (latest && results[count] === latest) count += 1
    return {
      teamId, wins, losses, ties,
      pointsFor: Math.round(pointsFor * 100) / 100,
      pointsAgainst: Math.round(pointsAgainst * 100) / 100,
      streak: latest ? `${count}${latest}` : null,
    }
  })

  return records.sort((a, b) => b.wins - a.wins || a.losses - b.losses || b.pointsFor - a.pointsFor)
}

<file path="lib/use-stable-callback.ts">
import { useCallback, useLayoutEffect, useRef } from "react"

/**
 * Returns a function with a permanently stable identity that always invokes the latest `callback`.
 * Lets large parents hand handlers to `React.memo` children without re-rendering them every render.
 */
export function useStableCallback<Args extends unknown[], Result>(callback: (...args: Args) => Result): (...args: Args) => Result {
  const ref = useRef(callback)
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    ref.current = callback
  })
  return useCallback((...args: Args) => ref.current(...args), [])
}

<file path="lib/waiver-run.ts">
import { getCurrentFantasyWeek, getEasternDate, getFantasyWeekDates, getFantasyWeekForDate } from "@/lib/season-calendar"
import { isWeekFinal } from "@/lib/matchup-scoring"

const EASTERN = "America/New_York"

export const WAIVER_RESOLUTIONS = {
  WON: "WON",
  OUTBID: "OUTBID",
  INSUFFICIENT_FAAB: "INSUFFICIENT_FAAB",
  ROSTER_FULL: "ROSTER_FULL",
  ALREADY_ROSTERED: "ALREADY_ROSTERED",
  DROP_MISSING: "DROP_MISSING",
} as const

/** Monday 00:00 America/New_York on the calendar day after this week's Sunday. */
export function mondayMidnightAfter(weekEndDate: string): Date {
  const [year, month, day] = weekEndDate.split("-").map(Number)
  const next = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day + 1))
  const monday = `${next.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(next.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(next.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`
  return easternMidnight(monday)
}

/** When a claim submitted at `now` will be processed: the Monday midnight that ends the current fantasy week. */
export function nextWaiverProcessAt(season: number, now: Date = new Date()): Date {
  const week = getCurrentFantasyWeek(season, now)
  return mondayMidnightAfter(getFantasyWeekDates(week, season).endDate)
}

/**
 * The Monday midnight that should clear this claim, and the fantasy week whose games must be final.
 * New claims store that Monday midnight. Older claims stored the moment they were submitted.
 */
export function runInstantForProcessDate(season: number, processDate: Date): { week: number; runAt: Date } {
  const containing = getFantasyWeekForDate(getEasternDate(processDate), season)
  const opened = easternMidnight(getFantasyWeekDates(containing, season).startDate)
  const closesPreviousWeek = Math.abs(processDate.getTime() - opened.getTime()) < 5 * 60 * 1000
  const week = closesPreviousWeek ? containing - 1 : containing
  const { endDate } = getFantasyWeekDates(Math.max(week, 1), season)
  return { week, runAt: mondayMidnightAfter(endDate) }
}

/** Midnight for `week` has passed, and every NHL game that week is finished. An empty schedule waits. */
export function waiverRunReadyForWeek(season: number, week: number, gameStates: string[], now: Date = new Date()): { ready: true; week: number } | { ready: false; reason: string } {
  if (week < 1) return { ready: false, reason: "Waivers run Monday at midnight, after the final game of the week." }
  const { endDate } = getFantasyWeekDates(week, season)
  if (now.getTime() < mondayMidnightAfter(endDate).getTime()) {
    return { ready: false, reason: "Waivers run Monday at midnight, after the final game of the week." }
  }
  if (!isWeekFinal(endDate, getEasternDate(now), gameStates)) {
    return { ready: false, reason: "Waiting for the final game of the week." }
  }
  return { ready: true, week }
}

/** Start of the current fantasy week, which is also the instant the previous week's waivers were due. */
export function currentWeekOpenedAt(season: number, now: Date = new Date()): Date {
  const { startDate } = getFantasyWeekDates(getCurrentFantasyWeek(season, now), season)
  return easternMidnight(startDate)
}

export function waiverOutcomeLabel(status: string, resolution?: string | null): string | null {
  if (resolution === WAIVER_RESOLUTIONS.WON || status === "SUCCESSFUL" || status === "won") return "Won"
  switch (resolution) {
    case WAIVER_RESOLUTIONS.OUTBID:
      return "Outbid"
    case WAIVER_RESOLUTIONS.INSUFFICIENT_FAAB:
      return "Not enough FAAB"
    case WAIVER_RESOLUTIONS.ROSTER_FULL:
      return "No open roster spot"
    case WAIVER_RESOLUTIONS.ALREADY_ROSTERED:
      return "Already rostered"
    case WAIVER_RESOLUTIONS.DROP_MISSING:
      return "Drop is no longer on your roster"
    default:
      return status === "FAILED" || status === "failed" ? "Not awarded" : null
  }
}

function easternOffsetMs(instant: Date): number {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
    timeZone: EASTERN,
    hourCycle: "h23",
    year: "numeric",
    month: "2-digit",
    day: "2-digit",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    second: "2-digit",
  }).formatToParts(instant)
  const value = (type: string) => Number(parts.find((part) => part.type === type)?.value)
  const asUtc = Date.UTC(value("year"), value("month") - 1, value("day"), value("hour") % 24, value("minute"), value("second"))
  return asUtc - instant.getTime()
}

function easternMidnight(date: string): Date {
  const [year, month, day] = date.split("-").map(Number)
  const utcGuess = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, 0, 0, 0))
  const first = new Date(utcGuess.getTime() - easternOffsetMs(utcGuess))
  return new Date(utcGuess.getTime() - easternOffsetMs(first))
}

import assert from "node:assert/strict"
import { buildPlayoffBracket, type PlayoffResult } from "../lib/playoff-bracket"

const teams = ["One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "Six", "Seven"]
const standings = teams.map((team) => ({ team }))

function game(week: number, homeTeam: string, awayTeam: string, homeScore: number, awayScore: number, isFinal: boolean): PlayoffResult {
  return { week, homeTeam, awayTeam, homeScore, awayScore, isFinal }
}

const projected = buildPlayoffBracket({ standings, results: [], currentWeek: 3 })
assert.equal(projected.live, false)
assert.equal(projected.rounds[0].games[0].status, "Bye")
assert.equal(projected.rounds[0].games[0].home.label, "#1 One")
assert.equal(projected.rounds[0].games[2].home.label, "#3 Three")
assert.equal(projected.rounds[0].games[2].away?.label, "#6 Six")
assert.equal(projected.rounds[0].games[2].home.points, null)
assert.equal(projected.rounds[1].games[0].away?.label, "Winner of #4 vs #5")
assert.equal(projected.rounds[2].games[0].home.label, "Winner of semifinals")

const live = buildPlayoffBracket({
  standings,
  currentWeek: 15,
  results: [
    game(15, "Three", "Other", 10, 4, false),
    game(15, "Six", "Another", 12, 3, false),
  ],
})
assert.equal(live.live, true)
assert.equal(live.rounds[0].games[2].status, "Live")
assert.equal(live.rounds[0].games[2].home.points, 10)
assert.equal(live.rounds[0].games[2].away?.points, 12)
assert.equal(live.rounds[0].games[2].home.winner, false)

const decided = buildPlayoffBracket({
  standings,
  currentWeek: 16,
  results: [
    game(15, "Three", "Other", 10, 1, true),
    game(15, "Six", "Another", 14, 2, true),
    game(15, "Four", "X", 9, 1, true),
    game(15, "Five", "Y", 8, 1, true),
    game(16, "Two", "Z", 20, 1, true),
    game(16, "Six", "Q", 11, 1, true),
  ],
})
const firstLow = decided.rounds[0].games[2]
assert.equal(firstLow.status, "Final")
assert.equal(firstLow.away?.winner, true)
assert.equal(firstLow.away?.team, "Six")
const semiTwo = decided.rounds[1].games[1]
assert.equal(semiTwo.home.team, "Two")
assert.equal(semiTwo.away?.team, "Six")
assert.equal(semiTwo.status, "Final")
assert.equal(semiTwo.home.winner, true)

const tied = buildPlayoffBracket({
  standings,
  currentWeek: 15,
  results: [game(15, "Four", "A", 7, 0, true), game(15, "Five", "B", 7, 0, true)],
})
assert.equal(tied.rounds[0].games[3].home.winner, true)
assert.equal(tied.rounds[0].games[3].home.team, "Four")

# John Scott Dynasty Hockey - Cursor Rules

## Architecture & Stack
- Framework: Next.js (App Router, Node.js runtime)
- Database & ORM: PostgreSQL (Neon) via Prisma
- Package Manager: npm (Never install or reference pnpm or yarn)
- UI: Tailwind CSS, Radix/Base UI, Lucide icons, Dark Sleeper theme
- Mobile Constraint: All dashboard views are restricted to max-w-[430px] with h-dvh layout.

## Code Conventions
- React Components: Functional components with TypeScript. Use "use client" only when client state/effects are required.
- Prisma Usage: Always import `{ prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"`. Never instantiate `new PrismaClient()` in routes.
- Authentication: Handled via HTTP-only cookie `dynasty_manager` containing `{ managerId, teamId, handle, teamName, isCommissioner }`.
- API Routes: Always return typed `NextResponse.json(...)` with explicit HTTP status codes.

## Dynasty Hockey Domain Rules
- Matchup Weeks: Weekly schedules run Monday to Sunday. Unplayed games must show actual score `0.0`, never falling back to weekly projected totals.
- Roster Integrity: Active starting slots are C, W, F, D, G. Taxi squad threshold is < 50 GP. IR is pure IR (DTD/IR+ ineligible).
- Waivers: FAAB bids deduct from team faabBalance. Drops are optional only if team has open bench spots (< 27 roster capacity).

## Testing & Verification
- Test Suite: Playwright E2E in `e2e/`. Tests run against authenticated manager storage state in `e2e/.auth/manager.json`.
- Before suggesting completed tasks, verify code compiles with `npx tsc --noEmit`.

# John Scott Dynasty – Audit Report

## Final status
| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `npx tsc --noEmit` | Pass |
| `npm run build` | Pass |
| `npx playwright test` | 17 / 17 pass (7 regression tests in `e2e/05-audit-regressions.spec.ts`) |

## Issues found and fixed

### Matchups
- **Projections shown as actuals** (away D showed 29.4 instead of 0.0). Actual and projected points are now separate: `getWeekActualPoints` returns 0 for unplayed games / other weeks, `getWeekProjectedPoints` is only used for projection labels. `PlayerSchedule` is now week-tagged.
- **Upcoming weeks** reset to 0.00 vs 0.00.
- **Away player cards** now open the profile (looked up in `allDynastyPlayers`).
- Files: `lib/hockey-data.ts`, `components/hockey/matchup-panel.tsx`, `app/dashboard-client.tsx`.

### Commissioner / auth
- `isCommissioner` is decoded the same way in `app/api/auth/session/route.ts` and `lib/auth-session.ts` (DB is source of truth).
- `@commissioner` / Montreal Monarchs seeded as commissioner (`prisma/seed.ts`).
- Saving league settings (`PATCH /api/admin/league-settings`) refreshes client state (`commissioner-settings-dialog.tsx`, `dashboard-client.tsx`).

### Waivers
- Claims without a drop are allowed when the roster is under 27 (`lib/services/transactions.ts`, `waiver-claim-dialog.tsx`, `lib/db/rosters.ts`).
- Waiver dialog now receives `teamId`, so claims persist to the DB.

### Teams
- Ghost teams (Edmonton Ember, Minnesota Northstars) removed; the 12 canonical handles are shared by Standings, Matchups, Trade Builder and DMs (`lib/hockey-data.ts`, `lib/dashboard-data.ts`, `trade partners` in `dashboard-client.tsx`).
- Duplicate React keys in the league feed fixed (`league-feed.tsx`).

### Performance
- Player list is fetched once; types deduped.
- `React.memo` / `useMemo` / `useCallback` on `PlayerItem`, `PlayersMarketView`, `MatchupPanel`, derived roster lists; new `lib/use-stable-callback.ts`.

### UI
- Gear icon opens the unified settings drawer with Switch Team / Log Out.
- Chat bar docks to the safe area.
- Market filters: F = C/LW/RW/W, W = wingers only, G swaps sort controls to W, SV, SV%, GAA, SO; roster-owned players excluded from Free Agents.

## Side effect of my test runs (repaired)
Enabling waiver persistence meant the e2e waiver test wrote real claims to the shared Neon DB, and the `/api/cron/waivers` e2e test then processed them. Over 4 runs this swapped Matthews and MacKinnon out of Montreal Monarchs for Nikishin and Pietrangelo and spent 4 FAAB.
Repair (limited to those records): re-added Matthews and MacKinnon (slot C), removed the two pickups, FAAB back to 100, Montreal back to waiver priority 1 (others shifted +1), deleted the 4 test claims and their 8 activity-log rows.
Caveat: lineup swaps from earlier e2e runs may have rearranged slots (e.g. a D in a G slot); I could not know the original arrangement.
Prevention: the waiver and lineup-swap e2e tests now mock `/api/waivers` and `/api/roster/move`.

## Lineup moves reverting after a rules change
Symptom: a move to IR looked successful, then reverted after saving commissioner rules (which reloads the page).
Root causes:
1. **Permanent roster locks.** `enforceRosterLocks` in `lib/services/nhl-sync.ts` locked every player whose team had *ever* started a game and never unlocked them. After a sync, 200 of 202 slots were locked, so the server rejected every move with "slot is locked". Locks are now daily: only players whose team's game today (US/Eastern) has started are locked, and the rest are released. The 200 stale locks were cleared.
2. **Errors were swallowed.** The client updated the UI optimistically and only logged network errors, so an HTTP 400 never rolled the move back. It now rolls back and shows the server's message.
3. **The swap logic was wrong.** With a full target slot (IR holds 1) the server benched the mover instead of placing them in the slot, so the move did nothing. It now swaps the two players properly and validates both: pure IR, taxi GP cap and position eligibility. The client sends the exact swap target.
4. `/api/roster/move` now requires a session and only allows editing your own team. The IR dialog only offers IR to players whose status is IR.

New e2e tests: an injured player swaps into a full IR slot, persists and is reverted; a healthy player is rejected from IR. Playwright 20 / 20.
## Round 4: NHL week sync, retroactive scoring, weekly lock, test suite

- **Calendar**: weeks are Monday to Sunday; week 1 of 2026-27 starts Mon 2026-09-28, so Mon 2026-10-12 is week 3 (lib/season-calendar.ts). League.currentWeek is now updated by the sync from the calendar and can no longer be hand-set.
- **Root cause of wrong schedule data**: the sync stored every game of a schedule request under the requested date, so a whole week sat on one day. Games now use their real date.
- **Retroactive scoring**: /api/cron/sync rescans weeks 1..current from NHL boxscores (?backfill=1 pulls the whole season), scores starters only with the league's scoring rules, and marks weeks final once the week is over and every NHL game is finished. Editing scoring in the rulebook re-prices all stat lines and rebuilds every matchup.
- **Standings** now come from final matchups (lib/standings.ts), including ties and streaks. The league feed no longer overwrites season points with the current week's score.
- **Weekly lineup lock** (default) plus a Daily option: new League.lineupLockMode, editable in Commissioner settings, Roster tab. Locks are computed live from the schedule at move time. Injured (IR status) starters can still be moved to IR.
- **Data repaired**: Montreal's taxi players over the 50 GP cap (Celebrini, Power) moved to bench; other teams' starters sitting in slots they cannot play (goalies in D, centers in W, etc.) were re-slotted by position and season points.
- **Tests**: 81 total (80 pass, 1 conditional skip). New specs: 06 rules engine (calendar, scoring, standings, locks), 07 data integrity and retroactive scores, 08 weekly lock and week sync, 09 mobile layout.

<file path="app/api/admin/roles/route.ts">
import { NextResponse } from "next/server"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { getManagerSession } from "@/lib/auth-session"

async function requireCommissioner() {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  if (!session?.isCommissioner) return null
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: session.managerId }, select: { isCommissioner: true } })
  return user?.isCommissioner ? session : null
}

export async function GET() {
  const session = await requireCommissioner()
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 })
  const team = await prisma.team.findUnique({ where: { id: session.teamId }, select: { leagueId: true } })
  if (!team) return NextResponse.json({ error: "League not found." }, { status: 404 })
  const managers = await prisma.user.findMany({
    where: { managedTeams: { some: { leagueId: team.leagueId } } },
    select: { id: true, name: true, handle: true, isCommissioner: true },
    orderBy: { handle: "asc" },
  })
  return NextResponse.json({ managers })
}

export async function PATCH(request: Request) {
  const session = await requireCommissioner()
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 })
  const body = await request.json().catch(() => null) as { targetManagerId?: unknown; isCommissioner?: unknown } | null
  if (typeof body?.targetManagerId !== "string" || typeof body.isCommissioner !== "boolean") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "targetManagerId and isCommissioner are required." }, { status: 400 })
  }
  if (body.targetManagerId === session.managerId && !body.isCommissioner) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "You cannot remove your own commissioner role." }, { status: 400 })
  }
  const team = await prisma.team.findUnique({ where: { id: session.teamId }, select: { leagueId: true } })
  const target = team
    ? await prisma.user.findFirst({
        where: { id: body.targetManagerId, managedTeams: { some: { leagueId: team.leagueId } } },
        select: { id: true },
      })
    : null
  if (!target) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Manager not found in this league." }, { status: 404 })
  await prisma.user.update({
    where: { id: body.targetManagerId },
    data: { isCommissioner: body.isCommissioner },
  })
  return NextResponse.json({ success: true })
}

<file path="app/api/chat/route.ts">
import { NextResponse } from "next/server"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { getManagerSession } from "@/lib/auth-session"

function formatMessage(message: { id: string; body: string; createdAt: Date; sender: { name: string; handle: string; managedTeams: { name: string }[] } }) {
  const teamName = message.sender.managedTeams[0]?.name ?? ""
  return { id: message.id, author: message.sender.name, avatarInitials: message.sender.name.split(/\s+/).map((part) => part[0]).join("").slice(0, 2).toUpperCase(), message: message.body, time: new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", timeZone: "America/New_York" }).format(message.createdAt), teamName, teamAbbreviation: teamName.slice(0, 3).toUpperCase() }
}

const senderSelect = { name: true, handle: true, managedTeams: { select: { name: true }, take: 1 } } as const

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  const leagueId = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get("leagueId")
  const team = session ? await prisma.team.findFirst({ where: { id: session.teamId, managerId: session.managerId } }) : null
  const targetLeagueId = leagueId ?? team?.leagueId
  if (!targetLeagueId || !team || (leagueId !== null && leagueId !== team.leagueId)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication required for this league." }, { status: 401 })
  const messages = await prisma.leagueMessage.findMany({ where: { leagueId: targetLeagueId }, orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }, take: 50, include: { sender: { select: senderSelect } } })
  return NextResponse.json(messages.reverse().map(formatMessage))
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  const body = await request.json().catch(() => null) as { leagueId?: unknown; body?: unknown } | null
  if (!session || typeof body?.leagueId !== "string" || typeof body.body !== "string" || !body.body.trim()) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication and message body are required." }, { status: 400 })
  const member = await prisma.team.findFirst({ where: { leagueId: body.leagueId, id: session.teamId, managerId: session.managerId } })
  if (!member) return NextResponse.json({ error: "You are not a member of this league." }, { status: 403 })
  const message = await prisma.leagueMessage.create({ data: { leagueId: body.leagueId, senderId: session.managerId, body: body.body.trim() }, include: { sender: { select: senderSelect } } })
  return NextResponse.json(formatMessage(message))
}

<file path="app/api/team-stats/route.ts">
import { NextResponse } from "next/server"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"

type Standing = {
  teamName?: { default?: string }
  teamAbbrev?: { default?: string }
  gamesPlayed?: number
  goalFor?: number
  goalAgainst?: number
  wins?: number
  losses?: number
  otLosses?: number
  points?: number
  pointPctg?: number
}

type TeamSummary = {
  teamFullName?: string
  goalsForPerGame?: number
  goalsAgainstPerGame?: number
  powerPlayPct?: number
  penaltyKillPct?: number
}

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const team = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get("team")?.toUpperCase()
  if (!team) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Team abbreviation is required" }, { status: 400 })
  const league = await prisma.league.findFirst({ select: { currentSeason: true }, orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" } })
  const season = league?.currentSeason ?? 2026
  const seasonId = `${season}${season + 1}`
  const [standingsResponse, statsResponse] = await Promise.all([
    fetch("https://api-web.nhle.com/v1/standings/now", {
      headers: { Accept: "application/json", "User-Agent": "JohnScottDynasty/1.0" },
      next: { revalidate: 300 },
    }),
    fetch(`https://api.nhle.com/stats/rest/en/team/summary?isAggregate=false&isGame=false&start=0&limit=100&cayenneExp=seasonId=${seasonId}`, {
      headers: { Accept: "application/json", "User-Agent": "JohnScottDynasty/1.0" },
      next: { revalidate: 300 },
    }),
  ])
  if (!standingsResponse.ok || !statsResponse.ok) return NextResponse.json({ error: "NHL team statistics unavailable" }, { status: 502 })
  const data = await standingsResponse.json() as { standings?: Standing[] }
  const statsData = await statsResponse.json() as { data?: TeamSummary[] }
  const standings = data.standings ?? []
  const teamSummary = statsData.data ?? []
  const normalizeTeamName = (value: string | undefined) => (value ?? "").normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase()
  const ranked = standings.map((entry) => {
    const summary = teamSummary.find((candidate) => normalizeTeamName(candidate.teamFullName) === normalizeTeamName(entry.teamName?.default))
    return {
      ...entry,
      abbreviation: entry.teamAbbrev?.default ?? "",
      goalsForPerGame: summary?.goalsForPerGame ?? (entry.goalFor ?? 0) / Math.max(1, entry.gamesPlayed ?? 0),
      goalsAgainstPerGame: summary?.goalsAgainstPerGame ?? (entry.goalAgainst ?? 0) / Math.max(1, entry.gamesPlayed ?? 0),
      powerPlayPct: summary?.powerPlayPct ?? null,
      penaltyKillPct: summary?.penaltyKillPct ?? null,
    }
  })
  const current = ranked.find((entry) => entry.abbreviation === team)
  if (!current) return NextResponse.json({ error: `Team ${team} not found` }, { status: 404 })
  const offenseRank = [...ranked].sort((a, b) => b.goalsForPerGame - a.goalsForPerGame).findIndex((entry) => entry.abbreviation === team) + 1
  const defenseRank = [...ranked].sort((a, b) => a.goalsAgainstPerGame - b.goalsAgainstPerGame).findIndex((entry) => entry.abbreviation === team) + 1
  return NextResponse.json({
    source: "NHL standings",
    team,
    record: `${current.wins ?? 0}-${current.losses ?? 0}-${current.otLosses ?? 0}`,
    points: current.points ?? 0,
    pointPct: current.pointPctg ?? 0,
    goalsForPerGame: Number(current.goalsForPerGame.toFixed(2)),
    goalsAgainstPerGame: Number(current.goalsAgainstPerGame.toFixed(2)),
    offenseRank,
    defenseRank,
    powerPlay: current.powerPlayPct == null ? null : Number((current.powerPlayPct * 100).toFixed(1)),
    penaltyKill: current.penaltyKillPct == null ? null : Number((current.penaltyKillPct * 100).toFixed(1)),
  })
}

<file path="app/api/teams/settings/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { getManagerSession } from "@/lib/auth-session"

type TeamSettingsBody = {
  teamId?: unknown
  name?: unknown
  logoUrl?: unknown
}

export async function PATCH(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication required" }, { status: 401 })
  try {
    const body = await request.json() as TeamSettingsBody
    if (typeof body.teamId !== "string" || !body.teamId.trim()) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "teamId is required" }, { status: 400 })
    }
    if (typeof body.name !== "string" || !body.name.trim()) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Team name is required" }, { status: 400 })
    }
    if (body.logoUrl !== undefined && typeof body.logoUrl !== "string") {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "logoUrl must be a string" }, { status: 400 })
    }
    if (body.teamId !== session.teamId && !session.isCommissioner) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 })
    }

    const team = await prisma.team.update({
      where: { id: body.teamId },
      data: {
        name: body.name.trim(),
        logoUrl: typeof body.logoUrl === "string" && body.logoUrl.trim() ? body.logoUrl.trim() : null,
      },
      select: { id: true, name: true, logoUrl: true },
    })
    return NextResponse.json(team)
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    console.error("Could not update team settings", error)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Could not update team settings" }, { status: 500 })
  }
}

<file path="app/api/waivers/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server"
import { ClaimStatus } from "@prisma/client"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { getManagerSession } from "@/lib/auth-session"
import { submitWaiverClaim } from "@/lib/services/transactions"
import { currentWeekOpenedAt, waiverOutcomeLabel } from "@/lib/waiver-run"

export const runtime = "nodejs"

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication required" }, { status: 401 })
  const teamId = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("teamId") ?? session.teamId
  if (teamId !== session.teamId) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 })
  const team = await prisma.team.findUnique({ where: { id: teamId }, select: { league: { select: { currentSeason: true } } } })
  const openedAt = currentWeekOpenedAt(team?.league.currentSeason ?? 2026)
  const claims = await prisma.waiverClaim.findMany({
    where: {
      teamId,
      OR: [
        { status: ClaimStatus.PENDING },
        { status: { in: [ClaimStatus.SUCCESSFUL, ClaimStatus.FAILED] }, processDate: { gte: openedAt } },
      ],
    },
    include: { playerToAdd: { select: { name: true } }, playerToDrop: { select: { name: true } } },
    orderBy: [{ status: "asc" }, { processDate: "asc" }, { bidAmount: "desc" }],
  })
  const presented = claims.map((claim) => ({
    id: claim.id,
    bidAmount: claim.bidAmount,
    status: claim.status === ClaimStatus.SUCCESSFUL ? "won" as const : claim.status === ClaimStatus.FAILED ? "failed" as const : "pending" as const,
    outcome: waiverOutcomeLabel(claim.status, claim.resolution),
    processDate: claim.processDate.toISOString(),
    playerToAdd: claim.playerToAdd,
    playerToDrop: claim.playerToDrop,
  }))
  const rank = { pending: 0, won: 1, failed: 2 }
  presented.sort((left, right) => rank[left.status] - rank[right.status])
  return NextResponse.json({ claims: presented })
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication required" }, { status: 401 })
  try {
    const body = await request.json() as { teamId?: string; playerToAddId?: number; playerToDropId?: number | null; bidAmount?: number }
    if (!body.teamId || !Number.isInteger(body.playerToAddId) || !Number.isInteger(body.bidAmount)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "teamId, playerToAddId, and bidAmount are required" }, { status: 400 })
    if (body.teamId !== session.teamId) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 })
    const claim = await submitWaiverClaim({
      teamId: body.teamId,
      playerToAddId: body.playerToAddId as number,
      playerToDropId: body.playerToDropId ?? null,
      bidAmount: body.bidAmount as number,
    })
    return NextResponse.json({ claim }, { status: 201 })
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    console.error("Waiver claim submission failed", error)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Waiver claim submission failed" }, { status: 400 })
  }
}

export async function DELETE(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication required" }, { status: 401 })
  try {
    const body = await request.json() as { claimId?: string; teamId?: string }
    if (!body.claimId || !body.teamId) return NextResponse.json({ error: "claimId and teamId are required" }, { status: 400 })
    if (body.teamId !== session.teamId) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 })
    const result = await prisma.waiverClaim.updateMany({ where: { id: body.claimId, teamId: body.teamId, status: ClaimStatus.PENDING }, data: { status: ClaimStatus.CANCELLED } })
    if (result.count !== 1) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Pending waiver claim not found" }, { status: 404 })
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true })
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    console.error("Waiver cancellation failed", error)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Waiver cancellation failed" }, { status: 400 })
  }
}

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Avatar as AvatarPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/avatar"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

function Avatar({
  className,
  size = "default",
  ...props

<file path="e2e/01-navigation-and-tabs.spec.ts">
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test"

function installRuntimeErrorGuard(page: Page) {
  const errors: string[] = []
  page.on("pageerror", (error) => errors.push(error.message))
  page.on("console", (message) => {
    if (message.type() === "error") errors.push(message.text())
  })
  return errors
}

test("dashboard loads and all primary tabs render without runtime errors", async ({ page }) => {
  const errors = installRuntimeErrorGuard(page)
  await page.goto("/")
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "JOHN SCOTT DYNASTY" })).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByText("Montreal Monarchs", { exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible()

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "MATCH", exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page.getByText("Starters", { exact: false }).first()).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByText("vs", { exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByText(/proj \d+\.\d/).first()).toBeVisible()

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "PLAYERS", exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Available", exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Filters", exact: true }).click()
  for (const label of ["ALL", "C", "W", "D", "G"]) {
    await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: label, exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible()
  }
  await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Available", exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.locator("button").filter({ hasText: "FA" }).first()).toBeVisible()

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "LEAGUE", exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Matchups", exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Standings", exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Activity", exact: true })).toBeVisible()

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "TEAM", exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page.getByText(/Starters \(/).first()).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByText(/Bench \(/).first()).toBeVisible()
  expect(errors, errors.join("\n")).toEqual([])
})

import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test"

test("schedule API returns the expected shape", async ({ request }) => {
  const response = await request.get("/api/schedule")
  expect(response.status()).toBe(200)
  const body = await response.json()
  expect(body).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({
    date: expect.any(String),
    games: expect.any(Array),
    weekGames: expect.any(Array),
    playerGameLogs: expect.any(Object),
  }))
})

test("players API returns players", async ({ request }) => {
  const response = await request.get("/api/players")
  expect(response.status()).toBe(200)
  const body = await response.json()
  expect(Array.isArray(body)).toBe(true)
  expect(body.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
})

test("/api/cron/sync accepts the configured query secret", async ({ request }) => {
  test.setTimeout(120_000)
  const response = await request.get("/api/cron/sync?secret=super-secret-hockey-key-123")
  expect(response.status()).toBe(200)
  expect(await response.json()).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ success: true }))
})

// Deliberately does NOT run waivers: that processes real pending claims in the shared database.
for (const endpoint of ["/api/cron/waivers", "/api/trades"]) {
  test(`${endpoint} rejects unauthenticated mutation`, async ({ playwright, baseURL }) => {
    const anonymous = await playwright.request.newContext({ baseURL, storageState: { cookies: [], origins: [] } })
    const response = endpoint === "/api/trades"
      ? await anonymous.patch(endpoint, { data: { tradeOfferId: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", action: "REJECT" } })
      : await anonymous.get(endpoint)
    expect([401, 403]).toContain(response.status())
    await anonymous.dispose()
  })
}

<file path="e2e/06-rules-engine.spec.ts">
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test"
import { getFantasyWeekDates, getFantasyWeekForDate, getCurrentFantasyWeek } from "../lib/season-calendar"
import { computeStandings, isCompletedMatchup } from "../lib/standings"
import { hasWeekStarted, isSlotLocked, isStarterSlot, normalizeLockMode, type LockContext } from "../lib/lineup-lock"
import { displacedLandingSlot, positionFitsSlot } from "../lib/roster-eligibility"
import { isWeekFinal, scoreTeams } from "../lib/matchup-scoring"
import { DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING, scoreGameStat, type RawGameStat } from "../lib/scoring"

const stat = (overrides: Partial<RawGameStat> = {}): RawGameStat => ({
  goals: 0, assists: 0, shots: 0, hits: 0, blocks: 0, plusMinus: 0, powerPlayPoints: 0, shorthandedGoals: 0,
  gameWinningGoals: 0, saves: 0, goalsAgainst: 0, shutouts: 0, decision: null, ...overrides,
})

test.describe("season calendar (Monday to Sunday NHL weeks)", () => {
  test("Monday 2026-10-12 is the start of week 3", () => {
    expect(getFantasyWeekForDate("2026-10-12")).toBe(3)
    expect(getFantasyWeekDates(3).startDate).toBe("2026-10-12")
    expect(getCurrentFantasyWeek(2026, new Date("2026-10-12T16:00:00Z"))).toBe(3)
  })

  test("week 1 starts Monday 2026-09-28 and week 2 starts 2026-10-05", () => {
    expect(getFantasyWeekDates(1).startDate).toBe("2026-09-28")
    expect(getFantasyWeekDates(2).startDate).toBe("2026-10-05")
  })

  test("every week is seven days, Monday first and Sunday last", () => {
    for (let week = 1; week <= 24; week += 1) {
      const { dates, startDate, endDate } = getFantasyWeekDates(week)
      expect(dates).toHaveLength(7)
      expect(new Date(`${startDate}T12:00:00Z`).getUTCDay()).toBe(1)
      expect(new Date(`${endDate}T12:00:00Z`).getUTCDay()).toBe(0)
    }
  })

  test("Sunday night still belongs to the old week and Monday rolls over", () => {
    expect(getFantasyWeekForDate("2026-10-11")).toBe(2)
    expect(getFantasyWeekForDate("2026-10-18")).toBe(3)
    expect(getFantasyWeekForDate("2026-10-19")).toBe(4)
  })

  test("round trip: every date in a week maps back to that week", () => {
    for (const week of [1, 2, 3, 10, 24]) {
      for (const date of getFantasyWeekDates(week).dates) expect(getFantasyWeekForDate(date)).toBe(week)
    }
  })

  test("US/Eastern is used to pick the day (late-night games belong to the Eastern date)", () => {
    // 2026-10-12 02:30 UTC is still Sunday evening 22:30 in New York, i.e. week 2.
    expect(getCurrentFantasyWeek(2026, new Date("2026-10-12T02:30:00Z"))).toBe(2)
  })
})

test.describe("league scoring", () => {
  test("default league rules: goal 3, assist 2, shot 0.2, hit 0.2, block 0.2", () => {
    expect(scoreGameStat(stat({ goals: 1, assists: 1, shots: 5, hits: 5, blocks: 5 }), DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING)).toBe(8)
  })

  test("goalies: win 4, saves 0.2, goals against -1, shutout 3", () => {
    expect(scoreGameStat(stat({ decision: "W", saves: 30, goalsAgainst: 2, shutouts: 0 }), DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING)).toBe(8)
    expect(scoreGameStat(stat({ decision: "W", saves: 25, goalsAgainst: 0, shutouts: 1 }), DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING)).toBe(12)
    expect(scoreGameStat(stat({ decision: "L", saves: 20, goalsAgainst: 4 }), DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING)).toBe(0)
  })

  test("commissioner overrides change the result (power play points, plus/minus, OT loss)", () => {
    const custom = { ...DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING, ppp: 1, plusMinus: 0.5, overtimeLoss: 1 }
    expect(scoreGameStat(stat({ powerPlayPoints: 2, plusMinus: -2 }), custom)).toBe(1)
    expect(scoreGameStat(stat({ decision: "OT", saves: 10, goalsAgainst: 3 }), custom)).toBe(0)
  })

  test("missing settings fall back to defaults", () => {
    expect(scoreGameStat(stat({ goals: 2 }), undefined)).toBe(6)
    expect(scoreGameStat(stat({ goals: 2 }), {})).toBe(6)
  })
})

test.describe("matchup scoring", () => {
  const slots = [
    { teamId: "A", playerId: 1, slot: "C" },
    { teamId: "A", playerId: 2, slot: "BN" },
    { teamId: "A", playerId: 3, slot: "IR" },
    { teamId: "B", playerId: 4, slot: "G" },
    { teamId: "B", playerId: 5, slot: "TAXI" },
  ]
  const stats = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((playerId) => ({ playerId, ...stat({ goals: 1 }) }))

  test("only starters score; bench, IR and taxi never count", () => {
    const totals = scoreTeams(slots, stats, DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING)
    expect(totals.get("A")).toBe(3)
    expect(totals.get("B")).toBe(3)
  })

  test("a team with no starters stays at 0 and a player without stats adds nothing", () => {
    const totals = scoreTeams([{ teamId: "A", playerId: 9, slot: "BN" }], [{ playerId: 9, ...stat({ goals: 4 }) }], DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING)
    expect(totals.get("A") ?? 0).toBe(0)
  })

  test("multiple games in a week add up", () => {
    const totals = scoreTeams([{ teamId: "A", playerId: 1, slot: "W" }], [{ playerId: 1, ...stat({ goals: 1 }) }, { playerId: 1, ...stat({ assists: 2 }) }], DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING)
    expect(totals.get("A")).toBe(7)
  })

  test("a week is final only after it ended and all NHL games are finished", () => {
    expect(isWeekFinal("2026-10-11", "2026-10-12", ["FINAL", "OFF"])).toBe(true)
    expect(isWeekFinal("2026-10-18", "2026-10-12", ["FINAL"])).toBe(false)
    expect(isWeekFinal("2026-10-11", "2026-10-12", ["FINAL", "LIVE"])).toBe(false)
    expect(isWeekFinal("2026-10-11", "2026-10-12", ["FINAL", "FUT"])).toBe(false)
    expect(isWeekFinal("2026-10-11", "2026-10-12", [])).toBe(false)
  })
})

test.describe("standings from matchup results", () => {
  const m = (week: number, home: string, away: string, hs: number | null, as: number | null, isFinal = true) =>
    ({ week, homeTeamId: home, awayTeamId: away, homeScore: hs, awayScore: as, isFinal })

  test("wins, losses, points for and against come from final matchups", () => {
    const rows = computeStandings(["A", "B", "C"], [m(1, "A", "B", 100, 80), m(2, "C", "A", 90, 95)], 3)
    const a = rows.find((row) => row.teamId === "A")!
    expect(a).toMatchObject({ wins: 2, losses: 0, pointsFor: 195, pointsAgainst: 170, streak: "2W" })
    const b = rows.find((row) => row.teamId === "B")!
    expect(b).toMatchObject({ wins: 0, losses: 1, pointsFor: 80, pointsAgainst: 100, streak: "1L" })
    expect(rows[0].teamId).toBe("A")
  })

  test("the in-progress week does not count until it is final", () => {
    const rows = computeStandings(["A", "B"], [m(3, "A", "B", 40, 10, false)], 3)
    expect(rows.every((row) => row.wins === 0 && row.losses === 0)).toBe(true)
  })

  test("a past week with recorded scores counts even if the flag was never set", () => {
    const rows = computeStandings(["A", "B"], [m(1, "A", "B", 20, 10, false)], 3)
    expect(rows.find((row) => row.teamId === "A")!.wins).toBe(1)
  })

  test("matchups without scores never count", () => {
    expect(isCompletedMatchup(m(1, "A", "B", null, null, true), 3)).toBe(false)
  })

  test("ties are tracked separately and break the streak", () => {
    const rows = computeStandings(["A", "B"], [m(1, "A", "B", 10, 10), m(2, "A", "B", 12, 5)], 3)
    const a = rows.find((row) => row.teamId === "A")!
    expect(a).toMatchObject({ wins: 1, ties: 1, losses: 0, streak: "1W" })
  })

  test("tie-break order: wins, then fewer losses, then points for", () => {
    const rows = computeStandings(["A", "B", "C"], [m(1, "A", "C", 50, 10), m(1, "B", "C", 70, 10)], 3)
    expect(rows.map((row) => row.teamId).slice(0, 2)).toEqual(["B", "A"])
  })

  test("streak counts consecutive latest results", () => {
    const rows = computeStandings(["A", "B"], [m(1, "A", "B", 1, 9), m(2, "A", "B", 9, 1), m(3, "A", "B", 9, 1)], 4)
    expect(rows.find((row) => row.teamId === "A")!.streak).toBe("2W")
  })
})

test.describe("roster swap eligibility", () => {
  test("a defenseman leaving IR cannot take the goalie slot he was swapped with", () => {
    expect(positionFitsSlot("G", "D")).toBe(false)
    expect(displacedLandingSlot("G", "D", true)).toBe("BN")
    expect(displacedLandingSlot("G", "D", false)).toBeNull()
  })

  test("a player who can play the vacated slot takes it, including flex", () => {
    expect(displacedLandingSlot("G", "G", false)).toBe("G")
    expect(displacedLandingSlot("C", "C", false)).toBe("C")
    expect(displacedLandingSlot("F", "LW", false)).toBe("F")
    expect(displacedLandingSlot("W", "C", true)).toBe("BN")
  })
})

test.describe("lineup lock modes", () => {
  const weekly = (weekStarted: boolean): LockContext => ({ mode: "WEEKLY", weekStarted, startedTeams: new Set() })
  const daily = (teams: string[]): LockContext => ({ mode: "DAILY", weekStarted: false, startedTeams: new Set(teams) })

  test("weekly: nothing is locked before the first game of the week", () => {
    for (const slot of ["C", "W", "F", "D", "G", "BN", "IR", "TAXI"]) expect(isSlotLocked(weekly(false), slot, "MTL")).toBe(false)
  })

  test("weekly: once the first game starts every starter is locked for the whole week, whatever team they play for", () => {
    for (const slot of ["C", "W", "F", "D", "G"]) {
      expect(isSlotLocked(weekly(true), slot, "MTL")).toBe(true)
      expect(isSlotLocked(weekly(true), slot, "VGK")).toBe(true)
    }
  })

  test("weekly: bench, IR and taxi stay movable after the lock", () => {
    for (const slot of ["BN", "IR", "IR_PLUS", "TAXI"]) expect(isSlotLocked(weekly(true), slot, "MTL")).toBe(false)
  })

  test("daily: only players whose team already started playing today are locked", () => {
    expect(isSlotLocked(daily(["MTL"]), "C", "MTL")).toBe(true)
    expect(isSlotLocked(daily(["MTL"]), "BN", "MTL")).toBe(true)
    expect(isSlotLocked(daily(["MTL"]), "C", "TOR")).toBe(false)
  })

  test("the week has started once any game's puck has dropped", () => {
    const now = new Date("2026-10-12T20:00:00Z")
    expect(hasWeekStarted([new Date("2026-10-12T23:00:00Z")], now)).toBe(false)
    expect(hasWeekStarted([new Date("2026-10-12T23:00:00Z"), new Date("2026-10-12T19:00:00Z")], now)).toBe(true)
    expect(hasWeekStarted([], now)).toBe(false)
  })

  test("lock mode defaults to weekly and only accepts WEEKLY or DAILY", () => {
    expect(normalizeLockMode(undefined)).toBe("WEEKLY")
    expect(normalizeLockMode("garbage")).toBe("WEEKLY")
    expect(normalizeLockMode("DAILY")).toBe("DAILY")
    expect(isStarterSlot("F")).toBe(true)
    expect(isStarterSlot("BN")).toBe(false)
  })
})

<file path="e2e/07-league-integrity.spec.ts">
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test"
import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client"
import { getFantasyWeekDates, getCurrentFantasyWeek } from "../lib/season-calendar"
import { computeStandings } from "../lib/standings"
import { scoreTeams } from "../lib/matchup-scoring"
import type { LeagueScoring } from "../lib/scoring"
import { scoringSlotsForWeek } from "../lib/services/week-lineups"

// Read-only checks against the live league database (nothing here writes).
process.loadEnvFile?.(".env")
const prisma = new PrismaClient()
const SEASON = 2026

test.afterAll(async () => { await prisma.$disconnect() })

test.describe("league data integrity (read-only)", () => {
  test("the league has 12 uniquely named teams, each with one manager", async () => {
    const teams = await prisma.team.findMany({ select: { name: true, managerId: true } })
    expect(teams).toHaveLength(12)
    expect(new Set(teams.map((team) => team.name)).size).toBe(12)
    expect(new Set(teams.map((team) => team.managerId)).size).toBe(12)
  })

  test("no player is rostered by two teams", async () => {
    const slots = await prisma.rosterSlot.findMany({ select: { playerId: true } })
    expect(new Set(slots.map((slot) => slot.playerId)).size).toBe(slots.length)
  })

  test("no roster exceeds the league's capacity and slot limits", async () => {
    const league = await prisma.league.findFirstOrThrow()
    const positions = (league.rosterPositions ?? {}) as Record<string, number>
    const teams = await prisma.team.findMany({ include: { rosterSlots: { select: { slot: true } } } })
    for (const team of teams) {
      const count = (slot: string) => team.rosterSlots.filter((entry) => entry.slot === slot).length
      for (const slot of ["C", "W", "F", "D", "G", "BN"]) expect(count(slot), `${team.name} ${slot}`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(positions[slot] ?? 0)
      expect(count("TAXI"), `${team.name} taxi`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(league.taxiSlots)
      expect(count("IR") + count("IR_PLUS"), `${team.name} IR`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(league.irSlots)
    }
  })

  test("taxi players are all under the league's NHL games cap", async () => {
    const league = await prisma.league.findFirstOrThrow()
    const taxi = await prisma.rosterSlot.findMany({ where: { slot: "TAXI" }, include: { player: true } })
    for (const entry of taxi) expect(entry.player.nhlGamesPlayed, entry.player.name).toBeLessThan(league.taxiMaxGames)
  })

  test("IR slots only hold players whose status is IR", async () => {
    const ir = await prisma.rosterSlot.findMany({ where: { slot: "IR" }, include: { player: true } })
    for (const entry of ir) expect(entry.player.injuryStatus, entry.player.name).toBe("IR")
  })

  test("starters are position-eligible for their slot", async () => {
    const eligible: Record<string, string[]> = { C: ["C"], W: ["LW", "RW"], F: ["C", "LW", "RW"], D: ["D"], G: ["G"] }
    const starters = await prisma.rosterSlot.findMany({ where: { slot: { in: ["C", "W", "F", "D", "G"] } }, include: { player: true } })
    for (const entry of starters) expect(eligible[entry.slot], `${entry.player.name} in ${entry.slot}`).toContain(entry.player.position)
  })

  test("every team plays exactly one opponent each week and never itself", async () => {
    const matchups = await prisma.matchup.findMany({ where: { season: SEASON } })
    const weeks = new Set(matchups.map((matchup) => matchup.week))
    expect(weeks.size).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(20)
    for (const week of weeks) {
      const inWeek = matchups.filter((matchup) => matchup.week === week)
      const ids = inWeek.flatMap((matchup) => [matchup.homeTeamId, matchup.awayTeamId])
      expect(ids, `week ${week} plays 12 distinct teams`).toHaveLength(12)
      expect(new Set(ids).size, `week ${week} no team twice`).toBe(12)
    }
  })

  test("league week follows the NHL calendar (today is never behind the calendar)", async () => {
    const league = await prisma.league.findFirstOrThrow()
    expect(league.currentWeek).toBe(getCurrentFantasyWeek(SEASON))
  })

  test("every NHL game is stored under its own date (no week bucketed on a single day)", async () => {
    const week = getCurrentFantasyWeek(SEASON)
    const { dates } = getFantasyWeekDates(week, SEASON)
    const games = await prisma.nhlGame.findMany({ where: { gameDate: { in: dates } }, select: { gameDate: true } })
    expect(games.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
    expect(new Set(games.map((game) => game.gameDate)).size).toBeGreaterThan(2)
  })

  test("finished NHL games all have player stat lines", async () => {
    const missing = await prisma.nhlGame.count({ where: { gameState: { in: ["FINAL", "OFF"] }, gameStats: { none: {} } } })
    expect(missing).toBe(0)
  })
})

test.describe("retroactive matchup scores and standings", () => {
  test("weeks before the current one are final and carry scores", async () => {
    const current = getCurrentFantasyWeek(SEASON)
    const past = await prisma.matchup.findMany({ where: { season: SEASON, week: { lt: current } } })
    expect(past.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
    for (const matchup of past) {
      expect(matchup.isFinal, `week ${matchup.week}`).toBe(true)
      expect(matchup.homeScore).not.toBeNull()
      expect(matchup.awayScore).not.toBeNull()
    }
  })

  test("future weeks are never final", async () => {
    const current = getCurrentFantasyWeek(SEASON)
    const future = await prisma.matchup.findMany({ where: { season: SEASON, week: { gt: current } } })
    for (const matchup of future) expect(matchup.isFinal).toBe(false)
  })

  test("stored scores match a fresh calculation from boxscores and the league scoring rules", async () => {
    const league = await prisma.league.findFirstOrThrow()
    for (const week of [1, 2]) {
      const slots = await scoringSlotsForWeek(league.id, SEASON, week)
      const { dates } = getFantasyWeekDates(week, SEASON)
      const stats = await prisma.playerGameStat.findMany({ where: { game: { gameDate: { in: dates } } } })
      const totals = scoreTeams(slots, stats, league.scoringSettings as LeagueScoring)
      const matchups = await prisma.matchup.findMany({ where: { season: SEASON, week } })
      for (const matchup of matchups) {
        expect(Number(matchup.homeScore), `w${week} home`).toBeCloseTo(totals.get(matchup.homeTeamId) ?? 0, 1)
        expect(Number(matchup.awayScore), `w${week} away`).toBeCloseTo(totals.get(matchup.awayTeamId) ?? 0, 1)
      }
    }
  })

  test("standings equal the sum of the final matchup results in the database", async () => {
    const league = await prisma.league.findFirstOrThrow()
    const teams = await prisma.team.findMany({ select: { id: true } })
    const matchups = await prisma.matchup.findMany({ where: { season: SEASON, isFinal: true } })
    const standings = computeStandings(teams.map((team) => team.id), matchups, getCurrentFantasyWeek(SEASON))
    const games = standings.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.wins + row.losses + row.ties, 0)
    expect(games).toBe(matchups.length * 2)
    expect(league.currentWeek).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3)
    const pointsFor = standings.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.pointsFor, 0)
    const pointsAgainst = standings.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.pointsAgainst, 0)
    expect(pointsFor).toBeCloseTo(pointsAgainst, 1)
  })
})

import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test"
import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client"
import { getCurrentFantasyWeek, getFantasyWeekDates } from "../lib/season-calendar"

process.loadEnvFile?.(".env")
const prisma = new PrismaClient()
test.afterAll(async () => { await prisma.$disconnect() })

async function weekHasStarted() {
  const { dates } = getFantasyWeekDates(getCurrentFantasyWeek(2026), 2026)
  const first = await prisma.nhlGame.findFirst({ where: { gameDate: { in: dates } }, orderBy: { startTimeUTC: "asc" } })
  return Boolean(first && first.startTimeUTC.getTime() <= Date.now())
}

test.describe("league settings: lineup lock option", () => {
  test("GET exposes the lock mode (weekly by default)", async ({ request }) => {
    const response = await request.get("/api/admin/league-settings")
    expect(response.status()).toBe(200)
    const body = await response.json()
    expect(["WEEKLY", "DAILY"]).toContain(body.lineupLockMode)
  })

  test("PATCH rejects an unknown lock mode", async ({ request }) => {
    const response = await request.patch("/api/admin/league-settings", { data: { lineupLockMode: "HOURLY" } })
    expect(response.status()).toBe(400)
  })

  test("PATCH ignores attempts to hand-set the league week", async ({ request }) => {
    const before = await (await request.get("/api/admin/league-settings")).json()
    const response = await request.patch("/api/admin/league-settings", { data: { currentWeek: 17 } })
    expect(response.status()).toBe(200)
    expect((await response.json()).currentWeek).toBe(before.currentWeek)
  })

  test("the mode can be switched and restored (self-reverting)", async ({ request }) => {
    const original = (await (await request.get("/api/admin/league-settings")).json()).lineupLockMode as "WEEKLY" | "DAILY"
    const other = original === "WEEKLY" ? "DAILY" : "WEEKLY"
    try {
      const response = await request.patch("/api/admin/league-settings", { data: { lineupLockMode: other } })
      expect(response.status()).toBe(200)
      expect((await (await request.get("/api/admin/league-settings")).json()).lineupLockMode).toBe(other)
    } finally {
      await request.patch("/api/admin/league-settings", { data: { lineupLockMode: original } })
    }
    expect((await (await request.get("/api/admin/league-settings")).json()).lineupLockMode).toBe(original)
  })

  test("the rulebook shows the lock option under Roster", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/")
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "LEAGUE", exact: true }).click()
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: /settings/i }).first().click()
    await expect(page.getByText("Lineup lock").first()).toBeVisible()
  })
})

test.describe("weekly starter lock", () => {
  test("anonymous roster moves are rejected", async ({ playwright, baseURL }) => {
    const anonymous = await playwright.request.newContext({ baseURL })
    const response = await anonymous.post("/api/roster/move", { data: { teamId: "x", playerId: 1, targetSlot: "BN" } })
    expect([401, 403]).toContain(response.status())
    await anonymous.dispose()
  })

  test("after the first game of the week a starter cannot be benched (rejected, nothing changes)", async ({ request }) => {
    const league = await prisma.league.findFirstOrThrow()
    test.skip(league.lineupLockMode !== "WEEKLY" || !(await weekHasStarted()), "needs weekly mode and a started week")
    const team = await prisma.team.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { name: "Montreal Monarchs" } })
    const starter = await prisma.rosterSlot.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { teamId: team.id, slot: { in: ["C", "W", "F", "D"] } } })
    const response = await request.post("/api/roster/move", { data: { teamId: team.id, playerId: starter.playerId, targetSlot: "BN" } })
    expect(response.status()).toBe(400)
    expect((await response.json()).error).toMatch(/locked/i)
    const after = await prisma.rosterSlot.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: starter.id } })
    expect(after.slot).toBe(starter.slot)
  })

  test("after the first game a bench player cannot be pulled into a starting slot", async ({ request }) => {
    const league = await prisma.league.findFirstOrThrow()
    test.skip(league.lineupLockMode !== "WEEKLY" || !(await weekHasStarted()), "needs weekly mode and a started week")
    const team = await prisma.team.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { name: "Montreal Monarchs" } })
    const bench = await prisma.rosterSlot.findFirst({ where: { teamId: team.id, slot: "BN", player: { position: { in: ["C", "LW", "RW", "D"] } } }, include: { player: true } })
    test.skip(!bench, "no skater on the bench")
    const target = bench!.player.position === "D" ? "D" : "F"
    const response = await request.post("/api/roster/move", { data: { teamId: team.id, playerId: bench!.playerId, targetSlot: target } })
    expect(response.status()).toBe(400)
    expect((await response.json()).error).toMatch(/locked/i)
  })

  test("the lineup page tells the manager that starters are locked", async ({ page }) => {
    const league = await prisma.league.findFirstOrThrow()
    test.skip(league.lineupLockMode !== "WEEKLY" || !(await weekHasStarted()), "needs weekly mode and a started week")
    await page.goto("/")
    await expect(page.getByTestId("lineup-lock-banner")).toContainText("locked until Monday")
  })

  test("a move for another manager's team is refused", async ({ request }) => {
    const other = await prisma.team.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { name: { not: "Montreal Monarchs" } } })
    const slot = await prisma.rosterSlot.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { teamId: other.id } })
    const response = await request.post("/api/roster/move", { data: { teamId: other.id, playerId: slot.playerId, targetSlot: "BN" } })
    expect([400, 401, 403]).toContain(response.status())
    const after = await prisma.rosterSlot.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: slot.id } })
    expect(after.slot).toBe(slot.slot)
  })
})

test.describe("week sync in the UI", () => {
  test("the league tab opens on the real NHL week (week 3 on Oct 12)", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/")
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "LEAGUE", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(page.getByText(`Week ${getCurrentFantasyWeek(2026)}`).first()).toBeVisible()
  })

  test("previous weeks show their final scores from the database", async ({ page }) => {
    const matchup = await prisma.matchup.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { week: 2, season: 2026 }, include: { homeTeam: true, awayTeam: true } })
    const stepsBack = Math.max(0, getCurrentFantasyWeek(2026) - 2)
    await page.goto("/")
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "LEAGUE", exact: true }).click()
    for (let step = 0; step < stepsBack; step += 1) {
      await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Previous league week" }).click()
    }
    await expect(page.getByText("Week 2").first()).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByText(Number(matchup.homeScore).toFixed(2)).first()).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByText(Number(matchup.awayScore).toFixed(2)).first()).toBeVisible()
  })

  test("the team header record matches the standings computed from final matchups", async ({ page }) => {
    const team = await prisma.team.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { name: "Montreal Monarchs" } })
    const finals = await prisma.matchup.findMany({ where: { season: 2026, isFinal: true, OR: [{ homeTeamId: team.id }, { awayTeamId: team.id }] } })
    let wins = 0, losses = 0
    for (const m of finals) {
      const home = m.homeTeamId === team.id
      const mine = Number(home ? m.homeScore : m.awayScore), theirs = Number(home ? m.awayScore : m.homeScore)
      if (mine > theirs) wins += 1
      else if (mine < theirs) losses += 1
    }
    await page.goto("/")
    await expect(page.getByText(`${wins}-${losses}`).first()).toBeVisible()
  })
})
