<file path="lib/services/lineup-locks.ts">
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { getCurrentFantasyWeek, getEasternDate, getFantasyWeekDates } from "@/lib/season-calendar"
import { hasWeekStarted, normalizeLockMode, type LineupLockMode, type LockContext } from "@/lib/lineup-lock"

export interface LockSummary extends LockContext {
  week: number
  /** First puck drop of the fantasy week (ISO), if the schedule is known. */
  firstGameAt: string | null
  weekEndDate: string
  /** WEEKLY: the fantasy week has started. DAILY: at least one NHL team has started today. */
  locked: boolean
}

/** Computes the live lock state for a league at `now` straight from the NHL schedule (no cron needed). */
export async function getLockSummary(season: number, rawMode: unknown, now: Date = new Date()): Promise<LockSummary> {
  const mode: LineupLockMode = normalizeLockMode(rawMode)
  const week = getCurrentFantasyWeek(season, now)
  const { dates, endDate } = getFantasyWeekDates(week, season)

  if (mode === "WEEKLY") {
    const weekGames = await prisma.nhlGame.findMany({
      where: { gameDate: { in: dates } },
      select: { startTimeUTC: true },
      orderBy: { startTimeUTC: "asc" },
    })
    const starts = weekGames.map((game) => game.startTimeUTC)
    const weekStarted = hasWeekStarted(starts, now)
    return {
      mode, week, weekEndDate: endDate,
      firstGameAt: starts[0]?.toISOString() ?? null,
      weekStarted,
      startedTeams: new Set(),
      locked: weekStarted,
    }
  }

  const startedToday = await prisma.nhlGame.findMany({
    where: { gameDate: getEasternDate(now), startTimeUTC: { lte: now } },
    select: { homeTeamAbbrev: true, awayTeamAbbrev: true },
  })
  const startedTeams = new Set(startedToday.flatMap((game) => [game.homeTeamAbbrev, game.awayTeamAbbrev]))
  return {
    mode, week, weekEndDate: endDate, firstGameAt: null, weekStarted: false,
    startedTeams,
    locked: startedTeams.size > 0,
  }
}
</file>

<file path="lib/services/week-lineups.ts">
import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { getLockSummary } from "@/lib/services/lineup-locks"

type TransactionClient = Prisma.TransactionClient
type Db = TransactionClient | typeof prisma

export interface WeekAssignment {
  teamName: string
  nhlId: number
  slot: string
}

/** Copies the live roster into the week snapshot once. Later trades do not rewrite it. */
export async function freezeWeekLineup(db: Db, leagueId: string, season: number, week: number) {
  const [teamCount, frozenTeams] = await Promise.all([
    db.team.count({ where: { leagueId } }),
    db.weekLineup.findMany({
      where: { season, week, team: { leagueId } },
      distinct: ["teamId"],
      select: { teamId: true },
    }),
  ])
  if (frozenTeams.length >= teamCount) return

  const covered = new Set(frozenTeams.map((row) => row.teamId))
  const slots = await db.rosterSlot.findMany({
    where: { team: { leagueId } },
    select: { teamId: true, playerId: true, slot: true },
  })
  const missing = slots.filter((slot) => !covered.has(slot.teamId))
  if (missing.length === 0) return
  await db.weekLineup.createMany({
    data: missing.map((slot) => ({ teamId: slot.teamId, season, week, playerId: slot.playerId, slot: slot.slot })),
    skipDuplicates: true,
  })
}

export async function weekLineupForLeague(leagueId: string, season: number, week: number, now: Date = new Date()) {
  const league = await prisma.league.findUnique({ where: { id: leagueId }, select: { lineupLockMode: true } })
  const lock = await getLockSummary(season, league?.lineupLockMode, now)
  const lockedWeek = lock.mode === "WEEKLY" && week === lock.week && lock.weekStarted
  if (lockedWeek) await freezeWeekLineup(prisma, leagueId, season, week)

  const snapshot = await prisma.weekLineup.findMany({
    where: { season, week, team: { leagueId } },
    select: { slot: true, playerId: true, team: { select: { name: true } } },
  })
  const pastWeek = week < lock.week
  const frozen = snapshot.length > 0 || pastWeek || lockedWeek
  if (snapshot.length > 0) {
    return {
      week,
      currentWeek: lock.week,
      frozen: true,
      assignments: snapshot.map((row) => ({ teamName: row.team.name, nhlId: row.playerId, slot: row.slot })),
    }
  }
  const live = await prisma.rosterSlot.findMany({
    where: { team: { leagueId } },
    select: { slot: true, playerId: true, team: { select: { name: true } } },
  })
  return {
    week,
    currentWeek: lock.week,
    frozen,
    assignments: live.map((row) => ({ teamName: row.team.name, nhlId: row.playerId, slot: row.slot })),
  }
}

/** Starter rows used to score a week. A frozen snapshot wins over the live roster. */
export async function scoringSlotsForWeek(leagueId: string, season: number, week: number) {
  const snapshot = await prisma.weekLineup.findMany({
    where: { season, week, team: { leagueId } },
    select: { teamId: true, playerId: true, slot: true },
  })
  if (snapshot.length > 0) return snapshot
  return prisma.rosterSlot.findMany({
    where: { team: { leagueId } },
    select: { teamId: true, playerId: true, slot: true },
  })
}

export function isWeekLineupLocked(lock: { mode: string; week: number; weekStarted: boolean }, week: number) {
  if (week < lock.week) return true
  return lock.mode === "WEEKLY" && week === lock.week && lock.weekStarted
}

export const FUTURE_LINEUP_LOCK_MESSAGE = "This week's lineup is locked. Switch to a later week to slot players from a trade."
</file>

<file path="lib/activity-format.ts">
import type { ActivityItem } from "@/lib/hockey-data"
import { getEasternDate } from "@/lib/season-calendar"

type ActivityRecord = {
  id: string
  action: "ADD" | "DROP" | "TRADE" | "COMMISSIONER"
  details: unknown
  createdAt: Date
  team: { name: string; manager: { name: string; handle: string } } | null
}

function previousEasternDay(now: Date) {
  const [year, month, day] = getEasternDate(now).split("-").map(Number)
  return getEasternDate(new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day - 1, 17)))
}

function relativeTime(createdAt: Date) {
  const now = new Date()
  const createdDay = getEasternDate(createdAt)
  const sameDay = createdDay === getEasternDate(now)
  if (createdDay === previousEasternDay(now)) return "Yesterday"
  if (sameDay && now.getTime() - createdAt.getTime() < 60_000) return "Just now"
  if (sameDay) return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false, timeZone: "America/New_York" }).format(createdAt)
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hour12: false, timeZone: "America/New_York" }).format(createdAt)
}

export function formatActivity(record: ActivityRecord): ActivityItem {
  const details = record.details && typeof record.details === "object" ? record.details as Record<string, unknown> : {}
  const player = typeof details.playerName === "string" ? details.playerName : record.action === "TRADE" ? "Trade assets" : "Roster transaction"
  const teamName = record.team?.name ?? "League"
  const handle = record.team?.manager.handle ?? "commissioner"
  const detail = record.action === "TRADE"
    ? `${typeof details.assetCount === "number" ? details.assetCount : 0} assets · ${teamName}`
    : typeof details.bidAmount === "number"
      ? `Bid $${details.bidAmount} · ${teamName}`
      : teamName
  return {
    id: record.id,
    owner: `@${handle}`,
    action: record.action === "COMMISSIONER" ? "TRADE" : record.action,
    player,
    detail,
    time: relativeTime(record.createdAt),
  }
}

<file path="lib/playoff-bracket.ts">
/**
 * Six-team bracket, one week per round, matching the league's current playoff picture.
 * Seeds 1 and 2 bye in week 15. Seed 1 then plays the winner of 4 vs 5.
 * Seed 2 plays the winner of 3 vs 6. A tie goes to the higher seed.
 */

export const PLAYOFF_START_WEEK = 15
export const PLAYOFF_TEAM_COUNT = 6

export type PlayoffResult = {
  week: number
  homeTeam: string
  awayTeam: string
  homeScore: number
  awayScore: number
  isFinal: boolean
}

export type PlayoffStanding = {
  team: string
}

export type BracketSide = {
  seed: number | null
  team: string | null
  label: string
  points: number | null
  winner: boolean
}

export type BracketGame = {
  id: string
  week: number
  status: "Projected" | "Live" | "Final" | "Bye"
  home: BracketSide
  away: BracketSide | null
}

export type PlayoffRound = {
  title: string
  week: number
  games: BracketGame[]
}

export type PlayoffBracketView = {
  live: boolean
  rounds: PlayoffRound[]
}

type Seeded = { seed: number; team: string }

function rankedTeams(standings: PlayoffStanding[], results: PlayoffResult[], currentWeek: number): string[] {
  const names = standings.map((row) => row.team)
  if (currentWeek < PLAYOFF_START_WEEK) return names
  const table = new Map(names.map((team, index) => [team, { team, wins: 0, losses: 0, pointsFor: 0, index }]))
  for (const game of results) {
    if (game.week >= PLAYOFF_START_WEEK) continue
    if (!(game.isFinal || game.week < currentWeek)) continue
    const sides = [
      [game.homeTeam, game.homeScore, game.awayScore],
      [game.awayTeam, game.awayScore, game.homeScore],
    ] as const
    for (const [team, score, opponent] of sides) {
      const row = table.get(team)
      if (!row) continue
      row.pointsFor = Math.round((row.pointsFor + score) * 100) / 100
      if (score > opponent) row.wins += 1
      else if (score < opponent) row.losses += 1
    }
  }
  return [...table.values()]
    .sort((a, b) => b.wins - a.wins || a.losses - b.losses || b.pointsFor - a.pointsFor || a.index - b.index)
    .map((row) => row.team)
}

function weekScore(results: PlayoffResult[], week: number, team: string) {
  const game = results.find((result) => result.week === week && (result.homeTeam === team || result.awayTeam === team))
  if (!game) return null
  return {
    points: game.homeTeam === team ? game.homeScore : game.awayScore,
    final: game.isFinal,
  }
}

function side(seed: number | null, team: string | null, label: string, points: number | null, winner = false): BracketSide {
  return { seed, team, label, points, winner }
}

function teamLabel(seed: number, team: string | null) {
  return team ? `#${seed} ${team}` : `#${seed}`
}

function series(id: string, week: number, homeSeed: Seeded | null, awaySeed: Seeded | null, results: PlayoffResult[], currentWeek: number, pendingLabel: string): BracketGame & { winnerTeam: string | null; loserTeam: string | null } {
  const started = currentWeek >= week
  const homeLine = homeSeed && started ? weekScore(results, week, homeSeed.team) : null
  const awayLine = awaySeed && started ? weekScore(results, week, awaySeed.team) : null
  const bothFinal = Boolean(homeLine?.final && awayLine?.final && homeSeed && awaySeed)
  let winnerTeam: string | null = null
  let loserTeam: string | null = null
  if (bothFinal && homeSeed && awaySeed && homeLine && awayLine) {
    if (homeLine.points > awayLine.points || (homeLine.points === awayLine.points && homeSeed.seed < awaySeed.seed)) {
      winnerTeam = homeSeed.team
      loserTeam = awaySeed.team
    } else {
      winnerTeam = awaySeed.team
      loserTeam = homeSeed.team
    }
  }
  const status = !started || !homeSeed || !awaySeed ? "Projected" : bothFinal ? "Final" : "Live"
  return {
    id,
    week,
    status,
    home: side(homeSeed?.seed ?? null, homeSeed?.team ?? null, homeSeed ? teamLabel(homeSeed.seed, homeSeed.team) : pendingLabel, started && homeLine ? homeLine.points : null, winnerTeam != null && winnerTeam === homeSeed?.team),
    away: side(awaySeed?.seed ?? null, awaySeed?.team ?? null, awaySeed ? teamLabel(awaySeed.seed, awaySeed.team) : pendingLabel, started && awayLine ? awayLine.points : null, winnerTeam != null && winnerTeam === awaySeed?.team),
    winnerTeam,
    loserTeam,
  }
}

function seeded(seed: number, teams: string[]): Seeded | null {
  const team = teams[seed - 1]
  return team ? { seed, team } : null
}

function advanced(game: BracketGame & { winnerTeam: string | null; loserTeam: string | null }, which: "winner" | "loser"): Seeded | null {
  const team = which === "winner" ? game.winnerTeam : game.loserTeam
  if (!team) return null
  const winnerSide = game.home.winner ? game.home : game.away
  const loserSide = game.home.winner ? game.away : game.home
  const picked = which === "winner" ? winnerSide : loserSide
  return picked?.seed != null ? { seed: picked.seed, team } : { seed: 0, team }
}

export function buildPlayoffBracket({ standings, results, currentWeek }: { standings: PlayoffStanding[]; results: PlayoffResult[]; currentWeek: number }): PlayoffBracketView {
  const teams = rankedTeams(standings, results, currentWeek)
  const seed = (rank: number) => seeded(rank, teams)
  const firstHigh = series("r1-4-5", 15, seed(4), seed(5), results, currentWeek, "Winner of #4 vs #5")
  const firstLow = series("r1-3-6", 15, seed(3), seed(6), results, currentWeek, "Winner of #3 vs #6")
  const semiOne = series("semi-1", 16, seed(1), advanced(firstHigh, "winner"), results, currentWeek, "Winner of #4 vs #5")
  const semiTwo = series("semi-2", 16, seed(2), advanced(firstLow, "winner"), results, currentWeek, "Winner of #3 vs #6")
  const final = series("final", 17, advanced(semiOne, "winner"), advanced(semiTwo, "winner"), results, currentWeek, "Winner of semifinals")
  const thirdHome = advanced(semiOne, "loser")
  const thirdAway = advanced(semiTwo, "loser")
  const third = series("third", 17, thirdHome, thirdAway, results, currentWeek, "Semifinal loser")
  const bye = (rank: number): BracketGame => ({
    id: `bye-${rank}`,
    week: 15,
    status: "Bye",
    home: side(rank, teams[rank - 1] ?? null, teamLabel(rank, teams[rank - 1] ?? null), null),
    away: null,
  })

  return {
    live: currentWeek >= PLAYOFF_START_WEEK,
    rounds: [
      { title: "Round 1 · Week 15", week: 15, games: [bye(1), bye(2), firstLow, firstHigh] },
      { title: "Semifinals · Week 16", week: 16, games: [semiOne, semiTwo] },
      { title: "Finals · Week 17", week: 17, games: [final, third] },
    ],
  }
}
</file>

<file path="lib/season-calendar.ts">
/**
 * Fantasy calendar: weeks run Monday to Sunday.
 * Week 1 of the 2026-27 NHL fantasy season starts on Monday 2026-09-28, so Monday 2026-10-12 is the start of week 3.
 * Add a new entry here for each following season.
 */
const WEEK_ONE_MONDAY: Record<number, string> = {
  2026: "2026-09-28",
}

export const MAX_FANTASY_WEEK = 24

const DAY_MS = 86_400_000

function weekOneStart(season: number): Date {
  const configured = WEEK_ONE_MONDAY[season]
  if (configured) return new Date(`${configured}T00:00:00Z`)
  // Fallback for seasons without an entry: the last Monday of September.
  const firstOfOctober = new Date(Date.UTC(season, 9, 1))
  const daysSinceMonday = (firstOfOctober.getUTCDay() + 6) % 7
  return new Date(firstOfOctober.getTime() - (daysSinceMonday === 0 ? 7 : daysSinceMonday) * DAY_MS)
}

function toDateString(date: Date): string {
  return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
}

/** Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) in US/Eastern, which is how NHL game dates are expressed. */
export function getEasternDate(now: Date = new Date()): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", { timeZone: "America/New_York" }).format(now)
}

export function getFantasyWeekDates(week: number, season = 2026): {
  startDate: string
  endDate: string
  dates: string[]
} {
  const normalizedWeek = Number.isFinite(week) ? Math.max(1, Math.floor(week)) : 1
  const start = weekOneStart(season).getTime() + (normalizedWeek - 1) * 7 * DAY_MS
  const dates = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, index) => toDateString(new Date(start + index * DAY_MS)))
  return { startDate: dates[0], endDate: dates[6], dates }
}

/** Fantasy week containing the given Eastern calendar date (weeks before the season start clamp to week 1). */
export function getFantasyWeekForDate(date: string, season = 2026): number {
  const elapsedDays = Math.floor((new Date(`${date}T00:00:00Z`).getTime() - weekOneStart(season).getTime()) / DAY_MS)
  return Math.max(1, Math.floor(elapsedDays / 7) + 1)
}

export function getCurrentFantasyWeek(season = 2026, now: Date = new Date()): number {
  return getFantasyWeekForDate(getEasternDate(now), season)
}

<file path="README.md">
# John Scott Dynasty

Mobile fantasy hockey dashboard for one dynasty league. Managers sign in with a 4-digit PIN, set a weekly lineup, bid FAAB on waivers, trade players, picks, and FAAB, and follow head-to-head matchups scored from live NHL box scores.

The UI is a single page at `/`, locked to a phone-width shell (`max-w-[430px]`, `h-dvh`). Four tabs:

| Tab | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| Match | This week's head-to-head, other league matchups, and the playoff bracket |
| Team | Starting lineup, bench, taxi, and IR |
| Players | Free agents, waiver claims, and the trade builder |
| League | Standings, activity, chat, and commissioner settings |

Use npm. This repo does not use pnpm or yarn.

## Stack

- Next.js 16 (App Router) and React 19
- PostgreSQL through Prisma 6 (`prisma/schema.prisma`)
- Tailwind CSS 4, Base UI, Lucide
- Playwright for end-to-end tests in `e2e/`

Import the database client from `@/lib/prisma`. Do not construct a new `PrismaClient` in routes or components. The seed script is the exception.

## Local setup

You need Node.js and a Postgres database (Neon works).

```bash
npm install
```

Create `.env` with:

```bash
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@HOST/DB?sslmode=require"
CRON_SECRET="any-long-random-string"
```

`DATABASE_URL` is required. `CRON_SECRET` is required only for the NHL sync and waiver cron routes.

There is no `prisma/migrations` folder. Push the schema, then seed the league:

```bash
npx prisma db push
npm run prisma:seed
npm run dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000). Every seeded manager uses PIN `1234`. The commissioner account is **Montreal Monarchs** (`@commissioner`).

`npm install` runs `prisma generate`. `npm run build` also refreshes `public/data/nhl-players.json` from the NHL search API before `next build`, so a build needs network access.

If the league row is missing, the page falls back to the static roster in `lib/hockey-data.ts` instead of the database.

## Scripts

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run dev` | Next.js dev server |
| `npm run build` / `npm start` | Production build and server |
| `npm run sync-players` | Rewrite the local NHL player registry |
| `npm run prisma:seed` | Upsert players, the league, 12 teams, the 24-week schedule, rosters, and 2027–2029 draft picks |
| `npm run test:e2e` | Playwright against `http://localhost:3000` |
| `npm run test:e2e:ui` | Playwright UI mode |
| `npx tsc --noEmit` | Typecheck |

## League rules the code enforces

The seeded league id is `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001`, name **John Scott Dynasty**, season `2026`.

**Weeks.** Fantasy weeks run Monday through Sunday in `America/New_York`. Week 1 of the 2026 season starts Monday 2026-09-28 (`lib/season-calendar.ts`). The season is 24 weeks. Unplayed games count as `0.0`. Do not substitute a weekly projection for a missing actual score.

**Roster.** Capacity is 27. Starting slots are C, W, F, D, and G, seeded as 3 / 6 / 3 / 6 / 2, plus 7 bench. Taxi holds players under 50 NHL games played (`taxiMaxGames`). IR accepts `PlayerStatus.IR` only. Day-to-day and IR+ (`O`) are not IR-eligible.

**Lineup lock.** Default mode is `WEEKLY`: starters freeze at the first puck drop of the fantasy week; bench, taxi, and IR stay movable. `DAILY` freezes a player once that NHL team's game today has started. A frozen week is copied into `WeekLineup` and later trades do not rewrite it.

**Waivers.** FAAB. A winning bid is deducted from `Team.faabBalance`. A drop is required only when the roster is already at 27. Claims process at Monday 00:00 Eastern after that week's NHL games are final. Outcomes are stored on `WaiverClaim.resolution`: `WON`, `OUTBID`, `INSUFFICIENT_FAAB`, `ROSTER_FULL`, `ALREADY_ROSTERED`, `DROP_MISSING`.

**Trades.** A trade can move players, future picks, and FAAB. Seeded settings use commissioner review, a 24-hour window, a deadline at week 18, and pick trading enabled.

**Playoffs.** Six teams. Seeds 1 and 2 have a bye in week 15. Seed 1 then plays the winner of 4 vs 5; seed 2 plays the winner of 3 vs 6. A tie goes to the higher seed (`lib/playoff-bracket.ts`).

**Draft.** `Draft` / `DraftSlot` is the live snake draft. `DraftPick` is the tradable future-pick asset. They are separate tables.

## Scoring

Matchup totals and `PlayerGameStat.fantasyPoints` use `scoreGameStat` in `lib/scoring.ts`. Weights come from `League.scoringSettings`, filled in by `DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING` when a key is missing:

| Skater | Pts | Goalie | Pts |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: |
| Goal | 3 | Win | 4 |
| Assist | 2 | Save | 0.2 |
| Shot | 0.2 | Goal against | -1 |
| Hit | 0.2 | Shutout | 3 |
| Block | 0.2 | | |

The commissioner can change those weights. `rescoreAllStats` rewrites stored fantasy points after a change.

Player cards, season totals, and projections use `calculateSkaterFPTS` and `calculateGoalieFPTS` in `lib/hockey-data.ts`. That formula is fixed (shots 0.3, hits 0.25, blocks 0.35, plus power-play points, short-handed goals, and game-winning goals) and does not read league settings. Change the function that actually feeds the screen you are looking at.

## Auth

`POST /api/auth/login` checks the manager's PIN and sets an HTTP-only cookie named `dynasty_manager` for 30 days. The payload is `{ managerId, teamId, handle, teamName, isCommissioner }`. `lib/auth-session.ts` reads it. Logging out is `DELETE /api/auth/session`.

## NHL sync and waivers jobs

Both cron routes accept `Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET`, `?secret=`, or a signed-in commissioner.

| Route | When it runs | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /api/cron/sync` | GitHub Actions every 5 minutes from 23:00–05:00 UTC (`.github/workflows/nhl-sync.yml`) | Pulls the NHL schedule and box scores, locks lineups, and recomputes matchup scores. `?backfill=1` covers the season so far; otherwise it syncs last week, this week, and next week |
| `GET /api/cron/waivers` | Vercel cron Monday at 04:00, 05:00, and 12:00 UTC (`vercel.json`) | Processes due FAAB claims once Monday midnight has passed and every game that week is final |

`lib/services/nhl-sync.ts` talks to the NHL API. `lib/services/transactions.ts` owns waiver processing, trades, and roster moves.

## API routes

All routes return `NextResponse.json` with an explicit status.

| Route | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/session` | PIN login and the current session |
| `/api/roster/move`, `/api/roster/week` | Lineup edits and a frozen week |
| `/api/players`, `/api/waivers` | Player pool and FAAB claims |
| `/api/trades` | Offers, assets, accept / reject |
| `/api/schedule`, `/api/team-stats` | Week schedule and scoring |
| `/api/draft` | Live draft room |
| `/api/activity` | League transaction feed |
| `/api/chat`, `/api/messages` | League chat and direct messages |
| `/api/news`, `/api/headshot` | News and player photos |
| `/api/teams/settings` | Team name and logo |
| `/api/admin/league-settings`, `/api/admin/roles` | Commissioner controls |

## Where things live

```
app/page.tsx                 Server page: session, roster, standings, schedule
app/dashboard-client.tsx     The four tabs and client state
components/hockey/           Lineup, matchup, market, draft, chat, settings
components/auth/pin-gate.tsx PIN screen
lib/scoring.ts               League scoring used for matchups
lib/hockey-data.ts           Roster shapes, display scoring, seed fixtures
lib/season-calendar.ts       Monday–Sunday week math
lib/services/                NHL sync, transactions, locks, draft, week lineups

```

import { NextResponse } from "next/server"
import { getManagerSession } from "@/lib/auth-session"

export async function GET() {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  return NextResponse.json({ authenticated: Boolean(session), isCommissioner: session?.isCommissioner ?? false, user: session }, { status: 200 })
}

export async function DELETE() {
  const response = NextResponse.json({ success: true })
  response.cookies.set("dynasty_manager", "", {
    httpOnly: true,
    sameSite: "lax",
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
    path: "/",
    maxAge: 0,
  })
  return response
}

<file path="app/api/headshot/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server"
import fs from "node:fs"
import path from "node:path"

export const runtime = "nodejs"

// Resolved headshots, including NHL search misses that are not in the local file.
const idCache = new Map<string, string>()
let nhlIdByName: Map<string, number> | null = null

function normalizeName(value: string): string {
  return value.normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ").trim()
}

function loadNhlIdByName(): Map<string, number> | null {
  if (nhlIdByName) return nhlIdByName
  const filePath = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "data", "nhl-players.json")
  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return null
  const players = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8")) as Array<{ name?: string; nhlId?: number }>
  const index = new Map<string, number>()
  for (const player of players) {
    const nhlId = player.nhlId
    if (!player.name || nhlId == null || !Number.isFinite(nhlId)) continue
    const key = normalizeName(player.name)
    if (!index.has(key)) index.set(key, nhlId)
  }
  nhlIdByName = index
  return index
}

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url)
  const name = searchParams.get("name")?.trim()

  if (!name) {
    return new NextResponse(null, { status: 404 })
  }

  const cleanName = normalizeName(name)

  if (idCache.has(cleanName)) {
    const cachedId = idCache.get(cleanName)!
    return NextResponse.redirect(`https://assets.nhle.com/mugs/nhl/latest/${cachedId}.png`, {
      headers: { "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=604800, stale-while-revalidate=86400" },
    })
  }

  const indexedId = loadNhlIdByName()?.get(cleanName)
  if (indexedId != null) {
    const playerId = String(indexedId)
    idCache.set(cleanName, playerId)
    return NextResponse.redirect(`https://assets.nhle.com/mugs/nhl/latest/${playerId}.png`, {
      headers: { "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=604800, stale-while-revalidate=86400" },
    })
  }

  try {
    const nhlRes = await fetch(
      `https://search.d3.nhle.com/api/v1/search/player?culture=en-us&limit=1&q=${encodeURIComponent(cleanName)}&active=true`,
      { headers: { Accept: "application/json", "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0" }, next: { revalidate: 86400 } }
    )

    if (nhlRes.ok) {
      const data = await nhlRes.json()
      const player = data?.[0]
      if (player?.playerId) {
        idCache.set(cleanName, String(player.playerId))
        return NextResponse.redirect(`https://assets.nhle.com/mugs/nhl/latest/${player.playerId}.png`, {
          headers: { "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=604800, stale-while-revalidate=86400" },
        })
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // The generic portrait below is the intentional fallback when NHL lookup fails.
  }

  return new NextResponse(null, { status: 404 })
}
</file>

<file path="app/api/roster/move/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server"
import { SlotType } from "@prisma/client"
import { updateRosterPlacement } from "@/lib/services/transactions"
import { getManagerSession } from "@/lib/auth-session"

export const runtime = "nodejs"

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication required" }, { status: 401 })
  try {
    const body = await request.json() as { teamId?: string; playerId?: number; targetSlot?: string; targetPlayerId?: number; week?: number }
    if (!body.teamId || !Number.isInteger(body.playerId) || !body.targetSlot || !Object.values(SlotType).includes(body.targetSlot as SlotType)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "teamId, playerId, and a valid targetSlot are required" }, { status: 400 })
    }
    if (body.teamId !== session.teamId) return NextResponse.json({ error: "You can only edit your own lineup" }, { status: 403 })
    if (body.targetPlayerId !== undefined && !Number.isInteger(body.targetPlayerId)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "targetPlayerId must be an integer" }, { status: 400 })
    if (body.week !== undefined && !Number.isInteger(body.week)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "week must be an integer" }, { status: 400 })
    const roster = await updateRosterPlacement(body.teamId, body.playerId as number, body.targetSlot as SlotType, body.targetPlayerId, body.week)
    return NextResponse.json({ roster })
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    console.error("Roster move failed", error)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Roster move failed" }, { status: 400 })
  }
}

"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { ArrowLeft, Delete, LockKeyhole } from "lucide-react"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

export type PinGateTeam = {
  id: string
  name: string
  managerId: string
  managerName: string
  managerHandle: string
  isCommissioner?: boolean
  avatarUrl?: string | null
}

export function PinGate({ teams }: { teams: PinGateTeam[] }) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<PinGateTeam | null>(null)
  const [pin, setPin] = useState("")
  const [error, setError] = useState("")
  const [shaking, setShaking] = useState(false)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const submittedPin = useRef("")

  useEffect(() => {
    if (pin.length !== 4 || !selected || loading || submittedPin.current === pin) return
    submittedPin.current = pin
    setLoading(true)
    void fetch("/api/auth/login", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ managerId: selected.managerId, pin }),
    })
      .then(async (response) => {
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(((await response.json()) as { error?: string }).error ?? "Incorrect PIN.")
        window.location.reload()
      })
      .catch((reason: unknown) => {
        setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : "Incorrect PIN.")
        setPin("")
        submittedPin.current = ""
        setShaking(true)
        window.setTimeout(() => setShaking(false), 450)
      })
      .finally(() => setLoading(false))
  }, [loading, pin, selected])

  const addDigit = (digit: string) => {
    if (loading || pin.length >= 4) return
    setError("")
    submittedPin.current = ""
    setPin((current) => current + digit)
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#050812] px-4 py-8 text-white">
      <div className="mx-auto flex min-h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] w-full max-w-[430px] flex-col justify-center">
        <header className="mb-8 text-center">
          <div className="mx-auto flex size-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-[#19ffff]/30 bg-[#102642] text-[#19ffff] shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(25,255,255,0.12)]">
            <LockKeyhole className="size-7" />
          </div>
          <p className="mt-5 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-[#19ffff]">John Scott Dynasty</p>
          <h1 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black">Manager Access</h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-[#8ba0c7]">Choose your team to unlock the league.</p>
        </header>

        {!selected ? (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            {teams.map((team) => (
              <button
                key={team.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => { setSelected(team); setError("") }}
                className="flex min-h-24 items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-[#1b2b46] bg-[#0d1424] p-3 text-left transition hover:border-[#19ffff]/60 hover:bg-[#102642] active:scale-[0.98]"
              >
                {team.avatarUrl ? <img src={team.avatarUrl} alt="" className="size-10 rounded-full object-cover" /> : <span className="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#172338] text-xs font-black text-[#19ffff]">{team.managerName.split(/\s+/).map((part) => part[0]).join("").slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}</span>}
                <span className="min-w-0"><b className="block truncate text-xs">{team.name}</b><small className="mt-1 block truncate text-xs text-[#6d86ab]">@{team.managerHandle}</small>{team.isCommissioner && <small className="mt-1 inline-block rounded-full bg-amber-400/15 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-black text-amber-300">👑 Commish</small>}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <section className="rounded-3xl border border-[#1b2b46] bg-[#0d1424] p-5">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => { setSelected(null); setPin(""); setError(""); submittedPin.current = "" }} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]"><ArrowLeft className="size-4" /> Change team</button>
            <div className="mt-6 text-center">
              <h2 className="text-xl font-black">{selected.name}</h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">PIN for @{selected.managerHandle}</p>
              <div className={cn("mt-6 flex justify-center gap-3", shaking && "animate-[shake_0.45s_ease-in-out]")} aria-label="PIN progress">
                {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((index) => <span key={index} className={cn("size-3 rounded-full border", pin.length > index ? "border-[#19ffff] bg-[#19ffff] shadow-[0_0_10px_#19ffff]" : "border-[#5e7090]")} />)}
              </div>
              <p className="mt-4 min-h-5 text-xs text-rose-300">{error}</p>
              <div className="mx-auto mt-4 grid max-w-[280px] grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                {["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "8", "9"].map((digit) => <button key={digit} type="button" onClick={() => addDigit(digit)} className="flex size-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-[#263858] bg-[#101829] text-xl font-black hover:border-[#19ffff] active:scale-90">{digit}</button>)}
                <span />
                <button type="button" onClick={() => addDigit("0")} className="flex size-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-[#263858] bg-[#101829] text-xl font-black hover:border-[#19ffff] active:scale-90">0</button>
                <button type="button" aria-label="Backspace" onClick={() => { setError(""); submittedPin.current = ""; setPin((current) => current.slice(0, -1)) }} className="flex size-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-[#263858] bg-[#101829] text-[#8ba0c7] hover:border-[#19ffff] active:scale-90"><Delete className="size-5" /></button>
              </div>
              <p className="mt-6 text-xs text-[#6d86ab]">Default league PIN is 1234</p>
            </div>
          </section>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  )
}

<file path="components/hockey/draft-room.tsx">
"use client"

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react"
import { SlidersHorizontal, X } from "lucide-react"
import { Sheet, SheetContent } from "@/components/ui/sheet"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import type { MarketPlayer } from "@/lib/hockey-data"

type DraftSlotView = {
  pickNumber: number
  round: number
  slot: number
  teamId: string
  teamName: string
  playerId: number | null
  playerName: string | null
  position: string | null
  nhlTeam: string | null
}

type DraftOrder = "LINEAR" | "SNAKE"

type DraftView = {
  id: string
  type: DraftOrder
  status: "SCHEDULED" | "LIVE" | "COMPLETE"
  rounds: number
  timerSeconds: number
  startAt: string
  paused: boolean
  remainingSeconds: number
  yourTurn: boolean
  onClockTeamId: string | null
  teams: { id: string; name: string; slot: number }[]
  queue: number[]
  slots: DraftSlotView[]
}

type DraftPayload = {
  scheduled: { startAt: string; rounds: number; timerSeconds: number; type: DraftOrder } | null
  draft: DraftView | null
}

const positionBar: Record<string, string> = {
  C: "bg-[#1d4ed8]",
  LW: "bg-[#0d9488]",
  RW: "bg-[#0d9488]",
  W: "bg-[#0d9488]",
  F: "bg-[#7c3aed]",
  D: "bg-[#b45309]",
  G: "bg-[#0284c7]",
}

function shortName(name: string) {
  const parts = name.trim().split(/\s+/)
  return parts.length < 2 ? name : `${parts[0][0]}. ${parts.slice(1).join(" ")}`
}

function clockLabel(seconds: number) {
  const safe = Math.max(0, seconds)
  return `${Math.floor(safe / 60)}:${String(safe % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`
}

function whenLabel(iso: string) {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric", hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" }).format(new Date(iso))
}

export function DraftCard({ players, isCommissioner }: { players: MarketPlayer[]; isCommissioner: boolean }) {
  const [payload, setPayload] = useState<DraftPayload | null>(null)
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [receivedAt, setReceivedAt] = useState(Date.now())
  const [now, setNow] = useState(Date.now())

  const load = (ensure: boolean) => {
    const query = ensure ? "?ensure=1" : ""
    return fetch(`/api/draft${query}`, { cache: "no-store" })
      .then((response) => response.ok ? response.json() as Promise<DraftPayload> : null)
      .then((next) => {
        if (!next) return
        setPayload(next)
        setReceivedAt(Date.now())
      })
      .catch(() => undefined)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    void load(false)
    const poll = setInterval(() => void load(open), open ? 3000 : 15000)
    const tick = setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 1000)
    return () => { clearInterval(poll); clearInterval(tick) }
  }, [open])

  const scheduled = payload?.scheduled
  const draft = payload?.draft ?? null
  if (!scheduled && !draft) return null
  const live = draft?.status === "LIVE"
  const startAt = draft?.startAt ?? scheduled?.startAt
  const rounds = draft?.rounds ?? scheduled?.rounds ?? 0
  const draftType = draft?.type ?? scheduled?.type
  const elapsed = Math.floor((now - receivedAt) / 1000)
  const remaining = draft && live && !draft.paused ? Math.max(0, draft.remainingSeconds - elapsed) : draft?.remainingSeconds ?? 0

  return (
    <>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-[#19ffff]/25 bg-[#0d1424] px-4 py-3 shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_rgba(24,48,71,0.8)]">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-xs font-black tracking-[0.18em] text-[#19ffff]">DRAFT</p>
          {live ? (
            <p className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-white"><span className="size-2 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-[#ff3b6b]" />Draft is live</p>
          ) : draft?.status === "COMPLETE" ? (
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold text-white">Draft complete</p>
          ) : (
            <p className="mt-1 truncate text-sm font-bold text-white">{startAt ? whenLabel(startAt) : "Scheduled"}</p>
          )}
          <p className="text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">{draftType === "LINEAR" ? "Linear" : "Snake"} · {rounds} rounds</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => { setOpen(true); void load(true) }} className={cn("shrink-0 rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold", live ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "border border-[#19ffff] text-[#19ffff]")}>Draft room</button>
      </div>
      <DraftRoom open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} draft={draft} players={players} isCommissioner={isCommissioner} remaining={remaining} onChange={(next) => { setPayload((current) => ({ scheduled: current?.scheduled ?? null, draft: next })); setReceivedAt(Date.now()) }} />
    </>
  )
}

function DraftRoom({ open, onOpenChange, draft, players, isCommissioner, remaining, onChange }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void; draft: DraftView | null; players: MarketPlayer[]; isCommissioner: boolean; remaining: number; onChange: (draft: DraftView) => void }) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"board" | "players" | "queue">("board")
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("")
  const [position, setPosition] = useState("ALL")
  const [armed, setArmed] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [settingsOpen, setSettingsOpen] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)

  const act = async (body: { action: string; playerId?: number; timerSeconds?: number }) => {
    setBusy(true)
    setError(null)
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/draft", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body) })
      const payload = await response.json() as { draft?: DraftView; error?: string }
      if (!response.ok || !payload.draft) {
        setError(payload.error ?? "Draft action failed")
        return
      }
      onChange(payload.draft)
      if (body.action === "pick") setArmed(null)
    } finally {
      setBusy(false)
    }
  }

  const drafted = useMemo(() => new Set((draft?.slots ?? []).map((slot) => slot.playerId).filter((id): id is number => id != null)), [draft])
  const current = draft?.slots?.find((slot) => slot.playerId == null) ?? null
  const round = current?.round ?? draft?.rounds ?? 1
  const roundSlots = (draft?.slots ?? []).filter((slot) => slot.round === round).sort((a, b) => a.pickNumber - b.pickNumber)
  const available = players.filter((player) => {
    if (player.nhlId == null || drafted.has(player.nhlId)) return false
    const matchesPosition = position === "ALL" || player.position === position || (position === "W" && (player.position === "LW" || player.position === "RW"))
    return matchesPosition && player.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.trim().toLowerCase())
  }).slice(0, 80)
  const queued = (draft?.queue ?? []).map((id) => players.find((player) => player.nhlId === id)).filter((player): player is MarketPlayer => player != null)

  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <SheetContent side="bottom" spring="snappy" className="relative mx-auto flex h-dvh max-h-dvh max-w-[430px] flex-col gap-0 rounded-none border-[#1a263d] bg-[#070a12] p-0 text-white">
        <header className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between border-b border-[#172338] px-2 py-2">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)} className="rounded-full px-3 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">Exit</button>
          <div className="min-w-0 text-center">
            <p className="text-sm font-black">{draft?.status === "COMPLETE" ? "Draft complete" : current ? `Round ${current.round} · Pick ${current.pickNumber}` : "Draft"}</p>
            {draft?.status === "LIVE" && <p className="text-xs font-bold tabular-nums text-[#19ffff]">{draft.paused ? "Paused" : clockLabel(remaining)}</p>}
            {draft?.status === "SCHEDULED" && <p className="text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">Not started</p>}
          </div>
          {isCommissioner ? (
            <button type="button" aria-label="Draft settings" onClick={() => setSettingsOpen(true)} className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#8ba0c7]"><SlidersHorizontal className="size-5" /></button>
          ) : <span className="w-11" />}
        </header>

        {draft && (
          <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-2 overflow-x-auto border-b border-[#172338] px-3 py-2">
            {roundSlots.map((slot) => (
              <div key={slot.pickNumber} className={cn("w-16 shrink-0 rounded-lg border px-1.5 py-1.5 text-center", slot.pickNumber === current?.pickNumber ? "border-[#19ffff]" : "border-[#172338]")}>
                <p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-white">{shortName(slot.teamName)}</p>
                <p className="truncate text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">{slot.playerName ? shortName(slot.playerName) : slot.pickNumber}</p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="flex shrink-0 border-b border-[#172338]">
          {(["board", "players", "queue"] as const).map((item) => (
            <button key={item} type="button" onClick={() => setTab(item)} className={cn("flex-1 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold capitalize", tab === item ? "text-white" : "text-[#5e7090]")}>{item}</button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
          {!draft && <p className="p-6 text-center text-sm text-[#8ba0c7]">The draft board is not ready.</p>}
          {draft && tab === "board" && <DraftBoard draft={draft} currentPick={current?.pickNumber ?? null} />}
          {draft && tab === "players" && (
            <div>
              <div className="sticky top-0 space-y-2 bg-[#070a12] px-3 py-3">
                <input value={query} onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)} placeholder="Search players" className="w-full rounded-xl border border-[#263858] bg-[#101829] px-3 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none" />
                <div className="flex gap-2">{["ALL", "C", "W", "D", "G"].map((value) => <button key={value} type="button" onClick={() => setPosition(value)} className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold", position === value ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>{value}</button>)}</div>
              </div>
              <ul>
                {available.map((player) => (
                  <li key={player.nhlId}>
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => setArmed(player.nhlId ?? null)} className={cn("flex w-full items-center gap-3 border-b border-[#172338] px-3 py-3 text-left", armed === player.nhlId && "bg-[#10283a]")}>
                      <span className={cn("flex h-7 min-w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md px-1 text-xs font-black text-white", positionBar[player.position])}>{player.position}</span>
                      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <span className="block truncate text-sm font-bold">{player.name}</span>
                        <span className="block text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">{player.team}</span>
                      </span>
                      <span role="button" tabIndex={0} onClick={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); if (player.nhlId == null) return; void act({ action: draft.queue.includes(player.nhlId) ? "queue-remove" : "queue-add", playerId: player.nhlId }) }} className="text-xs font-bold text-[#19ffff]">{player.nhlId != null && draft.queue.includes(player.nhlId) ? "Queued" : "Queue"}</span>
                    </button>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}
          {draft && tab === "queue" && (
            <ul>
              {queued.length === 0 && <li className="p-6 text-center text-sm text-[#8ba0c7]">Your queue is empty.</li>}
              {queued.map((player) => (
                <li key={player.nhlId} className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-[#172338] px-3 py-3">
                  <span className={cn("flex h-7 min-w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md px-1 text-xs font-black text-white", positionBar[player.position])}>{player.position}</span>
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-sm font-bold">{player.name}</span>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => void act({ action: "queue-remove", playerId: player.nhlId })} className="text-xs font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">Remove</button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </div>

        {draft && tab === "players" && (
          <div className="shrink-0 border-t border-[#172338] bg-[#070a12] px-4 py-3">
            {error && <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-bold text-rose-300">{error}</p>}
            <button type="button" disabled={busy || armed == null || draft.status !== "LIVE" || draft.paused || (!draft.yourTurn && !isCommissioner)} onClick={() => armed != null && void act({ action: "pick", playerId: armed })} className="h-12 w-full rounded-full bg-[#19ffff] text-sm font-bold text-[#080c14] disabled:opacity-40">
              {draft.status !== "LIVE" ? "Waiting for the draft to start" : draft.yourTurn || isCommissioner ? "Draft" : "Waiting"}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {settingsOpen && isCommissioner && draft && (
          <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-10 rounded-t-3xl border-t border-[#1a263d] bg-[#070a12] p-4">
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h2 className="text-base font-black">Draft settings</h2>
              <button type="button" aria-label="Close draft settings" onClick={() => setSettingsOpen(false)} className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#8ba0c7]"><X className="size-5" /></button>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => void act({ action: "start" })} className="h-12 rounded-xl bg-[#19ffff] text-sm font-bold text-[#080c14]">Start now</button>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => void act({ action: draft.paused ? "resume" : "pause" })} className="h-12 rounded-xl bg-[#172338] text-sm font-bold">{draft.paused ? "Resume" : "Pause"}</button>
            </div>
            <p className="mt-4 text-xs font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">Timer</p>
            <div className="mt-2 flex gap-2">
              {[60, 90, 120, 180].map((seconds) => (
                <button key={seconds} type="button" onClick={() => void act({ action: "timer", timerSeconds: seconds })} className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold", draft.timerSeconds === seconds ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>{seconds}s</button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  )
}

function DraftBoard({ draft, currentPick }: { draft: DraftView; currentPick: number | null }) {
  const columns = [...draft.teams].sort((a, b) => a.slot - b.slot)
  const rounds = Array.from({ length: draft.rounds }, (_, index) => index + 1)
  return (
    <div className="overflow-x-auto p-3">
      <div className="flex gap-1">
        <div className="w-8 shrink-0" />
        {columns.map((team) => <div key={team.slot} className="w-[4.75rem] shrink-0 truncate px-1 text-center text-xs font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">{shortName(team.name)}</div>)}
      </div>
      {rounds.map((round) => (
        <div key={round} className="mt-1 flex gap-1">
          <div className="flex w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold text-[#5e7090]">{round}</div>
          {columns.map((team) => {
            const cell = draft.slots.find((slot) => slot.round === round && slot.slot === team.slot)
            if (!cell) return <div key={team.slot} className="h-14 w-[4.75rem]" />
            return (
              <div key={team.slot} className={cn("relative flex h-14 w-[4.75rem] flex-col justify-center rounded-md bg-[#101829] px-2", cell.pickNumber === currentPick && "ring-2 ring-[#19ffff]")}>
                {cell.position && <span className={cn("absolute inset-y-1 left-1 w-1 rounded-full", positionBar[cell.position] ?? "bg-[#5e7090]")} />}
                <span className={cn("truncate pl-2 text-xs font-bold", cell.playerName ? "text-white" : "text-[#5e7090]")}>{cell.playerName ? shortName(cell.playerName) : cell.pickNumber}</span>
                {cell.teamId !== team.id && <span className="truncate pl-2 text-[10px] font-bold leading-tight text-[#19ffff]">{shortName(cell.teamName)}</span>}
              </div>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
</file>

<file path="components/hockey/league-settings-panel.tsx">
"use client"

import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { ChevronRight, Crown, LockKeyhole, LogOut, RefreshCw, Shield, Swords } from "lucide-react"
import { CommissionerSettingsDialog, defaultLeagueSettings, mergeLeagueSettings, type LeagueSettings } from "@/components/hockey/commissioner-settings-dialog"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

type Manager = { id: string; name: string; handle: string; isCommissioner: boolean }
type LeagueInfo = LeagueSettings & { name?: string; rosterSize?: number }

const SCORING_LABELS: Array<[string, string]> = [["goal", "G"], ["assist", "A"], ["shot", "SOG"], ["hit", "HIT"], ["block", "BLK"], ["ppp", "PPP"], ["shg", "SHG"], ["gwg", "GWG"], ["plusMinus", "+/-"], ["win", "W"], ["save", "SV"], ["goalsAgainst", "GA"], ["shutout", "SO"], ["overtimeLoss", "OTL"]]

function pinDigits(value: string) {
  return value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 4)
}

function Row({ label, value }: { label: string; value: React.ReactNode }) {
  return <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-1.5 text-xs"><span className="text-[#8ba0c7]">{label}</span><span className="text-right font-bold text-white">{value}</span></div>
}

function Card({ title, icon, children }: { title: string; icon?: React.ReactNode; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return <section className="rounded-xl border border-[#172338] bg-[#0f1829] p-3"><h3 className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5e7090]">{icon}{title}</h3><div className="divide-y divide-[#172338]">{children}</div></section>
}

export function LeagueSettingsPanel({ managerHandle, isCommissioner, teamName, rank, faab, waiverPriority }: { managerHandle?: string; isCommissioner?: boolean; teamName: string; rank: number; faab?: number; waiverPriority?: number }) {
  const [league, setLeague] = useState<LeagueInfo>(defaultLeagueSettings)
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false)
  const [managers, setManagers] = useState<Manager[]>([])
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ ok: boolean; text: string } | null>(null)
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [rulebookOpen, setRulebookOpen] = useState(false)
  const [pinOpen, setPinOpen] = useState(false)
  const [currentPin, setCurrentPin] = useState("")
  const [newPin, setNewPin] = useState("")
  const [confirmPin, setConfirmPin] = useState("")
  const [pinBusy, setPinBusy] = useState(false)
  const [pinStatus, setPinStatus] = useState<{ ok: boolean; text: string } | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false
    fetch("/api/admin/league-settings", { cache: "no-store" })
      .then((response) => response.ok ? response.json() as Promise<Partial<LeagueInfo>> : Promise.reject(new Error(`Settings failed (${response.status})`)))
      .then((data) => { if (!cancelled) { setLeague({ ...mergeLeagueSettings(defaultLeagueSettings, data), name: data.name, rosterSize: data.rosterSize }); setLoaded(true) } })
      .catch((error: unknown) => console.error("Failed to load league settings", error))
    return () => { cancelled = true }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isCommissioner) return
    let cancelled = false
    fetch("/api/admin/roles", { cache: "no-store" })
      .then((response) => response.ok ? response.json() as Promise<{ managers?: Manager[] }> : Promise.reject(new Error(`Role list failed (${response.status})`)))
      .then((data) => { if (!cancelled) setManagers(data.managers ?? []) })
      .catch((error: unknown) => console.error("Failed to load commissioner roles", error))
    return () => { cancelled = true }
  }, [isCommissioner])

  const run = async (endpoint: string, label: string) => {
    setBusy(label)
    setStatus(null)
    try {
      const response = await fetch(endpoint, { method: "POST" })
      const data = await response.json().catch(() => null) as { message?: string } | null
      setStatus({ ok: response.ok, text: response.ok ? (data?.message ?? `${label} complete`) : `${label} failed (${response.status})` })
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      console.error(`Commissioner action failed: ${label}`, error)
      setStatus({ ok: false, text: `${label} failed` })
    } finally {
      setBusy(null)
    }
  }

  const setRole = async (manager: Manager, value: boolean) => {
    setBusy(manager.id)
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/admin/roles", { method: "PATCH", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ targetManagerId: manager.id, isCommissioner: value }) })
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Role update failed (${response.status})`)
      setManagers((current) => current.map((item) => item.id === manager.id ? { ...item, isCommissioner: value } : item))
      setStatus({ ok: true, text: `@${manager.handle} is ${value ? "now a co-commissioner" : "no longer a commissioner"}` })
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      console.error("Role update failed", error)
      setStatus({ ok: false, text: "Role update failed" })
    } finally {
      setBusy(null)
    }
  }

  const changePin = async () => {
    if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(currentPin) || !/^\d{4}$/.test(newPin)) {
      setPinStatus({ ok: false, text: "Current PIN and new PIN must be 4 digits." })
      return
    }
    if (newPin !== confirmPin) {
      setPinStatus({ ok: false, text: "New PIN and confirmation do not match." })
      return
    }
    setPinBusy(true)
    setPinStatus(null)
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/auth/login", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ currentPin, newPin }),
      })
      const data = await response.json().catch(() => null) as { error?: string } | null
      if (!response.ok) {
        setPinStatus({ ok: false, text: data?.error ?? "Could not change PIN." })
        return
      }
      setCurrentPin("")
      setNewPin("")
      setConfirmPin("")
      setPinStatus({ ok: true, text: "PIN updated." })
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      console.error("PIN update failed", error)
      setPinStatus({ ok: false, text: "Could not change PIN." })
    } finally {
      setPinBusy(false)
    }
  }

  const positions = league.rosterPositions
  const capacity = league.rosterSize ?? Object.values(positions).reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0)
  const waiverType = String(league.waiverSettings.type ?? "FAAB")
  const draft = league.draftSettings
  const draftDate = new Date(String(draft.scheduledDate ?? ""))

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3 p-4">
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#1c2c48] bg-gradient-to-br from-[#12203a] to-[#0d1424] p-3.5">
        <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5e7090]">Signed in as</p>
        <div className="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between gap-2"><p className="truncate text-sm font-black text-white">{teamName}</p>{isCommissioner && <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-amber-400/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-black uppercase text-amber-300"><Crown className="size-3" />Commissioner</span>}</div>
        <p className="text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">@{managerHandle ?? "manager"}</p>
        <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-center">
          {[["Rank", rank > 0 ? `#${rank}` : "-"], ["FAAB", `$${faab ?? 0}`], ["Waiver", waiverPriority ? `#${waiverPriority}` : "-"]].map(([label, value]) => <div key={label} className="rounded-lg bg-[#0a1120] py-2"><p className="text-sm font-black tabular-nums text-[#19ffff]">{value}</p><p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-[#5e7090]">{label}</p></div>)}
        </div>
      </div>

      <section className="rounded-xl border border-[#172338] bg-[#0f1829] p-3">
        <button type="button" aria-expanded={pinOpen} onClick={() => setPinOpen((open) => !open)} className="flex w-full items-center justify-between text-left">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5e7090]"><LockKeyhole className="size-3.5" />Change PIN</span>
          <ChevronRight className={cn("size-4 text-[#5e7090] transition", pinOpen && "rotate-90")} />
        </button>
        {pinOpen && (
          <form className="mt-3 space-y-2" onSubmit={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); void changePin() }}>
            {([["current-pin", "Current PIN", currentPin, setCurrentPin, "current-password"], ["new-pin", "New PIN", newPin, setNewPin, "new-password"], ["confirm-pin", "Confirm PIN", confirmPin, setConfirmPin, "new-password"]] as const).map(([id, label, value, setValue, autoComplete]) => (
              <label key={id} htmlFor={id} className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">{label}
                <input id={id} type="password" inputMode="numeric" autoComplete={autoComplete} maxLength={4} pattern="[0-9]{4}" value={value} disabled={pinBusy} onChange={(event) => { setValue(pinDigits(event.target.value)); setPinStatus(null) }} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-[#263858] bg-[#0a1120] px-3 py-2 text-sm font-bold tracking-[0.3em] text-white outline-none focus:border-[#19ffff] disabled:opacity-50" />
              </label>
            ))}
            <button type="submit" disabled={pinBusy} className="w-full rounded-lg bg-[#19ffff]/15 py-2 text-xs font-black text-[#19ffff] transition hover:bg-[#19ffff]/25 disabled:opacity-50">Update PIN</button>
            {pinStatus && <p role="status" className={cn("text-xs font-bold", pinStatus.ok ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-rose-400")}>{pinStatus.text}</p>}
          </form>
        )}
      </section>

      {isCommissioner && (
        <section className="space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/30 bg-[#161a29] p-3">
          <h3 className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-400"><Shield className="size-3.5" />Commissioner tools</h3>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setRulebookOpen(true)} className="flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 p-3 text-left text-xs font-bold text-amber-300 transition hover:bg-amber-500/20"><span>Open Commissioner Rulebook &amp; Settings</span><ChevronRight className="size-4" /></button>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <button type="button" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void run("/api/cron/sync", "NHL score sync")} className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-[#263858] bg-[#0d1424] py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-[#8ba0c7] transition hover:text-white disabled:opacity-50"><RefreshCw className={cn("size-3.5", busy === "NHL score sync" && "animate-spin")} />Force NHL sync</button>
            <button type="button" disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void run("/api/cron/waivers", "Waiver processing")} className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-[#263858] bg-[#0d1424] py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-[#8ba0c7] transition hover:text-white disabled:opacity-50"><Swords className="size-3.5" />Run waivers</button>
          </div>
          <div className="border-t border-amber-500/20 pt-2">
            <p className="mb-1 text-xs font-black uppercase text-amber-300">Co-commissioners</p>
            {managers.length === 0 && <p className="text-xs text-[#5e7090]">Loading managers...</p>}
            <ul className="divide-y divide-[#1f2638]">
              {managers.map((manager) => {
                const self = manager.handle === managerHandle
                return (
                  <li key={manager.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 py-1.5">
                    <span className="min-w-0 truncate text-xs text-white">@{manager.handle}{manager.isCommissioner && <Crown className="ml-1 inline size-3 text-amber-400" aria-label="Commissioner" />}</span>
                    <button type="button" disabled={self || busy === manager.id} onClick={() => void setRole(manager, !manager.isCommissioner)} className={cn("shrink-0 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-black transition disabled:opacity-40", manager.isCommissioner ? "bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-300" : "bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300")}>{self ? "You" : manager.isCommissioner ? "Revoke" : "Grant"}</button>
                  </li>
                )
              })}
            </ul>
          </div>
          {status && <p role="status" className={cn("text-xs font-bold", status.ok ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-rose-400")}>{status.text}</p>}
        </section>
      )}

      <div className={cn("space-y-3 transition-opacity", !loaded && "opacity-60")}>
        <Card title="Roster">
          <Row label="Starting lineup" value={["C", "W", "F", "D", "G"].map((key) => `${positions[key] ?? 0} ${key}`).join(" / ")} />
          <Row label="Bench" value={positions.BN ?? 0} />
          <Row label="Roster size" value={capacity} />
          <Row label="Taxi squad" value={`${league.taxiSlots} spots, under ${league.taxiMaxGames} NHL GP`} />
          <Row label="Lineup lock" value={league.lineupLockMode === "DAILY" ? "Daily, per player game" : "Weekly, first game of week"} />
          <Row label="Injured reserve" value={`${league.irSlots} (pure IR only)`} />
        </Card>
        <Card title="Scoring">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5 py-2">
            {SCORING_LABELS.map(([key, label]) => <div key={key} className="rounded-lg bg-[#0a1120] px-2 py-1.5 text-center"><p className={cn("text-xs font-black tabular-nums", Number(league.scoringSettings[key] ?? 0) < 0 ? "text-rose-400" : Number(league.scoringSettings[key] ?? 0) === 0 ? "text-[#5e7090]" : "text-[#19ffff]")}>{Number(league.scoringSettings[key] ?? 0)}</p><p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#5e7090]">{label}</p></div>)}
          </div>
        </Card>
        <Card title="Waivers & trades">
          <Row label="Waiver system" value={waiverType === "FAAB" ? `FAAB, $${String(league.waiverSettings.faabBudget ?? 100)} budget` : "Rolling priority"} />
          <Row label="Waiver hold" value={`${String(league.waiverSettings.holdHours ?? 48)}h`} />
          <Row label="Waiver run" value="Monday midnight, after the final game" />
          <Row label="Trade review" value={String(league.tradeSettings.reviewType) === "VOTE" ? "League vote" : "Commissioner"} />
          <Row label="Trade deadline" value={`Week ${String(league.tradeSettings.deadlineWeek ?? 18)}`} />
          <Row label="Pick trading" value={league.tradeSettings.allowPickTrading === false ? "Off" : "On"} />
        </Card>
        <Card title="Draft">
          <Row label="Type" value={String(draft.type ?? "LINEAR")} />
          <Row label="Rounds" value={String(draft.rounds ?? 5)} />
          <Row label="Order" value={String(draft.orderType ?? "REVERSE_STANDINGS") === "LOTTERY" ? "Lottery" : "Reverse standings"} />
          <Row label="Scheduled" value={Number.isNaN(draftDate.getTime()) ? "TBD" : draftDate.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" })} />
        </Card>
        {!isCommissioner && <p className="rounded-lg border border-[#172338] bg-[#111c30] p-3 text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">Rules are set by the league commissioner.</p>}
      </div>

      <button type="button" onClick={async () => { await fetch("/api/auth/session", { method: "DELETE" }); window.location.reload() }} className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-rose-500/40 bg-rose-500/10 py-3 text-xs font-bold text-rose-400 transition hover:bg-rose-500/20 active:scale-95"><LogOut className="size-4" />Switch Team / Log Out</button>
      {isCommissioner && <CommissionerSettingsDialog open={rulebookOpen} onOpenChange={setRulebookOpen} />}
    </div>
  )
}

<file path="components/hockey/lineup-alerts.tsx">
import { AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, Lock } from "lucide-react"
import { TAXI_MAX_NHL_GAMES, isStarterSlot, type Player } from "@/lib/hockey-data"
import { positionFitsSlot } from "@/lib/roster-eligibility"

type Props = {
  roster: Player[]
  capacities: Record<string, number>
  irSlots: number
  lock?: { mode: "WEEKLY" | "DAILY"; locked: boolean; weekEndDate: string }
}

/** Sleeper-style lineup health check: injured starters, empty starting slots and IR players parked elsewhere. */
export function LineupAlerts({ roster, capacities, irSlots, lock }: Props) {
  const issues: string[] = []
  const starters = roster.filter((player) => isStarterSlot(player.slot))
  const injured = starters.filter((player) => player.status === "O" || player.status === "IR")
  const dtd = starters.filter((player) => player.status === "DTD")
  const emptyStarters = Object.entries(capacities).reduce((sum, [slot, capacity]) => isStarterSlot(slot as Player["slot"]) ? sum + Math.max(0, capacity - starters.filter((player) => player.slot === slot).length) : sum, 0)
  const irParked = roster.filter((player) => player.status === "IR" && player.slot !== "IR")
  const irOpen = Math.max(0, irSlots - roster.filter((player) => player.slot === "IR").length)
  const taxiViolations = roster.filter((player) => player.slot === "TAXI" && (player.nhlGamesPlayed ?? 0) >= TAXI_MAX_NHL_GAMES)
  const outOfPosition = starters.filter((player) => !positionFitsSlot(player.slot, player.position))

  if (emptyStarters > 0) issues.push(`${emptyStarters} empty starting slot${emptyStarters === 1 ? "" : "s"}`)
  if (injured.length > 0) issues.push(`${injured.map((player) => player.name).slice(0, 2).join(", ")}${injured.length > 2 ? ` +${injured.length - 2}` : ""} injured in your lineup`)
  if (dtd.length > 0) issues.push(`${dtd.length} day-to-day starter${dtd.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}`)
  if (outOfPosition.length > 0) issues.push(`${outOfPosition.map((player) => player.name).slice(0, 2).join(", ")}${outOfPosition.length > 2 ? ` +${outOfPosition.length - 2}` : ""} out of position`)
  if (taxiViolations.length > 0) issues.push(`${taxiViolations.map((player) => player.name).slice(0, 2).join(", ")}${taxiViolations.length > 2 ? ` +${taxiViolations.length - 2}` : ""} ineligible for the taxi squad (${TAXI_MAX_NHL_GAMES}+ NHL GP)`)
  if (irParked.length > 0 && irOpen > 0) issues.push(`${irParked[0].name} can move to IR`)

  const lockBanner = lock?.locked
    ? <div role="status" data-testid="lineup-lock-banner" className="mx-3 mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-sky-400/30 bg-sky-400/5 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-sky-300"><Lock className="size-4 shrink-0" />{lock.mode === "WEEKLY" ? "Starters are locked until Monday (first game of the week has started)" : "Players whose game has started are locked today"}</div>
    : null

  if (issues.length === 0) {
    return <>{lockBanner}<div role="status" className="mx-3 mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-emerald-400/20 bg-emerald-400/5 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-300"><CheckCircle2 className="size-4 shrink-0" />Lineup is set</div></>
  }
  return (
    <>
    {lockBanner}
    <div role="alert" className="mx-3 mt-3 rounded-xl border border-amber-400/30 bg-amber-400/5 px-3 py-2">
      <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wide text-amber-300"><AlertTriangle className="size-4 shrink-0" />Lineup needs attention</p>
      <ul className="mt-1 space-y-0.5 pl-6 text-xs text-[#c9b27a]">{issues.map((issue) => <li key={issue} className="list-disc">{issue}</li>)}</ul>
    </div>
    </>
  )
}

export type PlayerGridViewType = "Projections" | "Stats" | "ADP"
export type PlayerGridPeriod = "Last 7 Days" | "Last 14 Days" | "Last 30 Days" | "Season Totals" | "Season Avg / Per Game" | "This Week" | "Next 14 Days" | "Rest of Season (ROS)"

export interface PlayerGridSettings {
  viewType: PlayerGridViewType
  period: PlayerGridPeriod
  year: string
}

export function PlayerGridSettingsDialog({
  open,
  settings,
  onOpenChange,
  onApply,
}: {
  open: boolean
  settings: PlayerGridSettings
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void
  onApply: (settings: PlayerGridSettings) => void
}) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(settings)
  useEffect(() => setDraft(settings), [settings, open])
  const viewTypes: PlayerGridViewType[] = ["Projections", "Stats", "ADP"]
  const backwardPeriods: PlayerGridPeriod[] = ["Last 7 Days", "Last 14 Days", "Last 30 Days", "Season Totals", "Season Avg / Per Game"]

  const periods = draft.viewType === "Projections" ? forwardPeriods : backwardPeriods
  useEffect(() => {

    if (!valid) setDraft({ ...draft, period: draft.viewType === "Projections" ? "Next 14 Days" : "Last 14 Days" })
  }, [draft.viewType, draft.period, periods])
  const years = ["2026", "2025", "2024", "2023"]

"use client"

import { useState } from "react"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { getPlayerPhoto, type PlayerPortraitSource } from "@/lib/hockey-data"

export function PlayerPortrait({
  player,
  name,
  className,
}: {
  player?: PlayerPortraitSource
  name: string
  className?: string
}) {
  const [hasError, setHasError] = useState(false)
  const source = player ?? { name }
  const photo = getPlayerPhoto(source)
  const initials = name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .map((part) => part[0])
    .join("")
    .slice(0, 2)
    .toUpperCase()

  if (!photo || hasError) {
    return (
      <span
        className={cn(
          "flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#1b2842] text-xs font-black text-[#8ba0c7]",
          className
        )}
      >
        {initials}
      </span>
    )
  }

  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "relative flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[#1b2842]",
        className
      )}
    >
      <img
        src={photo}
        alt=""
        className="size-full scale-[1.35] object-cover object-[50%_18%]"
        onError={() => setHasError(true)}
      />
    </span>
  )
}

<file path="lib/db/leagues.ts">
import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { computeStandings } from "@/lib/standings"
import { getCurrentFantasyWeek } from "@/lib/season-calendar"

export async function getLeague(leagueId: string) {
  return prisma.league.findUnique({
    where: { id: leagueId },
    include: {
      teams: {
        orderBy: { name: "asc" },
        include: { manager: { select: { id: true, name: true, handle: true, avatarUrl: true, isCommissioner: true } } },
      },
    },
  })
}

export async function getLeagueStandings(leagueId: string, season?: number) {
  const league = await prisma.league.findUnique({
    where: { id: leagueId },
    select: { currentSeason: true },
  })
  if (!league) return null

  const targetSeason = season ?? league.currentSeason
  const currentWeek = getCurrentFantasyWeek(targetSeason)
  const [teams, matchups] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.team.findMany({
      where: { leagueId },
      include: { manager: { select: { handle: true, name: true } } },
      orderBy: { name: "asc" },
    }),
    prisma.matchup.findMany({
      where: { leagueId, season: targetSeason },
      select: { homeTeamId: true, awayTeamId: true, homeScore: true, awayScore: true, week: true, isFinal: true },
    }),
  ])

  const records = new Map(computeStandings(teams.map((team) => team.id), matchups, currentWeek).map((record) => [record.teamId, record]))
  return teams
    .map((team) => {
      const record = records.get(team.id)!
      return { team, wins: record.wins, losses: record.losses, ties: record.ties, pointsFor: record.pointsFor, pointsAgainst: record.pointsAgainst, streak: record.streak }
    })
    .sort((a, b) => b.wins - a.wins || a.losses - b.losses || b.pointsFor - a.pointsFor)
}

export async function getWeeklyMatchups(leagueId: string, season: number, week: number) {
  return prisma.matchup.findMany({
    where: { leagueId, season, week },
    include: {
      homeTeam: { select: { id: true, name: true, manager: { select: { handle: true } } } },
      awayTeam: { select: { id: true, name: true, manager: { select: { handle: true } } } },
    },
    orderBy: { id: "asc" },
  })
}

export type LeagueScoringSettings = Prisma.JsonObject

<file path="lib/db/rosters.ts">
import { PlayerStatus, SlotType } from "@prisma/client"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"

export async function getTeamRoster(teamId: string) {
  return prisma.rosterSlot.findMany({
    where: { teamId },
    include: { player: true },
    orderBy: [{ slot: "asc" }, { player: { name: "asc" } }],
  })
}

export async function validateTaxiSquad(teamId: string) {
  const team = await prisma.team.findUnique({
    where: { id: teamId },
    select: { league: { select: { taxiMaxGames: true } } },
  })
  if (!team) return null

  const taxiSlots = await prisma.rosterSlot.findMany({
    where: { teamId, slot: SlotType.TAXI },
    include: { player: { select: { id: true, name: true, nhlGamesPlayed: true } } },
  })
  return taxiSlots
    .filter(({ player }) => player.nhlGamesPlayed >= team.league.taxiMaxGames)
    .map(({ player }) => ({
      playerId: player.id,
      playerName: player.name,
      gamesPlayed: player.nhlGamesPlayed,
      maxGames: team.league.taxiMaxGames,
    }))
}

export async function getRosterWithCompliance(teamId: string) {
  const [roster, taxiViolations] = await Promise.all([
    getTeamRoster(teamId),
    validateTaxiSquad(teamId),
  ])
  return { roster, taxiViolations }
}

export function isEligibleForIr(status: PlayerStatus) {
  return status === PlayerStatus.IR
}
