<file path="lib/services/draft.ts">
import { ActivityAction, DraftStatus, Prisma, SlotType } from "@prisma/client"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { getLeagueStandings } from "@/lib/db/leagues"

export type DraftOrder = "LINEAR" | "SNAKE"

type DraftConfig = { startAt: Date; rounds: number; timerSeconds: number; type: DraftOrder }

export function draftOrderType(raw: unknown): DraftOrder {
  const settings = raw && typeof raw === "object" ? raw as Record<string, unknown> : {}
  return settings.type === "LINEAR" ? "LINEAR" : "SNAKE"
}

export function draftConfig(raw: unknown): DraftConfig | null {
  const settings = raw && typeof raw === "object" ? raw as Record<string, unknown> : {}
  const startAt = new Date(String(settings.scheduledDate ?? ""))
  if (Number.isNaN(startAt.getTime())) return null
  const rounds = Math.max(1, Math.min(30, Math.floor(Number(settings.rounds ?? 5)) || 5))
  const timerSeconds = Math.max(30, Math.min(600, Math.floor(Number(settings.timerSeconds ?? 120)) || 120))
  return { startAt, rounds, timerSeconds, type: draftOrderType(settings) }
}

export function snakeSlots(teamIds: string[], rounds: number) {
  const slots: { pickNumber: number; round: number; slot: number; teamId: string }[] = []
  let pickNumber = 1
  for (let round = 1; round <= rounds; round += 1) {
    const order = round % 2 === 1 ? teamIds : [...teamIds].reverse()
    for (const teamId of order) {
      slots.push({ pickNumber, round, slot: teamIds.indexOf(teamId), teamId })
      pickNumber += 1
    }
  }
  return slots
}

/** Same team order every round. Even rounds stay in `teamIds` order. */
export function linearSlots(teamIds: string[], rounds: number) {
  const slots: { pickNumber: number; round: number; slot: number; teamId: string }[] = []
  let pickNumber = 1
  for (let round = 1; round <= rounds; round += 1) {
    for (const teamId of teamIds) {
      slots.push({ pickNumber, round, slot: teamIds.indexOf(teamId), teamId })
      pickNumber += 1
    }
  }
  return slots
}

/** `slot.teamId` starts as the original team. A traded `DraftPick` moves that slot to `currentTeamId`. */
export async function buildDraftSlots(leagueId: string, season: number, teamIds: string[], rounds: number, type: DraftOrder) {
  const picks = await prisma.draftPick.findMany({ where: { leagueId, season, round: { lte: rounds } } })
  return (type === "LINEAR" ? linearSlots : snakeSlots)(teamIds, rounds).map((slot) => {
    const pick = picks.find((item) => item.round === slot.round && item.originalTeamId === slot.teamId)
    return pick ? { ...slot, teamId: pick.currentTeamId } : slot
  })
}

async function draftTeams(leagueId: string) {
  const standings = await getLeagueStandings(leagueId)
  return [...(standings ?? [])].reverse().map((row) => ({ id: row.team.id, name: row.team.name }))
}

async function draftTeamIds(leagueId: string) {
  return (await draftTeams(leagueId)).map((team) => team.id)
}

type PickOwner = { round: number; currentTeamId: string; originalTeam: { id: string; name: string } }

/** Original team for a column, using a round whose current owner holds only that pick. */
function originalTeamForColumn(column: LoadedDraft["slots"], picks: PickOwner[]) {
  for (const slot of column) {
    const matches = picks.filter((pick) => pick.round === slot.round && pick.currentTeamId === slot.teamId)
    if (matches.length === 1) return { id: matches[0].originalTeam.id, name: matches[0].originalTeam.name }
  }
  if (picks.length === 0 && column[0]) return { id: column[0].team.id, name: column[0].team.name }
  return null
}

/** Columns are original draft slots 0..N-1, even when a team traded away its round-1 pick. */
async function columnTeams(draft: LoadedDraft) {
  const count = draft.slots.reduce((max, slot) => Math.max(max, slot.slot + 1), 0)
  if (count === 0) return []
  const picks = await prisma.draftPick.findMany({
    where: { leagueId: draft.leagueId, season: draft.startAt.getUTCFullYear(), round: { lte: draft.rounds } },
    select: { round: true, currentTeamId: true, originalTeam: { select: { id: true, name: true } } },
  })
  const resolved = new Map<number, { id: string; name: string }>()
  for (let slot = 0; slot < count; slot += 1) {
    const original = originalTeamForColumn(draft.slots.filter((item) => item.slot === slot), picks)
    if (original) resolved.set(slot, original)
  }
  if (resolved.size < count) {
    const used = new Set([...resolved.values()].map((team) => team.id))
    const ordered = await draftTeams(draft.leagueId)
    for (let slot = 0; slot < count; slot += 1) {
      if (resolved.has(slot)) continue
      const team = ordered[slot]
      if (!team || used.has(team.id)) continue
      resolved.set(slot, team)
      used.add(team.id)
    }
  }
  for (const item of draft.slots.filter((slot) => slot.round === 1)) {
    if (!resolved.has(item.slot)) resolved.set(item.slot, { id: item.team.id, name: item.team.name })
  }
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, slot) => ({
    id: resolved.get(slot)?.id ?? `slot-${slot}`,
    name: resolved.get(slot)?.name ?? "Team",
    slot,
  }))
}

function queuesOf(value: Prisma.JsonValue): Record<string, number[]> {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return {}
  const queues: Record<string, number[]> = {}
  for (const [teamId, ids] of Object.entries(value)) {
    if (!Array.isArray(ids)) continue
    queues[teamId] = ids.filter((id): id is number => Number.isInteger(id))
  }
  return queues
}

function remainingSeconds(draft: { status: DraftStatus; paused: boolean; pausedRemaining: number | null; timerSeconds: number; clockStartedAt: Date | null }, now = new Date()) {
  if (draft.paused) return draft.pausedRemaining ?? draft.timerSeconds
  if (draft.status !== DraftStatus.LIVE || !draft.clockStartedAt) return draft.timerSeconds
  const elapsed = Math.floor((now.getTime() - draft.clockStartedAt.getTime()) / 1000)
  return Math.max(0, draft.timerSeconds - elapsed)
}

const draftInclude = {
  slots: {
    orderBy: { pickNumber: "asc" as const },
    include: {
      team: { select: { id: true, name: true } },
      player: { select: { id: true, name: true, position: true, teamAbbrev: true } },
    },
  },
} satisfies Prisma.DraftInclude

type LoadedDraft = Prisma.DraftGetPayload<{ include: typeof draftInclude }>

async function draftOrderFor(leagueId: string) {
  const league = await prisma.league.findUnique({ where: { id: leagueId }, select: { draftSettings: true } })
  return draftOrderType(league?.draftSettings)
}

async function present(draft: LoadedDraft, teamId: string, type?: DraftOrder) {
  const queues = queuesOf(draft.queues)
  const current = draft.slots.find((slot) => slot.playerId == null) ?? null
  const teams = await columnTeams(draft)
  return {
    id: draft.id,
    type: type ?? await draftOrderFor(draft.leagueId),
    status: draft.status,
    rounds: draft.rounds,
    timerSeconds: draft.timerSeconds,
    startAt: draft.startAt.toISOString(),
    onClock: draft.onClock,
    paused: draft.paused,
    remainingSeconds: remainingSeconds(draft),
    yourTurn: current?.teamId === teamId && draft.status === DraftStatus.LIVE && !draft.paused,
    onClockTeamId: current?.teamId ?? null,
    teams,
    queue: queues[teamId] ?? [],
    slots: draft.slots.map((slot) => ({
      pickNumber: slot.pickNumber,
      round: slot.round,
      slot: slot.slot,
      teamId: slot.teamId,
      teamName: slot.team.name,
      playerId: slot.playerId,
      playerName: slot.player?.name ?? null,
      position: slot.player?.position ?? null,
      nhlTeam: slot.player?.teamAbbrev ?? null,
    })),
  }
}

async function presentCurrent(draft: LoadedDraft, teamId: string, type?: DraftOrder) {
  return present(await autopickIfExpired(draft), teamId, type)
}

async function load(draftId: string) {
  return prisma.draft.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: draftId }, include: draftInclude })
}

function clockExpired(draft: LoadedDraft) {
  return draft.status === DraftStatus.LIVE && !draft.paused && remainingSeconds(draft) <= 0
}

function takenPlayerIds(draft: LoadedDraft) {
  return new Set(draft.slots.flatMap((slot) => (slot.playerId == null ? [] : [slot.playerId])))
}

/** Queue order is priority. The first id still undrafted is the highest-ranked available player. */
async function firstQueuedPlayer(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, draft: LoadedDraft, teamId: string) {
  const taken = takenPlayerIds(draft)
  for (const playerId of queuesOf(draft.queues)[teamId] ?? []) {
    if (taken.has(playerId)) continue
    const player = await tx.player.findUnique({ where: { id: playerId }, select: { id: true, name: true, nhlGamesPlayed: true } })
    if (player) return player
  }
  return null
}

async function commitPick(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, draft: LoadedDraft, slot: LoadedDraft["slots"][number], player: { id: number; name: string; nhlGamesPlayed: number }) {
  const claimed = await tx.draftSlot.updateMany({
    where: { id: slot.id, playerId: null },
    data: { playerId: player.id, pickedAt: new Date() },
  })
  if (claimed.count !== 1) return false
  const alreadyRostered = await tx.rosterSlot.findFirst({ where: { playerId: player.id, team: { leagueId: draft.leagueId } } })
  if (!alreadyRostered) {
    const [league, rosterSlots] = await Promise.all([
      tx.league.findUnique({ where: { id: draft.leagueId }, select: { rosterSize: true, taxiSlots: true, taxiMaxGames: true } }),
      tx.rosterSlot.findMany({ where: { teamId: slot.teamId }, select: { slot: true } }),
    ])
    if (league) {
      const taxiCount = rosterSlots.filter((entry) => entry.slot === SlotType.TAXI).length
      const rosterCount = rosterSlots.filter((entry) => entry.slot !== SlotType.TAXI && entry.slot !== SlotType.IR && entry.slot !== SlotType.IR_PLUS).length
      const placement = player.nhlGamesPlayed < league.taxiMaxGames && taxiCount < league.taxiSlots
        ? SlotType.TAXI
        : rosterCount < league.rosterSize
          ? SlotType.BN
          : null
      if (placement) {
        await tx.rosterSlot.create({ data: { teamId: slot.teamId, playerId: player.id, slot: placement } })
        await tx.activityLog.create({
          data: {
            leagueId: draft.leagueId,
            teamId: slot.teamId,
            action: ActivityAction.ADD,
            details: { playerId: player.id, playerName: player.name, slot: placement, pickNumber: slot.pickNumber },
          },
        })
      }
    }
  }
  const remaining = draft.slots.filter((item) => item.playerId == null && item.id !== slot.id)
  await tx.draft.update({
    where: { id: draft.id },
    data: remaining.length === 0
      ? { status: DraftStatus.COMPLETE, onClock: slot.pickNumber, clockStartedAt: null, paused: false }
      : { onClock: slot.pickNumber, clockStartedAt: new Date() },
  })
  return true
}

async function autopickIfExpired(draft: LoadedDraft) {
  if (!clockExpired(draft)) return draft
  const open = draft.slots.find((slot) => slot.playerId == null)
  const taken = open ? takenPlayerIds(draft) : null
  const queued = open ? (queuesOf(draft.queues)[open.teamId] ?? []).some((playerId) => !taken?.has(playerId)) : false
  if (!open || !queued) return draft
  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const fresh = await tx.draft.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: draft.id }, include: draftInclude })
    if (!clockExpired(fresh)) return fresh
    const slot = fresh.slots.find((item) => item.playerId == null)
    if (!slot) return fresh
    const player = await firstQueuedPlayer(tx, fresh, slot.teamId)
    if (!player || !(await commitPick(tx, fresh, slot, player))) {
      return tx.draft.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: draft.id }, include: draftInclude })
    }
    return tx.draft.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: draft.id }, include: draftInclude })
  })
}

async function promoteIfDue(draft: LoadedDraft) {
  if (draft.status !== DraftStatus.SCHEDULED || draft.startAt.getTime() > Date.now()) return draft
  await prisma.draft.update({
    where: { id: draft.id },
    data: { status: DraftStatus.LIVE, clockStartedAt: new Date(), paused: false, pausedRemaining: null },
  })
  return load(draft.id)
}

export async function readDraft(leagueId: string, teamId: string, createBeforeStart: boolean) {
  const league = await prisma.league.findUnique({ where: { id: leagueId }, select: { draftSettings: true } })
  const config = draftConfig(league?.draftSettings)
  if (!config) return { scheduled: null, draft: null }
  const scheduled = { startAt: config.startAt.toISOString(), rounds: config.rounds, timerSeconds: config.timerSeconds, type: config.type }
  const season = config.startAt.getUTCFullYear()

  let draft = await prisma.draft.findUnique({ where: { leagueId }, include: draftInclude })
  const due = config.startAt.getTime() <= Date.now()
  if (!draft && (due || createBeforeStart)) {
    const teamIds = await draftTeamIds(leagueId)
    if (teamIds.length < 2) return { scheduled, draft: null }
    try {
      draft = await prisma.draft.create({
        data: {
          leagueId,
          status: due ? DraftStatus.LIVE : DraftStatus.SCHEDULED,
          rounds: config.rounds,
          timerSeconds: config.timerSeconds,
          startAt: config.startAt,
          clockStartedAt: due ? new Date() : null,
          slots: { create: await buildDraftSlots(leagueId, season, teamIds, config.rounds, config.type) },
        },
        include: draftInclude,
      })
    } catch {
      draft = await prisma.draft.findUnique({ where: { leagueId }, include: draftInclude })
    }
  }
  if (
    draft &&
    draft.status === DraftStatus.SCHEDULED &&
    draft.slots.every((slot) => slot.playerId == null) &&
    (draft.rounds !== config.rounds || draft.timerSeconds !== config.timerSeconds || draft.startAt.getTime() !== config.startAt.getTime())
  ) {
    const teamIds = await draftTeamIds(leagueId)
    if (teamIds.length >= 2) {
      const draftId = draft.id
      const slots = await buildDraftSlots(leagueId, season, teamIds, config.rounds, config.type)
      draft = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        await tx.draftSlot.deleteMany({ where: { draftId } })
        return tx.draft.update({
          where: { id: draftId },
          data: {
            rounds: config.rounds,
            timerSeconds: config.timerSeconds,
            startAt: config.startAt,
            slots: { create: slots },
          },
          include: draftInclude,
        })
      })
    }
  }
  if (draft) draft = await promoteIfDue(draft)
  return {
    scheduled,
    draft: draft ? await presentCurrent(draft, teamId, config.type) : null,
  }
}

async function requireDraft(leagueId: string, teamId: string) {
  const view = await readDraft(leagueId, teamId, true)
  if (!view.draft) throw new Error("No draft is scheduled.")
  return view.draft.id
}

export async function startDraft(leagueId: string, teamId: string) {
  const id = await requireDraft(leagueId, teamId)
  const draft = await load(id)
  if (draft.status === DraftStatus.COMPLETE) throw new Error("The draft is complete.")
  if (draft.status === DraftStatus.LIVE && !draft.paused) return presentCurrent(draft, teamId)
  await prisma.draft.update({
    where: { id },
    data: { status: DraftStatus.LIVE, paused: false, pausedRemaining: null, clockStartedAt: new Date() },
  })
  return presentCurrent(await load(id), teamId)
}

export async function pauseDraft(leagueId: string, teamId: string) {
  const id = await requireDraft(leagueId, teamId)
  const draft = await load(id)
  if (draft.status !== DraftStatus.LIVE || draft.paused) throw new Error("The draft is not running.")
  await prisma.draft.update({
    where: { id },
    data: { paused: true, pausedRemaining: remainingSeconds(draft), clockStartedAt: null },
  })
  return presentCurrent(await load(id), teamId)
}

export async function resumeDraft(leagueId: string, teamId: string) {
  const id = await requireDraft(leagueId, teamId)
  const draft = await load(id)
  if (!draft.paused) throw new Error("The draft is not paused.")
  const remaining = draft.pausedRemaining ?? draft.timerSeconds
  const elapsed = Math.max(0, draft.timerSeconds - remaining)
  await prisma.draft.update({
    where: { id },
    data: { paused: false, pausedRemaining: null, status: DraftStatus.LIVE, clockStartedAt: new Date(Date.now() - elapsed * 1000) },
  })
  return presentCurrent(await load(id), teamId)
}

export async function setDraftTimer(leagueId: string, teamId: string, timerSeconds: number) {
  const id = await requireDraft(leagueId, teamId)
  const seconds = Math.max(30, Math.min(600, Math.floor(timerSeconds)))
  const draft = await load(id)
  await prisma.draft.update({
    where: { id },
    data: {
      timerSeconds: seconds,
      pausedRemaining: draft.paused ? seconds : null,
      clockStartedAt: draft.status === DraftStatus.LIVE && !draft.paused ? new Date() : draft.clockStartedAt,
    },
  })
  return presentCurrent(await load(id), teamId)
}

export async function makeDraftPick(leagueId: string, teamId: string, playerId: number, commissioner: boolean) {
  const id = await requireDraft(leagueId, teamId)
  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const draft = await tx.draft.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id }, include: draftInclude })
    if (draft.status !== DraftStatus.LIVE || draft.paused) throw new Error("The draft is not accepting picks.")
    const slot = draft.slots.find((item) => item.playerId == null)
    if (!slot) throw new Error("The draft is complete.")
    if (slot.teamId !== teamId && !commissioner) throw new Error("It is not your pick.")
    const taken = draft.slots.some((item) => item.playerId === playerId)
    if (taken) throw new Error("That player is already drafted.")
    const player = await tx.player.findUnique({ where: { id: playerId }, select: { id: true, name: true, nhlGamesPlayed: true } })
    if (!player) throw new Error("Player not found.")
    if (!(await commitPick(tx, draft, slot, player))) throw new Error("That pick was already made.")
    return present(await tx.draft.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id }, include: draftInclude }), teamId)
  })
}

export async function updateDraftQueue(leagueId: string, teamId: string, playerId: number, add: boolean) {
  const id = await requireDraft(leagueId, teamId)
  const draft = await load(id)
  const queues = queuesOf(draft.queues)
  const current = queues[teamId] ?? []
  queues[teamId] = add ? [...current.filter((id) => id !== playerId), playerId] : current.filter((id) => id !== playerId)
  await prisma.draft.update({ where: { id }, data: { queues } })
  return presentCurrent(await load(id), teamId)
}

<file path="lib/hockey-calculators.ts">
import {
  calculateGoalieFPTS,
  calculateSkaterFPTS,
  type GoalieStats,
  type MarketPlayer,
  type Player,
  type PlayerGameLog,
  type SkaterStats,
} from "@/lib/hockey-data"
import { DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING, scoreGameStat } from "@/lib/scoring"
import { getEasternDate } from "@/lib/season-calendar"

export type LeaderCategory = "FPTS" | "G" | "A" | "SOG" | "HIT" | "BLK" | "W" | "SV" | "SV%" | "SO"
export type LeaderMode = "total" | "per_game"
export type SearchPlayer = (Player | MarketPlayer) & { id: string; owner: string }

export const normalizeSearchText = (value: string): string =>
  value.normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase()

export function getSyncedPlayerStats(player: MarketPlayer): SkaterStats | GoalieStats {
  const current = player.currentSeasonStats
  if (player.position === "G") {
    return {
      gp: current?.gamesPlayed ?? player.gp,
      wins: current?.wins ?? player.wins ?? 0,
      otLosses: current?.otLosses ?? 0,
      saves: current?.saves ?? player.saves ?? 0,
      goalsAgainst: current?.goalsAgainst ?? 0,
      shutouts: current?.shutouts ?? player.shutouts ?? 0,
      savePct: current?.savePct ?? player.savePct ?? 0,
      goals: current?.goals ?? player.goals,
      assists: current?.assists ?? player.assists,
      sog: current?.shots ?? player.sog,
      hits: current?.hits ?? player.hits,
      blocks: current?.blocks ?? player.blocks,
      ppp: current?.powerPlayPoints ?? 0,
      shg: current?.shorthandedGoals ?? 0,
      gwg: current?.gameWinningGoals ?? 0,
      plusMinus: current?.plusMinus ?? 0,
    }
  }
  return {
    gp: current?.gamesPlayed ?? player.gp,
    goals: current?.goals ?? player.goals,
    assists: current?.assists ?? player.assists,
    sog: current?.shots ?? player.sog,
    hits: current?.hits ?? player.hits,
    blocks: current?.blocks ?? player.blocks,
    ppp: current?.powerPlayPoints ?? 0,
    shg: current?.shorthandedGoals ?? 0,
    gwg: current?.gameWinningGoals ?? 0,
    plusMinus: current?.plusMinus ?? 0,
  }
}

const ROLLING_DAY_WINDOWS: Record<string, number> = {
  "Last 7 Days": 7,
  "Last 14 Days": 14,
  "Last 30 Days": 30,
}

function calendarDay(value: string): string {
  return value.slice(0, 10)
}

function daysBefore(later: string, earlier: string): number {
  const end = Date.parse(`${calendarDay(later)}T00:00:00Z`)
  const start = Date.parse(`${calendarDay(earlier)}T00:00:00Z`)
  return Math.round((end - start) / 86_400_000)
}

function horizonGames(player: MarketPlayer, horizon?: string, referenceDate?: string): PlayerGameLog[] | null {
  const days = horizon ? ROLLING_DAY_WINDOWS[horizon] : undefined
  if (!days || !Array.isArray(player.gameLog)) return null
  const anchor = referenceDate ? calendarDay(referenceDate) : getEasternDate()
  return player.gameLog.filter((game) => {
    if (!game.gameDate) return false
    const age = daysBefore(anchor, game.gameDate)
    return Number.isFinite(age) && age >= 0 && age <= days
  })
}

function pointsForLoggedGame(game: PlayerGameLog): number {
  if (typeof game.fantasyPoints === "number" && Number.isFinite(game.fantasyPoints)) return game.fantasyPoints
  const saves = typeof game.saves === "number" && Number.isFinite(game.saves)
    ? game.saves
    : Math.max(0, (game.shotsAgainst ?? 0) - (game.goalsAgainst ?? 0))
  return scoreGameStat({
    goals: Number(game.goals) || 0,
    assists: Number(game.assists) || 0,
    shots: Number(game.shots) || 0,
    hits: Number(game.hits) || 0,
    blocks: Number(game.blocks) || 0,
    plusMinus: Number(game.plusMinus) || 0,
    powerPlayPoints: Number(game.powerPlayPoints) || 0,
    shorthandedGoals: Number(game.shorthandedGoals) || 0,
    gameWinningGoals: Number(game.gameWinningGoals) || 0,
    saves,
    goalsAgainst: Number(game.goalsAgainst) || 0,
    shutouts: Number(game.shutouts) || 0,
    decision: game.decision,
  }, DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING)
}

function statsFpts(player: MarketPlayer, stats: SkaterStats | GoalieStats): number {
  return player.position === "G" ? calculateGoalieFPTS(stats as GoalieStats) : calculateSkaterFPTS(stats as SkaterStats)
}

/** Season game-log points, when the log is the season the counting line describes. */
function seasonLogPoints(player: MarketPlayer): number | undefined {
  if (!Array.isArray(player.gameLog) || player.gameLog.length === 0) return undefined
  const officialGp = player.currentSeasonStats?.gamesPlayed
  if (typeof officialGp === "number" && officialGp > 0 && officialGp !== player.gameLog.length) return undefined
  return player.gameLog.reduce((total, game) => total + pointsForLoggedGame(game), 0)
}

/** Season totals, unless `horizon` is Last 7/14/30 Days and `player.gameLog` is an array. */
export function getPlayerStatsForHorizon(player: MarketPlayer, horizon?: string, referenceDate?: string): SkaterStats | GoalieStats {
  const games = horizonGames(player, horizon, referenceDate)
  if (!games) return getSyncedPlayerStats(player)
  const sum = (read: (game: PlayerGameLog) => number) => games.reduce((total, game) => total + (Number(read(game)) || 0), 0)

  if (player.position === "G") {
    const shotsAgainst = sum((game) => game.shotsAgainst)
    const saves = sum((game) => {
      const recorded = game.saves
      return typeof recorded === "number" && Number.isFinite(recorded) && recorded > 0
        ? recorded
        : Math.max(0, (game.shotsAgainst ?? 0) - (game.goalsAgainst ?? 0))
    })
    return {
      gp: games.length,
      wins: games.reduce((total, game) => total + (game.decision === "W" ? 1 : 0), 0),
      otLosses: games.reduce((total, game) => total + (game.decision === "OT" || game.decision === "OTL" ? 1 : 0), 0),
      saves,
      goalsAgainst: sum((game) => game.goalsAgainst),
      shutouts: sum((game) => game.shutouts),
      savePct: shotsAgainst > 0 ? saves / shotsAgainst : 0,
      goals: sum((game) => game.goals),
      assists: sum((game) => game.assists),
      sog: sum((game) => game.shots),
      hits: sum((game) => game.hits),
      blocks: sum((game) => game.blocks),
      ppp: sum((game) => game.powerPlayPoints),
      shg: sum((game) => game.shorthandedGoals),
      gwg: sum((game) => game.gameWinningGoals),
      plusMinus: sum((game) => game.plusMinus),
    }
  }

  return {
    gp: games.length,
    goals: sum((game) => game.goals),
    assists: sum((game) => game.assists),
    sog: sum((game) => game.shots),
    hits: sum((game) => game.hits),
    blocks: sum((game) => game.blocks),
    ppp: sum((game) => game.powerPlayPoints),
    shg: sum((game) => game.shorthandedGoals),
    gwg: sum((game) => game.gameWinningGoals),
    plusMinus: sum((game) => game.plusMinus),
  }
}

export function getSyncedPlayerFPTS(player: MarketPlayer, horizon?: string, referenceDate?: string): number {
  const window = horizonGames(player, horizon, referenceDate)
  const stats = getPlayerStatsForHorizon(player, horizon, referenceDate)
  const total = window
    ? window.reduce((sum, game) => sum + pointsForLoggedGame(game), 0)
    : seasonLogPoints(player) ?? statsFpts(player, stats)
  if (horizon === "Season Avg / Per Game") return Number((total / Math.max(1, stats.gp)).toFixed(1))
  return Number(total.toFixed(1))
}

export function getLeaderStat(
  player: SearchPlayer,
  category: LeaderCategory,
  mode: LeaderMode,
  projectionGames?: number,
  horizon?: string,
  referenceDate?: string,
): { numeric: number; display: string } {
  const marketPlayer = player as MarketPlayer
  const usesLoggedStats = "position" in player && ("currentSeasonStats" in player || Array.isArray(marketPlayer.gameLog))
  const source = usesLoggedStats
    ? getPlayerStatsForHorizon(marketPlayer, horizon, referenceDate)
    : "stats" in player && player.stats ? player.stats : player
  const rawGp = Number("gp" in source ? source.gp : "gamesPlayed" in player ? player.gamesPlayed : "gp" in player ? player.gp : 20)
  const gp = Number.isFinite(rawGp) ? Math.max(1, rawGp) : 1
  const stats = source as unknown as Record<string, number | undefined>
  if (category === "SV%") {
    if (rawGp <= 0 || (Number(stats.saves ?? 0) <= 0 && Number(stats.gp ?? 0) <= 0)) {
      return { numeric: 0, display: "0.000" }
    }
    const savePct = stats.savePct ?? ("savePct" in player ? player.savePct : 0.915) ?? 0.915
    return { numeric: savePct, display: savePct.toFixed(3) }
  }

  const calculatedFpts = usesLoggedStats
    ? getSyncedPlayerFPTS(marketPlayer, horizon === "Season Avg / Per Game" ? undefined : horizon, referenceDate)
    : player.position === "G"
    ? calculateGoalieFPTS({
        gp,
        wins: Number(stats.wins ?? ("wins" in player ? player.wins : 0)) || 0,
        otLosses: Number(stats.otLosses ?? 0) || 0,
        saves: Number(stats.saves ?? ("saves" in player ? player.saves : 0)) || 0,
        goalsAgainst: Number(stats.goalsAgainst ?? 0) || 0,
        shutouts: Number(stats.shutouts ?? ("shutouts" in player ? player.shutouts : 0)) || 0,
        savePct: Number(stats.savePct ?? ("savePct" in player ? player.savePct : 0.915)) || 0.915,
        goals: Number(stats.goals ?? ("goals" in player ? player.goals : 0)) || 0,
        assists: Number(stats.assists ?? ("assists" in player ? player.assists : 0)) || 0,
        sog: Number(stats.sog ?? ("sog" in player ? player.sog : 0)) || 0,
        hits: Number(stats.hits ?? ("hits" in player ? player.hits : 0)) || 0,
        blocks: Number(stats.blocks ?? ("blocks" in player ? player.blocks : 0)) || 0,
        ppp: Number(stats.ppp ?? 0) || 0,
        shg: Number(stats.shg ?? 0) || 0,
        gwg: Number(stats.gwg ?? 0) || 0,
        plusMinus: Number(stats.plusMinus ?? 0) || 0,
      })
    : calculateSkaterFPTS({
        gp,
        goals: Number(stats.goals ?? ("goals" in player ? player.goals : 0)) || 0,
        assists: Number(stats.assists ?? ("assists" in player ? player.assists : 0)) || 0,
        sog: Number(stats.sog ?? ("sog" in player ? player.sog : 0)) || 0,
        hits: Number(stats.hits ?? ("hits" in player ? player.hits : 0)) || 0,
        blocks: Number(stats.blocks ?? ("blocks" in player ? player.blocks : 0)) || 0,
        ppp: Number(stats.ppp ?? 0) || 0,
        shg: Number(stats.shg ?? 0) || 0,
        gwg: Number(stats.gwg ?? 0) || 0,
        plusMinus: Number(stats.plusMinus ?? 0) || 0,
      })
  const rawTotal = (category === "G" ? stats.goals ?? ("goals" in player ? player.goals : 0)
    : category === "A" ? stats.assists ?? ("assists" in player ? player.assists : 0)
    : category === "SOG" ? stats.sog ?? ("sog" in player ? player.sog : 0)
    : category === "HIT" ? stats.hits ?? ("hits" in player ? player.hits : 0)
    : category === "BLK" ? stats.blocks ?? ("blocks" in player ? player.blocks : 0)
    : category === "W" ? stats.wins ?? ("wins" in player ? player.wins : 0)
    : category === "SV" ? stats.saves ?? ("saves" in player ? player.saves : 0)
    : stats.shutouts ?? ("shutouts" in player ? player.shutouts : 0)) ?? 0
  const total = category === "FPTS"
    ? projectionGames != null
      ? calculatedFpts === 0
        ? ((Number("projection" in player ? player.projection : "projPts" in player ? player.projPts : 0) || 0) / 3.5) * projectionGames
        : (calculatedFpts / gp) * projectionGames
      : calculatedFpts
    : projectionGames != null
      ? (rawTotal / gp) * projectionGames
      : rawTotal
  const numeric = mode === "per_game" ? total / gp : total
  return {
    numeric,
    display: mode === "per_game" ? numeric.toFixed(category === "FPTS" ? 1 : 2) : category === "FPTS" ? numeric.toFixed(1) : Math.round(numeric).toString(),
  }
}

export function getProjectedFPTS(player: MarketPlayer, games: number): number {
  const stats = getSyncedPlayerStats(player)
  const seasonFpts = getSyncedPlayerFPTS(player)
  return Number(((seasonFpts / Math.max(1, stats.gp)) * games).toFixed(1))
}

import fs from "node:fs"

const OUTPUT_PATH = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "data", "nhl-players.json")

  "Victor Hedman", "Igor Shesterkin", "Andrei Vasilevskiy", "Tim Stützle", "Trevor Zegras",

  "Dustin Wolf", "Logan Stankoven", "Will Smith", "Cutter Gauthier", "Rutger McGroarty", "Shane Wright",
  "Connor McDavid", "Jack Hughes",
  "Artemi Panarin", "David Pastrnak", "Kirill Kaprizov", "Mikko Rantanen", "Jason Robertson", "Brady Tkachuk",
  "Nick Suzuki", "Juraj Slafkovsky", "Juraj Slafkovský", "Trevor Connelly", "Aliaksei Protas",
])
const KNOWN_PLAYER_IDS = new Map([
  ["Tim Stutzle", 8482116],
  ["Juraj Slafkovsky", 8483515],
])

async function searchPlayerByName(name) {
  const url = `https://search.d3.nhle.com/api/v1/search/player?culture=en-us&limit=10&q=${encodeURIComponent(name)}&active=true`
  const response = await fetch(url, { headers: { Accept: "application/json", "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0" } })
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Player search failed for ${name}: ${response.status}`)
  const results = await response.json()
  return results.find((player) => player.name === name && player.playerId) ?? null
}

function normalizePosition(code) {
  if (code === "L") return "LW"
  if (code === "R") return "RW"
  if (code === "D") return "D"
  if (code === "G") return "G"
  return "C"
}

function calculateAge(birthDate) {
  if (!birthDate) return null
  const birth = new Date(`${birthDate}T00:00:00Z`)
  const now = new Date()
  let age = now.getUTCFullYear() - birth.getUTCFullYear()
  const birthdayPassed = now.getUTCMonth() > birth.getUTCMonth() ||
    (now.getUTCMonth() === birth.getUTCMonth() && now.getUTCDate() >= birth.getUTCDate())
  if (!birthdayPassed) age -= 1
  return age
}

function formatHeight(inches) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(inches)) return null
  return `${Math.floor(inches / 12)}'${inches % 12}"`
}

function localized(value) {
  if (typeof value === "string") return value
  return value?.default ?? null
}

function normalizeInjuryStatus(value) {
  const status = localized(value)?.toUpperCase() ?? value?.abbreviation?.toUpperCase() ?? value?.name?.toUpperCase()
  if (!status) return null
  if (status.includes("IR") || status.includes("INJURED")) return "IR"
  if (status.includes("DTD") || status.includes("DAY-TO-DAY") || status.includes("DAY TO DAY")) return "DTD"
  if (status === "O" || status.includes("OUT")) return "O"
  return null
}

function normalizeName(value) {
  return String(value ?? "").normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ").trim()
}

async function fetchEspnInjuries() {
  const response = await fetch("https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/hockey/nhl/injuries", {
    headers: { Accept: "application/json", "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0" },
  })
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`ESPN injury report failed: ${response.status}`)
  const data = await response.json()
  const injuries = new Map()
  for (const team of data.injuries ?? []) {
    for (const injury of team.injuries ?? []) {
      const name = injury.athlete?.displayName
      if (!name) continue
      const status = normalizeInjuryStatus(injury.type) ?? normalizeInjuryStatus(injury.status) ??
        normalizeInjuryStatus([injury.details, injury.shortComment, injury.longComment].filter(Boolean).join(" "))
      if (status) injuries.set(normalizeName(name), status)
    }
  }
  console.log(`🩺 Loaded ${injuries.size} ESPN injury designations.`)
  return injuries
}

async function enrichPlayer(player) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`https://api-web.nhle.com/v1/player/${player.nhlId}/landing`, {
      headers: { Accept: "application/json", "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0" },
    })
    if (!response.ok) return player
    const detail = await response.json()
    const draft = detail.draftDetails
    const stats = detail.featuredStats?.regularSeason?.subSeason
    const draftYear = draft?.year
    const seasonYear = Number(String(detail.featuredStats?.season ?? "").slice(0, 4))
    const experience = detail.yearsPro ?? detail.experience ?? (draftYear && seasonYear ? Math.max(0, seasonYear - draftYear) : null)
    const position = normalizePosition(detail.positionCode || (detail.position === "D" ? "D" : detail.position))
    const injuryStatus = normalizeInjuryStatus(detail.injuryStatus) ??
      normalizeInjuryStatus(detail.playerStatus) ??
      normalizeInjuryStatus(detail.status) ??
      player.injuryStatus ??
      null
    const gameLogResponse = await fetch(`https://api-web.nhle.com/v1/player/${player.nhlId}/game-log/${CURRENT_SEASON}/2`, {
      headers: { Accept: "application/json", "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0" },
    })
    const gameLogData = gameLogResponse.ok ? await gameLogResponse.json() : null
    const gameLog = (gameLogData?.gameLog ?? []).map((game) => ({
      gameId: game.gameId,
      gameDate: game.gameDate,
      teamAbbrev: game.teamAbbrev,
      opponentAbbrev: game.opponentAbbrev,
      homeRoadFlag: game.homeRoadFlag,
      goals: game.goals ?? 0,
      assists: game.assists ?? 0,
      shots: game.shots ?? 0,
      hits: game.hits ?? 0,
      blocks: game.blocks ?? 0,
      pim: game.pim ?? 0,
      points: game.points ?? 0,
      plusMinus: game.plusMinus ?? 0,
      powerPlayPoints: game.powerPlayPoints ?? 0,
      shorthandedGoals: game.shorthandedGoals ?? 0,
      gameWinningGoals: game.gameWinningGoals ?? 0,
      toi: game.toi ?? "—",
      decision: game.decision ?? null,
      shotsAgainst: game.shotsAgainst ?? 0,
      goalsAgainst: game.goalsAgainst ?? 0,
      savePctg: game.savePctg ?? null,
      shutouts: game.shutouts ?? 0,
      powerPlayToi: game.powerPlayToi ?? "—",
      penaltyKillToi: game.shorthandedToi ?? "—",
    }))
    const historicalSeasons = (detail.seasonTotals ?? [])
      .filter((season) => season.gameTypeId === 2 && season.leagueAbbrev === "NHL")
      .map((season) => ({
        season: season.season,
        team: localized(season.teamName) ?? player.team,
        gamesPlayed: season.gamesPlayed ?? 0,
        goals: season.goals ?? 0,
        assists: season.assists ?? 0,
        points: season.points ?? 0,
        shots: season.shots ?? 0,
        pim: season.pim ?? 0,
        plusMinus: season.plusMinus ?? 0,
        wins: season.wins ?? 0,
        saves: season.saves ?? 0,
        goalsAgainst: season.goalsAgainst ?? 0,
        shutouts: season.shutouts ?? 0,
        savePctg: season.savePctg ?? null,
      }))
    const nhlGamesPlayed = detail.careerTotals?.regularSeason?.gamesPlayed ??
      historicalSeasons.reduce((total, season) => total + season.gamesPlayed, 0)
    const hits = gameLog.reduce((total, game) => total + (game.hits ?? 0), 0)
    const blocks = gameLog.reduce((total, game) => total + (game.blocks ?? 0), 0)
    const saves = gameLog.reduce((total, game) => total + ((game.shotsAgainst ?? 0) - (game.goalsAgainst ?? 0)), 0)
    const goalsAgainst = gameLog.reduce((total, game) => total + (game.goalsAgainst ?? 0), 0)
    const wins = gameLog.reduce((total, game) => total + (game.decision === "W" ? 1 : 0), 0)
    const shutouts = gameLog.reduce((total, game) => total + (game.shutouts ?? 0), 0)
    const shotsAgainst = gameLog.reduce((total, game) => total + (game.shotsAgainst ?? 0), 0)
    const savePct = shotsAgainst > 0 ? Number((saves / shotsAgainst).toFixed(3)) : 0
    return {
      ...player,
      hits,
      blocks,
      wins,
      saves,
      goalsAgainst,
      shutouts,
      savePct,
      team: detail.currentTeamAbbrev || player.team,
      position,
      slot: position === "LW" || position === "RW"
        ? "W"
        : position,
      profile: {
        sweaterNumber: detail.sweaterNumber ?? null,
        heightInInches: detail.heightInInches ?? null,
        height: formatHeight(detail.heightInInches),
        weightInPounds: detail.weightInPounds ?? null,
        birthDate: detail.birthDate ?? null,
        age: calculateAge(detail.birthDate),
        birthplace: [localized(detail.birthCity), localized(detail.birthStateProvince), localized(detail.birthCountry)].filter(Boolean).join(", ") || null,
        shoots: detail.shootsCatches ?? null,
        experience,
        draft: draft ? { year: draft.year, round: draft.round, pick: draft.overallPick ?? draft.pickInRound, team: draft.teamAbbrev ?? null } : null,
      },
      currentSeasonStats: stats ? {
        season: detail.featuredStats.season,
        gamesPlayed: stats.gamesPlayed ?? 0,
        goals: stats.goals ?? 0,
        assists: stats.assists ?? 0,
        points: stats.points ?? 0,
        shots: stats.shots ?? 0,
        powerPlayPoints: stats.powerPlayPoints ?? 0,
        shorthandedGoals: stats.shorthandedGoals ?? 0,
        gameWinningGoals: stats.gameWinningGoals ?? 0,
        pim: stats.pim ?? 0,
        plusMinus: stats.plusMinus ?? 0,
        hits,
        blocks,
        wins,
        saves,
        goalsAgainst,
        shutouts,
        savePct,
      } : null,
      gameLog,
      historicalSeasons,
      nhlGamesPlayed,
      injuryStatus,
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn(`Profile enrichment failed for ${player.name}: ${error.message}`)
    return player
  }
}

async function fetchDynastyPool() {
  console.log("🏒 Fetching complete NHL player & prospect pool...")
  const playerMap = new Map()
  let espnInjuryMap = new Map()
  try {
    espnInjuryMap = await fetchEspnInjuries()
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn(`ESPN injury sync failed: ${error.message}`)
  }

  // Use the active index so retired players are not imported from NHL search history.
  try {
    const res = await fetch(
      "https://search.d3.nhle.com/api/v1/search/player?culture=en-us&limit=5000&q=*&active=true",
      { headers: { Accept: "application/json", "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0" } }
    )
    if (res.ok) {
      const data = await res.json()
      for (const p of data) {
        if (!p.playerId || !p.name) continue
        const position = normalizePosition(p.positionCode)
        playerMap.set(String(p.playerId), {
          id: `nhl-${p.playerId}`,
          nhlId: Number(p.playerId),
          name: p.name,
          team: p.teamAbbrev || p.lastTeamAbbrev || "NHL",
          position,
          slot: position === "LW" || position === "RW" ? "W" : position,
          projPts: position === "G" ? 12.5 : position === "D" ? 9.8 : 11.2,
          todayPts: null,
          waiver: "FA",
          opponent: "—",
          headshot: `https://assets.nhle.com/mugs/nhl/latest/${p.playerId}.png`,
          injuryStatus: normalizeInjuryStatus(p.injuryStatus ?? p.status),
        })
      }
      console.log(`✅ Loaded ${playerMap.size} NHL database players.`)
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to fetch active player index:", err)
  }

  const missingPriorityNames = [...PRIORITY_NAMES].filter((name) => ![...playerMap.values()].some((player) => player.name === name))
  for (const name of missingPriorityNames) {
    try {
      const player = await searchPlayerByName(name)
      const fallbackId = KNOWN_PLAYER_IDS.get(name)
      if (!player && fallbackId) {
        playerMap.set(String(fallbackId), {
          id: `nhl-${fallbackId}`,
          nhlId: fallbackId,
          name,
          team: "OTT",
          position: "C",
          slot: "C",
          projPts: 11.2,
          todayPts: null,
          waiver: "FA",
          opponent: "—",
          headshot: `https://assets.nhle.com/mugs/nhl/latest/${fallbackId}.png`,
        })
        continue
      }
      if (!player) {
        console.warn(`No exact NHL search result found for ${name}`)
        continue
      }
      const position = normalizePosition(player.positionCode)
      playerMap.set(String(player.playerId), {
        id: `nhl-${player.playerId}`,
        nhlId: Number(player.playerId),
        name: player.name,
        team: player.teamAbbrev || player.lastTeamAbbrev || "NHL",
        position,
        slot: position === "LW" || position === "RW" ? "W" : position,
        projPts: position === "G" ? 12.5 : position === "D" ? 9.8 : 11.2,
        todayPts: null,
        waiver: "FA",
        opponent: "—",
        headshot: `https://assets.nhle.com/mugs/nhl/latest/${player.playerId}.png`,
      })
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn(`Exact NHL search failed for ${name}: ${error.message}`)
    }
  }
  for (const [name, nhlId] of KNOWN_PLAYER_IDS) {
    if (![...playerMap.values()].some((player) => player.name === name)) {
      playerMap.set(String(nhlId), {
        id: `nhl-${nhlId}`,
        nhlId,
        name,
        team: "OTT",
        position: "C",
        slot: "C",
        projPts: 11.2,
        todayPts: null,
        waiver: "FA",
        opponent: "—",
        headshot: `https://assets.nhle.com/mugs/nhl/latest/${nhlId}.png`,
      })
    }
  }

  const allPlayers = Array.from(playerMap.values())
    .map((player) => {
      const status = espnInjuryMap.get(normalizeName(player.name)) ?? player.injuryStatus ?? null
      return {
        ...player,
        injuryStatus: status,
        injuryVerification: status ? "single-source" : null,
        injurySources: status ? ["ESPN"] : [],
      }
    })
    .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
  const priorityPlayers = allPlayers.filter((player) => PRIORITY_NAMES.has(player.name) || [...KNOWN_PLAYER_IDS.values()].includes(player.nhlId))
  const profileTargets = [...new Map([...priorityPlayers, ...allPlayers].map((player) => [player.nhlId, player])).values()].slice(0, PROFILE_LIMIT)
  console.log(`🔎 Enriching ${profileTargets.length} relevant players with NHL profiles and current-season stats...`)
  for (let index = 0; index < profileTargets.length; index += 8) {
    const batch = profileTargets.slice(index, index + 8)
    const enriched = await Promise.all(batch.map(enrichPlayer))
    enriched.forEach((player) => playerMap.set(String(player.nhlId), player))
  }
  for (const [name, nhlId] of KNOWN_PLAYER_IDS) {
    const player = playerMap.get(String(nhlId))
    if (player) player.name = name
  }
  const enrichedPlayers = Array.from(playerMap.values())
    .map((player) => {
      const status = espnInjuryMap.get(normalizeName(player.name)) ?? player.injuryStatus ?? null
      return {
        ...player,
        injuryStatus: status,
        injuryVerification: status ? "single-source" : null,
        injurySources: status ? ["ESPN"] : [],
      }
    })
    .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))

  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(OUTPUT_PATH), { recursive: true })
  fs.writeFileSync(OUTPUT_PATH, JSON.stringify(enrichedPlayers, null, 2))
  console.log(`🎉 Saved ${enrichedPlayers.length} total dynasty players to public/data/nhl-players.json`)
}

fetchDynastyPool()
</file>

## Cursor Cloud specific instructions

- Install dependencies with `npm ci`. The `postinstall` script runs `prisma generate`.
- The committed `.env` `DATABASE_URL` points at a hosted Neon database. Use local PostgreSQL for development so commands do not write to that hosted database. Export `DATABASE_URL=postgresql://johnscott:johnscott@127.0.0.1:5432/johnscott` before Prisma or `next dev`. A variable already set in the environment overrides `.env`.
- There are no Prisma migration files. Sync the schema with `npx prisma db push`. Seed with `npm run prisma:seed` only when `"League"` is empty. Seeding replaces roster slots.
- Dev server: `npm run dev` (port 3000). Open `http://localhost:3000`. Next.js blocks dev assets when the page is opened as `127.0.0.1`, so the PIN gate will not hydrate on that host. There is no lint script. Typecheck with `npx tsc --noEmit`. End-to-end tests: `npm run test:e2e` (Playwright, Chromium).
- `npm run build` runs `prebuild`, which fetches NHL data and rewrites `public/data/nhl-players.json`.
- Seeded managers sign in with PIN `1234`. The e2e setup chooses Montreal Monarchs.

<file path="app/api/admin/league-settings/route.ts">
import { NextResponse } from "next/server"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { getManagerSession } from "@/lib/auth-session"
import { rescoreAllStats, recomputeMatchupsThroughWeek } from "@/lib/services/nhl-sync"
import { getCurrentFantasyWeek } from "@/lib/season-calendar"
import { getLockSummary } from "@/lib/services/lineup-locks"
import type { LeagueScoring } from "@/lib/scoring"

/** Scoring weights and roster shape lock once week 1 has started. */
export async function isSeasonStructureLocked(season: number, lineupLockMode: unknown, now: Date = new Date()) {
  const week = getCurrentFantasyWeek(season, now)
  if (week > 1) return true
  const lock = await getLockSummary(season, lineupLockMode, now)
  return lock.weekStarted
}

const DEFAULT_LEAGUE_ID = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
const jsonFields = ["rosterPositions", "scoringSettings", "waiverSettings", "tradeSettings", "draftSettings"] as const

async function resolveLeagueId(teamId: string) {
  const team = await prisma.team.findUnique({ where: { id: teamId }, select: { leagueId: true } })
  return team?.leagueId ?? DEFAULT_LEAGUE_ID
}

async function getLeague(leagueId: string) {
  return prisma.league.findUnique({
    where: { id: leagueId },
    select: {
      id: true, name: true, currentSeason: true, currentWeek: true, rosterSize: true, taxiSlots: true, taxiMaxGames: true, irSlots: true, lineupLockMode: true,
      scoringSettings: true, rosterPositions: true, waiverSettings: true, tradeSettings: true, draftSettings: true,
    },
  })
}

async function commissionerSession() {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  if (!session) return null
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: session.managerId }, select: { isCommissioner: true } })
  return user?.isCommissioner ? session : null
}

export async function GET() {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication required." }, { status: 401 })
  const league = await getLeague(await resolveLeagueId(session.teamId))
  if (!league) return NextResponse.json({ error: "League not found." }, { status: 404 })
  const structureLocked = await isSeasonStructureLocked(league.currentSeason, league.lineupLockMode)
  return NextResponse.json({ ...league, structureLocked })
}

export async function PATCH(request: Request) {
  const session = await commissionerSession()
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 })
  const body = await request.json().catch(() => null) as Record<string, unknown> | null
  if (!body) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid settings payload." }, { status: 400 })
  const data: Record<string, unknown> = {}
  for (const field of jsonFields) {
    if (field in body) {
      if (typeof body[field] !== "object" || body[field] === null || Array.isArray(body[field])) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: `${field} must be an object.` }, { status: 400 })
      }
      data[field] = body[field]
    }
  }
  for (const field of ["taxiSlots", "taxiMaxGames", "irSlots"]) {
    if (field in body) {
      if (typeof body[field] !== "number" || !Number.isInteger(body[field]) || body[field] < 0) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: `${field} must be a non-negative integer.` }, { status: 400 })
      }
      data[field] = body[field]
    }
  }
  // currentWeek follows the NHL calendar and cannot be set by hand.
  if ("lineupLockMode" in body) {
    if (body.lineupLockMode !== "WEEKLY" && body.lineupLockMode !== "DAILY") {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "lineupLockMode must be WEEKLY or DAILY." }, { status: 400 })
    }
    data.lineupLockMode = body.lineupLockMode
  }
  const leagueId = await resolveLeagueId(session.teamId)
  const existing = await getLeague(leagueId)
  if (!existing) return NextResponse.json({ error: "League not found." }, { status: 404 })
  if (await isSeasonStructureLocked(existing.currentSeason, existing.lineupLockMode)) {
    delete data.rosterPositions
    delete data.scoringSettings
    delete data.taxiSlots
    delete data.taxiMaxGames
    delete data.irSlots
  }
  // Roster capacity always follows the configured slots, independent of which other fields were sent.
  if (data.rosterPositions) {
    const positions = Object.values(data.rosterPositions as Record<string, unknown>)
    if (positions.some((value) => typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isInteger(value) || value < 0)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "rosterPositions values must be non-negative integers." }, { status: 400 })
    }
    data.rosterSize = (positions as number[]).reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0)
  }
  const league = await prisma.league.update({ where: { id: leagueId }, data, select: {
    id: true, name: true, currentSeason: true, currentWeek: true, rosterSize: true, taxiSlots: true, taxiMaxGames: true, irSlots: true, lineupLockMode: true,
    scoringSettings: true, rosterPositions: true, waiverSettings: true, tradeSettings: true, draftSettings: true,
  } })
  const structureLocked = await isSeasonStructureLocked(league.currentSeason, league.lineupLockMode)
  if (data.scoringSettings) {
    // Scoring changed: re-price every stat line and rebuild all matchup totals and standings from history.
    await rescoreAllStats(data.scoringSettings as LeagueScoring)
    await recomputeMatchupsThroughWeek(leagueId, getCurrentFantasyWeek())
  }
  return NextResponse.json({ ...league, structureLocked })
}

<file path="app/api/auth/login/route.ts">
import { timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto"
import { NextResponse } from "next/server"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { getManagerSession, signManagerSession } from "@/lib/auth-session"

const MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS = 5
const WINDOW_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000
const PIN_PATTERN = /^\d{4}$/
const MANAGER_ID_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i

type AttemptBucket = { failures: number; resetAt: number }

const pinRateLimitState = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
  __dynastyPinAttempts?: Map<string, AttemptBucket>
}
const pinAttempts = pinRateLimitState.__dynastyPinAttempts ?? new Map<string, AttemptBucket>()
pinRateLimitState.__dynastyPinAttempts = pinAttempts

function attemptKey(scope: "manager" | "ip", id: string) {
  return `${scope}:${id}`
}

function clientIp(request: Request) {
  const forwarded = request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for")?.split(",")[0]?.trim()
  if (forwarded) return forwarded
  const realIp = request.headers.get("x-real-ip")?.trim()
  return realIp || "unknown"
}

function activeBucket(key: string, now: number) {
  const bucket = pinAttempts.get(key)
  if (!bucket || bucket.resetAt <= now) {
    if (bucket) pinAttempts.delete(key)
    return null
  }
  return bucket
}

function retryAfterSeconds(keys: string[], now: number) {
  let wait = 0
  for (const key of keys) {
    const bucket = activeBucket(key, now)
    if (bucket && bucket.failures >= MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS) {
      wait = Math.max(wait, Math.ceil((bucket.resetAt - now) / 1000))
    }
  }
  return wait
}

function recordFailure(key: string, now: number) {
  const bucket = activeBucket(key, now)
  if (!bucket) {
    pinAttempts.set(key, { failures: 1, resetAt: now + WINDOW_MS })
    return
  }
  bucket.failures += 1
  if (pinAttempts.size > 500) {
    for (const [storedKey, stored] of pinAttempts) {
      if (stored.resetAt <= now) pinAttempts.delete(storedKey)
    }
  }
}

function clearFailures(keys: string[]) {
  for (const key of keys) pinAttempts.delete(key)
}

function retryMessage(seconds: number) {
  if (seconds < 60) {
    const count = Math.max(1, seconds)
    return `Too many failed PIN attempts. Try again in ${count} second${count === 1 ? "" : "s"}.`
  }
  const minutes = Math.ceil(seconds / 60)
  return `Too many failed PIN attempts. Try again in ${minutes} minute${minutes === 1 ? "" : "s"}.`
}

function tooManyAttempts(seconds: number) {
  return NextResponse.json(
    { error: retryMessage(seconds) },
    { status: 429, headers: { "Retry-After": String(seconds) } },
  )
}

function pinsMatch(storedPin: string, providedPin: string) {
  const provided = Buffer.from(providedPin)
  const stored = Buffer.from(storedPin)
  if (stored.length !== provided.length) {
    timingSafeEqual(provided, Buffer.alloc(provided.length))
    return false
  }
  return timingSafeEqual(stored, provided)
}

function attemptKeys(request: Request, managerId: string) {
  return [attemptKey("manager", managerId), attemptKey("ip", clientIp(request))]
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const body = await request.json().catch(() => null) as { managerId?: unknown; pin?: unknown } | null
  if (typeof body?.managerId !== "string" || typeof body.pin !== "string" || !PIN_PATTERN.test(body.pin)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "A manager and 4-digit PIN are required." }, { status: 400 })
  }

  const keys = attemptKeys(request, body.managerId)
  const wait = retryAfterSeconds(keys, Date.now())
  if (wait > 0) return tooManyAttempts(wait)

  const user = MANAGER_ID_PATTERN.test(body.managerId)
    ? await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: body.managerId } })
    : null
  const pinOk = pinsMatch(user?.pin ?? "0000", body.pin)
  if (!user || !pinOk) {
    const now = Date.now()
    for (const key of keys) recordFailure(key, now)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Incorrect PIN." }, { status: 401 })
  }

  clearFailures(keys)

  const team = await prisma.team.findFirst({
    where: { managerId: user.id },
    orderBy: { name: "asc" },
  })
  if (!team) return NextResponse.json({ error: "No team is assigned to this manager." }, { status: 404 })

  const session = signManagerSession({
    managerId: user.id,
    teamId: team.id,
    handle: user.handle,
    teamName: team.name,
    isCommissioner: user.isCommissioner,
  })
  const response = NextResponse.json({ success: true, teamId: team.id, teamName: team.name })
  response.cookies.set("dynasty_manager", session, {
    httpOnly: true,
    sameSite: "lax",
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
    path: "/",
    maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 30,
  })
  return response
}

export async function PATCH(request: Request) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Sign in to change your PIN." }, { status: 401 })

  const body = await request.json().catch(() => null) as { currentPin?: unknown; newPin?: unknown } | null
  if (
    typeof body?.currentPin !== "string" ||
    typeof body.newPin !== "string" ||
    !PIN_PATTERN.test(body.currentPin) ||
    !PIN_PATTERN.test(body.newPin)
  ) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Current PIN and new PIN must be 4 digits." }, { status: 400 })
  }

  const keys = attemptKeys(request, session.managerId)
  const wait = retryAfterSeconds(keys, Date.now())
  if (wait > 0) return tooManyAttempts(wait)

  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: session.managerId } })
  const currentOk = pinsMatch(user?.pin ?? "0000", body.currentPin)
  if (!user || !currentOk) {
    const now = Date.now()
    for (const key of keys) recordFailure(key, now)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Current PIN is incorrect." }, { status: 401 })
  }

  clearFailures(keys)
  await prisma.user.update({ where: { id: session.managerId }, data: { pin: body.newPin } })
  return NextResponse.json({ success: true })
}

<file path="app/api/cron/sync/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server"
import { headers } from "next/headers"
import { getCurrentFantasyWeek } from "@/lib/season-calendar"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { getManagerSession, verifyCronSecret } from "@/lib/auth-session"
import {
  enforceRosterLocks,
  syncActiveGameBoxscores,
  recomputeMatchupsThroughWeek,
  syncLeagueWeek,
  syncScheduleForWeeks,
} from "@/lib/services/nhl-sync"

export const runtime = "nodejs"
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"

async function runSync(request: NextRequest) {
  const startedAt = Date.now()
  const requestHeaders = await headers()
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  const commissioner = session
    ? await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: session.managerId }, select: { isCommissioner: true } })
    : null
  const commissionerAuthorized = commissioner?.isCommissioner === true
  const authorization = requestHeaders.get("authorization")
  const bearerToken = authorization?.startsWith("Bearer ") ? authorization.slice("Bearer ".length) : null
  const bearerAuthorized = verifyCronSecret(bearerToken)
  const queryAuthorized = verifyCronSecret(request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("secret"))
  if (!bearerAuthorized && !queryAuthorized && !commissionerAuthorized) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 })
  }

  // ?backfill=1 pulls the whole season so far; otherwise just last, this and next week.
  const backfill = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("backfill") === "1"
  const leagues = await prisma.league.findMany({ select: { id: true, currentSeason: true } })
  let scheduledGames = 0
  for (const league of leagues) {
    const week = getCurrentFantasyWeek(league.currentSeason)
    const weeks = backfill
      ? Array.from({ length: week + 1 }, (_, index) => index + 1)
      : [Math.max(1, week - 1), week, week + 1]
    scheduledGames += await syncScheduleForWeeks(league.currentSeason, weeks)
  }
  const processedGames = await syncActiveGameBoxscores(backfill ? 400 : 40)
  await enforceRosterLocks()

  for (const league of leagues) {
    const week = (await syncLeagueWeek(league.id)) ?? 1
    await recomputeMatchupsThroughWeek(league.id, week)
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    success: true,
    processedGames: Math.max(scheduledGames, processedGames),
    durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
  })
}

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  return runSync(request)
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  return runSync(request)
}

<file path="app/api/cron/waivers/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server"
import { headers } from "next/headers"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { processWaiversForLeague } from "@/lib/services/transactions"
import { getManagerSession, verifyCronSecret } from "@/lib/auth-session"
import { runInstantForProcessDate, waiverRunReadyForWeek } from "@/lib/waiver-run"
import { getFantasyWeekDates } from "@/lib/season-calendar"
import { ClaimStatus } from "@prisma/client"

export const runtime = "nodejs"

async function run(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  const commissioner = session
    ? await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: session.managerId }, select: { isCommissioner: true } })
    : null
  const commissionerAuthorized = commissioner?.isCommissioner === true
  const authorization = (await headers()).get("authorization")
  const bearerToken = authorization?.startsWith("Bearer ") ? authorization.slice("Bearer ".length) : null
  const authorized = verifyCronSecret(bearerToken) || verifyCronSecret(request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("secret"))
  if (!authorized && !commissionerAuthorized) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 })

  const now = new Date()
  const leagueId = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("leagueId")
  const leagues = leagueId
    ? await prisma.league.findMany({ where: { id: leagueId }, select: { id: true, currentSeason: true } })
    : await prisma.league.findMany({ select: { id: true, currentSeason: true } })

  const processed: Array<{ leagueId: string; count: number; week?: number; skipped?: string }> = []
  for (const league of leagues) {
    const dueDates = await prisma.waiverClaim.findMany({
      where: { status: ClaimStatus.PENDING, processDate: { lte: now }, team: { leagueId: league.id } },
      distinct: ["processDate"],
      orderBy: { processDate: "asc" },
      select: { processDate: true },
    })
    if (dueDates.length === 0) {
      processed.push({ leagueId: league.id, count: 0, skipped: "Waivers run Monday at midnight, after the final game of the week." })
      continue
    }
    let readyUntil: Date | null = null
    let blocked: string | null = null
    let closedWeek = 0
    for (const due of dueDates) {
      const scheduled = runInstantForProcessDate(league.currentSeason, due.processDate)
      const week = scheduled.week
      const { dates } = getFantasyWeekDates(week, league.currentSeason)
      const games = await prisma.nhlGame.findMany({ where: { gameDate: { in: dates } }, select: { gameState: true } })
      const gate = waiverRunReadyForWeek(league.currentSeason, week, games.map((game) => game.gameState), now)
      if (!gate.ready) {
        blocked = gate.reason
        break
      }
      readyUntil = scheduled.runAt
      closedWeek = week
    }
    if (!readyUntil) {
      processed.push({ leagueId: league.id, count: 0, skipped: blocked ?? "Waiting for the final game of the week." })
      continue
    }
    processed.push({ leagueId: league.id, week: closedWeek, count: await processWaiversForLeague(league.id, readyUntil) })
  }

  const awarded = processed.reduce((sum, result) => sum + result.count, 0)
  const waiting = processed.find((result) => result.skipped)
  const message = waiting && awarded === 0
    ? waiting.skipped
    : `Processed ${awarded} waiver claim${awarded === 1 ? "" : "s"}.`
  return NextResponse.json({ success: true, processed, message })
}

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  return run(request)
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  return run(request)
}

<file path="app/api/messages/route.ts">
import { NextResponse } from "next/server"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { getManagerSession } from "@/lib/auth-session"

function formatTime(date: Date) {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", timeZone: "America/New_York" }).format(date)
}

async function caller() {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  const managerId = session?.managerId
  return managerId ? prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: managerId } }) : null
}

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const user = await caller()
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication required." }, { status: 401 })
  const url = new URL(request.url)
  if (url.searchParams.get("unreadOnly") === "1") {
    const unreadCount = await prisma.directMessage.count({ where: { recipientId: user.id, readAt: null } })
    return NextResponse.json([{ unreadCount }])
  }
  const recipientId = url.searchParams.get("recipientId")
  if (recipientId) {
    const messages = await prisma.directMessage.findMany({
      where: { OR: [{ senderId: user.id, recipientId }, { senderId: recipientId, recipientId: user.id }] },
      orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
      include: { sender: { select: { name: true } } },
    })
    return NextResponse.json(messages.map((message) => ({
      id: message.id, senderId: message.senderId, senderName: message.sender.name, text: message.body,
      timestamp: formatTime(message.createdAt), isMe: message.senderId === user.id,
    })))
  }
  const [partners, latestByPair, unreadGroups] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.user.findMany({
      where: { id: { not: user.id }, managedTeams: { some: {} } },
      include: { managedTeams: { select: { name: true }, take: 1 } },
      orderBy: { name: "asc" },
    }),
    prisma.directMessage.findMany({
      where: { OR: [{ senderId: user.id }, { recipientId: user.id }] },
      distinct: ["senderId", "recipientId"],
      orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    }),
    prisma.directMessage.groupBy({
      by: ["senderId"],
      where: { recipientId: user.id, readAt: null },
      _count: { _all: true },
    }),
  ])
  const unreadBySender = new Map(unreadGroups.map((group) => [group.senderId, group._count._all]))
  const latestByPartner = new Map<string, typeof latestByPair[number]>()
  for (const message of latestByPair) {
    const partnerId = message.senderId === user.id ? message.recipientId : message.senderId
    const current = latestByPartner.get(partnerId)
    const messageTime = message.createdAt.getTime()
    const currentTime = current?.createdAt.getTime()
    if (currentTime == null || messageTime > currentTime || (messageTime === currentTime && message.senderId === user.id)) {
      latestByPartner.set(partnerId, message)
    }
  }
  const summaries = partners.map((partner) => {
    const latest = latestByPartner.get(partner.id)
    return {
      managerId: partner.id, name: partner.name, handle: `@${partner.handle}`, teamName: partner.managedTeams[0]?.name ?? "Unassigned",
      lastMessage: latest?.body ?? "Start a conversation", timestamp: latest ? formatTime(latest.createdAt) : "", unreadCount: unreadBySender.get(partner.id) ?? 0,
    }
  })
  return NextResponse.json(summaries)
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  const body = await request.json().catch(() => null) as { recipientId?: unknown; body?: unknown } | null
  if (!session || typeof body?.recipientId !== "string" || typeof body.body !== "string" || !body.body.trim()) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication and message body are required." }, { status: 400 })
  if (body.recipientId === session.managerId) return NextResponse.json({ error: "You cannot message yourself." }, { status: 400 })
  const recipient = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: body.recipientId },
    select: { id: true, managedTeams: { select: { leagueId: true }, take: 1 } },
  })
  const senderTeam = await prisma.team.findFirst({ where: { id: session.teamId, managerId: session.managerId }, select: { leagueId: true } })
  if (!recipient || !senderTeam || recipient.managedTeams[0]?.leagueId !== senderTeam.leagueId) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "That manager is not available in your league." }, { status: 404 })
  }
  const message = await prisma.directMessage.create({ data: { senderId: session.managerId, recipientId: body.recipientId, body: body.body.trim() }, include: { sender: { select: { name: true } } } })
  return NextResponse.json({ id: message.id, senderId: message.senderId, senderName: message.sender.name, text: message.body, timestamp: formatTime(message.createdAt), isMe: true })
}

export async function PATCH(request: Request) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  const body = await request.json().catch(() => null) as { conversationPartnerId?: unknown } | null
  if (!session || typeof body?.conversationPartnerId !== "string") return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication required." }, { status: 400 })
  await prisma.directMessage.updateMany({ where: { senderId: body.conversationPartnerId, recipientId: session.managerId, readAt: null }, data: { readAt: new Date() } })
  return NextResponse.json({ success: true })
}

<file path="app/api/trades/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server"
import { TradeStatus } from "@prisma/client"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { getManagerSession } from "@/lib/auth-session"
import { createTradeOffer, executeTrade, type TradeAssetInput } from "@/lib/services/transactions"

export const runtime = "nodejs"

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication required" }, { status: 401 })
  const leagueId = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("leagueId")
  if (!leagueId) return NextResponse.json({ error: "leagueId is required" }, { status: 400 })
  const membership = await prisma.team.findFirst({
    where: { id: session.teamId, managerId: session.managerId, leagueId },
    select: { id: true },
  })
  if (!membership) return NextResponse.json({ error: "You do not belong to this league" }, { status: 403 })
  const offers = await prisma.tradeOffer.findMany({
    where: { leagueId, status: { in: [TradeStatus.PENDING, TradeStatus.ACCEPTED, TradeStatus.PROCESSED, TradeStatus.REJECTED] } },
    include: { assets: { include: { player: true, draftPick: true } }, proposingTeam: true, receivingTeam: true },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
  })
  const picks = await prisma.draftPick.findMany({
    where: { leagueId },
    select: { id: true, season: true, round: true, currentTeamId: true },
    orderBy: [{ season: "asc" }, { round: "asc" }],
  })
  const teams = await prisma.team.findMany({
    where: { leagueId },
    select: { id: true, name: true, faabBalance: true, manager: { select: { name: true, handle: true } } },
  })
  return NextResponse.json({ offers, picks, teams })
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication required" }, { status: 401 })
  try {
    const body = await request.json() as { leagueId?: string; proposingTeamId?: string; receivingTeamId?: string; assets?: TradeAssetInput[]; expiresAt?: string }
    if (body.proposingTeamId !== session.teamId) return NextResponse.json({ error: "You can only propose trades from your own team" }, { status: 403 })
    if (!body.leagueId || !body.proposingTeamId || !body.receivingTeamId || !Array.isArray(body.assets)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "leagueId, team IDs, and assets are required" }, { status: 400 })
    const offer = await createTradeOffer({
      leagueId: body.leagueId,
      proposingTeamId: body.proposingTeamId,
      receivingTeamId: body.receivingTeamId,
      assets: body.assets,
      expiresAt: body.expiresAt ? new Date(body.expiresAt) : undefined,
    })
    return NextResponse.json({ offer }, { status: 201 })
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    console.error("Trade creation failed", error)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Trade creation failed" }, { status: 400 })
  }
}

export async function PATCH(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getManagerSession()
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Authentication required" }, { status: 401 })
  try {
    const body = await request.json() as { tradeOfferId?: string; action?: "ACCEPT" | "REJECT" | "CANCEL" }
    if (!body.tradeOfferId || !body.action) return NextResponse.json({ error: "tradeOfferId and action are required" }, { status: 400 })
    if (!["ACCEPT", "REJECT", "CANCEL"].includes(body.action)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid action" }, { status: 400 })
    const offer = await prisma.tradeOffer.findUnique({ where: { id: body.tradeOfferId }, select: { proposingTeamId: true, receivingTeamId: true } })
    if (!offer) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Trade offer not found" }, { status: 404 })
    // The proposer cancels through onDeclineTrade, which sends REJECT. Treat that as CANCEL.
    const action = body.action === "REJECT" && session.teamId === offer.proposingTeamId ? "CANCEL" : body.action
    // Only the receiving team may accept/reject; only the proposer may cancel. Commissioners can act on any offer.
    const allowedTeam = action === "CANCEL" ? offer.proposingTeamId : offer.receivingTeamId
    if (session.teamId !== allowedTeam && !session.isCommissioner) return NextResponse.json({ error: "You are not allowed to do that with this trade" }, { status: 403 })
    if (action === "ACCEPT") return NextResponse.json({ offer: await executeTrade(body.tradeOfferId) })
    const status = action === "REJECT" ? TradeStatus.REJECTED : TradeStatus.CANCELLED
    const result = await prisma.tradeOffer.updateMany({ where: { id: body.tradeOfferId, status: TradeStatus.PENDING }, data: { status } })
    if (result.count !== 1) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Pending trade offer not found" }, { status: 404 })
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, status })
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    console.error("Trade update failed", error)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Trade update failed" }, { status: 400 })
  }
}
