<file path="components/hockey/direct-messages-dialog.tsx">
"use client"

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { ArrowLeft, Search, Send, X } from "lucide-react"
import { Sheet, SheetContent } from "@/components/ui/sheet"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

export interface DirectMessage {
  id: string
  senderId: string
  senderName: string
  text: string
  timestamp: string
  isMe: boolean
}

export interface ConversationMeta {
  id: string
  managerName: string
  handle: string
  teamName: string
  avatar: string
  lastMessage: string
  timestamp: string
  unread: boolean
}

type ConversationResponse = {
  managerId: string
  name: string
  handle: string
  teamName: string
  lastMessage: string
  timestamp: string
  unreadCount: number
}

export function DirectMessagesDialog({ open, onOpenChange, onTrade, onUnreadChange }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void; onTrade?: (conversation: ConversationMeta) => void; onUnreadChange?: (unread: boolean) => void }) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("")
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState<ConversationMeta[]>([])
  const [threads, setThreads] = useState<Record<string, DirectMessage[]>>({})
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("")
  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const readConversationIds = useRef(new Set<string>())
  const conversationLoadRef = useRef(0)
  const activeIdRef = useRef(activeId)
  activeIdRef.current = activeId
  const active = conversations.find((conversation) => conversation.id === activeId) ?? null
  const thread = active ? threads[active.id] ?? [] : []
  const filtered = useMemo(() => conversations.filter((item) => `${item.managerName} ${item.teamName} ${item.handle}`.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())), [conversations, query])

  const loadConversations = async () => {
    const requestId = ++conversationLoadRef.current
    const response = await fetch("/api/messages", { cache: "no-store" })
    if (!response.ok || requestId !== conversationLoadRef.current) return
    const data = await response.json() as ConversationResponse[]
    const mapped = data.map((item) => ({ id: item.managerId, managerName: item.name, handle: item.handle, teamName: item.teamName, avatar: item.name.split(/\s+/).map((part) => part[0]).join("").slice(0, 2).toUpperCase(), lastMessage: item.lastMessage, timestamp: item.timestamp, unread: item.unreadCount > 0 && !readConversationIds.current.has(item.managerId) }))
    setConversations(mapped)
    onUnreadChange?.(mapped.some((item) => item.unread))
  }

  const loadThread = async (partnerId: string) => {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/messages?recipientId=${encodeURIComponent(partnerId)}`, { cache: "no-store" })
    if (!response.ok) return
    const messages = await response.json() as DirectMessage[]
    setThreads((current) => ({ ...current, [partnerId]: messages }))
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    void loadConversations()
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      void loadConversations()
      const partnerId = activeIdRef.current
      if (partnerId) void loadThread(partnerId)
    }, 6000)
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer)
  }, [open])

  useEffect(() => { if (open && activeId) void loadThread(activeId) }, [open, activeId])
  useEffect(() => { messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" }) }, [activeId, thread.length])

  const markConversationRead = async (partnerId: string) => {
    try {
      await fetch("/api/messages", { method: "PATCH", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ conversationPartnerId: partnerId }) })
    } finally {
      readConversationIds.current.delete(partnerId)
      await loadConversations()
    }
  }

  const selectConversation = (conversation: ConversationMeta) => {
    setActiveId(conversation.id)
    readConversationIds.current.add(conversation.id)
    setConversations((current) => current.map((item) => item.id === conversation.id ? { ...item, unread: false } : item))
    onUnreadChange?.(conversations.some((item) => item.id !== conversation.id && item.unread))
    void markConversationRead(conversation.id)
  }

  const handleSendMessage = async () => {
    if (!active || !draft.trim()) return
    const text = draft.trim()
    const optimistic: DirectMessage = { id: `optimistic-${Date.now()}`, senderId: "you", senderName: "You", text, timestamp: "Just now", isMe: true }
    setThreads((current) => ({ ...current, [active.id]: [...(current[active.id] ?? []), optimistic] }))
    setConversations((current) => current.map((item) => item.id === active.id ? { ...item, lastMessage: `You: ${text}`, timestamp: "Just now" } : item))
    setDraft("")
    const response = await fetch("/api/messages", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ recipientId: active.id, body: text }) })
    if (response.ok) await loadThread(active.id)
  }

  return <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}><SheetContent side="bottom" spring="gentle" overlayClassName="!z-40 !bg-black/70 supports-backdrop-filter:!backdrop-blur-sm" className="!fixed !bottom-0 !left-1/2 !right-auto !top-auto !z-50 !w-full !max-w-[430px] !-translate-x-1/2 !h-[85vh] !max-h-[85vh] !flex !flex-col !gap-0 !overflow-hidden !rounded-t-3xl !border-x !border-t !border-[#1a263d] !bg-[#070a12] !p-0 !text-white !shadow-2xl">
    <div className="shrink-0 border-b border-[#1a263d] p-4"><div className="flex items-center justify-between"><div className="flex items-center gap-2">{active && <button type="button" onClick={() => setActiveId(null)} aria-label="Back to direct messages"><ArrowLeft className="size-5" /></button>}<h2 className="text-lg font-black">{active ? active.handle : "Direct Messages"}</h2></div><button type="button" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)} aria-label="Close direct messages"><X className="size-5" /></button></div>{!active && <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-[#1b2842] bg-[#0d1424] px-3 py-2"><Search className="size-4 text-[#5e7090]" /><input value={query} onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)} placeholder="Search managers" className="min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent text-sm outline-none placeholder:text-[#5e7090]" /></div>}{active && <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[#6d86ab]"><span>{active.teamName}</span><button type="button" onClick={() => onTrade?.(active)} className="rounded-full bg-[#16233b] px-3 py-1 font-black text-[#19ffff]">Trade ⇄</button></div>}</div>
    <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain p-3">{active ? <div className="space-y-3">{thread.map((message) => <div key={message.id} className={cn("max-w-[82%] rounded-2xl px-3 py-2 text-sm", message.isMe ? "ml-auto rounded-tr-sm bg-[#0c2231] text-[#19ffff]" : "rounded-tl-sm bg-[#0d1424] text-[#cbd5e1]")}>{message.text}<small className="mt-1 block text-xs opacity-60">{message.timestamp}</small></div>)}<div ref={messagesEndRef} /></div> : <div className="space-y-1">{filtered.map((item) => <button key={item.id} type="button" onClick={() => selectConversation(item)} className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-xl p-3 text-left hover:bg-[#111c2e]"><span className="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#172338] text-xs font-black text-[#19ffff]">{item.avatar}</span><span className="min-w-0 flex-1"><b className="block text-sm">{item.managerName}</b><small className="text-xs text-[#6d86ab]">{item.handle} · {item.teamName}</small><span className="block truncate text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">{item.lastMessage}</span></span><span className="text-xs text-[#5e7090]">{item.timestamp}</span>{item.unread && <i className="size-2 rounded-full bg-[#f43f5e]" />}</button>)}</div>}</div>
    {active && <form onSubmit={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); void handleSendMessage() }} className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 border-t border-[#141e33] p-3"><input value={draft} onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)} placeholder="Message..." className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-full border border-[#1b2842] bg-[#0d1424] px-4 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#19ffff]" /><button type="submit" aria-label="Send direct message" className="flex size-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]"><Send className="size-4" /></button></form>}
  </SheetContent></Sheet>

<file path="components/hockey/transactions-drawer.tsx">
"use client"

import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { X } from "lucide-react"
import { Sheet, SheetContent } from "@/components/ui/sheet"
import type { ActivityItem, WaiverClaim } from "@/lib/hockey-data"

type ShownClaim = WaiverClaim & { outcome?: string | null }

export function TransactionsDrawer({ open, claims, activities, onOpenChange, onCancel, teamId }: {
  open: boolean
  claims: WaiverClaim[]
  activities: ActivityItem[]
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void
  onCancel: (claim: WaiverClaim) => void
  teamId?: string
}) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<ShownClaim | null>(null)
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false)
  const [cancelling, setCancelling] = useState(false)
  const [cancelError, setCancelError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [liveClaims, setLiveClaims] = useState<ShownClaim[]>(claims)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!teamId) setLiveClaims(claims)
  }, [claims, teamId])
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !teamId) return
    fetch(`/api/waivers?teamId=${encodeURIComponent(teamId)}`, { cache: "no-store" })
      .then(async (response) => response.ok ? (await response.json() as { claims?: ShownClaim[] }).claims ?? [] : [])
      .then(setLiveClaims)
      .catch((error: unknown) => console.error("Could not load waiver claims", error))
  }, [open, teamId])
  const displayedClaims = teamId ? liveClaims : claims
  const pending = displayedClaims.filter((claim) => claim.status !== "won" && claim.status !== "failed")
  const results = displayedClaims.filter((claim) => claim.status === "won" || claim.status === "failed")
  const close = () => { setSelected(null); setConfirming(false); setCancelError(null); onOpenChange(false) }
  const confirmCancel = async () => {
    if (!selected || cancelling) return
    if (!teamId) {
      onCancel(selected)
      setSelected(null)
      setConfirming(false)
      setCancelError(null)
      return
    }
    setCancelling(true)
    setCancelError(null)
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/waivers", { method: "DELETE", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ teamId, claimId: selected.id }) })
      if (!response.ok) {
        const failure = await response.json().catch(() => null) as { error?: string } | null
        setCancelError(failure?.error ?? "Could not cancel waiver.")
        return
      }
      setLiveClaims((current) => current.filter((claim) => claim.id !== selected.id))
      onCancel(selected)
      setSelected(null)
      setConfirming(false)
      setCancelError(null)
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      console.error("Could not cancel waiver", error)
      setCancelError("Could not cancel waiver.")
    } finally {
      setCancelling(false)
    }
  }
  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={(value) => !value && close()}>
      <SheetContent side="bottom" spring="gentle" className="mx-auto max-h-[82vh] max-w-[430px] overflow-y-auto rounded-t-2xl border-t border-[#1a263d] bg-[#0d1424] p-0 text-white">
        <div className="mx-auto mt-2 h-1 w-10 rounded-full bg-[#5e7090]" />
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#172338] px-4 pb-3 pt-2">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-black">Transactions</h2>
          <button type="button" onClick={close} aria-label="Close"><X className="size-5 text-[#8ba0c7]" /></button>
        </div>
        <div className="p-4">
          <h3 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5e7090]">Waiver Claims</h3>
          {pending.length === 0 && results.length === 0 && <p className="mt-2 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-[#263858] p-3 text-xs text-[#5e7090]">No pending waivers</p>}
          {pending.length === 0 && results.length > 0 && <p className="mt-2 rounded-lg border border-[#172338] bg-[#111c30] p-3 text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">Waivers have processed.</p>}
          {pending.length > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-2 space-y-2">
              {pending.map((claim, index) => (
                <button key={claim.id} type="button" onClick={() => { setSelected(claim); setConfirming(false); setCancelError(null) }} className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-[#172338] bg-[#111c30] p-3 text-left">
                  <span className="text-lg font-black text-[#5e7090]">{index + 1}</span>
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-[#19ffff]">+ ADD {claim.playerToAdd.name}</p>
                    <p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-[#ff2a85]">- DROP {claim.playerToDrop?.name ?? "No player"}</p>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">For next week&apos;s lineup · Monday midnight</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right text-xs font-bold text-[#5e7090]">BID ${claim.bidAmount}</div>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          {results.length > 0 && (
            <>
              <h3 className="mt-6 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5e7090]">This week&apos;s results</h3>
              <div className="mt-2 space-y-2">
                {results.map((claim) => (
                  <div key={claim.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-[#172338] bg-[#111c30] p-3">
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-white">+ ADD {claim.playerToAdd.name}</p>
                      <p className="truncate text-xs text-[#5e7090]">- DROP {claim.playerToDrop?.name ?? "No player"} · ${claim.bidAmount}</p>
                    </div>
                    <p className={claim.status === "won" ? "text-xs font-black text-[#19ffff]" : "text-xs font-black text-[#ff2a85]"}>{claim.outcome ?? (claim.status === "won" ? "Won" : "Not awarded")}</p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </>
          )}
          <h3 className="mt-6 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5e7090]">Transaction History</h3>
          <div className="mt-2 space-y-2">
            {activities.map((activity) => (
              <div key={activity.id} className="rounded-lg border border-[#172338] bg-[#111c30] p-3">
                <p className="text-xs text-[#5e7090]">{activity.owner} · {activity.time}</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-bold text-white">
                  <span className={activity.action === "ADD" ? "text-[#19ffff]" : "text-[#ff2a85]"}>{activity.action === "ADD" ? "+ ADD" : activity.action === "DROP" ? "- DROP" : "TRADE"}</span> {activity.player} <span className="text-[#5e7090]">({activity.detail})</span>
                </p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        {selected && selected.status !== "won" && selected.status !== "failed" && (
          <div className="border-t border-[#172338] bg-[#101829] p-4">
            <p className="text-sm font-black text-white">{confirming ? "Cancel Waiver - Please confirm you want to do this!" : `Manage waiver for ${selected.playerToAdd.name}`}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">This add is for next week&apos;s lineup. It processes Monday at midnight, after the final game.</p>
            {confirming ? (
              <div className="mt-3">
                {cancelError && <p role="alert" className="mb-2 text-xs font-bold text-rose-400">{cancelError}</p>}
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <button type="button" disabled={cancelling} onClick={() => { setConfirming(false); setCancelError(null) }} className="h-10 flex-1 rounded-full bg-[#172338] text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-40">No</button>
                  <button type="button" disabled={cancelling} onClick={() => void confirmCancel()} className="h-10 flex-1 rounded-full bg-[#ff2a85] text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-40">{cancelling ? "Cancelling..." : "Yes"}</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setSelected(null)} className="h-10 flex-1 rounded-full bg-[#172338] text-xs font-black text-white">Cancel</button>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setConfirming(true)} className="h-10 flex-1 rounded-full bg-[#ff2a85] text-xs font-black uppercase text-white">Cancel Waiver</button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  )
}

<file path="e2e/05-audit-regressions.spec.ts">
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test"
import { getCurrentFantasyWeek } from "../lib/season-calendar"

test.describe("audit regressions", () => {
  test("players market: F/W/G filters and goalie sort controls", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/")
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "PLAYERS", exact: true }).click()
    await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Available", exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Filters", exact: true }).click()

    // Skater sorts include SOG; goalie sorts must replace them with W / SV / SV% / GAA / SO.
    await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "SOG", exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByTestId("position-filter-G").click()
    for (const sort of ["W", "SV", "SV%", "GAA", "SO"]) {
      await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: sort, exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible()
    }
    await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "SOG", exact: true })).toHaveCount(0)

    await page.getByTestId("position-filter-F").click()
    await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "SOG", exact: true })).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByTestId("position-filter-W").click()
    await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "SOG", exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  })

  test("matchup: unplayed future weeks reset to 0.00 vs 0.00 and never show projections as actuals", async ({ page }) => {

  test("roster move: swapping an injured player into a full IR slot persists, and is reversible", async ({ request }) => {
    const BEDARD = 8484144
    const SHESTERKIN = 8478048
    const session = await (await request.get("/api/auth/session")).json() as { user?: { teamId: string } }
    const teamId = session.user!.teamId
    type Row = { playerId: number; slot: string }
    // The current week locks starters once the first game starts. Arrange next week so the IR swap can still run.
    const openWeek = getCurrentFantasyWeek() + 1
    const move = (playerId: number, targetSlot: string) => request.post("/api/roster/move", { data: { teamId, playerId, targetSlot, week: openWeek } })
    const slotsOf = async (response: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof move>>) => {
      expect(response.ok(), await response.text()).toBe(true)
      return new Map(((await response.json()) as { roster: Row[] }).roster.map((row) => [row.playerId, row.slot]))
    }

    // Probe (a no-op move) so the test only runs against the expected starting layout.
    const before = await slotsOf(await move(BEDARD, "IR"))
    test.skip(before.get(BEDARD) !== "IR" || before.get(SHESTERKIN) === "IR", "Unexpected starting roster layout")

    const swapped = await move(SHESTERKIN, "IR")
    expect(swapped.status()).toBe(200)
    const after = await slotsOf(swapped)
    expect(after.get(SHESTERKIN)).toBe("IR")
    expect(after.get(BEDARD)).not.toBe("IR")
    // Bedard is a center. Coming off IR must not drop him into Shesterkin's goalie slot.
    if (before.get(SHESTERKIN) === "G") expect(after.get(BEDARD)).not.toBe("G")

    // Revert so the shared database is left exactly as it was found.
    const restoredMover = await slotsOf(await move(SHESTERKIN, before.get(SHESTERKIN) ?? "G"))
    expect(restoredMover.get(SHESTERKIN)).toBe(before.get(SHESTERKIN))
    const reverted = await slotsOf(await move(BEDARD, "IR"))
    expect(reverted.get(BEDARD)).toBe("IR")
  })

  test("roster move: healthy players cannot be placed on IR", async ({ request }) => {
    const session = await (await request.get("/api/auth/session")).json() as { user?: { teamId: string } }
    const response = await request.post("/api/roster/move", { data: { teamId: session.user!.teamId, playerId: 8479318, targetSlot: "IR" } })
    expect(response.status()).toBe(400)
  })})

<file path="lib/services/nhl-sync.ts">
import { PlayerStatus, Position, Prisma, SlotType } from "@prisma/client"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { scoreGameStat, DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING, type LeagueScoring } from "@/lib/scoring"
import { scoreTeams } from "@/lib/matchup-scoring"
import { isWeekFinal } from "@/lib/matchup-scoring"
import { getCurrentFantasyWeek, getEasternDate, getFantasyWeekDates } from "@/lib/season-calendar"
import { getLockSummary } from "@/lib/services/lineup-locks"
import { isStarterSlot } from "@/lib/lineup-lock"
import { freezeWeekLineup, scoringSlotsForWeek } from "@/lib/services/week-lineups"

const NHL_HEADERS = { Accept: "application/json", "User-Agent": "JohnScottDynasty/1.0" }
const ACTIVE_STATES = ["LIVE", "CRIT", "FINAL", "OFF"]
const RECENT_FINAL_WINDOW_MS = 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000

type ScheduleGame = {
  id: number
  season?: number
  gameDate?: string
  startTimeUTC?: string
  gameState?: string
  periodDescriptor?: { number?: number }
  clock?: { timeRemaining?: string }
  awayTeam?: { abbrev?: string; score?: number | null }
  homeTeam?: { abbrev?: string; score?: number | null }
}

type BoxscorePlayer = Record<string, unknown> & {
  playerId?: number
  name?: string | { default?: string }
  firstName?: string | { default?: string }
  lastName?: string | { default?: string }
  position?: string
}

type BoxscoreSide = {
  forwards?: BoxscorePlayer[]
  defense?: BoxscorePlayer[]
  goalies?: BoxscorePlayer[]
}

type Boxscore = {
  playerByGameStats?: { awayTeam?: BoxscoreSide; homeTeam?: BoxscoreSide }
}

const numberValue = (value: unknown) => typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0
const stringValue = (value: unknown, fallback: string) => typeof value === "string" ? value : fallback

function playerName(player: BoxscorePlayer): string {
  if (typeof player.name === "string" && player.name.trim()) {
    return player.name.trim()
  }
  if (
    typeof player.name === "object" &&
    player.name !== null &&
    "default" in player.name &&
    typeof player.name.default === "string"
  ) {
    const localizedName = player.name.default.trim()
    if (localizedName) return localizedName
  }
  const first = typeof player.firstName === "string" ? player.firstName : player.firstName?.default ?? ""
  const last = typeof player.lastName === "string" ? player.lastName : player.lastName?.default ?? ""
  const fullName = `${first} ${last}`.trim()
  if (fullName) return fullName
  return `NHL Player ${player.playerId ?? "Unknown"}`
}

function positionFor(player: BoxscorePlayer, goalie: boolean): Position {
  if (goalie) return Position.G
  // NHL boxscores use single-letter codes (C/L/R/D/G); accept both styles.
  switch (player.position) {
    case "D": return Position.D
    case "L":
    case "LW": return Position.LW
    case "R":
    case "RW": return Position.RW
    default: return Position.C
  }
}

async function getJson<T>(url: string): Promise<T | null> {
  const response = await fetch(url, { headers: NHL_HEADERS })
  if (!response.ok) {
    console.error(`NHL request failed: ${response.status} ${url}`)
    return null
  }
  return response.json() as Promise<T>
}

export async function syncScheduleForDate(dateStr: string) {
  const data = await getJson<{ gameWeek?: Array<{ date?: string; games?: ScheduleGame[] }> }>(`https://api-web.nhle.com/v1/schedule/${dateStr}`)
  // NHL returns each game under its day; the game object itself carries no date.
  const games = data?.gameWeek?.flatMap((day) => (day.games ?? []).map((game) => ({ ...game, gameDate: game.gameDate ?? day.date }))) ?? []
  const writes = []

  for (const game of games) {
    if (!game.startTimeUTC || !game.homeTeam?.abbrev || !game.awayTeam?.abbrev) continue
    const record = {
      season: game.season ?? Number(dateStr.slice(0, 4)),
      gameDate: game.gameDate ?? dateStr,
      startTimeUTC: new Date(game.startTimeUTC),
      homeTeamAbbrev: game.homeTeam.abbrev,
      awayTeamAbbrev: game.awayTeam.abbrev,
      gameState: game.gameState ?? "FUT",
      period: game.periodDescriptor?.number ?? null,
      clock: game.clock?.timeRemaining ?? null,
      homeScore: game.homeTeam.score ?? 0,
      awayScore: game.awayTeam.score ?? 0,
    }
    writes.push(prisma.nhlGame.upsert({ where: { id: game.id }, update: record, create: { id: game.id, ...record } }))
  }
  if (writes.length === 0) return 0
  await prisma.$transaction(writes)
  return writes.length
}

type PlayerRow = { playerId: number; name: string; position: Position; teamAbbrev: string; stat: Prisma.PlayerGameStatCreateManyInput }

function parseSaveShotsAgainst(value: unknown): { saves: number; shotsAgainst: number } | null {
  if (typeof value !== "string") return null
  const [savesText, shotsText, extra] = value.split("/")
  if (shotsText == null || extra != null) return null
  const saves = Number(savesText.trim())
  const shotsAgainst = Number(shotsText.trim())
  if (!Number.isFinite(saves) || !Number.isFinite(shotsAgainst)) return null
  return { saves, shotsAgainst }
}

function collectSide(gameId: number, teamAbbrev: string, side: BoxscoreSide | undefined, scoring: LeagueScoring): PlayerRow[] {
  const playedGoalies = (side?.goalies ?? []).filter((goalie) => {
    const toi = stringValue(goalie.toi ?? goalie.timeOnIce, "0:00")
    return (toi !== "0:00" && toi !== "00:00" && toi !== "")
      || numberValue(goalie.saves) > 0
      || numberValue(goalie.shotsAgainst) > 0
      || Boolean(parseSaveShotsAgainst(goalie.saveShotsAgainst)?.shotsAgainst)
      || typeof goalie.decision === "string"
  }).length
  const rows: PlayerRow[] = []
  for (const [players, goalie] of [[side?.forwards, false], [side?.defense, false], [side?.goalies, true]] as const) {
    for (const player of players ?? []) {
      if (!player.playerId) continue
      const goals = numberValue(player.goals)
      const assists = numberValue(player.assists)
      const shots = numberValue(player.sog ?? player.shots)
      const hits = numberValue(player.hits)
      const blocks = numberValue(player.blockedShots)
      const powerPlayPoints = numberValue(player.powerPlayPoints)
      const shorthandedGoals = numberValue(player.shorthandedGoals)
      const gameWinningGoals = numberValue(player.gameWinningGoals)
      let saves = numberValue(player.saves)
      let shotsAgainst = numberValue(player.shotsAgainst)
      if (saves === 0 || shotsAgainst === 0) {
        const parsed = parseSaveShotsAgainst(player.saveShotsAgainst)
        if (parsed) {
          if (saves === 0) saves = parsed.saves
          if (shotsAgainst === 0) shotsAgainst = parsed.shotsAgainst
        }
      }
      const goalsAgainst = numberValue(player.goalsAgainst)
      const decision = typeof player.decision === "string" ? player.decision : null
      const plusMinus = numberValue(player.plusMinus)
      const shutouts = numberValue(player.shutouts) || (goalie && playedGoalies === 1 && decision === "W" && goalsAgainst === 0 && (saves > 0 || shotsAgainst > 0) ? 1 : 0)
      const savePct = typeof player.savePctg === "number" ? player.savePctg : typeof player.savePct === "number" ? player.savePct : shotsAgainst > 0 ? Number((saves / shotsAgainst).toFixed(4)) : null
      const pim = numberValue(player.pim)
      const toi = stringValue(player.toi ?? player.timeOnIce, "0:00")
      // Dressed backups (especially goalies) are listed with no time, no decision, and an empty line.
      if (
        (toi === "0:00" || toi === "00:00" || toi === "") &&
        !decision &&
        goals + assists + shots + hits + blocks + pim + Math.abs(plusMinus) + shotsAgainst + goalsAgainst + saves + shutouts === 0
      ) continue
      const fantasyPoints = scoreGameStat({ goals, assists, shots, hits, blocks, plusMinus, powerPlayPoints, shorthandedGoals, gameWinningGoals, saves, goalsAgainst, shutouts, decision }, scoring)
      rows.push({
        playerId: player.playerId,
        name: playerName(player),
        position: positionFor(player, goalie),
        teamAbbrev,
        stat: {
          playerId: player.playerId,
          gameId,
          goals, assists, shots, hits, blocks,
          pim,
          plusMinus,
          powerPlayPoints, shorthandedGoals, gameWinningGoals,
          toi,
          shotsAgainst,
          goalsAgainst, saves, shutouts,
          savePct,
          decision,
          fantasyPoints,
        },
      })
    }
  }
  return rows
}

/** Stores one game's boxscore, then refreshes team abbreviations and games played for the players who appeared. */
async function syncGameStats(game: { id: number; homeTeamAbbrev: string; awayTeamAbbrev: string }, boxscore: NonNullable<Boxscore["playerByGameStats"]>, scoring: LeagueScoring) {
  const rows = [
    ...collectSide(game.id, game.awayTeamAbbrev, boxscore.awayTeam, scoring),
    ...collectSide(game.id, game.homeTeamAbbrev, boxscore.homeTeam, scoring),
  ]
  if (rows.length === 0) return
  const playerIds = [...new Set(rows.map((row) => row.playerId))]
  const known = await prisma.player.findMany({ where: { id: { in: playerIds } }, select: { id: true, teamAbbrev: true } })
  const knownTeams = new Map(known.map((player) => [player.id, player.teamAbbrev]))
  const missingById = new Map<number, PlayerRow>()
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (!knownTeams.has(row.playerId)) missingById.set(row.playerId, row)
  }
  if (missingById.size > 0) {
    await prisma.player.createMany({
      data: [...missingById.values()].map((row) => ({ id: row.playerId, name: row.name, teamAbbrev: row.teamAbbrev, position: row.position, injuryStatus: PlayerStatus.HEALTHY })),
      skipDuplicates: true,
    })
  }
  await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.playerGameStat.deleteMany({ where: { gameId: game.id } }),
    prisma.playerGameStat.createMany({ data: rows.map((row) => row.stat), skipDuplicates: true }),
  ])

  const teamChanges = new Map<string, number[]>()
  for (const row of rows) {
    const stored = knownTeams.get(row.playerId)
    if (stored === undefined || stored === row.teamAbbrev) continue
    const ids = teamChanges.get(row.teamAbbrev) ?? []
    if (!ids.includes(row.playerId)) ids.push(row.playerId)
    teamChanges.set(row.teamAbbrev, ids)
  }
  if (teamChanges.size > 0) {
    await prisma.$transaction(
      [...teamChanges].map(([teamAbbrev, ids]) => prisma.player.updateMany({ where: { id: { in: ids } }, data: { teamAbbrev } })),
    )
  }

  await prisma.$executeRaw`
    UPDATE "Player" AS p
    SET "nhlGamesPlayed" = GREATEST(
      p."nhlGamesPlayed",
      (
        SELECT COUNT(*)::int
        FROM "PlayerGameStat" AS s
        INNER JOIN "NhlGame" AS g ON g.id = s."gameId"
        WHERE s."playerId" = p.id
          AND g."gameState" IN ('FINAL', 'OFF')
          AND (s.toi NOT IN ('0:00', '00:00', '') OR s.decision IS NOT NULL OR s.shots > 0 OR s.saves > 0 OR s.goals > 0 OR s.assists > 0)
      )
    )
    WHERE p.id IN (${Prisma.join(playerIds)})
  `
}

/**
 * Pulls boxscores for live games, games that finished in the last 48 hours, and older finished games
 * that have no stats yet or were stored with every shot total at 0 (boxscores synced before `sog` was read).
 * Recently finalized games are always included so a schedule sync that flips LIVE to FINAL cannot skip the final boxscore.
 * `limit` bounds how many of those older finished games are backfilled in one run.
 */
export async function syncActiveGameBoxscores(limit = 40) {
  const gameSelect = { id: true, homeTeamAbbrev: true, awayTeamAbbrev: true } as const
  const recentCutoff = new Date(Date.now() - RECENT_FINAL_WINDOW_MS)
  const [live, recentlyFinished, missing] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.nhlGame.findMany({ where: { gameState: { in: ["LIVE", "CRIT"] } }, select: gameSelect }),
    prisma.nhlGame.findMany({
      where: { gameState: { in: ["FINAL", "OFF"] }, startTimeUTC: { gte: recentCutoff } },
      select: gameSelect,
    }),
    prisma.nhlGame.findMany({
      where: { gameState: { in: ["FINAL", "OFF"] }, OR: [{ gameStats: { none: {} } }, { gameStats: { every: { shots: 0 } } }] },
      select: gameSelect,
      orderBy: { startTimeUTC: "asc" },
      take: limit,
    }),
  ])
  const seen = new Set<number>()
  const games = []
  for (const game of [...live, ...recentlyFinished, ...missing]) {
    if (seen.has(game.id)) continue
    seen.add(game.id)
    games.push(game)
  }
  const league = await prisma.league.findFirst({ select: { scoringSettings: true } })
  const scoring = (league?.scoringSettings ?? DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING) as LeagueScoring
  let processedGames = 0
  for (const game of games) {
    const boxscore = await getJson<Boxscore>(`https://api-web.nhle.com/v1/gamecenter/${game.id}/boxscore`)
    if (!boxscore?.playerByGameStats) continue
    await syncGameStats(game, boxscore.playerByGameStats, scoring)
    processedGames += 1
  }
  return processedGames
}

/** Syncs the NHL schedule for the given fantasy weeks (each schedule call returns that Monday-to-Sunday week). */
export async function syncScheduleForWeeks(season: number, weeks: number[]) {
  const counts = await Promise.all(weeks.map((week) => syncScheduleForDate(getFantasyWeekDates(week, season).startDate)))
  return counts.reduce((total, count) => total + count, 0)
}

/**
 * Scores a fantasy week from the NHL games played on the week's real calendar dates.
 * Past weeks, and the current week once it has started under weekly lock, are copied into
 * an immutable WeekLineup snapshot before scoring so later trades and lineup moves cannot rewrite them.
 * Marks the matchup final once the week is over and every NHL game in it has finished.
 */
export async function updateWeeklyMatchupScores(leagueId: string, week: number) {
  const league = await prisma.league.findUnique({ where: { id: leagueId }, select: { currentSeason: true, scoringSettings: true, lineupLockMode: true } })
  if (!league) return 0
  const matchups = await prisma.matchup.findMany({
    where: { leagueId, week, season: league.currentSeason },
    select: { id: true, homeTeamId: true, awayTeamId: true },
  })
  if (matchups.length === 0) return 0

  const { dates, endDate } = getFantasyWeekDates(week, league.currentSeason)
  const currentWeek = getCurrentFantasyWeek(league.currentSeason)
  if (week < currentWeek) {
    await freezeWeekLineup(prisma, leagueId, league.currentSeason, week)
  } else if (week === currentWeek) {
    const lock = await getLockSummary(league.currentSeason, league.lineupLockMode)
    if (lock.mode === "WEEKLY" && lock.weekStarted) await freezeWeekLineup(prisma, leagueId, league.currentSeason, week)
  }
  const [games, slots] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.nhlGame.findMany({ where: { gameDate: { in: dates } }, select: { id: true, gameState: true } }),
    scoringSlotsForWeek(leagueId, league.currentSeason, week),
  ])
  const stats = await prisma.playerGameStat.findMany({
    where: { gameId: { in: games.map((game) => game.id) }, playerId: { in: slots.filter((slot) => isStarterSlot(slot.slot)).map((slot) => slot.playerId) } },
  })
  const totals = scoreTeams(slots, stats, league.scoringSettings as LeagueScoring | null)
  const final = isWeekFinal(endDate, getEasternDate(), games.map((game) => game.gameState))

  await prisma.$transaction(
    matchups.map((matchup) => {
      const home = totals.get(matchup.homeTeamId) ?? 0
      const away = totals.get(matchup.awayTeamId) ?? 0
      return prisma.matchup.update({
        where: { id: matchup.id },
        data: { homePoints: home, awayPoints: away, homeScore: home, awayScore: away, isFinal: final },
      })
    }),
  )
  return matchups.length
}

/** Recomputes every week from week 1 through the current week so history always matches the stats in the database. */
export async function recomputeMatchupsThroughWeek(leagueId: string, throughWeek: number) {
  let updated = 0
  for (let week = 1; week <= throughWeek; week += 1) updated += await updateWeeklyMatchupScores(leagueId, week)
  return updated
}

/** Keeps `League.currentWeek` aligned with the NHL calendar. */
export async function syncLeagueWeek(leagueId: string) {
  const league = await prisma.league.findUnique({ where: { id: leagueId }, select: { currentSeason: true, currentWeek: true } })
  if (!league) return null
  const week = getCurrentFantasyWeek(league.currentSeason)
  if (week !== league.currentWeek) await prisma.league.update({ where: { id: leagueId }, data: { currentWeek: week } })
  return week
}

/**
 * Persists lock timestamps so every view agrees with `getLockSummary`:
 * WEEKLY locks all starting slots from the first game of the week to Sunday night; DAILY locks players whose team's game started today.
 */
export async function enforceRosterLocks() {
  const leagues = await prisma.league.findMany({ select: { id: true, currentSeason: true, lineupLockMode: true } })
  let locked = 0
  for (const league of leagues) {
    const summary = await getLockSummary(league.currentSeason, league.lineupLockMode)
    const inLeague = { team: { leagueId: league.id } }
    if (summary.mode === "WEEKLY") {
      if (summary.weekStarted) await freezeWeekLineup(prisma, league.id, league.currentSeason, summary.week)
      const starters = [SlotType.C, SlotType.W, SlotType.F, SlotType.D, SlotType.G]
      await prisma.rosterSlot.updateMany({
        where: { ...inLeague, lockedAt: { not: null }, ...(summary.weekStarted ? { slot: { notIn: starters } } : {}) },
        data: { lockedAt: null },
      })
      if (summary.weekStarted) {
        const result = await prisma.rosterSlot.updateMany({ where: { ...inLeague, lockedAt: null, slot: { in: starters } }, data: { lockedAt: new Date() } })
        locked += result.count
      }
      continue
    }
    const teams = [...summary.startedTeams]
    await prisma.rosterSlot.updateMany({ where: { ...inLeague, lockedAt: { not: null }, player: { teamAbbrev: { notIn: teams } } }, data: { lockedAt: null } })
    if (teams.length === 0) continue
    const result = await prisma.rosterSlot.updateMany({ where: { ...inLeague, lockedAt: null, player: { teamAbbrev: { in: teams } } }, data: { lockedAt: new Date() } })
    locked += result.count
  }
  return locked
}
export type SyncError = Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError

/** Re-prices every stored stat line with the league scoring rules (run after the commissioner edits scoring). */
export async function rescoreAllStats(scoring: LeagueScoring) {
  const s = { ...DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING, ...scoring }
  const n = (value: number) => (Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0)
  return prisma.$executeRaw`
    UPDATE "PlayerGameStat" SET "fantasyPoints" = ROUND((
      goals * ${n(s.goal)} + assists * ${n(s.assist)} + shots * ${n(s.shot)} + hits * ${n(s.hit)} + blocks * ${n(s.block)}
      + "powerPlayPoints" * ${n(s.ppp)} + "shorthandedGoals" * ${n(s.shg)} + "gameWinningGoals" * ${n(s.gwg)} + "plusMinus" * ${n(s.plusMinus)}
      + CASE WHEN decision = 'W' THEN ${n(s.win)} WHEN decision IN ('OT','OTL') THEN ${n(s.overtimeLoss)} ELSE 0 END
      + saves * ${n(s.save)} + "goalsAgainst" * ${n(s.goalsAgainst)} + shutouts * ${n(s.shutout)}
    )::numeric, 2)`
}

<file path="lib/scoring.ts">
export interface FantasyStats {
  goals?: number | null
  assists?: number | null
  shots?: number | null
  hits?: number | null
  blocks?: number | null
  powerPlayPoints?: number | null
  shorthandedGoals?: number | null
  gameWinningGoals?: number | null
  wins?: number | null
  saves?: number | null
  goalsAgainst?: number | null
  shutouts?: number | null
  otLosses?: number | null
}

const value = (number: number | null | undefined) => number ?? 0

/** League-configurable scoring (keys match the commissioner rulebook). */
export type LeagueScoring = Partial<Record<
  "goal" | "assist" | "shot" | "hit" | "block" | "ppp" | "shg" | "gwg" | "plusMinus" | "win" | "save" | "goalsAgainst" | "shutout" | "overtimeLoss",
  number
>>

export const DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING: Required<LeagueScoring> = {
  goal: 3, assist: 2, shot: 0.2, hit: 0.2, block: 0.2, ppp: 0, shg: 0, gwg: 0, plusMinus: 0,
  win: 4, save: 0.2, goalsAgainst: -1, shutout: 3, overtimeLoss: 0,
}

export function calculateFantasyPoints(stats: FantasyStats): number {
  const scoring = DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING
  const total =
    value(stats.goals) * scoring.goal +
    value(stats.assists) * scoring.assist +
    value(stats.shots) * scoring.shot +
    value(stats.hits) * scoring.hit +
    value(stats.blocks) * scoring.block +
    value(stats.powerPlayPoints) * scoring.ppp +
    value(stats.shorthandedGoals) * scoring.shg +
    value(stats.gameWinningGoals) * scoring.gwg +
    value(stats.wins) * scoring.win +
    value(stats.saves) * scoring.save +
    value(stats.goalsAgainst) * scoring.goalsAgainst +
    value(stats.shutouts) * scoring.shutout +
    value(stats.otLosses) * scoring.overtimeLoss
  return Math.round(total * 100) / 100
}

export interface RawGameStat {
  goals: number
  assists: number
  shots: number
  hits: number
  blocks: number
  plusMinus: number
  powerPlayPoints: number
  shorthandedGoals: number
  gameWinningGoals: number
  saves: number
  goalsAgainst: number
  shutouts: number
  decision?: string | null
}

export interface CountingLine {
  goals?: number | null
  assists?: number | null
  shots?: number | null
  hits?: number | null
  blocks?: number | null
  plusMinus?: number | null
  powerPlayPoints?: number | null
  shorthandedGoals?: number | null
  gameWinningGoals?: number | null
  wins?: number | null
  overtimeLosses?: number | null
  saves?: number | null
  goalsAgainst?: number | null
  shutouts?: number | null
}

/** Same weights as `scoreGameStat`, for a season total or any other counting line. */
export function scoreCountingLine(counts: CountingLine, settings: LeagueScoring | null | undefined): number {
  const s = { ...DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING, ...(settings ?? {}) }
  const n = (number: number | null | undefined) => number ?? 0
  const total =
    n(counts.goals) * s.goal +
    n(counts.assists) * s.assist +
    n(counts.shots) * s.shot +
    n(counts.hits) * s.hit +
    n(counts.blocks) * s.block +
    n(counts.powerPlayPoints) * s.ppp +
    n(counts.shorthandedGoals) * s.shg +
    n(counts.gameWinningGoals) * s.gwg +
    n(counts.plusMinus) * s.plusMinus +
    n(counts.wins) * s.win +
    n(counts.overtimeLosses) * s.overtimeLoss +
    n(counts.saves) * s.save +
    n(counts.goalsAgainst) * s.goalsAgainst +
    n(counts.shutouts) * s.shutout
  return Math.round(total * 100) / 100
}

export function scoreGameStat(stat: RawGameStat, settings: LeagueScoring | null | undefined): number {
  return scoreCountingLine({
    goals: stat.goals,
    assists: stat.assists,
    shots: stat.shots,
    hits: stat.hits,
    blocks: stat.blocks,
    plusMinus: stat.plusMinus,
    powerPlayPoints: stat.powerPlayPoints,
    shorthandedGoals: stat.shorthandedGoals,
    gameWinningGoals: stat.gameWinningGoals,
    wins: stat.decision === "W" ? 1 : 0,
    overtimeLosses: stat.decision === "OTL" || stat.decision === "OT" ? 1 : 0,
    saves: stat.saves,
    goalsAgainst: stat.goalsAgainst,
    shutouts: stat.shutouts,
  }, settings)
}

<file path="prisma/seed.ts">
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises"
import { join } from "node:path"
import { PrismaClient, PlayerStatus, Position, SlotType } from "@prisma/client"
import { getMatchupsForWeek, getTeamRoster, roster, standings } from "../lib/hockey-data"
import { DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING } from "../lib/scoring"

type RegistryPlayer = {
  nhlId: number
  name: string
  team?: string
  position?: string
  headshot?: string
  injuryStatus?: string | null
  nhlGamesPlayed?: number
  currentSeasonStats?: { gamesPlayed?: number } | null
}

const prisma = new PrismaClient()
const positions = new Set<string>(Object.values(Position))
const slots = new Set<string>(Object.values(SlotType))

function enumPosition(value: string | undefined): Position {
  return positions.has(value ?? "") ? (value as Position) : Position.C
}

function playerStatus(value: string | null | undefined): PlayerStatus {
  if (value === "IR" || value === "O" || value === "DTD") return value
  return PlayerStatus.HEALTHY
}

async function main() {
  const source = await readFile(join(process.cwd(), "public", "data", "nhl-players.json"), "utf8")
  const registry = JSON.parse(source) as RegistryPlayer[]

  for (const player of registry) {
    await prisma.player.upsert({
      where: { id: player.nhlId },
      update: {
        name: player.name,
        teamAbbrev: player.team ?? "FA",
        position: enumPosition(player.position),
        nhlGamesPlayed: player.nhlGamesPlayed ?? player.currentSeasonStats?.gamesPlayed ?? 0,
        injuryStatus: playerStatus(player.injuryStatus),
        headshotUrl: player.headshot ?? null,
      },
      create: {
        id: player.nhlId,
        name: player.name,
        teamAbbrev: player.team ?? "FA",
        position: enumPosition(player.position),
        nhlGamesPlayed: player.nhlGamesPlayed ?? player.currentSeasonStats?.gamesPlayed ?? 0,
        injuryStatus: playerStatus(player.injuryStatus),
        headshotUrl: player.headshot ?? null,
      },
    })
  }

  const league = await prisma.league.upsert({
    where: { id: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" },
    update: {
      currentSeason: 2026,
      currentWeek: 1,
      rosterSize: 27,
      taxiSlots: 2,
      irSlots: 1,
      taxiMaxGames: 50,
      rosterPositions: { C: 3, W: 6, F: 3, D: 6, G: 2, BN: 7 },
      waiverSettings: { type: "FAAB", faabBudget: 100, minBid: 0, holdHours: 48 },
      tradeSettings: { reviewType: "COMMISSIONER", reviewHours: 24, deadlineWeek: 18, allowPickTrading: true },
      draftSettings: { type: "LINEAR", rounds: 5, timerSeconds: 120, scheduledDate: "2027-08-15T18:00:00Z", orderType: "REVERSE_STANDINGS" },
      scoringSettings: { ...DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING },
    },
    create: {
      id: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
      name: "John Scott Dynasty",
      currentSeason: 2026,
      currentWeek: 1,
      rosterSize: 27,
      taxiSlots: 2,
      irSlots: 1,
      taxiMaxGames: 50,
      scoringSettings: { ...DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING },
      rosterPositions: { C: 3, W: 6, F: 3, D: 6, G: 2, BN: 7 },
      waiverSettings: { type: "FAAB", faabBudget: 100, minBid: 0, holdHours: 48 },
      tradeSettings: { reviewType: "COMMISSIONER", reviewHours: 24, deadlineWeek: 18, allowPickTrading: true },
      draftSettings: { type: "LINEAR", rounds: 5, timerSeconds: 120, scheduledDate: "2027-08-15T18:00:00Z", orderType: "REVERSE_STANDINGS" },
    },
  })

  const teams = []
  for (const [index, standing] of standings.entries()) {
    // The Montreal Monarchs / @commissioner manager is always seeded as the league commissioner.
    const handle = standing.owner === "You" || standing.team === "Montreal Monarchs" ? "commissioner" : standing.owner.replace(/^@/, "")
    const isCommish = handle === "commissioner"
    const name = isCommish ? "Commissioner" : handle
    const user = await prisma.user.upsert({
      where: { handle },
      update: { name, pin: "1234", isCommissioner: isCommish },
      create: {
        email: `${handle}@example.com`,
        name,
        handle,
        pin: "1234",
        isCommissioner: isCommish,
      },
    })
    const team = await prisma.team.upsert({
      where: { leagueId_managerId: { leagueId: league.id, managerId: user.id } },
      update: { name: standing.team, faabBalance: standing.faabRemaining, waiverPriority: index + 1 },
      create: {
        leagueId: league.id,
        managerId: user.id,
        name: standing.team,
        faabBalance: standing.faabRemaining,
        waiverPriority: index + 1,
      },
    })
    teams.push(team)
  }

  await prisma.matchup.deleteMany({ where: { leagueId: league.id, season: league.currentSeason } })
  const teamByName = new Map(teams.map((team) => [team.name, team]))
  for (let week = 1; week <= 24; week += 1) {
    for (const matchup of getMatchupsForWeek(week)) {
      const homeTeam = teamByName.get(matchup.homeTeam)
      const awayTeam = teamByName.get(matchup.awayTeam)
      if (!homeTeam || !awayTeam) continue
      await prisma.matchup.create({
        data: {
          leagueId: league.id,
          season: league.currentSeason,
          week,
          homeTeamId: homeTeam.id,
          awayTeamId: awayTeam.id,
        },
      })
    }
  }

  const registryByName = new Map(registry.map((player) => [player.name.toLowerCase(), player]))
  for (const [index, team] of teams.entries()) {
    const teamRoster = getTeamRoster(standings[index].team, roster)
    await prisma.rosterSlot.deleteMany({ where: { teamId: team.id } })
    for (const playerSlot of teamRoster) {
      const player = registryByName.get(playerSlot.name.toLowerCase())
      const slot = slots.has(playerSlot.slot) ? (playerSlot.slot as SlotType) : SlotType.BN
      if (player) {
        await prisma.rosterSlot.create({
          data: { teamId: team.id, playerId: player.nhlId, slot },
        })
      }
    }
  }

  for (const team of teams) {
    for (const season of [2027, 2028, 2029]) {
      for (let round = 1; round <= 5; round += 1) {
        await prisma.draftPick.upsert({
          where: {
            leagueId_season_round_originalTeamId: {
              leagueId: league.id,
              season,
              round,
              originalTeamId: team.id,
            },
          },
          update: { currentTeamId: team.id },
          create: {
            leagueId: league.id,
            season,
            round,
            originalTeamId: team.id,
            currentTeamId: team.id,
          },
        })
      }
    }
  }
}

main()
  .catch((error: unknown) => {
    console.error(error)
    process.exitCode = 1
  })
  .finally(async () => {
    await prisma.$disconnect()
  })
</file>

  {

import { NextResponse } from "next/server"
import fs from "node:fs"
import path from "node:path"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { type PlayerGameLog } from "@/lib/hockey-data"
import { DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING, scoreGameStat, type LeagueScoring, type RawGameStat } from "@/lib/scoring"

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"
export const runtime = "nodejs"

function normalizePlayer(player: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const position = player.position === "LW" || player.position === "RW" || player.position === "D" || player.position === "G" || player.position === "C"
    ? player.position
    : "C"
  const goalie = position === "G"
  const unplayedGoalie = goalie && !player.gp && !player.saves
  const injuryStatus = player.injuryStatus === "IR" || player.injuryStatus === "DTD" || player.injuryStatus === "O"
    ? player.injuryStatus
    : null
  return {
    rank: 0,
    name: String(player.name ?? "Unknown Player"),
    position,
    team: String(player.team ?? "NHL"),
    waiver: String(player.waiver ?? "FA"),
    velocity: "0",
    rostered: "0%",
    trend: "steady",
    fpts: Number(player.fpts ?? player.projPts ?? 0),
    projection: Number(player.projection ?? player.projPts ?? 0),
    gp: unplayedGoalie ? Number(player.gp ?? 0) : Math.max(1, Number(player.gp ?? 82)),
    goals: Number(player.goals ?? 0),
    assists: Number(player.assists ?? 0),
    sog: Number(player.sog ?? 0),
    hits: Number(player.hits ?? 0),
    blocks: Number(player.blocks ?? 0),
    adp: Number(player.adp ?? 999),
    ...(goalie ? {
      wins: Number(player.wins ?? 0),
      saves: Number(player.saves ?? 0),
      shutouts: Number(player.shutouts ?? 0),
      savePct: Number(player.savePct ?? (unplayedGoalie ? 0 : 0.915)),
    } : {}),
    nhlId: Number(player.nhlId),
    headshot: String(player.headshot ?? `https://assets.nhle.com/mugs/nhl/latest/${player.nhlId}.png`),
    id: String(player.id ?? `nhl-${player.nhlId}`),
    slot: player.slot,
    projPts: Number(player.projPts ?? 0),
    todayPts: player.todayPts ?? null,
    opponent: String(player.opponent ?? "—"),
    profile: player.profile,
    currentSeasonStats: player.currentSeasonStats,
    gameLog: Array.isArray(player.gameLog) ? staticGameLogs(player.gameLog) : undefined,
    historicalSeasons: player.historicalSeasons,
    nhlGamesPlayed: typeof player.nhlGamesPlayed === "number" ? player.nhlGamesPlayed : undefined,
    injuryStatus,
    injuryVerification: player.injuryVerification,
    injurySources: player.injurySources,
  }
}

type RegistryPlayer = ReturnType<typeof normalizePlayer>
type Position = RegistryPlayer["position"]
type InjuryStatus = NonNullable<RegistryPlayer["injuryStatus"]>

type DatabasePlayer = {
  id: number
  name: string
  teamAbbrev: string
  position: string
  injuryStatus: string
  nhlGamesPlayed: number
}

type LiveStat = {
  playerId: number
  goals: number
  assists: number
  shots: number
  hits: number
  blocks: number
  pim: number
  plusMinus: number
  powerPlayPoints: number
  shorthandedGoals: number
  gameWinningGoals: number
  toi: string
  decision: string | null
  shotsAgainst: number
  goalsAgainst: number
  saves: number
  savePct: number | null
  shutouts: number
  fantasyPoints: number
  gameId: number
  season: number
  gameDate: string
  homeTeamAbbrev: string
  awayTeamAbbrev: string
}

type MergedGame = PlayerGameLog & { saves: number; fantasyPoints?: number }

let cachedPlayers: { mtimeMs: number; payload: RegistryPlayer[] } | null = null
const PLAYER_POOL_CACHE_TTL_MS = 15_000
let overlaidPlayerCache: { mtimeMs: number; expiresAt: number; payload: RegistryPlayer[] } | null = null
let overlaidPlayerInFlight: Promise<RegistryPlayer[] | null> | null = null

function finite(value: unknown): number {
  const number = typeof value === "number" ? value : Number(value)
  return Number.isFinite(number) ? number : 0
}

function leagueScoring(value: unknown): LeagueScoring {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING
  return value as LeagueScoring
}

function usesDefaultScoring(scoring: LeagueScoring): boolean {
  for (const [key, points] of Object.entries(DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING) as [keyof LeagueScoring, number][]) {
    if ((scoring[key] ?? points) !== points) return false
  }
  return true
}

function rawStat(game: {
  goals: number
  assists: number
  shots: number
  hits: number
  blocks: number
  plusMinus: number
  powerPlayPoints: number
  shorthandedGoals: number
  gameWinningGoals: number
  saves: number
  goalsAgainst: number
  shutouts: number
  decision?: string | null
}): RawGameStat {
  return {
    goals: game.goals,
    assists: game.assists,
    shots: game.shots,
    hits: game.hits,
    blocks: game.blocks,
    plusMinus: game.plusMinus,
    powerPlayPoints: game.powerPlayPoints,
    shorthandedGoals: game.shorthandedGoals,
    gameWinningGoals: game.gameWinningGoals,
    saves: game.saves,
    goalsAgainst: game.goalsAgainst,
    shutouts: game.shutouts,
    decision: game.decision ?? null,
  }
}

function isPosition(value: string): value is Position {
  return value === "C" || value === "LW" || value === "RW" || value === "D" || value === "G"
}

function listedInjury(value: string): InjuryStatus | null {
  return value === "IR" || value === "DTD" || value === "O" ? value : null
}

function playerNhlId(player: { id: string; nhlId: number }): number | null {
  if (Number.isFinite(player.nhlId) && player.nhlId > 0) return player.nhlId
  const match = /^nhl-(\d+)$/.exec(player.id)
  return match ? Number(match[1]) : null
}

function readSeason(stats: unknown): number | undefined {
  if (typeof stats !== "object" || stats === null || !("season" in stats)) return undefined
  const season = (stats as { season: unknown }).season
  return typeof season === "number" && Number.isFinite(season) ? season : undefined
}

function nhlPlayersMtimeMs(): number {
  try {
    return fs.statSync(path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "data", "nhl-players.json")).mtimeMs
  } catch {
    return 0
  }
}

function readCachedPlayers(): RegistryPlayer[] | null {
  const filePath = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "data", "nhl-players.json")
  if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return null
  const stat = fs.statSync(filePath)
  if (!cachedPlayers || cachedPlayers.mtimeMs !== stat.mtimeMs) {
    const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8")) as Record<string, unknown>[]
    cachedPlayers = { mtimeMs: stat.mtimeMs, payload: data.map(normalizePlayer) }
  }
  return cachedPlayers.payload
}

async function readSearchFallback(): Promise<RegistryPlayer[] | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(
      "https://search.d3.nhle.com/api/v1/search/player?culture=en-us&limit=5000&q=*&active=true",
      { headers: { Accept: "application/json", "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0" } }
    )
    const data = await res.json()
    return (data ?? []).map((p: Record<string, unknown>) => normalizePlayer({
      id: `nhl-${p.playerId}`,
      nhlId: Number(p.playerId),
      name: p.name,
      team: p.teamAbbrev || p.lastTeamAbbrev || "NHL",
      position: p.positionCode === "L" ? "LW" : p.positionCode === "R" ? "RW" : p.positionCode || "C",
      slot: p.positionCode === "D" ? "D" : p.positionCode === "G" ? "G" : "W",
      projPts: 10.0,
      todayPts: null,
      waiver: "FA",
      opponent: "—",
      headshot: `https://assets.nhle.com/mugs/nhl/latest/${p.playerId}.png`,
    }))
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to load NHL player search fallback", error)
    return null
  }
}

function staticGameLogs(value: unknown, scoring: LeagueScoring = DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING): MergedGame[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return []
  const logs: MergedGame[] = []
  for (const entry of value) {
    if (typeof entry !== "object" || entry === null) continue
    const game = entry as Record<string, unknown>
    const gameId = finite(game.gameId)
    const gameDate = typeof game.gameDate === "string" ? game.gameDate : ""
    if (!gameId || !gameDate) continue
    const goals = finite(game.goals)
    const assists = finite(game.assists)
    const shotsAgainst = finite(game.shotsAgainst)
    const goalsAgainst = finite(game.goalsAgainst)
    const shots = finite(game.shots)
    const hits = finite(game.hits)
    const blocks = finite(game.blocks)
    const powerPlayPoints = finite(game.powerPlayPoints)
    const shorthandedGoals = finite(game.shorthandedGoals)
    const gameWinningGoals = finite(game.gameWinningGoals)
    const shutouts = finite(game.shutouts)
    const saves = typeof game.saves === "number" && Number.isFinite(game.saves) ? game.saves : shotsAgainst - goalsAgainst
    const plusMinus = finite(game.plusMinus)
    const decision = typeof game.decision === "string" ? game.decision : null
    const row: MergedGame = {
      gameId,
      gameDate,
      teamAbbrev: typeof game.teamAbbrev === "string" ? game.teamAbbrev : undefined,
      opponentAbbrev: typeof game.opponentAbbrev === "string" ? game.opponentAbbrev : undefined,
      homeRoadFlag: game.homeRoadFlag === "H" || game.homeRoadFlag === "R" ? game.homeRoadFlag : undefined,
      goals,
      assists,
      points: goals + assists,
      shots,
      hits,
      blocks,
      pim: finite(game.pim),
      plusMinus,
      powerPlayPoints,
      shorthandedGoals,
      gameWinningGoals,
      toi: typeof game.toi === "string" ? game.toi : "0:00",
      decision,
      shotsAgainst,
      goalsAgainst,
      saves,
      savePctg: typeof game.savePctg === "number" && Number.isFinite(game.savePctg) ? game.savePctg : null,
      shutouts,
      powerPlayToi: typeof game.powerPlayToi === "string" ? game.powerPlayToi : undefined,
      penaltyKillToi: typeof game.penaltyKillToi === "string" ? game.penaltyKillToi : undefined,
    }
    row.fantasyPoints = scoreGameStat(rawStat(row), scoring)
    logs.push(row)
  }
  return logs
}

/** Boxscores list dressed goalies who never entered the game as 00:00 with an empty line. */
function playedStat(stat: LiveStat): boolean {
  const toi = stat.toi.trim()
  const noTime = toi === "" || toi === "0:00" || toi === "00:00" || toi === "0:00:00"
  if (!noTime || stat.decision) return true
  return stat.goals + stat.assists + stat.shots + stat.hits + stat.blocks + stat.pim + Math.abs(stat.plusMinus)
    + stat.shotsAgainst + stat.goalsAgainst + stat.saves + stat.shutouts + stat.powerPlayPoints
    + stat.shorthandedGoals + stat.gameWinningGoals > 0
}

function liveGameLog(stat: LiveStat, team: string, priorTeam?: string): MergedGame {
  // A traded player's current club is not in older games. The static log still names the club that dressed them.
  const playedFor = team === stat.homeTeamAbbrev || team === stat.awayTeamAbbrev
    ? team
    : priorTeam === stat.homeTeamAbbrev || priorTeam === stat.awayTeamAbbrev
      ? priorTeam
      : team
  const home = stat.homeTeamAbbrev === playedFor
  return {
    gameId: stat.gameId,
    gameDate: stat.gameDate,
    teamAbbrev: playedFor,
    opponentAbbrev: home ? stat.awayTeamAbbrev : stat.homeTeamAbbrev,
    homeRoadFlag: home ? "H" : "R",
    goals: stat.goals,
    assists: stat.assists,
    points: stat.goals + stat.assists,
    shots: stat.shots,
    hits: stat.hits,
    blocks: stat.blocks,
    pim: stat.pim,
    plusMinus: stat.plusMinus,
    powerPlayPoints: stat.powerPlayPoints,
    shorthandedGoals: stat.shorthandedGoals,
    gameWinningGoals: stat.gameWinningGoals,
    toi: stat.toi,
    decision: stat.decision,
    shotsAgainst: stat.shotsAgainst,
    goalsAgainst: stat.goalsAgainst,
    saves: stat.saves,
    savePctg: stat.savePct,
    shutouts: stat.shutouts,
    fantasyPoints: stat.fantasyPoints,
  }
}

function mergeGameLogs(dbLogs: LiveStat[], staticLogs: MergedGame[], team: string, scoring: LeagueScoring): MergedGame[] {
  const staticById = new Map(staticLogs.map((game) => [game.gameId, game]))
  const live = dbLogs.filter(playedStat).map((stat) => {
    const prior = staticById.get(stat.gameId)
    const row = liveGameLog(stat, team, prior?.teamAbbrev)
    if (!prior) return row
    // The boxscore sync stored shots/special-teams as 0 (`sog` was unread). Keep the static count until a non-zero live value exists.
    const merged: MergedGame = {
      ...row,
      shots: row.shots || prior.shots,
      powerPlayPoints: row.powerPlayPoints || prior.powerPlayPoints,
      shorthandedGoals: row.shorthandedGoals || prior.shorthandedGoals,
      gameWinningGoals: row.gameWinningGoals || prior.gameWinningGoals,
      powerPlayToi: prior.powerPlayToi,
      penaltyKillToi: prior.penaltyKillToi,
    }
    const countingChanged = merged.shots !== row.shots
      || merged.powerPlayPoints !== row.powerPlayPoints
      || merged.shorthandedGoals !== row.shorthandedGoals
      || merged.gameWinningGoals !== row.gameWinningGoals
    if (countingChanged || typeof merged.fantasyPoints !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(merged.fantasyPoints)) {
      merged.fantasyPoints = scoreGameStat(rawStat(merged), scoring)
    }
    return merged
  })
  const seen = new Set(live.map((game) => game.gameId))
  const older = staticLogs.filter((game) => !seen.has(game.gameId))
  return [...live, ...older].sort((a, b) => b.gameDate.localeCompare(a.gameDate))
}

function sumGameLog(games: MergedGame[], season: number | undefined, player: { projPts?: number } = {}, scoring: LeagueScoring = DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING) {
  const sum = (read: (game: MergedGame) => number) => games.reduce((total, game) => total + read(game), 0)
  const goals = sum((game) => game.goals)
  const assists = sum((game) => game.assists)
  const shots = sum((game) => game.shots)
  const hits = sum((game) => game.hits)
  const blocks = sum((game) => game.blocks)
  const powerPlayPoints = sum((game) => game.powerPlayPoints)
  const shorthandedGoals = sum((game) => game.shorthandedGoals)
  const gameWinningGoals = sum((game) => game.gameWinningGoals)
  const shotsAgainst = sum((game) => game.shotsAgainst)
  const goalsAgainst = sum((game) => game.goalsAgainst)
  const shutouts = sum((game) => game.shutouts)
  const saves = sum((game) => game.saves)
  const wins = games.reduce((total, game) => total + (game.decision === "W" ? 1 : 0), 0)
  const gp = games.length
  const savePct = shotsAgainst > 0 ? Number((saves / shotsAgainst).toFixed(3)) : 0
  const loggedFantasyPoints = games.every((game) => typeof game.fantasyPoints === "number" && Number.isFinite(game.fantasyPoints))
  const totalPoints = games.reduce((total, game) => total + (loggedFantasyPoints ? Number(game.fantasyPoints) : scoreGameStat(rawStat(game), scoring)), 0)
  const fpts = Number(totalPoints.toFixed(1))
  const currentSeasonStats: Record<string, number> = {
    gamesPlayed: gp,
    goals,
    assists,
    points: goals + assists,
    shots,
    hits,
    blocks,
    powerPlayPoints,
    shorthandedGoals,
    gameWinningGoals,
    pim: sum((game) => game.pim),
    plusMinus: sum((game) => game.plusMinus),
    wins,
    saves,
    goalsAgainst,
    shutouts,
    savePct,
  }
  if (season != null) currentSeasonStats.season = season
  const perGame = gp > 0 ? fpts / gp : (player.projPts || 3.2) / 3.5
  const weeklyProjection = Number((perGame * 3.5).toFixed(1))
  return { gp, goals, assists, sog: shots, hits, blocks, wins, saves, shutouts, savePct, fpts, currentSeasonStats, projPts: weeklyProjection, projection: weeklyProjection }
}

function registryPlayerFromDatabase(dbPlayer: DatabasePlayer): RegistryPlayer {
  const position = isPosition(dbPlayer.position) ? dbPlayer.position : "C"
  return normalizePlayer({
    id: `nhl-${dbPlayer.id}`,
    nhlId: dbPlayer.id,
    name: dbPlayer.name,
    team: dbPlayer.teamAbbrev,
    position,
    slot: position === "LW" || position === "RW" ? "W" : position,
    waiver: "FA",
    opponent: "—",
    projPts: 0,
    fpts: 0,
    gp: dbPlayer.nhlGamesPlayed,
    headshot: `https://assets.nhle.com/mugs/nhl/latest/${dbPlayer.id}.png`,
    injuryStatus: listedInjury(dbPlayer.injuryStatus),
    nhlGamesPlayed: dbPlayer.nhlGamesPlayed,
  })
}

function preparedStaticLogs(gameLog: MergedGame[] | undefined, scoring: LeagueScoring): MergedGame[] {
  if (!gameLog || gameLog.length === 0) return []
  if (usesDefaultScoring(scoring)) return gameLog
  return gameLog.map((game) => ({ ...game, fantasyPoints: scoreGameStat(rawStat(game), scoring) }))
}

function applyLiveStats(player: RegistryPlayer, dbPlayer: DatabasePlayer | undefined, dbLogs: LiveStat[], scoring: LeagueScoring): RegistryPlayer {
  const team = dbPlayer && dbPlayer.teamAbbrev && dbPlayer.teamAbbrev !== "FA" && dbPlayer.teamAbbrev !== "NHL"
    ? dbPlayer.teamAbbrev
    : player.team
  const position = dbPlayer && isPosition(dbPlayer.position) ? dbPlayer.position : player.position
  const playedLogs = dbLogs.filter(playedStat)
  const nhlGamesPlayed = dbPlayer
    ? Math.max(player.nhlGamesPlayed ?? 0, dbPlayer.nhlGamesPlayed ?? 0, playedLogs.length)
    : player.nhlGamesPlayed
  const injuryStatus = dbPlayer
    ? dbPlayer.injuryStatus === "HEALTHY" ? player.injuryStatus : (listedInjury(dbPlayer.injuryStatus) ?? player.injuryStatus)
    : player.injuryStatus
  const gameLog = mergeGameLogs(dbLogs, preparedStaticLogs(player.gameLog, scoring), team, scoring)
  if (gameLog.length === 0) {
    return { ...player, team, position, nhlGamesPlayed, injuryStatus }
  }
  const season = dbLogs.reduce((latest, stat) => Math.max(latest, stat.season), 0) || readSeason(player.currentSeasonStats)
  return {
    ...player,
    team,
    position,
    nhlGamesPlayed,
    injuryStatus,
    gameLog,
    ...sumGameLog(gameLog, season, player, scoring),
  }
}

function overlayLiveStats(basePlayers: RegistryPlayer[], dbPlayers: DatabasePlayer[], gameStats: LiveStat[], scoring: LeagueScoring): RegistryPlayer[] {
  const logsByPlayerId = new Map<number, LiveStat[]>()
  for (const stat of gameStats) {
    const rows = logsByPlayerId.get(stat.playerId)
    if (rows) rows.push(stat)
    else logsByPlayerId.set(stat.playerId, [stat])
  }
  const dbById = new Map(dbPlayers.map((player) => [player.id, player]))
  const seen = new Set<number>()
  const overlaid = basePlayers.map((player) => {
    const nhlId = playerNhlId(player)
    const dbPlayer = nhlId == null ? undefined : dbById.get(nhlId)
    if (nhlId != null) seen.add(nhlId)
    return applyLiveStats(player, dbPlayer, nhlId == null ? [] : logsByPlayerId.get(nhlId) ?? [], scoring)
  })
  const extras = dbPlayers
    .filter((player) => !seen.has(player.id))
    .map((player) => applyLiveStats(registryPlayerFromDatabase(player), player, logsByPlayerId.get(player.id) ?? [], scoring))
  return [...overlaid, ...extras]
}

async function buildOverlaidPlayers(): Promise<RegistryPlayer[] | null> {
  const mtimeMs = nhlPlayersMtimeMs()
  const basePlayers = readCachedPlayers() ?? await readSearchFallback()
  if (!basePlayers) return null

  let dbPlayers: DatabasePlayer[] = []
  let gameStats: LiveStat[] = []
  let scoring: LeagueScoring = DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING
  let cacheable = true
  try {
    const [players, stats, league] = await Promise.all([
      prisma.player.findMany({ select: { id: true, name: true, teamAbbrev: true, position: true, injuryStatus: true, nhlGamesPlayed: true } }),
      prisma.playerGameStat.findMany({
        where: { game: { gameState: { in: ["LIVE", "CRIT", "FINAL", "OFF"] } } },
        include: { game: { select: { id: true, season: true, gameDate: true, homeTeamAbbrev: true, awayTeamAbbrev: true, startTimeUTC: true } } },
        orderBy: { game: { gameDate: "desc" } },
      }),
      prisma.league.findFirst({ select: { scoringSettings: true } }),
    ])
    scoring = leagueScoring(league?.scoringSettings)
    dbPlayers = players
    gameStats = stats.map((stat) => ({
      playerId: stat.playerId,
      goals: stat.goals,
      assists: stat.assists,
      shots: stat.shots,
      hits: stat.hits,
      blocks: stat.blocks,
      pim: stat.pim,
      plusMinus: stat.plusMinus,
      powerPlayPoints: stat.powerPlayPoints,
      shorthandedGoals: stat.shorthandedGoals,
      gameWinningGoals: stat.gameWinningGoals,
      toi: stat.toi,
      decision: stat.decision,
      shotsAgainst: stat.shotsAgainst,
      goalsAgainst: stat.goalsAgainst,
      saves: stat.saves,
      savePct: stat.savePct,
      shutouts: stat.shutouts,
      fantasyPoints: stat.fantasyPoints,
      gameId: stat.game.id,
      season: stat.game.season,
      gameDate: stat.game.gameDate,
      homeTeamAbbrev: stat.game.homeTeamAbbrev,
      awayTeamAbbrev: stat.game.awayTeamAbbrev,
    }))
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to read live player stats", error)
    cacheable = false
  }

  const payload = overlayLiveStats(basePlayers, dbPlayers, gameStats, scoring)
  if (cacheable) {
    overlaidPlayerCache = { mtimeMs, expiresAt: Date.now() + PLAYER_POOL_CACHE_TTL_MS, payload }
  }
  return payload
}

export async function GET() {
  const mtimeMs = nhlPlayersMtimeMs()
  if (overlaidPlayerCache && overlaidPlayerCache.mtimeMs === mtimeMs && overlaidPlayerCache.expiresAt > Date.now()) {
    return NextResponse.json(overlaidPlayerCache.payload, { headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } })
  }

  if (!overlaidPlayerInFlight) {
    const flight = buildOverlaidPlayers().finally(() => {
      if (overlaidPlayerInFlight === flight) overlaidPlayerInFlight = null
    })
    overlaidPlayerInFlight = flight
  }
  const players = await overlaidPlayerInFlight
  if (!players) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Failed to load players" }, { status: 500 })
  return NextResponse.json(players, { headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } })
}

<file path="app/api/schedule/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { getCurrentFantasyWeek, getEasternDate, getFantasyWeekDates, getFantasyWeekForDate } from "@/lib/season-calendar"

export const runtime = "nodejs"
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"

type PlayerGameLogRecord = Record<string, string | number | null>

/** Shared fallback sync: concurrent GETs for a week await one flight, then skip repeats briefly. */
const SCHEDULE_SYNC_COOLDOWN_MS = 30_000
const scheduleSyncInFlight = new Map<string, Promise<void>>()
const scheduleSyncCooldownUntil = new Map<string, number>()
/** Boxscore pulls and matchup recomputes cover every league, so all weeks share one flight. */
const BOXSCORE_SYNC_KEY = "boxscores"

function runScheduleSync(key: string, task: () => Promise<void>): Promise<boolean> {
  const current = scheduleSyncInFlight.get(key)
  if (current) return current.then(() => true)
  if ((scheduleSyncCooldownUntil.get(key) ?? 0) > Date.now()) return Promise.resolve(false)

  const flight = task().then(() => {
    scheduleSyncCooldownUntil.set(key, Date.now() + SCHEDULE_SYNC_COOLDOWN_MS)
  })
  scheduleSyncInFlight.set(key, flight)
  return flight.finally(() => {
    if (scheduleSyncInFlight.get(key) === flight) scheduleSyncInFlight.delete(key)
  }).then(() => true)
}

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const requestedDate = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("date")
    const requestedWeek = Number(request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("week"))
    const easternToday = getEasternDate()
    const currentWeek = getCurrentFantasyWeek()
    const fantasyWeek = Number.isInteger(requestedWeek) && requestedWeek > 0
      ? requestedWeek
      : getFantasyWeekForDate(requestedDate ?? easternToday)
    const weekDates = getFantasyWeekDates(fantasyWeek).dates
    const today = requestedDate ?? (weekDates.includes(easternToday) ? easternToday : weekDates[0])
    const gameStatsInclude = { include: { player: { select: { teamAbbrev: true } } } }
    let games = await prisma.nhlGame.findMany({
      where: { gameDate: { in: weekDates } },
      include: { gameStats: gameStatsInclude },
      orderBy: { startTimeUTC: "asc" },
    })
    const missingStats = games.length === 0 || games.some((game) =>
      (game.gameState === "FINAL" || game.gameState === "OFF") && (
        game.gameStats.length === 0 || game.gameStats.every((stat) => stat.shots === 0)
      ),
    )
    const weekKey = String(fantasyWeek)
    const futureWeek = fantasyWeek > currentWeek
    const shouldSync = (requestedWeek > 0 || weekDates.includes(easternToday)) && (futureWeek ? games.length === 0 : missingStats)
    if (shouldSync) {
      const synced = await runScheduleSync(weekKey, async () => {
        const { syncScheduleForDate, syncActiveGameBoxscores, recomputeMatchupsThroughWeek } = await import("@/lib/services/nhl-sync")
        if (games.length === 0) await syncScheduleForDate(weekDates[0])
        if (futureWeek) return
        await runScheduleSync(BOXSCORE_SYNC_KEY, async () => {
          await syncActiveGameBoxscores(50)
          const leagues = await prisma.league.findMany({ select: { id: true, currentSeason: true } })
          for (const league of leagues) {
            await recomputeMatchupsThroughWeek(league.id, getCurrentFantasyWeek(league.currentSeason))
          }
        })
      })
      if (synced) {
        games = await prisma.nhlGame.findMany({
          where: { gameDate: { in: weekDates } },
          include: { gameStats: gameStatsInclude },
          orderBy: { startTimeUTC: "asc" },
        })
      }
    }

    const mappedGames = games.map((game) => ({
      id: game.id,
      date: game.gameDate,
      day: new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { weekday: "short", timeZone: "UTC" }).format(new Date(`${game.gameDate}T12:00:00Z`)),
      gameState: game.gameState,
      startTimeUTC: game.startTimeUTC.toISOString(),
      awayTeam: { abbrev: game.awayTeamAbbrev, score: game.awayScore },
      homeTeam: { abbrev: game.homeTeamAbbrev, score: game.homeScore },
      period: game.period,
      clock: game.clock,
    }))

    const playerGameLogs: Record<string, PlayerGameLogRecord[]> = {}
    for (const game of games) {
      for (const stat of game.gameStats) {
        const toi = stat.toi.trim()
        const unplayed = (toi === "0:00" || toi === "00:00" || toi === "") && !stat.decision
          && stat.goals + stat.assists + stat.shots + stat.hits + stat.blocks + stat.pim + Math.abs(stat.plusMinus)
            + stat.shotsAgainst + stat.goalsAgainst + stat.saves + stat.shutouts === 0
        if (unplayed) continue
        const logs = playerGameLogs[String(stat.playerId)] ?? []
        const playerTeam = stat.player?.teamAbbrev
        const playedAway = playerTeam === game.awayTeamAbbrev
        const playedHome = playerTeam === game.homeTeamAbbrev
        // Current team can be a club that was not in this game (trade, call-up). Do not assume they were home.
        const teamAbbrev = playedAway ? game.awayTeamAbbrev : playedHome ? game.homeTeamAbbrev : null
        const opponentAbbrev = playedHome ? game.awayTeamAbbrev : playedAway ? game.homeTeamAbbrev : null
        const homeRoadFlag = playedHome ? "H" : playedAway ? "R" : null
        logs.push({
          gameId: game.id,
          gameDate: game.gameDate,
          teamAbbrev,
          opponentAbbrev,
          homeRoadFlag,
          goals: stat.goals,
          assists: stat.assists,
          shots: stat.shots,
          hits: stat.hits,
          blocks: stat.blocks,
          pim: stat.pim,
          points: stat.goals + stat.assists,
          plusMinus: stat.plusMinus,
          powerPlayPoints: stat.powerPlayPoints,
          shorthandedGoals: stat.shorthandedGoals,
          gameWinningGoals: stat.gameWinningGoals,
          toi: stat.toi,
          decision: stat.decision,
          shotsAgainst: stat.shotsAgainst,
          goalsAgainst: stat.goalsAgainst,
          saves: stat.saves,
          savePctg: stat.savePct,
          shutouts: stat.shutouts,
          fantasyPoints: stat.fantasyPoints,
        })
        playerGameLogs[String(stat.playerId)] = logs
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      date: games.some((game) => game.gameDate === today) ? today : games[0]?.gameDate ?? today,
      games: mappedGames.filter((game) => game.date === today),
      weekGames: mappedGames,
      playerGameLogs,
    })
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    console.error("Could not retrieve persisted NHL schedule", error)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Could not retrieve NHL schedule", games: [], weekGames: [], playerGameLogs: {} }, { status: 500 })
  }
}

function lockedRosterOrScoringChanged(previous: LeagueSettings, next: LeagueSettings) {
  const snapshot = (value: LeagueSettings) => ({
    rosterPositions: value.rosterPositions,
    scoringSettings: value.scoringSettings,
    taxiSlots: value.taxiSlots,
    taxiMaxGames: value.taxiMaxGames,
    irSlots: value.irSlots,
  })
  return JSON.stringify(snapshot(previous)) !== JSON.stringify(snapshot(next))
}

const tabs = ["Roster", "Scoring", "Waivers", "Trades", "Draft", "Tools"] as const

function Section({ title, hint, children }: { title: string; hint?: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
