function Stepper({ label, hint, value, onChange, min = 0, max = 999, step = 1, disabled = false }: { label: string; hint?: string; value: number; onChange: (value: number) => void; min?: number; max?: number; step?: number; disabled?: boolean }) {
  const clamp = (next: number) => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Math.round(next * 100) / 100))
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[#1c2c48] bg-[#0a1120] px-3 py-2", disabled && "opacity-50")}>
      <div className="min-w-0"><p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-white">{label}</p>{hint && <p className="truncate text-xs text-[#5e7090]">{hint}</p>}</div>
      <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
        <button type="button" aria-label={`Decrease ${label}`} onClick={() => onChange(clamp(value - step))} disabled={disabled || value <= min} className="flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7] transition active:scale-90 disabled:opacity-30"><Minus className="size-3.5" /></button>
        <input aria-label={label} type="number" inputMode="decimal" step={step} disabled={disabled} value={Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0} onChange={(event) => onChange(clamp(Number(event.target.value)))} className="w-14 rounded-md bg-transparent py-1 text-center text-sm font-black tabular-nums text-[#19ffff] outline-none focus:bg-[#172338] [appearance:textfield] [&::-webkit-inner-spin-button]:appearance-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed" />
        <button type="button" aria-label={`Increase ${label}`} onClick={() => onChange(clamp(value + step))} disabled={disabled || value >= max} className="flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7] transition active:scale-90 disabled:opacity-30"><Plus className="size-3.5" /></button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function Segmented<T extends string>({ label, value, options, onChange }: { label: string; value: T; options: Array<{ value: T; label: string }>; onChange: (value: T) => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#1c2c48] bg-[#0a1120] p-2">
      <p className="px-1 pb-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-white">{label}</p>
      <div className="flex gap-1" role="radiogroup" aria-label={label}>
        {options.map((option) => <button key={option.value} type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={value === option.value} onClick={() => onChange(option.value)} className={cn("flex-1 rounded-lg px-2 py-2 text-xs font-black transition", value === option.value ? "bg-amber-400 text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7] hover:text-white")}>{option.label}</button>)}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function Toggle({ label, hint, checked, onChange }: { label: string; hint?: string; checked: boolean; onChange: (value: boolean) => void }) {
  return (
    <button type="button" role="switch" aria-checked={checked} onClick={() => onChange(!checked)} className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[#1c2c48] bg-[#0a1120] px-3 py-2.5 text-left">
      <span><span className="block text-xs font-bold text-white">{label}</span>{hint && <span className="block text-xs text-[#5e7090]">{hint}</span>}</span>
      <span className={cn("relative h-5 w-9 shrink-0 rounded-full transition", checked ? "bg-amber-400" : "bg-[#263858]")}><span className={cn("absolute top-0.5 size-4 rounded-full bg-white transition-all", checked ? "left-[18px]" : "left-0.5")} /></span>
    </button>
  )
}

function toLocalInput(value: unknown) {
  const date = new Date(String(value ?? ""))
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return ""
  const offset = date.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000
  return new Date(date.getTime() - offset).toISOString().slice(0, 16)
}

export function CommissionerSettingsDialog({ open, onOpenChange }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void }) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>("Roster")
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<LeagueSettings>(defaultLeagueSettings)
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState<LeagueSettings>(defaultLeagueSettings)
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ tone: "info" | "ok" | "error"; text: string } | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
  const [structureLocked, setStructureLocked] = useState(false)

  const update = (patch: Partial<LeagueSettings>) => setSettings((current) => ({ ...current, ...patch }))
  const updateRecord = (field: RecordField, key: string, value: unknown) =>
    setSettings((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: { ...current[field], [key]: value } }))

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/admin/league-settings", { cache: "no-store" })
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Load failed (${response.status})`)
      const payload = await response.json() as Partial<LeagueSettings> & { structureLocked?: boolean }
      setStructureLocked(payload.structureLocked === true)
      const merged = mergeLeagueSettings(defaultLeagueSettings, payload)
      setSettings(merged)
      setSaved(merged)
      setStatus(null)
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      console.error("Failed to load commissioner settings", error)
      setStatus({ tone: "error", text: "Unable to load settings. Showing defaults." })
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) void load()
  }, [open, load])

  const dirty = useMemo(() => JSON.stringify(settings) !== JSON.stringify(saved), [settings, saved])
  const capacity = Object.values(settings.rosterPositions).reduce((sum, value) => sum + (Number(value) || 0), 0)
  const starters = ["C", "W", "F", "D", "G"].reduce((sum, key) => sum + (settings.rosterPositions[key] ?? 0), 0)
  const problems: string[] = []
  if ((settings.rosterPositions.G ?? 0) < 1) problems.push("At least one goalie slot is required.")
  if (starters < 1) problems.push("At least one starting slot is required.")
  if (settings.draftSettings.scheduledDate && Number.isNaN(new Date(String(settings.draftSettings.scheduledDate)).getTime())) problems.push("Draft date is invalid.")

  const save = async () => {
    if (problems.length > 0) { setStatus({ tone: "error", text: problems[0] }); return }
    setSaving(true)
    setStatus({ tone: "info", text: "Saving..." })
    try {
      const { rosterPositions, scoringSettings, waiverSettings, tradeSettings, draftSettings, taxiSlots, taxiMaxGames, irSlots, lineupLockMode } = settings
      const response = await fetch("/api/admin/league-settings", { method: "PATCH", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ rosterPositions, scoringSettings, waiverSettings, tradeSettings, draftSettings, taxiSlots, taxiMaxGames, irSlots, lineupLockMode }) })
      if (!response.ok) {
        const failure = await response.json().catch(() => null) as { error?: string } | null
        setStatus({ tone: "error", text: response.status === 403 ? "Only commissioners can save settings." : failure?.error ?? `Save failed (${response.status}).` })
        setSaving(false)
        return
      }
      const payload = await response.json() as Partial<LeagueSettings> & { structureLocked?: boolean }
      const locked = payload.structureLocked === true
      const rejectedLockedEdits = locked && lockedRosterOrScoringChanged(saved, settings)
      setStructureLocked(locked)
      const merged = mergeLeagueSettings(defaultLeagueSettings, payload)
      setSettings(merged)
      setSaved(merged)
      if (rejectedLockedEdits) {
        setStatus({ tone: "info", text: "Week 1 has already started, so only unlocked settings (lock mode, waivers, trades, draft) were persisted. Roster shape and scoring were left unchanged." })
        setSaving(false)
        return
      }
      setStatus({ tone: "ok", text: "Saved. Applying the new rules..." })
      // Server components hydrate slots/rules, so a reload applies them everywhere at once.
      window.setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 600)
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      console.error("Failed to save commissioner settings", error)
      setStatus({ tone: "error", text: "Save failed (network error)." })
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }

  const runAction = async (endpoint: string, label: string) => {
    setStatus({ tone: "info", text: `${label}...` })
    try {
      const response = await fetch(endpoint, { method: "POST" })
      const data = await response.json().catch(() => null) as { message?: string } | null
      setStatus(response.ok ? { tone: "ok", text: data?.message ?? `${label} complete.` } : { tone: "error", text: `${label} failed (${response.status}).` })
    } catch {
      setStatus({ tone: "error", text: `${label} failed (network error).` })
    }
  }

  const scoring = settings.scoringSettings
  const waiverType = String(settings.waiverSettings.type ?? "FAAB")
  const draft = settings.draftSettings

  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <SheetContent side="bottom" spring="gentle" className="mx-auto flex data-[side=bottom]:h-[88dvh] max-w-[430px] flex-col gap-0 overflow-hidden rounded-t-2xl border-t border-amber-500/30 bg-[#0d1424] p-0 text-white">
        <div className="mx-auto mt-2 h-1 w-10 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-[#5e7090]" />
        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-start justify-between border-b border-[#172338] px-4 py-3">
          <div><h2 className="text-lg font-black">Commissioner Rulebook</h2><p className="text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">League-wide rules. Changes apply to every team.</p></div>
          {dirty && <span className="rounded-full bg-amber-400/15 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-black uppercase text-amber-300">Unsaved</span>}
        </div>
        <div role="tablist" className="flex shrink-0 gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-[#172338] p-2">
          {tabs.map((item) => <button key={item} role="tab" aria-selected={tab === item} type="button" onClick={() => setTab(item)} className={cn("shrink-0 rounded-full px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold transition", tab === item ? "bg-amber-400 text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7] hover:text-white")}>{item}</button>)}
        </div>

        <div className={cn("min-h-0 flex-1 space-y-5 overflow-y-auto p-4", loading && "pointer-events-none opacity-60")}>
          {tab === "Roster" && <>
            {structureLocked && <p className="rounded-xl border border-amber-400/30 bg-amber-400/10 p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-amber-100">Roster shape and scoring locked after week 1. Waiver hold, the trade deadline, and pick trading can still change.</p>}
            <Section title="Lineup slots" hint="Starters score every week; bench players do not.">
              {["C", "W", "F", "D", "G", "BN"].map((key) => <Stepper key={key} label={key} hint={SLOT_LABELS[key]} value={settings.rosterPositions[key] ?? 0} max={20} onChange={(value) => updateRecord("rosterPositions", key, value)} />)}
            </Section>
            <Section title="Lineup lock" hint="Decides when starting slots (C/W/F/D/G) freeze. Bench, IR and taxi stay movable.">
              <Segmented label="Lock starters" value={settings.lineupLockMode} options={[{ value: "WEEKLY", label: "Weekly (first game)" }, { value: "DAILY", label: "Daily (each game)" }]} onChange={(value) => update({ lineupLockMode: value })} />
              <p className="px-1 text-xs text-[#5e7090]">{settings.lineupLockMode === "WEEKLY" ? "Starters lock when the first NHL game of the fantasy week begins and unlock Monday." : "A player locks only once their own team's game today has started."}</p>
            </Section>
            <Section title="Reserve spots" hint="IR is pure IR only (DTD / IR+ are not eligible).">
              <Stepper label="Taxi squad slots" value={settings.taxiSlots} max={10} onChange={(value) => update({ taxiSlots: value })} />
              <Stepper label="Taxi NHL games cap" hint="Eligible while career NHL GP is below this" value={settings.taxiMaxGames} max={400} step={5} onChange={(value) => update({ taxiMaxGames: value })} />
              <Stepper label="IR slots" value={settings.irSlots} max={10} onChange={(value) => update({ irSlots: value })} />
            </Section>
            <div className="rounded-xl bg-[#172338] p-3 text-xs"><p className="font-black text-[#19ffff]">Roster capacity: {capacity}</p><p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">{starters} starters + {settings.rosterPositions.BN ?? 0} bench. Waiver drops are optional while a team is below {capacity}.</p></div>
          </>}

          {tab === "Scoring" && <>
            {structureLocked && <p className="rounded-xl border border-amber-400/30 bg-amber-400/10 p-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-amber-100">Scoring locked after week 1 so finished weeks keep the weights they were played under.</p>}
            <Section title="Skaters">{SKATER_SCORING.map(([label, key]) => <Stepper key={key} label={label} value={Number(scoring[key] ?? 0)} min={-20} max={50} step={0.1} onChange={(value) => updateRecord("scoringSettings", key, value)} />)}</Section>
            <Section title="Goalies">{GOALIE_SCORING.map(([label, key]) => <Stepper key={key} label={label} value={Number(scoring[key] ?? 0)} min={-20} max={50} step={0.1} onChange={(value) => updateRecord("scoringSettings", key, value)} />)}</Section>
            <button type="button" disabled={structureLocked} onClick={() => update({ scoringSettings: { ...defaultLeagueSettings.scoringSettings } })} className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[#263858] py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-[#8ba0c7] hover:text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"><RotateCcw className="size-3.5" />Reset scoring to default</button>
          </>}

          {tab === "Waivers" && <>
            <Segmented label="Waiver system" value={waiverType} options={[{ value: "FAAB", label: "FAAB bidding" }, { value: "ROLLING", label: "Rolling priority" }]} onChange={(value) => updateRecord("waiverSettings", "type", value)} />
            {waiverType === "FAAB" && <><Stepper label="FAAB budget" hint="Per team, per season" value={Number(settings.waiverSettings.faabBudget ?? 100)} max={10000} step={5} onChange={(value) => updateRecord("waiverSettings", "faabBudget", value)} /><Stepper label="Minimum bid" value={Number(settings.waiverSettings.minBid ?? 0)} max={1000} onChange={(value) => updateRecord("waiverSettings", "minBid", value)} /></>}
            <Stepper label="Waiver hold (hours)" hint="Dropped players stay on waivers this long" value={Number(settings.waiverSettings.holdHours ?? 48)} max={168} step={6} onChange={(value) => updateRecord("waiverSettings", "holdHours", value)} />
          </>}

          {tab === "Trades" && <>
            <Segmented label="Trade review" value={String(settings.tradeSettings.reviewType ?? "COMMISSIONER")} options={[{ value: "COMMISSIONER", label: "Commissioner" }, { value: "VOTE", label: "League vote" }]} onChange={(value) => updateRecord("tradeSettings", "reviewType", value)} />
            <Stepper label="Review window (hours)" value={Number(settings.tradeSettings.reviewHours ?? 24)} max={168} step={6} onChange={(value) => updateRecord("tradeSettings", "reviewHours", value)} />
            <Stepper label="Trade deadline (week)" value={Number(settings.tradeSettings.deadlineWeek ?? 18)} max={30} onChange={(value) => updateRecord("tradeSettings", "deadlineWeek", value)} />
            <Toggle label="Allow draft pick trading" hint="Future rookie picks can be included in offers" checked={settings.tradeSettings.allowPickTrading !== false} onChange={(value) => updateRecord("tradeSettings", "allowPickTrading", value)} />
          </>}

          {tab === "Draft" && <>
            <Segmented label="Draft type" value={String(draft.type ?? "LINEAR")} options={[{ value: "LINEAR", label: "Rookie" }, { value: "SNAKE", label: "Snake" }, { value: "AUCTION", label: "Auction" }]} onChange={(value) => updateRecord("draftSettings", "type", value)} />
            <Stepper label="Rounds" value={Number(draft.rounds ?? 5)} min={1} max={30} onChange={(value) => updateRecord("draftSettings", "rounds", value)} />
            <label className="block rounded-xl border border-[#1c2c48] bg-[#0a1120] p-3 text-xs font-bold text-white">Pick timer
              <select value={String(draft.timerSeconds ?? 120)} onChange={(event) => updateRecord("draftSettings", "timerSeconds", Number(event.target.value))} className="mt-1.5 w-full rounded-lg bg-[#172338] p-2 text-xs font-normal text-white outline-none">
                <option value="60">60 seconds</option><option value="90">90 seconds</option><option value="120">120 seconds</option><option value="28800">Slow draft (8h)</option><option value="86400">Slow draft (24h)</option>
              </select>
            </label>
            <label className="block rounded-xl border border-[#1c2c48] bg-[#0a1120] p-3 text-xs font-bold text-white">Draft date &amp; time
              <input type="datetime-local" value={toLocalInput(draft.scheduledDate)} onChange={(event) => { const next = new Date(event.target.value); if (!Number.isNaN(next.getTime())) updateRecord("draftSettings", "scheduledDate", next.toISOString()) }} className="mt-1.5 w-full rounded-lg bg-[#172338] p-2 text-xs font-normal text-white outline-none [color-scheme:dark]" />
            </label>
            <Segmented label="Draft order" value={String(draft.orderType ?? "REVERSE_STANDINGS")} options={[{ value: "REVERSE_STANDINGS", label: "Reverse standings" }, { value: "LOTTERY", label: "Lottery" }]} onChange={(value) => updateRecord("draftSettings", "orderType", value)} />
          </>}

          {tab === "Tools" && <>
            <Section title="Season calendar" hint={`Weeks run Monday to Sunday and follow the NHL schedule automatically (week ${settings.currentWeek} now).`}>
              <div className="rounded-xl bg-[#172338] p-3 text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">The league week advances every Monday. Scores for finished weeks are recalculated from NHL boxscores on every sync.</div>
            </Section>
            <Section title="Manual jobs">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => void runAction("/api/cron/sync", "NHL stats sync")} className="w-full rounded-xl border border-[#263858] bg-[#172338] p-3 text-left text-xs font-bold hover:border-amber-400/50">Force NHL stats sync<span className="block text-xs font-normal text-[#5e7090]">Pull the latest scores, boxscores and injuries</span></button>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => void runAction("/api/cron/waivers", "Waiver run")} className="w-full rounded-xl border border-[#263858] bg-[#172338] p-3 text-left text-xs font-bold hover:border-amber-400/50">Run weekly waivers<span className="block text-xs font-normal text-[#5e7090]">Processes pending claims Monday at midnight, after the final game of the week</span></button>
            </Section>
          </>}
        </div>

        <div className="shrink-0 space-y-2 border-t border-[#172338] bg-[#0d1424] px-4 pb-[max(0.75rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] pt-3">
          {status && <p role="status" className={cn("text-xs font-bold", status.tone === "error" ? "text-rose-400" : status.tone === "ok" ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-[#8ba0c7]")}>{status.text}</p>}
          {!status && problems.length > 0 && <p role="status" className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-400">{problems[0]}</p>}
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button type="button" disabled={!dirty || saving} onClick={() => { setSettings(saved); setStatus(null) }} className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-[#263858] px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-[#8ba0c7] transition enabled:hover:text-white disabled:opacity-30"><RotateCcw className="size-3.5" />Discard</button>
            <button type="button" disabled={!dirty || saving || problems.length > 0} onClick={() => void save()} className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400 py-2.5 text-xs font-black text-[#080c14] transition active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-40">{status?.tone === "ok" ? <Check className="size-4" /> : <Save className="size-4" />}Save Rulebook Settings</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  )
}

<file path="components/hockey/league-chat-drawer.tsx">
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { Send, X, Zap } from "lucide-react"
import { Sheet, SheetContent, SheetHeader, SheetTitle } from "@/components/ui/sheet"
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@/components/ui/avatar"
import type { ChatMessage } from "@/lib/hockey-data"

type LiveChatMessage = ChatMessage & { teamName?: string }

export function LeagueChatDrawer({ open, onOpenChange, onLatestMessage, latestPreview, leagueId }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void; onLatestMessage?: (message: string) => void; latestPreview?: string; leagueId?: string }) {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<LiveChatMessage[]>([])
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("")
  const feedRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const load = async () => {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/chat${leagueId ? `?leagueId=${encodeURIComponent(leagueId)}` : ""}`, { cache: "no-store" })
    if (!response.ok) return
    const data = await response.json() as LiveChatMessage[]
    setMessages(data)
    const latest = data.at(-1)
    if (latest) onLatestMessage?.(`${latest.author}: ${latest.message}`)
  }
  useEffect(() => { void load() }, [leagueId])
  useEffect(() => { if (open) { void load(); if (feedRef.current) feedRef.current.scrollTop = feedRef.current.scrollHeight } }, [open])
  const send = async () => {
    if (!draft.trim() || !leagueId) return
    const text = draft.trim()
    setDraft("")
    const response = await fetch("/api/chat", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ leagueId, body: text }) })
    if (response.ok) {
      const message = await response.json() as LiveChatMessage
      setMessages((current) => [...current, message])
      onLatestMessage?.(`${message.author}: ${message.message}`)
    }
  }
  if (!open) return null
  return <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}><SheetContent side="bottom" spring="gentle" overlayClassName="!z-40 !bg-black/70 supports-backdrop-filter:!backdrop-blur-sm" className="!fixed !bottom-0 !left-1/2 !right-auto !top-auto !z-50 !w-full !max-w-[430px] !-translate-x-1/2 !h-[85vh] !max-h-[85vh] !flex !flex-col !gap-0 !overflow-hidden !rounded-t-3xl !border-x !border-t !border-[#1a263d] !bg-[#070a12] !p-0 !text-white !shadow-2xl"><SheetHeader className="shrink-0 flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-[#141e33] p-4"><SheetTitle className="text-sm font-black"># general-chat</SheetTitle><button type="button" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)} aria-label="Close league chat"><X className="size-5 text-[#8ba0c7]" /></button></SheetHeader><div ref={feedRef} className="min-h-0 flex-1 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain p-4">{messages.map((msg) => msg.system ? <div key={msg.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-400/30 bg-amber-400/10 px-3 py-2"><Zap className="size-4 text-amber-400" /><p className="text-xs font-medium text-amber-300">{msg.message}</p></div> : <div key={msg.id} className="flex items-start gap-2.5"><Avatar className="size-8 shrink-0 border border-zinc-700"><AvatarFallback className="bg-[#172338] text-xs text-[#19ffff]">{msg.avatarInitials}</AvatarFallback></Avatar><div className="min-w-0"><div className="flex items-baseline gap-2"><p className="text-xs font-semibold">{msg.author}</p><p className="text-xs text-[#5e7090]">{msg.time}</p></div><p className="mt-0.5 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm bg-[#0d1424] px-3 py-2 text-sm text-[#cbd5e1]">{msg.message}</p></div></div>)}</div><form onSubmit={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); void send() }} className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 border-t border-[#141e33] bg-[#070a12] p-3"><span className="text-lg">😊</span><input value={draft} onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)} placeholder="Send a message..." className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-full border border-[#1b2842] bg-[#0d1424] px-4 py-2 text-sm text-white outline-none placeholder:text-[#5e7090] focus:border-[#19ffff]" /><button type="submit" aria-label="Send message" className="flex size-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]"><Send className="size-4" /></button></form></SheetContent></Sheet>
}

<file path="components/hockey/player-item.tsx">
import React from "react"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { PlayerPortrait } from "@/components/hockey/player-portrait"
import { TAXI_MAX_NHL_GAMES, getWeekActualPoints, isStarterSlot, type Player } from "@/lib/hockey-data"
import { positionFitsSlot } from "@/lib/roster-eligibility"

export const slotBadgeColors: Record<string, string> = {
  C: "bg-[#1d4ed8] text-white", W: "bg-[#0d9488] text-white", F: "bg-[#7c3aed] text-white", D: "bg-[#b45309] text-white", G: "bg-[#0284c7] text-white", BN: "bg-[#1e293b] text-[#94a3b8]", TAXI: "bg-[#451a03] text-[#f59e0b] border border-[#78350f]", IR: "bg-[#4c0519] text-[#f43f5e] border border-[#881337]",
}

function isInvalidRosterPlacement(player: Player): boolean {
  const injured = player.status === "IR" || player.status === "O" || player.status === "DTD"
  if (player.slot === "BN") return false
  if (player.slot === "TAXI") return (player.nhlGamesPlayed ?? 0) >= TAXI_MAX_NHL_GAMES
  if (player.slot === "IR") return player.status !== "IR"
  if (isStarterSlot(player.slot) && !positionFitsSlot(player.slot, player.position)) return true
  return injured
}
export const PlayerItem = React.memo(function PlayerItem({
  player,
  fallbackSlot,
  onEdit,
  onSelect,
  nickname,
}: {
  player: Player | null
  fallbackSlot: string
  onEdit: (player: Player | null, fallbackSlot: string) => void
  onSelect: (player: Player) => void
  nickname?: string
}) {
  if (!player) {
    return (
      <button type="button" onClick={() => onEdit(null, fallbackSlot)} className="flex min-h-11 w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-between border-b border-[#0f1726] px-3.5 py-2 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-[#16233b] active:scale-[0.99]">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <span className={cn("flex h-7 min-w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[5px] px-1 text-xs font-black uppercase", slotBadgeColors[fallbackSlot])}>
            {fallbackSlot}
          </span>
          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#45546d]">Empty</span>
        </div>
        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#45546d]">—</span>
      </button>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className={cn("flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#0f1726] px-3.5 py-2 transition-colors", isInvalidRosterPlacement(player) ? "bg-rose-500/10" : "hover:bg-[#0c1220]")}>
      <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2.5">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onEdit(player, fallbackSlot)}
          className={cn("flex h-7 min-w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[5px] px-1 text-xs font-black uppercase transition-transform active:scale-95", slotBadgeColors[player.slot] || slotBadgeColors[player.position])}
        >
          {player.slot}
        </button>

        <button type="button" onClick={() => onSelect(player)} className="flex min-h-11 min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-2.5 cursor-pointer text-left">
          <PlayerPortrait player={player} name={player.name} className="size-8 border border-[#1b263b]" />
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight text-white">{player.name}</p>
              {player.status && (
                <span className={cn("shrink-0 rounded px-1 text-xs font-black uppercase", player.status === "DTD" ? "bg-amber-400/20 text-amber-300" : "bg-[#ff2a85]/20 text-[#ff2a85]")}>
                  {player.status}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            {nickname && <p className="truncate text-xs italic text-[#5e7090]">{nickname}</p>}
            <p className="flex min-w-0 items-baseline gap-1.5 text-xs leading-tight text-[#5e7090]">
              <span className="truncate">
                <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-300">{player.position}</span> - {player.team} • {player.schedule ? (player.schedule.opponent && player.schedule.opponent !== "—" ? `${player.schedule.day} ${player.schedule.time} ${player.schedule.opponent}` : `${player.schedule.day} ${player.schedule.time}`) : "No game this week"}
              </span>
              <span className="shrink-0 font-semibold tabular-nums">{player.schedule?.weekGamesScheduled ?? 0} GP</span>
            </p>
          </div>
        </button>
      </div>

      <button type="button" onClick={() => onSelect(player)} className="flex min-h-11 min-w-11 shrink-0 cursor-pointer flex-col items-end justify-center pl-2 text-right">
        <p className="text-sm font-black tabular-nums leading-none text-white">{getWeekActualPoints(player).toFixed(1)}</p>
        <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold tabular-nums leading-none text-[#8ba0c7]">{player.schedule ? player.schedule.weekProjectedFantasyPoints.toFixed(1) : "—"}</p>
      </button>
    </div>
  )
})

<file path="components/hockey/players-sub-tab-view.tsx">
import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { ArrowLeftRight, Award, Check, Search, X } from "lucide-react"
import { weekMatchups, getTeamRoster, type MarketPlayer, type Player, type TradeBlockEntry, type LeagueTradeOffer } from "@/lib/hockey-data"
import { PlayerDetailDialog, type PlayerDialogTarget } from "@/components/hockey/player-detail-dialog"
import type { PlayerGridSettings } from "@/components/hockey/player-grid-dialog"
import { PlayerPortrait } from "@/components/hockey/player-portrait"
import { Sheet, SheetContent } from "@/components/ui/sheet"
import { getLeaderStat, getPlayerStatsForHorizon, normalizeSearchText, type LeaderCategory, type LeaderMode, type SearchPlayer } from "@/lib/hockey-calculators"
type HorizonMode = "stats" | "projections"
type HockeyHorizon = "Last 7 Days" | "Last 14 Days" | "Last 30 Days" | "Season Totals" | "Season Avg / Per Game" | "This Week" | "Next 14 Days" | "Rest of Season (ROS)"

function rosterOwnerKey(player: { nhlId?: number; name: string }) {
  return player.nhlId != null ? String(player.nhlId) : normalizeSearchText(player.name)
}

function formatShortPlayerName(name: string): string {
  const parts = name.trim().split(/\s+/)
  return parts.length < 2 ? name : `${parts[0][0]}. ${parts.slice(1).join(" ")}`
}

function tradeAssetLines(assets: LeagueTradeOffer["sendingAssets"]) {
  const lines = [
    ...(assets.players ?? []).filter(Boolean).map((player) => player.name),
    ...(assets.picks ?? []),
  ]
  if (assets.faab) lines.push(`$${assets.faab} FAAB`)
  return lines.length ? lines : ["Nothing"]
}

function HorizonPicker({ mode, horizon, onChange }: { mode: HorizonMode; horizon: HockeyHorizon; onChange: (mode: HorizonMode, horizon: HockeyHorizon) => void }) {
  const options = mode === "stats" ? ["Last 7 Days", "Last 14 Days", "Last 30 Days", "Season Totals", "Season Avg / Per Game"] : ["This Week", "Next 14 Days", "Rest of Season (ROS)"]
  return (
    <>
      <p className="mt-4 text-[13px] font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">Window</p>
      <div className="mt-2 flex gap-2">
        <button type="button" onClick={() => onChange("stats", "Last 14 Days")} className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold", mode === "stats" ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>Stats</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => onChange("projections", "This Week")} className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold", mode === "projections" ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>Projections</button>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">{options.map((option) => <button key={option} type="button" onClick={() => onChange(mode, option as HockeyHorizon)} className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold", horizon === option ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>{option}</button>)}</div>
    </>
  )
}

function TradeOfferCard({ trade, onAccept, onDecline, onCounter }: { trade: LeagueTradeOffer; onAccept: () => void; onDecline: () => void; onCounter: () => void }) {
  const send = trade.isIncoming ? trade.receivingAssets : trade.sendingAssets
  const receive = trade.isIncoming ? trade.sendingAssets : trade.receivingAssets
  const statusLabel = trade.status === "ACTIVE" ? "Pending" : trade.status === "ACCEPTED" ? "Accepted" : "Declined"
  return (
    <article className="rounded-2xl border border-[#172338] bg-[#101829] p-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-white">{trade.isIncoming ? trade.senderTeam : trade.receiverTeam}</p>
          <p className="text-[13px] text-[#8ba0c7]">{trade.timestamp}</p>
        </div>
        <span className={cn("shrink-0 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold", trade.status === "ACTIVE" ? "bg-amber-300/15 text-amber-200" : trade.status === "ACCEPTED" ? "bg-emerald-300/15 text-emerald-200" : "bg-rose-300/15 text-rose-200")}>{statusLabel}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <div>
          <p className="text-[13px] font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">You send</p>
          <ul className="mt-1 space-y-1">{tradeAssetLines(send).map((line, index) => <li key={`${line}-${index}`} className="text-sm font-bold text-white">{line}</li>)}</ul>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="text-[13px] font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">You receive</p>
          <ul className="mt-1 space-y-1">{tradeAssetLines(receive).map((line, index) => <li key={`${line}-${index}`} className="text-sm font-bold text-white">{line}</li>)}</ul>
        </div>
      </div>
      {trade.status === "ACTIVE" && !trade.isIncoming ? (
        <div className="mt-4">
          <button type="button" onClick={onDecline} className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl bg-rose-500 text-sm font-bold text-white">Cancel Offer</button>
        </div>
      ) : trade.status === "ACTIVE" ? (
        <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
          <button type="button" onClick={onAccept} className="h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-400 text-sm font-bold text-[#080c14]">Accept</button>
          <button type="button" onClick={onDecline} className="h-10 rounded-xl bg-rose-500 text-sm font-bold text-white">Decline</button>
          <button type="button" onClick={onCounter} className="h-10 rounded-xl border border-[#19ffff] text-sm font-bold text-[#19ffff]">Counter</button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </article>
  )
}
export function PlayersSubTabView({ teamName, tab, roster, players: dynastyPlayers, tradeBlock, tradeOffers, onAcceptTrade, onDeclineTrade, onCounterTrade, onInitiateTrade, horizonMode, horizon, onHorizonChange, onSelect, onClaim, onOpenTradeBuilder, activeTradeFilter, setActiveTradeFilter }: { teamName: string; tab: "search" | "leaders" | "trade"; roster: Player[]; players: MarketPlayer[]; tradeBlock: TradeBlockEntry[]; tradeOffers: LeagueTradeOffer[]; onAcceptTrade: (tradeId: string) => void; onDeclineTrade: (tradeId: string) => void; onCounterTrade: (trade: LeagueTradeOffer) => void; onInitiateTrade: (player: PlayerDialogTarget) => void; horizonMode: HorizonMode; horizon: HockeyHorizon; onHorizonChange: (mode: HorizonMode, horizon: HockeyHorizon) => void; onSelect: (player: PlayerDialogTarget) => void; onClaim: (player: MarketPlayer) => void; onOpenTradeBuilder: () => void; activeTradeFilter: "ALL" | "ACTIVE" | "ACCEPTED" | "REJECTED"; setActiveTradeFilter: (filter: "ALL" | "ACTIVE" | "ACCEPTED" | "REJECTED") => void }) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("")
  const [selectedSearchPos, setSelectedSearchPos] = useState("ALL")
  const [searchOwnerFilter, setSearchOwnerFilter] = useState("ALL")
  const [searchTeamFilter, setSearchTeamFilter] = useState("ALL")
  const [searchFiltersOpen, setSearchFiltersOpen] = useState(false)
  const [leaderFiltersOpen, setLeaderFiltersOpen] = useState(false)
  const [leaderCategory, setLeaderCategory] = useState<LeaderCategory>("FPTS")
  const [leaderPosFilter, setLeaderPosFilter] = useState<"ALL" | "C" | "W" | "D" | "G">("ALL")
  const leaderMode: LeaderMode = horizon === "Season Avg / Per Game" ? "per_game" : "total"
  const goalieCategories: LeaderCategory[] = ["FPTS", "W", "SV", "SV%", "SO"]
  const skaterCategories: LeaderCategory[] = ["FPTS", "G", "A", "SOG", "HIT", "BLK"]
  const leaderCategories = leaderPosFilter === "G" ? goalieCategories : skaterCategories
  const selectLeaderPosition = (position: "ALL" | "C" | "W" | "D" | "G") => {
    setLeaderPosFilter(position)
    if (position === "G" && !goalieCategories.includes(leaderCategory)) setLeaderCategory("FPTS")
    if (position !== "G" && ["W", "SV", "SV%", "SO"].includes(leaderCategory)) setLeaderCategory("FPTS")
  }
  const selectLeaderCategory = (category: LeaderCategory) => {
    setLeaderCategory(category)
    if (["W", "SV", "SV%", "SO"].includes(category) && leaderPosFilter !== "G") setLeaderPosFilter("G")
  }
  const allRosters = useMemo(() => {
    const teamNames = new Set<string>()
    weekMatchups.forEach((matchup) => {
      teamNames.add(matchup.homeTeam)
      teamNames.add(matchup.awayTeam)
    })
    return Array.from(teamNames)
      .filter((otherTeamName) => otherTeamName !== teamName)
      .map((otherTeamName) => ({ teamName: otherTeamName, players: getTeamRoster(otherTeamName, roster, dynastyPlayers) }))
  }, [roster, dynastyPlayers, teamName])

  const canonicalPlayersByName = useMemo(() => new Map(dynastyPlayers.map((player) => [normalizeSearchText(player.name), player])), [dynastyPlayers])
  const allLeaguePlayers = useMemo<SearchPlayer[]>(() => {
    const rosterOwners = new Map<string, string>()
    roster.forEach((player) => rosterOwners.set(rosterOwnerKey(player), "You"))
    allRosters.forEach((teamRoster) => {
      teamRoster.players.forEach((player) => {
        const key = rosterOwnerKey(player)
        if (!rosterOwners.has(key)) rosterOwners.set(key, teamRoster.teamName)
      })
    })
    return dynastyPlayers.map((player) => {
      const stats = getPlayerStatsForHorizon(player, horizon)
      const owner = rosterOwners.get(rosterOwnerKey(player)) ?? "FA"
      return {
        ...player,
        id: `nhl-${player.nhlId ?? normalizeSearchText(player.name).replace(/\s+/g, "-")}`,
        stats,
        owner,
        projPts: player.projection,
      }
    })
  }, [roster, allRosters, dynastyPlayers, horizon])

  const filteredSearchResults = useMemo(() => {
    const query = normalizeSearchText(searchQuery.trim())
    return allLeaguePlayers.filter((player) => {
      const normalizedName = normalizeSearchText(player.name)
      const matchesText = !query ||
        normalizedName.includes(query) ||
        normalizeSearchText(player.team).includes(query) ||
        normalizeSearchText(player.position) === query
      const matchesPos = selectedSearchPos === "ALL" ||
        player.position === selectedSearchPos ||
        (selectedSearchPos === "W" && ["LW", "RW", "W"].includes(player.position)) ||
        (selectedSearchPos === "F" && ["C", "LW", "RW", "W", "F"].includes(player.position))
      const matchesOwner = searchOwnerFilter === "ALL" ||
        (searchOwnerFilter === "AVAILABLE" && (player.owner === "FA" || player.owner.startsWith("W"))) ||
        (searchOwnerFilter === "ROSTERED" && player.owner !== "FA" && !player.owner.startsWith("W"))
      const matchesTeam = searchTeamFilter === "ALL" || player.team === searchTeamFilter
      return matchesText && matchesPos && matchesOwner && matchesTeam
    })
  }, [allLeaguePlayers, searchQuery, selectedSearchPos, searchOwnerFilter, searchTeamFilter])
  const sortedLeaders = useMemo(() => {
    const goalieCategory = ["W", "SV", "SV%", "SO"].includes(leaderCategory)
    const goaliePositionFilter = leaderPosFilter === "G"
    const skaterPositionFilter = ["C", "W", "D"].includes(leaderPosFilter)
    const eligiblePool = allLeaguePlayers.filter((player) => {
      if (goalieCategory || goaliePositionFilter) return player.position === "G"
      if (skaterPositionFilter) return player.position !== "G"
      return true
    })
    const filteredByPos = eligiblePool.filter((player) => {
      if (leaderPosFilter === "ALL") return true
      if (leaderPosFilter === "C") return player.position === "C"
      if (leaderPosFilter === "W") return ["W", "LW", "RW"].includes(player.position)
      if (leaderPosFilter === "D") return ["D", "LD", "RD"].includes(player.position)
      if (leaderPosFilter === "G") return player.position === "G"
      return true
    })
    return filteredByPos
      .map((player) => {
        const projectionGames = horizonMode === "projections" ? horizon === "This Week" ? 3.5 : horizon === "Next 14 Days" ? 7 : 28
          : undefined
        const stat = getLeaderStat(player, leaderCategory, leaderMode, projectionGames, horizon)
        return { player, rawValue: stat.numeric, displayValue: stat.display }
      })
      .sort((a, b) => b.rawValue - a.rawValue)
      .map((item, index) => ({ ...item, rank: index + 1 }))
  }, [allLeaguePlayers, leaderCategory, leaderMode, leaderPosFilter, horizon, horizonMode])

  if (tab === "search") {
    const toTarget = (player: SearchPlayer): PlayerDialogTarget => {
      if ("slot" in player) return player
      return {
        name: player.name,
        position: player.position,
        team: player.team,
        opponent: ("schedule" in player ? player.schedule?.opponent : undefined) ?? "—",
        status: null,
        todayPts: player.fpts,
        projPts: player.projection,
        marketPlayer: player,
      }
    }
    const positionClass = (positionValue: string) =>
      positionValue === "G" ? "bg-sky-500 text-white" : positionValue === "D" ? "bg-amber-600 text-white" : positionValue === "C" ? "bg-blue-600 text-white" : "bg-teal-600 text-white"
    const teams = Array.from(new Set(allLeaguePlayers.map((player) => player.team))).sort()
    return <div className="p-3">
      <div className="relative mb-3">
        <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-2.5 size-4 text-[#5e7090]" />
        <input value={searchQuery} onChange={(event) => setSearchQuery(event.target.value)} placeholder="Search 300+ NHL players" className="w-full rounded-lg border border-[#263858] bg-[#101829] py-2 pl-9 pr-9 text-sm text-white outline-none focus:border-[#19ffff]" />
        {searchQuery.length > 0 && <button type="button" aria-label="Clear search" onClick={() => setSearchQuery("")} className="absolute right-2 top-1.5 rounded-full p-1 text-[#8ba0c7] hover:bg-[#172338] hover:text-white"><X className="size-4" /></button>}
      </div>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setSearchFiltersOpen(true)} className="mb-3 max-w-full truncate rounded-full bg-[#172338] px-3 py-1.5 text-left text-[13px] font-bold text-white">{selectedSearchPos} · {searchOwnerFilter === "AVAILABLE" ? "Available" : searchOwnerFilter === "ALL" ? "All owners" : "Rostered"}{searchTeamFilter !== "ALL" ? ` · ${searchTeamFilter}` : ""} · {horizon}</button>
      <Sheet open={searchFiltersOpen} onOpenChange={setSearchFiltersOpen}>
        <SheetContent side="bottom" spring="snappy" className="mx-auto max-h-[80vh] max-w-[430px] overflow-y-auto rounded-t-3xl border-t border-[#1a263d] bg-[#070a12] p-4 text-white">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-black">Filters</h2>
          <p className="mt-4 text-[13px] font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">Position</p>
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">{["ALL", "C", "LW", "RW", "D", "G"].map((value) => <button key={value} type="button" onClick={() => setSelectedSearchPos(value)} className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold", selectedSearchPos === value ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>{value}</button>)}</div>
          <p className="mt-4 text-[13px] font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">Ownership</p>
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">{[["ALL", "All"], ["AVAILABLE", "Available"], ["ROSTERED", "Rostered"]].map(([value, label]) => <button key={value} type="button" onClick={() => setSearchOwnerFilter(value)} className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold", searchOwnerFilter === value ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>{label}</button>)}</div>
          <p className="mt-4 text-[13px] font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">NHL team</p>
          <select aria-label="Filter by NHL team" value={searchTeamFilter} onChange={(event) => setSearchTeamFilter(event.target.value)} className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-[#263858] bg-[#101829] px-3 py-3 text-sm text-white outline-none"><option value="ALL">All NHL teams</option>{teams.map((team) => <option key={team} value={team}>{team}</option>)}</select>
          <HorizonPicker mode={horizonMode} horizon={horizon} onChange={onHorizonChange} />
        </SheetContent>
      </Sheet>
      {searchQuery.length > 0 && filteredSearchResults.length === 0 ? <div className="rounded-lg border border-[#172338] bg-[#0d1424] px-4 py-10 text-center text-sm text-[#8ba0c7]">No players found matching '{searchQuery}'</div> : <div className="rounded-lg border border-[#172338] bg-[#0d1424]">{filteredSearchResults.slice(0, 50).map((player) => {
        const available = player.owner === "FA" || player.owner.startsWith("W")
        const projectionGames = horizonMode === "projections" ? (horizon === "This Week" ? 3.5 : horizon === "Next 14 Days" ? 7 : 28) : undefined
        const points = getLeaderStat(player, "FPTS", leaderMode, projectionGames, horizon).numeric
        return <button type="button" key={player.id} onClick={() => onSelect(toTarget(player))} className="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 border-b border-[#172338] px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-[#0f1828]/80">
          <span className={cn("flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-xs font-black", positionClass(player.position))}>{player.position}</span>
          <span className="min-w-0 flex-1"><span className="block truncate text-sm font-bold text-white">{player.name}</span><span className="block truncate text-[13px] text-[#8ba0c7]">{player.team} · {"opponent" in player ? player.opponent : (player.schedule?.opponent ?? "—")}</span></span>
          <span className={cn("shrink-0 text-[13px] font-bold", available ? player.owner.startsWith("W") ? "text-amber-300" : "text-emerald-300" : "text-[#8ba0c7]")}>{player.owner}</span>
          <span className="w-12 text-right text-base font-black tabular-nums text-white">{points.toFixed(1)}</span>
        </button>
      })}</div>}
    </div>
  }
  if (tab === "leaders") {
    const toTarget = (player: SearchPlayer): PlayerDialogTarget => {
      if ("slot" in player) return player
      return { name: player.name, position: player.position, team: player.team, opponent: ("schedule" in player ? player.schedule?.opponent : undefined) ?? "—", status: null, todayPts: player.fpts, projPts: player.projection, marketPlayer: player }
    }
    const positionClass = (positionValue: string) =>
      positionValue === "G" ? "bg-sky-500 text-white" : positionValue === "D" ? "bg-amber-600 text-white" : positionValue === "C" ? "bg-blue-600 text-white" : "bg-teal-600 text-white"
    return <div className="p-3">
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setLeaderFiltersOpen(true)} className="mb-3 max-w-full truncate rounded-full bg-[#172338] px-3 py-1.5 text-left text-[13px] font-bold text-white">{leaderPosFilter} · {leaderCategory} · {horizon}</button>
      <Sheet open={leaderFiltersOpen} onOpenChange={setLeaderFiltersOpen}>
        <SheetContent side="bottom" spring="snappy" className="mx-auto max-h-[80vh] max-w-[430px] overflow-y-auto rounded-t-3xl border-t border-[#1a263d] bg-[#070a12] p-4 text-white">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-black">Filters</h2>
          <p className="mt-4 text-[13px] font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">Position</p>
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">{(["ALL", "C", "W", "D", "G"] as const).map((position) => <button key={position} type="button" onClick={() => selectLeaderPosition(position)} className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold", leaderPosFilter === position ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>{position}</button>)}</div>
          <p className="mt-4 text-[13px] font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">Category</p>
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">{leaderCategories.map((category) => <button key={category} type="button" onClick={() => selectLeaderCategory(category)} className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold", leaderCategory === category ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>{category}</button>)}</div>
          <HorizonPicker mode={horizonMode} horizon={horizon} onChange={onHorizonChange} />
        </SheetContent>
      </Sheet>
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-[#172338] bg-[#0d1424]">{sortedLeaders.slice(0, 50).map(({ player, displayValue, rank }) => <button type="button" key={player.id} onClick={() => onSelect(toTarget(player))} className="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 border-b border-[#172338] px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-[#0f1828]/80"><span className={cn("w-5 text-center text-xs font-black", rank === 1 ? "text-yellow-300" : rank === 2 ? "text-slate-300" : rank === 3 ? "text-amber-600" : "text-[#5e7090]")}>#{rank}</span><span className={cn("flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-xs font-black", positionClass(player.position))}>{player.position}</span><span className="min-w-0 flex-1"><span className="block truncate text-sm font-bold text-white">{player.name}</span><span className="block truncate text-[13px] text-[#8ba0c7]">{player.team} · {player.owner}</span></span><span className="text-right text-base font-black tabular-nums text-white">{displayValue}<small className="ml-1 text-xs font-bold text-[#5e7090]">{leaderCategory === "FPTS" && leaderMode === "per_game" ? "FPTS/G" : leaderCategory}</small></span></button>)}</div>
    </div>
  }
  const tradeBlockPlayers = tradeBlock.map((entry) => {
    const player = entry.teamName === teamName ? roster.find((item) => item.id === entry.playerId) : (Array.isArray(allRosters) ? allRosters : []).flatMap((team) => team.players).find((item) => item.id === entry.playerId)
    if (!player) return null
    const databasePlayer = dynastyPlayers.find((candidate) => rosterOwnerKey(candidate) === rosterOwnerKey(player))
    return { player: databasePlayer ? { ...player, ...databasePlayer, id: player.id, slot: player.slot, status: databasePlayer.injuryStatus ?? null, opponent: player.opponent, gameTime: player.gameTime } : player, entry }
  }).filter((item): item is { player: Player; entry: TradeBlockEntry } => item !== null)
  const displayedTrades = tradeOffers.filter((trade) => activeTradeFilter === "ALL" || trade.status === activeTradeFilter)
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 p-3">
      <section>
        <h2 className="mb-2 text-base font-black text-white">Trade block</h2>
        <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
          {tradeBlockPlayers.map(({ player, entry }) => (
            <button type="button" key={player.id} onClick={() => onSelect({ ...player, owned: entry.teamName === teamName, playerId: player.id, ownerName: entry.teamName, tradeBlockNote: entry.note })} className="min-w-[180px] rounded-2xl border border-[#172338] bg-[#101829] p-3 text-left">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <PlayerPortrait player={player} name={player.name} className="size-10" />
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-white">{formatShortPlayerName(player.name)}</p>
                  <p className="truncate text-[13px] text-[#8ba0c7]">{player.team}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p className="mt-3 truncate text-[13px] text-[#8ba0c7]">{entry.teamName}</p>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>
      <section className="rounded-2xl border border-[#19ffff]/30 bg-[#101a2b] p-4">
        <p className="text-sm font-bold text-[#19ffff]">Propose a trade</p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-[#8ba0c7]">Players, draft picks, and FAAB.</p>
        <button type="button" onClick={onOpenTradeBuilder} className="mt-3 h-10 w-full rounded-xl bg-[#19ffff] text-sm font-bold text-[#080c14]">Open Trade Builder</button>
      </section>
      <section>
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <h3 className="text-base font-black text-white">Offers</h3>
          <div className="flex gap-1">
            {(["ALL", "ACTIVE", "ACCEPTED", "REJECTED"] as const).map((filter) => (
              <button type="button" key={filter} onClick={() => setActiveTradeFilter(filter)} className={cn("rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold", activeTradeFilter === filter ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>{filter === "ALL" ? "All" : filter === "ACTIVE" ? "Open" : filter === "ACCEPTED" ? "Done" : "Out"}</button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {displayedTrades.length ? displayedTrades.map((trade) => (
            <TradeOfferCard key={trade.id} trade={trade} onAccept={() => onAcceptTrade(trade.id)} onDecline={() => onDeclineTrade(trade.id)} onCounter={() => onCounterTrade(trade)} />
          )) : <p className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-[#263858] p-6 text-center text-sm text-[#8ba0c7]">{activeTradeFilter === "ALL" ? "No offers." : `No ${activeTradeFilter.toLowerCase()} offers.`}</p>}
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  )
}

<file path="components/hockey/swipe-gestures.tsx">
"use client"

import { Children, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type PointerEvent as ReactPointerEvent, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { animate, motion, useMotionValue, type MotionValue } from "motion/react"
import { springs, type SpringName } from "@/lib/springs"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

type Direction = "left" | "right"
type Axis = "horizontal" | "vertical"
type ProgressInput = ((continuousIndex: number) => void) | MotionValue<number>

const useIsoLayoutEffect = typeof window === "undefined" ? useEffect : useLayoutEffect

function prefersReducedMotion() {
  return typeof window !== "undefined" && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches
}

function nestedClaim(target: EventTarget | null, zone: string) {
  const element = target instanceof Element ? target : null
  if (!element) return false
  const claim = element.closest("[data-swipe]")
  if (claim && claim.getAttribute("data-swipe") !== zone) return true
  return Boolean(element.closest("[data-swipe-ignore], input, textarea, select"))
}

function publishProgress(target: ProgressInput | undefined, progress: number) {
  if (!target || !Number.isFinite(progress)) return
  if (typeof target === "function") target(progress)
  else target.set(progress)
}

function paneWidthFor(width: number, peekPx: number, gapPx: number) {
  if (width <= 0) return 0
  if (peekPx > 0) return Math.max(1, width - peekPx - gapPx)
  return width
}

type DragState = {
  x: number
  y: number
  startTrackX: number
  time: number
  locked: Axis | null
  pointerId: number
}

/** Horizontal swipe that springs back. Vertical movement keeps normal scrolling. */
export function useHorizontalSwipe(zone: string, onSwipe: (direction: Direction) => void, enabled = true) {
  const start = useRef<{ x: number; y: number; ignore: boolean } | null>(null)
  const x = useMotionValue(0)

  const finish = (direction: Direction) => {
    if (prefersReducedMotion()) {
      x.set(0)
      onSwipe(direction)
      return
    }
    animate(x, direction === "left" ? -28 : 28, { duration: 0.08 }).finished.then(() => {
      onSwipe(direction)
      animate(x, 0, springs.snappy)
    })
  }

  const onPointerDown = (event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    if (!enabled || event.button !== 0) return
    start.current = {
      x: event.clientX,
      y: event.clientY,
      ignore: nestedClaim(event.target, zone),
    }
  }
  const onPointerMove = (event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    const origin = start.current
    if (!origin || origin.ignore) return
    const dx = event.clientX - origin.x
    const dy = event.clientY - origin.y
    if (Math.abs(dx) < 8 || Math.abs(dx) < Math.abs(dy)) return
    x.set(Math.max(-48, Math.min(48, dx * 0.35)))
  }
  const onPointerUp = (event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    const origin = start.current
    start.current = null
    if (!origin) return
    if (origin.ignore) return
    event.stopPropagation()
    const dx = event.clientX - origin.x
    const dy = event.clientY - origin.y
    if (Math.abs(dx) < 56 || Math.abs(dx) < Math.abs(dy) * 1.25) {
      animate(x, 0, springs.gentle)
      return
    }
    finish(dx < 0 ? "left" : "right")
  }
  const onPointerCancel = () => {
    start.current = null
    animate(x, 0, springs.gentle)
  }

  return {
    x,
    handlers: { onPointerDown, onPointerMove, onPointerUp, onPointerCancel },
  }
}

export function SwipeSurface({
  zone,
  onSwipeLeft,
  onSwipeRight,
  enabled = true,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  zone: string
  onSwipeLeft?: () => void
  onSwipeRight?: () => void
  enabled?: boolean
  className?: string
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  const swipe = useHorizontalSwipe(zone, (direction) => {
    if (direction === "left") onSwipeLeft?.()
    else onSwipeRight?.()
  }, enabled)
  return (
    <motion.div data-swipe={zone} className={className} style={{ x: swipe.x, touchAction: "pan-y" }} {...swipe.handlers}>
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  )
}

/**
 * 1:1 horizontal pager. The track follows the finger, then snaps by distance or velocity.
 * `fill` stretches the track to the pager height (main tabs). Matchup cards stay content-sized
 * and use `peekPx` / `gapPx` so the next card stays in view.
 */
export function SwipePager({
  zone,
  activeIndex,
  itemCount,
  onIndexChange,
  onProgressChange,
  loop = false,
  peekPx = 0,
  gapPx = 0,
  fill = false,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  zone: string
  activeIndex: number
  itemCount: number
  onIndexChange: (nextIndex: number) => void
  onProgressChange?: ProgressInput
  loop?: boolean
  peekPx?: number
  gapPx?: number
  fill?: boolean
  className?: string
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const childArray = Children.toArray(children)
  const pageCount = itemCount > 0 ? Math.min(itemCount, childArray.length) : childArray.length
  const safeIndex = pageCount <= 0 ? 0 : Math.min(Math.max(activeIndex, 0), pageCount - 1)
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(0)
  const paneWidth = paneWidthFor(width, peekPx, gapPx)
  const stride = paneWidth > 0 ? paneWidth + gapPx : 0
  // Percentage offset is correct before the container is measured, including server HTML.
  const x = useMotionValue<number | string>(stride > 0 ? -safeIndex * stride : `${-safeIndex * 100}%`)
  const drag = useRef<DragState | null>(null)
  const dragDistance = useRef(0)
  const controls = useRef<{ stop: () => void } | null>(null)
  const animatingTo = useRef<number | null>(null)
  const lastWidth = useRef(0)
  const widthRef = useRef(0)
  const strideRef = useRef(0)
  const activeIndexRef = useRef(0)
  const itemCountRef = useRef(itemCount)
  const loopRef = useRef(loop)
  const onIndexChangeRef = useRef(onIndexChange)
  const onProgressRef = useRef(onProgressChange)

  widthRef.current = width
  strideRef.current = stride
  activeIndexRef.current = safeIndex
  itemCountRef.current = pageCount
  loopRef.current = loop
  onIndexChangeRef.current = onIndexChange
  onProgressRef.current = onProgressChange

  const animateToRef = useRef<(index: number, immediate?: boolean) => void>(() => {})
  animateToRef.current = (index: number, immediate = false) => {
    const currentStride = strideRef.current
    const count = itemCountRef.current
    if (currentStride <= 0 || count <= 0) return
    const safe = Math.min(Math.max(index, 0), count - 1)
    const target = -safe * currentStride
    controls.current?.stop()
    animatingTo.current = safe
    if (immediate || prefersReducedMotion()) {
      x.set(target)
      return
    }
    controls.current = animate(x, target, springs.snappy)
  }

  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
    const element = containerRef.current
    if (!element) return
    const measure = () => {
      const style = getComputedStyle(element)
      const pad = (parseFloat(style.paddingLeft) || 0) + (parseFloat(style.paddingRight) || 0)
      const next = Math.max(0, Math.round(element.clientWidth - pad))
      if (next === widthRef.current) return
      widthRef.current = next
      setWidth(next)
    }
    measure()
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(measure)
    observer.observe(element)
    return () => observer.disconnect()
  }, [setWidth])

  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
    const emit = (latest: number | string) => {
      const currentStride = strideRef.current
      if (currentStride <= 0 || typeof latest !== "number") return
      publishProgress(onProgressRef.current, -latest / currentStride)
    }
    emit(x.get())
    return x.on("change", emit)
  }, [x])

  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (stride <= 0) {
      x.set(`${-safeIndex * 100}%`)
      return
    }
    const widthChanged = width !== lastWidth.current
    lastWidth.current = width
    if (drag.current?.locked === "horizontal") return
    if (!widthChanged && animatingTo.current === safeIndex) return
    const current = x.get()
    animateToRef.current(safeIndex, widthChanged || typeof current !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(current))
  }, [safeIndex, width, stride, gapPx, peekPx, x])

  const detachDrag = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null)
  const stopTracking = () => {
    detachDrag.current?.()
    detachDrag.current = null
  }
  useEffect(() => () => {
    controls.current?.stop()
    stopTracking()
  }, [])

  const finishDrag = (event: PointerEvent, cancel: boolean) => {
    const origin = drag.current
    if (!origin || origin.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return
    drag.current = null
    stopTracking()
    const node = containerRef.current
    if (node?.hasPointerCapture?.(origin.pointerId)) {
      try {
        node.releasePointerCapture(origin.pointerId)
      } catch {
        // The pointer can already be gone on cancel.
      }
    }
    if (cancel || origin.locked !== "horizontal") {
      dragDistance.current = 0
      if (origin.locked === "horizontal") animateToRef.current(activeIndexRef.current)
      return
    }
    const dx = event.clientX - origin.x
    dragDistance.current = dx
    const elapsed = Math.max((performance.now() - origin.time) / 1000, 0.016)
    const vx = dx / elapsed
    const currentStride = strideRef.current
    let next = activeIndexRef.current
    if (currentStride > 0 && (dx < -currentStride * 0.22 || vx < -320)) next += 1
    else if (currentStride > 0 && (dx > currentStride * 0.22 || vx > 320)) next -= 1
    const count = itemCountRef.current
    if (count <= 0) return
    if (loopRef.current) next = ((next % count) + count) % count
    else next = Math.max(0, Math.min(count - 1, next))
    animateToRef.current(next)
    if (next !== activeIndexRef.current) onIndexChangeRef.current(next)
  }

  const onPointerDown = (event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (event.button !== 0) return
    dragDistance.current = 0
    if (nestedClaim(event.target, zone)) return
    const trackX = x.get()
    if (typeof trackX !== "number" || strideRef.current <= 0) return
    // Track on the window so a fast drag that leaves the card is not dropped
    // before the axis locks. Capture only once the gesture is horizontal.
    controls.current?.stop()
    stopTracking()
    const pointerId = event.pointerId
    drag.current = {
      x: event.clientX,
      y: event.clientY,
      startTrackX: trackX,
      time: performance.now(),
      locked: null,
      pointerId,
    }
    const onMove = (move: PointerEvent) => {
      const origin = drag.current
      if (!origin || origin.pointerId !== move.pointerId || origin.locked === "vertical") return
      const dx = move.clientX - origin.x
      const dy = move.clientY - origin.y
      if (origin.locked !== "horizontal") {
        if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) <= 8) return
        if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx)) {
          origin.locked = "vertical"
          return
        }
        if (Math.abs(dx) <= Math.abs(dy)) return
        origin.locked = "horizontal"
        try {
          containerRef.current?.setPointerCapture(origin.pointerId)
        } catch {
          // Window listeners still receive the gesture if capture is unavailable.
        }
      }
      dragDistance.current = dx
      const currentStride = strideRef.current
      let next = origin.startTrackX + dx
      if (!loopRef.current && currentStride > 0) {
        const max = 0
        const min = -(itemCountRef.current - 1) * currentStride
        if (next > max) next = max + (next - max) * 0.25
        else if (next < min) next = min + (next - min) * 0.25
      }
      x.set(next)
      move.preventDefault()
    }
    const onUp = (up: PointerEvent) => finishDrag(up, up.type === "pointercancel")
    window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove)
    window.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp)
    window.addEventListener("pointercancel", onUp)
    detachDrag.current = () => {
      window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove)
      window.removeEventListener("pointerup", onUp)
      window.removeEventListener("pointercancel", onUp)
    }
  }

  const onClickCapture = (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (Math.abs(dragDistance.current) <= 10) return
    event.preventDefault()
    event.stopPropagation()
    dragDistance.current = 0
  }

  const renderOrder = pageCount > 0 ? [safeIndex, ...childArray.map((_, index) => index).filter((index) => index !== safeIndex)] : []

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      data-swipe={zone}
      className={cn("relative min-w-0 overflow-hidden", fill && "flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col", className)}
      style={{ touchAction: "pan-y" }}
      onPointerDown={onPointerDown}
      onClickCapture={onClickCapture}
    >
      <motion.div className={cn("flex w-full min-w-0", fill && "h-full min-h-0 flex-1")} style={{ x, gap: gapPx }}>
        {renderOrder.map((index) => (
          <div
            key={index}
            aria-hidden={index === safeIndex ? undefined : true}
            inert={fill && index !== safeIndex ? true : undefined}
            className={cn("min-w-0 overflow-hidden", fill && "h-full min-h-0")}
            style={{ order: index, width: paneWidth > 0 ? paneWidth : "100%", flex: "0 0 auto" }}
          >
            {childArray[index]}
          </div>
        ))}
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  )
}

/** Roster-row swipe. Right reveals the lineup action. Left reveals trade block. */
export function SwipeRow({
  children,
  onSwipeRight,
  onSwipeLeft,
  rightLabel,
  leftLabel,
  spring = "wiggly",
}: {
  children: ReactNode
  onSwipeRight?: () => void
  onSwipeLeft?: () => void
  rightLabel: string
  leftLabel: string
  spring?: SpringName
}) {
  const start = useRef<{ x: number; y: number; pointer: number } | null>(null)
  const x = useMotionValue(0)
  const moved = useRef(false)

  const onPointerDown = (event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (event.button !== 0) return
    moved.current = false
    start.current = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY, pointer: event.pointerId }
  }
  const onPointerMove = (event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const origin = start.current
    if (!origin) return
    const dx = event.clientX - origin.x
    const dy = event.clientY - origin.y
    if (!moved.current && Math.abs(dx) < 10) return
    if (!moved.current && Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx)) {
      start.current = null
      return
    }
    moved.current = true
    event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(origin.pointer)
    x.set(Math.max(-104, Math.min(104, dx)))
  }
  const onPointerUp = (event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const origin = start.current
    start.current = null
    if (!origin) return
    const dx = x.get()
    if (Math.abs(dx) > 64) {
      event.stopPropagation()
      if (dx > 0) onSwipeRight?.()
      else onSwipeLeft?.()
    }
    animate(x, 0, springs[spring])
  }

  return (
    <div data-swipe="row" className="relative overflow-hidden" onPointerUp={(event) => { if (moved.current) event.stopPropagation() }}>
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 left-0 z-0 flex w-24 items-center bg-[#19ffff] pl-3 text-xs font-black uppercase text-[#080c14]">{rightLabel}</div>
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 right-0 z-0 flex w-24 items-center justify-end bg-[#ff2a85] pr-3 text-xs font-black uppercase text-white">{leftLabel}</div>
      {/* Absolute rails paint above an in-flow row. Keep the lineup positioned so Bench/Block stay hidden until the swipe. */}
      <motion.div className="relative z-10 w-full bg-[#070a12]" style={{ x, touchAction: "pan-y" }} onPointerDown={onPointerDown} onPointerMove={onPointerMove} onPointerUp={onPointerUp} onPointerCancel={() => { start.current = null; animate(x, 0, springs.gentle) }}>
        {children}
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { Calendar, ArrowLeftRight, Receipt, Newspaper, Pencil } from "lucide-react"

type TeamAction = "schedule" | "team-settings" | "settings" | "transactions" | "news" | "trade"
export type { TeamAction }
function ordinal(n: number) {
  const s = ["th", "st", "nd", "rd"]
  const v = n % 100
  return `${n}${s[(v - 20) % 10] ?? s[v] ?? s[0]}`
}

export function TeamHeader({ teamName, logoUrl, standing, rank, pendingClaims, faabBalance, onAction }: { teamName: string; logoUrl?: string; standing?: { wins: number; losses: number; pointsFor: number; pointsAgainst: number; streak?: string | null }; rank: number; pendingClaims: number; faabBalance?: number; onAction: (action: TeamAction) => void }) {
  const actions = [
    { label: "sched.", icon: Calendar, action: "schedule" as const },
    { label: "trade", icon: ArrowLeftRight, action: "trade" as const },
    { label: "trans.", icon: Receipt, action: "transactions" as const },
    { label: "news", icon: Newspaper, action: "news" as const },
  ]
  return (
    <section className="border-b border-[#111929] bg-[#0d1424] px-3.5 py-3">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="flex size-11 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full border border-[#24375b] bg-[#1b2842] text-lg">{logoUrl ? <img src={logoUrl} alt="" className="size-full object-cover" /> : "🏒"}</div>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <p className="truncate text-base font-black text-white">{teamName}</p>
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">{standing ? `${standing.wins}-${standing.losses}` : "0-0"}{rank > 0 ? ` • ${ordinal(rank)}` : ""}{standing?.streak ? ` • ${standing.streak}` : ""}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-[#5e7090]">FAAB ${faabBalance ?? 100} • PF {(standing?.pointsFor ?? 0).toFixed(1)} • PA {(standing?.pointsAgainst ?? 0).toFixed(1)}</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => onAction("team-settings")} aria-label="Edit team customization" className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#8ba0c7] hover:bg-[#172338]"><Pencil className="size-5" /></button>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
        {actions.map(({ label, icon: Icon, action }) => <button key={label} type="button" onClick={() => onAction(action)} className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1 text-xs font-black text-[#8ba0c7] hover:text-[#19ffff]"><span className="relative flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-[#263858] bg-[#141e33]"><Icon className="size-4" />{action === "transactions" && pendingClaims > 0 && <span className="absolute -right-1 -top-1 flex size-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#f43f5e] text-xs font-black text-white shadow-md">{pendingClaims}</span>}</span>{label}</button>)}
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}
