<file path="components/hockey/trade-builder-dialog.tsx">
"use client"

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react"
import { ArrowLeft, Check, ChevronRight, CircleHelp, Handshake, Shield, X } from "lucide-react"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import type { Player } from "@/lib/hockey-data"
import { PlayerPortrait } from "@/components/hockey/player-portrait"
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/dialog"

export interface TradePick {
  id: string
  label: string
  detail?: string
}

export interface TradeTeam {
  id: string
  name: string
  abbreviation?: string
  avatar?: string
  players: Player[]
  draftPicks?: TradePick[]
  faabAvailable?: number
}

export type TradeAsset =
  | { kind: "player"; player: Player }
  | { kind: "pick"; pick: TradePick }

export interface TradeProposal {
  from: TradeTeam
  to: TradeTeam
  offering: TradeAsset[]
  receiving: TradeAsset[]
  faabFrom?: number
  faabTo?: number
  note?: string
}

export interface TradeBuilderDialogProps {
  open: boolean
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void
  team: TradeTeam
  partners: TradeTeam[]
  onPlayerClick?: (player: Player, team: TradeTeam) => void
  onSendTrade: (trade: TradeProposal) => void
  initialPartnerId?: string | null
  initialOffering?: string[]
  initialReceiving?: string[]
}

type Step = 1 | 2 | 3

function PlayerAvatar({ player }: { player: Player }) {
  return <PlayerPortrait player={player} name={player.name} className="size-9 border border-[#2a3f66]" />
}

function TeamAvatar({ team }: { team: TradeTeam }) {
  if (team.avatar) return <img src={team.avatar} alt="" className="size-9 rounded-full object-cover" />
  return <div className="flex size-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#172338] text-xs font-black text-[#19ffff]">{team.abbreviation ?? team.name.slice(0, 3).toUpperCase()}</div>
}

function AssetName({ asset }: { asset: TradeAsset }) {
  return asset.kind === "player" ? <>{asset.player.name}</> : <>{asset.pick.label}</>
}

export function TradeBuilderDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  team,
  partners,
  onPlayerClick,
  onSendTrade,
  initialPartnerId = null,
  initialOffering = [],
  initialReceiving = [],
}: TradeBuilderDialogProps) {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>(1)
  const [partnerId, setPartnerId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [offering, setOffering] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [receiving, setReceiving] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [faabFrom, setFaabFrom] = useState(0)
  const [faabTo, setFaabTo] = useState(0)
  const [note, setNote] = useState("")

  const partner = partners.find((candidate) => candidate.id === partnerId) ?? null
  const proposal = useMemo<TradeProposal | null>(() => {
    if (!partner) return null
    const playerAssets = (owner: TradeTeam, ids: string[]) => [
      ...owner.players.filter((player) => ids.includes(player.id)).map((player) => ({ kind: "player" as const, player })),
      ...(owner.draftPicks ?? []).filter((pick) => ids.includes(pick.id)).map((pick) => ({ kind: "pick" as const, pick })),
    ]
    return { from: team, to: partner, offering: playerAssets(team, offering), receiving: playerAssets(partner, receiving), faabFrom, faabTo, note }
  }, [faabFrom, faabTo, note, offering, partner, receiving, team])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setPartnerId(initialPartnerId)
      setOffering(initialOffering)
      setReceiving(initialReceiving)
      setStep(initialPartnerId ? 2 : 1)
    } else {
      setStep(1)
      setPartnerId(null)
      setOffering([])
      setReceiving([])
      setFaabFrom(0)
      setFaabTo(0)
      setNote("")
    }
  }, [open])

  const close = () => onOpenChange(false)
  const toggleAsset = (id: string, side: "offering" | "receiving") => {
    const setter = side === "offering" ? setOffering : setReceiving
    setter((current) => current.includes(id) ? current.filter((value) => value !== id) : [...current, id])
  }

  if (!open) return null

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="mx-auto flex h-[90vh] max-h-[90vh] max-w-[430px] flex-col rounded-t-3xl border-t border-[#1a263d] bg-[#070a12] p-0 text-white outline-none" showCloseButton={false}>
        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between border-b border-[#172338] px-4 py-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {step > 1 && <button type="button" onClick={() => setStep((step - 1) as Step)} aria-label="Previous step" className="rounded-full p-1.5 text-[#8ba0c7] hover:bg-[#172338]"><ArrowLeft className="size-4" /></button>}
            <div>
              <DialogTitle className="text-base font-black text-white">Trade Builder</DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#5e7090]">Step {step} of 3 · {step === 1 ? "Choose a trade partner" : step === 2 ? "Select assets" : "Review and send"}</DialogDescription>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={close} aria-label="Close trade builder" className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#8ba0c7] hover:bg-[#172338]"><X className="size-4" /></button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-1 px-4 pt-3" aria-label="Trade progress">
          {[1, 2, 3].map((item) => <div key={item} className={cn("h-1 flex-1 rounded-full", item <= step ? "bg-[#19ffff]" : "bg-[#1b2842]")} />)}
        </div>

        <div className={cn("min-h-0 flex-1 overscroll-contain px-4 pb-4 pt-4", step === 2 ? "overflow-hidden" : "overflow-y-auto")}>
          {step === 1 && (
            <section>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-black">Who do you want to trade with?</h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">Select a league mate to start building your offer.</p>
              <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
                {partners.map((candidate) => {
                  const pickCount = candidate.draftPicks?.length ?? 0
                  return (
                    <button key={candidate.id} type="button" onClick={() => { setPartnerId(candidate.id); setStep(2) }} className={cn("flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border p-3 text-left transition-colors", candidate.id === partnerId ? "border-[#19ffff] bg-[#123246]" : "border-[#1b2842] bg-[#101829] hover:bg-[#172338]")}>
                      <TeamAvatar team={candidate} />
                      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1"><b className="block truncate text-sm">{candidate.name}</b><small className="text-xs text-[#5e7090]">{candidate.players.length} players{pickCount > 0 ? ` · ${pickCount} picks` : ""}</small></span>
                      {candidate.id === partnerId && <Check className="size-4 text-[#19ffff]" />}
                    </button>
                  )
                })}
                {!partners.length && <p className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[#34476a] p-6 text-center text-xs text-[#5e7090]">No trade partners available.</p>}
              </div>
            </section>
          )}

          {step === 2 && partner && (
            <section className="grid h-full min-h-0 grid-cols-2 gap-2 overflow-hidden px-0 py-1">
              <AssetList title="YOU SEND" owner={team} selected={offering} side="offering" onToggle={toggleAsset} onPlayerClick={onPlayerClick} faab={faabFrom} onFaabChange={setFaabFrom} />
              <AssetList title="YOU RECEIVE" owner={partner} selected={receiving} side="receiving" onToggle={toggleAsset} onPlayerClick={onPlayerClick} faab={faabTo} onFaabChange={setFaabTo} receive />
            </section>
          )}

          {step === 3 && proposal && (
            <section>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-black">Review trade</h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">Make sure everything looks right before sending.</p>
              <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <ReviewColumn title={`You send · ${team.name}`} assets={proposal.offering} />
                <ReviewColumn title={`You receive · ${partner?.name}`} assets={proposal.receiving} />
              </div>
              <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs"><div className="rounded-lg bg-[#101829] p-3 text-amber-300">You send: ${proposal.faabFrom ?? 0} FAAB</div><div className="rounded-lg bg-[#101829] p-3 text-amber-300">You receive: ${proposal.faabTo ?? 0} FAAB</div></div>
              <textarea value={note} onChange={(event) => setNote(event.target.value)} placeholder="Add a note to the manager (optional)" className="mt-3 min-h-16 w-full rounded-lg border border-[#263858] bg-[#101829] p-3 text-xs text-white outline-none placeholder:text-[#5e7090]" />
              <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-amber-400/30 bg-amber-400/10 p-3 text-xs text-amber-200">⚠️ You will have {team.players.filter((player) => !["IR", "IR_PLUS", "TAXI"].includes(player.slot)).length - proposal.offering.filter((asset) => asset.kind === "player" && !["IR", "IR_PLUS", "TAXI"].includes(asset.player.slot)).length + proposal.receiving.filter((asset) => asset.kind === "player" && !["IR", "IR_PLUS", "TAXI"].includes(asset.player.slot)).length}/27 players if accepted.</div>
              {!proposal.offering.length && !proposal.receiving.length && <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2 rounded-lg bg-[#172338] p-3 text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]"><CircleHelp className="size-4 shrink-0 text-[#19ffff]" />Add at least one asset to make a trade.</div>}
            </section>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="shrink-0 flex gap-2 border-t border-[#1a263d] bg-[#070a12] p-4">
          {step === 1 && <button type="button" disabled={!partnerId} onClick={() => setStep(2)} className="flex h-12 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-[#19ffff] text-sm font-bold text-[#080c14] disabled:opacity-40">Choose assets <ChevronRight className="size-4" /></button>}
          {step === 2 && <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-2"><p className="text-center text-xs font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">Sending {offering.length} · Receiving {receiving.length}</p><button type="button" disabled={!partner || (!offering.length && !receiving.length)} onClick={() => setStep(3)} className="flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-[#19ffff] text-sm font-bold text-[#080c14] disabled:opacity-40">Review proposal <ChevronRight className="size-4" /></button></div>}
          {step === 3 && <button type="button" disabled={!proposal || (!proposal.offering.length && !proposal.receiving.length)} onClick={() => { if (proposal) { onSendTrade(proposal); close() } }} className="flex h-12 flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-[#19ffff] text-sm font-bold text-[#080c14] disabled:opacity-40">Send trade <Handshake className="size-4" /></button>}
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  )
}

function SectionHeader({ label, count }: { label: string; count: number }) {
  return <div className="my-1.5 flex items-center justify-between rounded bg-[#0b1220] px-2 py-1 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5e7090]"><span>{label}</span><span className="rounded bg-[#141e33] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">{count}</span></div>
}

function CompactTradePlayerRow({ player, selected, owner, onToggle, onPlayerClick }: { player: Player; selected: boolean; owner: TradeTeam; onToggle: () => void; onPlayerClick?: (player: Player, team: TradeTeam) => void }) {
  const position = player.slot === "IR" ? "IR" : player.slot === "TAXI" ? "TAXI" : player.slot === "F" ? "F" : player.position
  const positionClass = position === "G" ? "bg-sky-500 text-white" : position === "D" ? "bg-amber-600 text-white" : position === "C" ? "bg-blue-600 text-white" : position === "IR" ? "bg-rose-700 text-white" : position === "TAXI" ? "bg-amber-800 text-white" : position === "F" ? "bg-violet-600 text-white" : "bg-teal-600 text-white"
  const shortName = player.name.split(" ").slice(-1)[0]
  return <div role="button" tabIndex={0} onClick={onToggle} onKeyDown={(event) => { if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") onToggle() }} className={cn("flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border p-1.5 transition-colors", selected ? "border-[#19ffff]/50 bg-[#0c2231] text-white" : "border-[#141e33] bg-[#0d1424] text-[#cbd5e1] hover:bg-[#111c2e]")}>
    <input type="checkbox" checked={selected} onChange={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); onToggle() }} onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()} aria-label={`Select ${player.name}`} className="size-3.5 shrink-0 rounded accent-[#19ffff]" />
    <span className={cn("flex size-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded text-xs font-black", positionClass)}>{position === "LW" || position === "RW" ? "W" : position}</span>
    <button type="button" onClick={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); onPlayerClick?.(player, owner) }} className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 text-left"><PlayerAvatar player={player} /><span className="min-w-0"><b className="block truncate text-xs font-bold leading-tight text-white">{shortName}</b>    <small className="block text-xs tabular-nums text-[#5e7090]">{(player.schedule?.weekProjectedFantasyPoints ?? player.projPts).toFixed(1)}</small></span></button>
  </div>
}

function AssetList({ title, owner, selected, side, onToggle, onPlayerClick, faab, onFaabChange, receive = false }: {
  title: string
  owner: TradeTeam
  selected: string[]
  side: "offering" | "receiving"
  onToggle: (id: string, side: "offering" | "receiving") => void
  onPlayerClick?: (player: Player, team: TradeTeam) => void
  faab: number
  onFaabChange: (value: number) => void
  receive?: boolean
}) {
  const groups = [
    ["STARTERS", owner.players.filter((player) => ["C", "W", "LW", "RW", "F", "D", "G"].includes(player.slot)), "starter"],
    ["BENCH", owner.players.filter((player) => player.slot === "BN"), "player"],
    ["INJURED RESERVE", owner.players.filter((player) => player.slot === "IR"), "player"],
    ["TAXI SQUAD", owner.players.filter((player) => player.slot === "TAXI"), "player"],
  ] as const
  const picks = owner.draftPicks ?? []
  const assetCount = selected.length + (faab > 0 ? 1 : 0)
  return <div className="flex h-full min-h-0 min-w-0 flex-col overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain"><div className="sticky top-0 z-20 mb-2 shrink-0 border-b border-[#1a263d] bg-[#070a12] pb-2 pt-1"><div className={cn("flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider", receive ? "text-rose-400" : "text-[#19ffff]")}><TeamAvatar team={owner} /><span className="truncate">{title}</span></div><div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1"><p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-white">{owner.name}</p><span className="shrink-0 rounded bg-[#172338] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">{assetCount} selected</span></div></div>
    {groups.map(([label, players]) => <section key={label}><SectionHeader label={label} count={players.length} />{players.length ? <div className="space-y-1.5">{players.map((player) => <CompactTradePlayerRow key={player.id} player={player} selected={selected.includes(player.id)} owner={owner} onToggle={() => onToggle(player.id, side)} onPlayerClick={onPlayerClick} />)}</div> : <p className="px-1.5 py-1 text-xs italic text-[#3e4c63]">None</p>}</section>)}
    <SectionHeader label="DRAFT PICKS" count={picks.length} />
    {picks.length ? <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-1 px-1 py-1">{picks.map((pick) => { const checked = selected.includes(pick.id); return <button type="button" key={pick.id} onClick={() => onToggle(pick.id, side)} className={cn("flex items-center justify-between rounded border p-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition-colors", checked ? "border-[#19ffff] bg-[#0c2231] text-[#19ffff]" : "border-[#16233b] bg-[#0d1424] text-[#8ba0c7] hover:border-[#2a3f66]")}>{pick.label}<span>{checked ? "✓" : ""}</span></button> })}</div> : <p className="px-1.5 py-1 text-xs italic text-[#3e4c63]">None</p>}
    <SectionHeader label="FAAB BUDGET" count={owner.faabAvailable ?? 100} />
    <div className="mx-1 mt-1 rounded-lg border border-[#16233b] bg-[#0a0f1a] p-2"><label className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">FAAB Included <span className="flex items-center border border-[#263858] bg-[#101829] px-1.5 text-white">$<input type="number" min={0} max={owner.faabAvailable ?? 100} value={faab} onChange={(event) => onFaabChange(Math.max(0, Math.min(owner.faabAvailable ?? 100, Number(event.target.value) || 0)))} className="w-10 bg-transparent py-1 text-right text-xs outline-none" /></span></label><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#5e7090]">${owner.faabAvailable ?? 100} available</p></div>
  </div>
}

function ReviewColumn({ title, assets }: { title: string; assets: TradeAsset[] }) {
  return <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#1b2842] bg-[#101829] p-3"><h3 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5e7090]">{title}</h3><div className="mt-2 space-y-2">{assets.length ? assets.map((asset) => <div key={asset.kind === "player" ? asset.player.id : asset.pick.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold"><span className="size-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#19ffff]" /><AssetName asset={asset} /></div>) : <p className="text-xs text-[#5e7090]">Nothing selected</p>}</div></div>
}

<file path="lib/services/transactions.ts">
import { ActivityAction, AssetType, ClaimStatus, PlayerStatus, Prisma, SlotType, TradeStatus } from "@prisma/client"
import { getLockSummary } from "@/lib/services/lineup-locks"
import { isSlotLocked } from "@/lib/lineup-lock"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { nextWaiverProcessAt, WAIVER_RESOLUTIONS } from "@/lib/waiver-run"
import { DEFAULT_BENCH_CAPACITY, displacedLandingSlot } from "@/lib/roster-eligibility"
import { freezeWeekLineup, FUTURE_LINEUP_LOCK_MESSAGE, isWeekLineupLocked } from "@/lib/services/week-lineups"

type TransactionClient = Prisma.TransactionClient
const injuredStatuses = new Set<PlayerStatus>([PlayerStatus.IR, PlayerStatus.O, PlayerStatus.DTD])
const RESERVE_SLOTS: SlotType[] = [SlotType.TAXI, SlotType.IR, SlotType.IR_PLUS]

export interface SubmitWaiverClaimParams {
  teamId: string
  playerToAddId: number
  playerToDropId?: number | null
  bidAmount: number
}

export async function submitWaiverClaim(params: SubmitWaiverClaimParams) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(params.bidAmount) || params.bidAmount < 0) throw new Error("Bid amount must be a non-negative integer")
  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const team = await tx.team.findUnique({ where: { id: params.teamId }, select: { leagueId: true, faabBalance: true, league: { select: { rosterSize: true, currentSeason: true } } } })
    if (!team) throw new Error("Team not found")
    if (team.faabBalance < params.bidAmount) throw new Error("Insufficient FAAB balance")
    // A drop is optional while the team has an open roster spot; it is only required when the roster is full.
    if (params.playerToDropId == null) {
      const rosterCount = await tx.rosterSlot.count({ where: { teamId: params.teamId, slot: { notIn: RESERVE_SLOTS } } })
      if (rosterCount >= team.league.rosterSize) throw new Error("Roster is full. You must select a player to drop.")
    }

    const addPlayer = await tx.player.findUnique({ where: { id: params.playerToAddId }, select: { id: true } })
    if (!addPlayer) throw new Error("Player to add not found")
    const alreadyRostered = await tx.rosterSlot.findFirst({ where: { playerId: params.playerToAddId, team: { leagueId: team.leagueId } }, select: { id: true } })
    if (alreadyRostered) throw new Error("Player is already on a league roster")
    if (params.playerToDropId != null) {
      const dropSlot = await tx.rosterSlot.findUnique({
        where: { teamId_playerId: { teamId: params.teamId, playerId: params.playerToDropId } },
        select: { slot: true },
      })
      if (!dropSlot) throw new Error("Dropped player must be on your roster")
    }
    return tx.waiverClaim.create({
      data: {
        teamId: params.teamId,
        playerToAddId: params.playerToAddId,
        playerToDropId: params.playerToDropId ?? null,
        bidAmount: params.bidAmount,
        processDate: nextWaiverProcessAt(team.league.currentSeason),
      },
      include: { playerToAdd: true, playerToDrop: true },
    })
  })
}

export async function processWaiversForLeague(leagueId: string, now: Date = new Date()) {
  const claims = await prisma.waiverClaim.findMany({
    where: { status: ClaimStatus.PENDING, processDate: { lte: now }, team: { leagueId } },
    include: { team: true, playerToAdd: true, playerToDrop: true },
    orderBy: [{ bidAmount: "desc" }, { team: { waiverPriority: "asc" } }, { processDate: "asc" }],
  })
  const claimedPlayers = new Set<number>()
  let processed = 0
  for (const claim of claims) {
    if (claimedPlayers.has(claim.playerToAddId)) continue
    await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const team = await tx.team.findUnique({ where: { id: claim.teamId }, select: { leagueId: true, faabBalance: true } })
      if (!team || team.leagueId !== leagueId) {
        await tx.waiverClaim.update({ where: { id: claim.id }, data: { status: ClaimStatus.FAILED } })
        return
      }
      if (team.faabBalance < claim.bidAmount) {
        await tx.waiverClaim.update({ where: { id: claim.id }, data: { status: ClaimStatus.FAILED, resolution: WAIVER_RESOLUTIONS.INSUFFICIENT_FAAB } })
        return
      }
      const existingAdd = await tx.rosterSlot.findFirst({ where: { playerId: claim.playerToAddId, team: { leagueId } }, select: { id: true } })
      if (existingAdd) {
        await tx.waiverClaim.update({ where: { id: claim.id }, data: { status: ClaimStatus.FAILED, resolution: WAIVER_RESOLUTIONS.ALREADY_ROSTERED } })
        return
      }
      if (claim.playerToDropId != null) {
        const dropSlot = await tx.rosterSlot.findUnique({ where: { teamId_playerId: { teamId: claim.teamId, playerId: claim.playerToDropId } } })
        if (!dropSlot) {
          await tx.waiverClaim.update({ where: { id: claim.id }, data: { status: ClaimStatus.FAILED, resolution: WAIVER_RESOLUTIONS.DROP_MISSING } })
          return
        }
        await tx.rosterSlot.delete({ where: { id: dropSlot.id } })
        await tx.activityLog.create({ data: { leagueId, teamId: claim.teamId, action: ActivityAction.DROP, details: { playerId: claim.playerToDropId, playerName: claim.playerToDrop?.name ?? null } } })
      } else {
        const rosterCount = await tx.rosterSlot.count({ where: { teamId: claim.teamId, slot: { notIn: RESERVE_SLOTS } } })
        const league = await tx.league.findUnique({ where: { id: leagueId }, select: { rosterSize: true } })
        if (!league || rosterCount >= league.rosterSize) {
          await tx.waiverClaim.update({ where: { id: claim.id }, data: { status: ClaimStatus.FAILED, resolution: WAIVER_RESOLUTIONS.ROSTER_FULL } })
          return
        }
      }
      await tx.team.update({ where: { id: claim.teamId }, data: { faabBalance: { decrement: claim.bidAmount } } })
      await tx.rosterSlot.create({ data: { teamId: claim.teamId, playerId: claim.playerToAddId, slot: SlotType.BN } })
      await tx.activityLog.create({ data: { leagueId, teamId: claim.teamId, action: ActivityAction.ADD, details: { playerId: claim.playerToAddId, playerName: claim.playerToAdd.name, bidAmount: claim.bidAmount, outcome: "Won" } } })
      await tx.waiverClaim.update({ where: { id: claim.id }, data: { status: ClaimStatus.SUCCESSFUL, resolution: WAIVER_RESOLUTIONS.WON } })
      await tx.waiverClaim.updateMany({
        where: { team: { leagueId }, playerToAddId: claim.playerToAddId, status: ClaimStatus.PENDING, processDate: { lte: now }, id: { not: claim.id } },
        data: { status: ClaimStatus.FAILED, resolution: WAIVER_RESOLUTIONS.OUTBID },
      })
      await rotateWaiverPriority(tx, leagueId, claim.teamId)
      claimedPlayers.add(claim.playerToAddId)
      processed += 1
    })
  }
  return processed
}

async function rotateWaiverPriority(tx: TransactionClient, leagueId: string, winnerId: string) {
  const teams = await tx.team.findMany({ where: { leagueId }, orderBy: { waiverPriority: "asc" }, select: { id: true } })
  const ordered = [...teams.filter((team) => team.id !== winnerId), ...teams.filter((team) => team.id === winnerId)]
  for (const [index, team] of ordered.entries()) {
    await tx.team.update({ where: { id: team.id }, data: { waiverPriority: index + 1 } })
  }
}

export interface TradeAssetInput {
  fromTeamId: string
  toTeamId: string
  assetType: AssetType
  playerId?: number
  draftPickId?: string
  faabAmount?: number
}

export async function createTradeOffer(params: {
  leagueId: string
  proposingTeamId: string
  receivingTeamId: string
  assets: TradeAssetInput[]
  expiresAt?: Date
}) {
  if (params.proposingTeamId === params.receivingTeamId) throw new Error("Teams must be different")
  const league = await prisma.league.findUnique({
    where: { id: params.leagueId },
    select: { currentWeek: true, tradeSettings: true },
  })
  if (league) {
    const settings = (league.tradeSettings ?? {}) as { deadlineWeek?: number; allowPickTrading?: boolean }
    if (typeof settings.deadlineWeek === "number" && league.currentWeek > settings.deadlineWeek) {
      throw new Error(`The trade deadline (Week ${settings.deadlineWeek}) has passed`)
    }
    if (settings.allowPickTrading === false && params.assets.some((asset) => asset.assetType === AssetType.PICK)) {
      throw new Error("Draft pick trading is disabled in this league")
    }
  }
  return prisma.tradeOffer.create({
    data: {
      leagueId: params.leagueId,
      proposingTeamId: params.proposingTeamId,
      receivingTeamId: params.receivingTeamId,
      expiresAt: params.expiresAt,
      assets: { create: params.assets.map((asset) => ({ ...asset })) },
    },
    include: { assets: true },
  })
}

export async function executeTrade(tradeOfferId: string) {
  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const offer = await tx.tradeOffer.findUnique({ where: { id: tradeOfferId }, include: { assets: true, league: { select: { currentSeason: true, lineupLockMode: true } } } })
    if (!offer || offer.status !== TradeStatus.PENDING) throw new Error("Trade offer is not pending")
    const lock = await getLockSummary(offer.league.currentSeason, offer.league.lineupLockMode)
    if (lock.mode === "WEEKLY" && lock.weekStarted) await freezeWeekLineup(tx, offer.leagueId, offer.league.currentSeason, lock.week)
    const teams = await tx.team.findMany({ where: { id: { in: [offer.proposingTeamId, offer.receivingTeamId] } }, select: { id: true, faabBalance: true } })
    const balances = new Map(teams.map((team) => [team.id, team.faabBalance]))
    for (const asset of offer.assets) {
      if (![offer.proposingTeamId, offer.receivingTeamId].includes(asset.fromTeamId) || ![offer.proposingTeamId, offer.receivingTeamId].includes(asset.toTeamId) || asset.fromTeamId === asset.toTeamId) {
        throw new Error("Trade assets must transfer between the two teams in the offer")
      }
      if (asset.assetType === AssetType.PLAYER) {
        if (asset.playerId == null || !(await tx.rosterSlot.findUnique({ where: { teamId_playerId: { teamId: asset.fromTeamId, playerId: asset.playerId } } }))) throw new Error("A traded player is no longer on the sending roster")
      } else if (asset.assetType === AssetType.PICK) {
        if (asset.draftPickId == null || !(await tx.draftPick.findFirst({ where: { id: asset.draftPickId, currentTeamId: asset.fromTeamId } }))) throw new Error("A traded pick is no longer owned by the sending team")
      } else {
        const amount = asset.faabAmount ?? 0
        if (amount < 0 || (balances.get(asset.fromTeamId) ?? 0) < amount) throw new Error("Insufficient FAAB for trade")
        balances.set(asset.fromTeamId, (balances.get(asset.fromTeamId) ?? 0) - amount)
        balances.set(asset.toTeamId, (balances.get(asset.toTeamId) ?? 0) + amount)
      }
    }
    for (const asset of offer.assets) {
      if (asset.assetType === AssetType.PLAYER && asset.playerId != null) {
        const destination = await tx.rosterSlot.findUnique({ where: { teamId_playerId: { teamId: asset.fromTeamId, playerId: asset.playerId } } })
        if (!destination) throw new Error("A traded player is no longer available")
        const occupied = await tx.rosterSlot.findUnique({ where: { teamId_playerId: { teamId: asset.toTeamId, playerId: asset.playerId } } })
        if (occupied) throw new Error("Receiving team already owns a traded player")
        await tx.rosterSlot.update({ where: { id: destination.id }, data: { teamId: asset.toTeamId, slot: SlotType.BN, lockedAt: null } })
      }
      if (asset.assetType === AssetType.PICK && asset.draftPickId) await tx.draftPick.update({ where: { id: asset.draftPickId }, data: { currentTeamId: asset.toTeamId } })
    }
    for (const [teamId, balance] of balances) await tx.team.update({ where: { id: teamId }, data: { faabBalance: balance } })
    await tx.tradeOffer.update({ where: { id: tradeOfferId }, data: { status: TradeStatus.PROCESSED } })
    await tx.activityLog.create({ data: { leagueId: offer.leagueId, teamId: offer.proposingTeamId, action: ActivityAction.TRADE, details: { tradeOfferId, assetCount: offer.assets.length } } })
    await tx.activityLog.create({ data: { leagueId: offer.leagueId, teamId: offer.receivingTeamId, action: ActivityAction.TRADE, details: { tradeOfferId, assetCount: offer.assets.length } } })
    return offer
  })
}

const STARTER_ELIGIBILITY: Partial<Record<SlotType, string[]>> = {
  C: ["C"], W: ["LW", "RW"], F: ["C", "LW", "RW"], D: ["D"], G: ["G"],
}

type SlotPlayer = { injuryStatus: PlayerStatus; nhlGamesPlayed: number; position: string }

/** Throws if `player` may not occupy `slot` under the league rules (pure IR, taxi GP cap, position eligibility). */
function assertSlotEligible(player: SlotPlayer, slot: SlotType, taxiMaxGames: number, name: string) {
  if (slot === SlotType.IR && player.injuryStatus !== PlayerStatus.IR) throw new Error(`${name} is not eligible for injured reserve (pure IR only)`)
  if (slot === SlotType.IR_PLUS) throw new Error("IR+ is not enabled in this league")
  if (slot === SlotType.TAXI && player.nhlGamesPlayed >= taxiMaxGames) throw new Error(`${name} is not eligible for the taxi squad`)
  const allowed = STARTER_ELIGIBILITY[slot]
  if (allowed && !allowed.includes(player.position)) throw new Error(`${name} (${player.position}) cannot play ${slot}`)
}

function slotCapacity(league: { rosterPositions: Prisma.JsonValue; taxiSlots: number; irSlots: number }, slot: SlotType) {
  if (slot === SlotType.TAXI) return league.taxiSlots
  if (slot === SlotType.IR) return league.irSlots
  const positions = (league.rosterPositions ?? {}) as Record<string, number>
  if (slot === SlotType.BN) return positions.BN ?? DEFAULT_BENCH_CAPACITY
  return positions[slot] ?? 0
}

/**
 * Moves a player to `targetSlot`. If `targetPlayerId` is given (or the slot is full) the occupant
 * is displaced. They take the vacated slot only when their position can play it; otherwise they move
 * to the bench. A full bench blocks the swap. Every placement is validated for both players.
 */
export async function updateRosterPlacement(teamId: string, playerId: number, targetSlot: SlotType, targetPlayerId?: number, week?: number) {
  return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    const slot = await tx.rosterSlot.findUnique({ where: { teamId_playerId: { teamId, playerId } }, include: { player: true, team: { include: { league: true } } } })
    if (!slot) throw new Error("Player is not on this roster")
    const league = slot.team.league
    const lock = await getLockSummary(league.currentSeason, league.lineupLockMode)
    const selectedWeek = week ?? lock.week
    if (isWeekLineupLocked(lock, selectedWeek)) throw new Error(FUTURE_LINEUP_LOCK_MESSAGE)
    const arrangingFutureWeek = selectedWeek > lock.week
    // An injured (IR-status) starter may always be moved onto IR, even while starters are locked.
    const injuredToIr = slot.player.injuryStatus === "IR" && (targetSlot === SlotType.IR || targetSlot === SlotType.IR_PLUS)
    if (!arrangingFutureWeek && !injuredToIr && (isSlotLocked(lock, slot.slot, slot.player.teamAbbrev) || (lock.mode === "WEEKLY" && isSlotLocked(lock, targetSlot, slot.player.teamAbbrev)))) {
      throw new Error(lock.mode === "WEEKLY" ? "Starting lineups are locked until next week (first game has started)" : "Player's roster slot is locked (their game has started)")
    }
    if (slot.slot === targetSlot) return tx.rosterSlot.findMany({ where: { teamId }, include: { player: true }, orderBy: { slot: "asc" } })
    assertSlotEligible(slot.player, targetSlot, league.taxiMaxGames, slot.player.name)

    const occupants = await tx.rosterSlot.findMany({ where: { teamId, slot: targetSlot, id: { not: slot.id } }, include: { player: true }, orderBy: { id: "asc" } })
    let swapWith = targetPlayerId !== undefined ? await tx.rosterSlot.findUnique({ where: { teamId_playerId: { teamId, playerId: targetPlayerId } }, include: { player: true } }) : null
    if (targetPlayerId !== undefined && (!swapWith || swapWith.slot !== targetSlot)) throw new Error("The player you are swapping with has moved; refresh and try again")
    if (!swapWith && targetSlot !== SlotType.BN && occupants.length >= slotCapacity(league, targetSlot)) swapWith = occupants[0] ?? null

    if (swapWith) {
      if (!arrangingFutureWeek && (isSlotLocked(lock, swapWith.slot, swapWith.player.teamAbbrev) || isSlotLocked(lock, slot.slot, swapWith.player.teamAbbrev))) throw new Error("The target roster slot is locked")
      const benchCount = await tx.rosterSlot.count({ where: { teamId, slot: SlotType.BN, id: { notIn: [slot.id, swapWith.id] } } })
      const landing = displacedLandingSlot(slot.slot, swapWith.player.position, benchCount < slotCapacity(league, SlotType.BN))
      if (!landing) throw new Error(`${swapWith.player.name} (${swapWith.player.position}) cannot play ${slot.slot}, and the bench is full`)
      assertSlotEligible(swapWith.player, landing as SlotType, league.taxiMaxGames, swapWith.player.name)
      await tx.rosterSlot.update({ where: { id: slot.id }, data: { slot: targetSlot } })
      await tx.rosterSlot.update({ where: { id: swapWith.id }, data: { slot: landing as SlotType } })
    } else {
      await tx.rosterSlot.update({ where: { id: slot.id }, data: { slot: targetSlot } })
    }
    return tx.rosterSlot.findMany({ where: { teamId }, include: { player: true }, orderBy: { slot: "asc" } })
  })
}

<file path="lib/auth-session.ts">
import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto"
import { cookies } from "next/headers"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"

export type ManagerSession = {
  managerId: string
  teamId: string
  handle: string
  teamName: string
  isCommissioner: boolean
}

const DEV_SESSION_SECRET = "john-scott-dynasty-default-secret"

function sessionSecret() {
  const secret = process.env.SESSION_SECRET ?? process.env.CRON_SECRET
  if (secret) return secret
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production") {
    throw new Error("SESSION_SECRET or CRON_SECRET must be set in production")
  }
  return DEV_SESSION_SECRET
}

export function verifyCronSecret(provided: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  const secret = process.env.CRON_SECRET
  if (!secret || !provided) return false
  const providedBytes = Buffer.from(provided)
  const secretBytes = Buffer.from(secret)
  if (providedBytes.length !== secretBytes.length) return false
  return timingSafeEqual(providedBytes, secretBytes)
}

export function signManagerSession(payload: ManagerSession): string {
  const encoded = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(payload)).toString("base64url")
  const signature = createHmac("sha256", sessionSecret()).update(encoded).digest("base64url")
  return `${encoded}.${signature}`
}

export function verifyManagerSessionCookie(rawCookie: string): Partial<ManagerSession> | null {
  const separator = rawCookie.indexOf(".")
  if (separator <= 0 || rawCookie.indexOf(".", separator + 1) !== -1) return null
  const encoded = rawCookie.slice(0, separator)
  const signature = rawCookie.slice(separator + 1)
  const expected = createHmac("sha256", sessionSecret()).update(encoded).digest()
  const provided = Buffer.from(signature, "base64url")
  if (provided.length !== expected.length || !timingSafeEqual(provided, expected)) return null
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(encoded, "base64url").toString("utf8"))
    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== "object") return null
    return parsed as Partial<ManagerSession>
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

export async function getManagerSession(): Promise<ManagerSession | null> {
  const value = (await cookies()).get("dynasty_manager")?.value
  if (!value) return null
  try {
    const session = verifyManagerSessionCookie(value)
    if (!session || typeof session.managerId !== "string" || typeof session.teamId !== "string") return null
    const team = await prisma.team.findFirst({
      where: { id: session.teamId, managerId: session.managerId },
      select: { id: true, name: true, manager: { select: { isCommissioner: true, handle: true } } },
    })
    if (!team) return null
    return {
      managerId: session.managerId,
      teamId: team.id,
      handle: team.manager.handle,
      teamName: team.name,
      isCommissioner: team.manager.isCommissioner === true,
    }
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

const starterSlots = ["C", "C", "C", "W", "W", "W", "W", "W", "W", "F", "F", "F", "D", "D", "D", "D", "D", "D", "G", "G"] as const
const badgeColors: Record<string, string> = { C: "bg-blue-500", W: "bg-teal-500", F: "bg-violet-500", D: "bg-amber-500", G: "bg-sky-300 text-slate-900" }

function calculateRosterSummary(team: string, roster: Player[], players: MarketPlayer[], week: number) {
  return getTeamRoster(team, roster, players)
    .filter((player) => isStarterSlot(player.slot))
    .reduce(
      (summary, player) => ({
        score: summary.score + getWeekActualPoints(player, week),
        projected: summary.projected + (getWeekProjectedPoints(player, week) ?? 0),
      }),
      { score: 0, projected: 0 },
    )
}

function getWeeklyRecords(week: number, results: MatchupResult[]) {
    const records = new Map<string, { wins: number; losses: number }>()
    const ensure = (team: string) => {
      if (!records.has(team)) records.set(team, { wins: 0, losses: 0 })
      return records.get(team)!
    }
    for (const matchup of results) {
      if (!matchup.isFinal || matchup.week >= week) continue
      const home = ensure(matchup.homeTeam)
      const away = ensure(matchup.awayTeam)
      if (matchup.homeScore > matchup.awayScore) {
        home.wins += 1
        away.losses += 1
      } else if (matchup.awayScore > matchup.homeScore) {
        away.wins += 1
        home.losses += 1
      }
    }
    return records
}

function recordFor(team: string, records: Map<string, { wins: number; losses: number }>) {
    const record = records.get(team)
    return `${record?.wins ?? 0}-${record?.losses ?? 0}`
}

export function LeagueFeed({
  matchupResults = [],
  week = 1,
  teamName = "Montreal Monarchs",
  teamLogo = "",
  standings = defaultStandings,
  liveMatchups = {},
  activities = defaultActivities,
  roster = defaultRoster,
  players = [],
  isCommissioner = false,
  onWeekChange,
  onSelectMatchup,
  onSelectPlayer,
  onTrade,
  onSettings,
}: FeedProps) {
  const [showStandings, setShowStandings] = useState(false)
  const [showTransactions, setShowTransactions] = useState(false)
  const [showFilters, setShowFilters] = useState(false)
  const [playoffMode, setPlayoffMode] = useState(false)
  const [activityFilter, setActivityFilter] = useState<ActivityFilter>("ALL")
  const filteredActivities = activities.filter((item) => activityFilter === "ALL" || item.action === activityFilter)
  const weekSchedule = getWeekMatchups(week)
  const weeklyRecords = getWeeklyRecords(week, matchupResults)
  const displayMatchups = weekSchedule.map((matchup) => {
    const final = matchupResults.find((result) => result.week === week && result.isFinal && result.homeTeam === matchup.homeTeam && result.awayTeam === matchup.awayTeam)
    if (final) {
      return { ...matchup, homeRecord: recordFor(matchup.homeTeam, weeklyRecords), awayRecord: recordFor(matchup.awayTeam, weeklyRecords), homeScore: final.homeScore, awayScore: final.awayScore, projectedHome: final.homeScore, projectedAway: final.awayScore, status: "Final" }
    }
    const live = liveMatchups[matchup.id]
    const isUserHome = matchup.homeTeam === teamName
    const isUserAway = matchup.awayTeam === teamName
    const displayMatchup = {
      ...matchup,
      homeTeam: isUserHome ? teamName : matchup.homeTeam,
      awayTeam: isUserAway ? teamName : matchup.awayTeam,
    }
    if (live) {
      return {
        ...live,
        homeTeam: isUserHome ? teamName : live.homeTeam,
        awayTeam: isUserAway ? teamName : live.awayTeam,
        homeRecord: recordFor(matchup.homeTeam, weeklyRecords),
        awayRecord: recordFor(matchup.awayTeam, weeklyRecords),
      }
    }
    const home = calculateRosterSummary(matchup.homeTeam, roster, players, week)
    const away = calculateRosterSummary(matchup.awayTeam, roster, players, week)
    return {
      ...displayMatchup,
      homeRecord: recordFor(matchup.homeTeam, weeklyRecords),
      awayRecord: recordFor(matchup.awayTeam, weeklyRecords),
      homeScore: home.score,
      awayScore: away.score,
      projectedHome: home.projected,
      projectedAway: away.projected,
    }
  })
  const liveStandings = standings

  return (
    <section className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col bg-[#070a12] text-white">
      <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain px-3 py-3 space-y-5">
        <DraftCard players={players} isCommissioner={isCommissioner} />
        <WeeklyPodium week={week} matchups={displayMatchups} />

          results={matchupResults ?? []}

          playoffMode={playoffMode}
          onToggle={() => setPlayoffMode((value) => !value)}

          onTrade={onTrade}
        />

/** Home win % from projected totals (which already include points banked so far); 50% when no projection exists. */
function winProbability(matchup: DisplayMatchup) {
  const home = matchup.projectedHome ?? matchup.homeScore
  const away = matchup.projectedAway ?? matchup.awayScore
  if (matchup.status === "Final") return matchup.homeScore === matchup.awayScore ? 50 : matchup.homeScore > matchup.awayScore ? 100 : 0
  if (home + away <= 0) return 50
  const spread = Math.max(10, 0.12 * (home + away))
  return Math.min(95, Math.max(5, Math.round(100 / (1 + Math.exp(-(home - away) / spread)))))
}

function WeeklyPodium({ week, matchups }: { week: number; matchups: DisplayMatchup[] }) {
  const teams = matchups.flatMap((matchup) => [
    { team: matchup.homeTeam, owner: matchup.homeOwner, points: matchup.homeScore > 0 ? matchup.homeScore : matchup.projectedHome ?? 0, projected: !(matchup.homeScore > 0) },
    { team: matchup.awayTeam, owner: matchup.awayOwner, points: matchup.awayScore > 0 ? matchup.awayScore : matchup.projectedAway ?? 0, projected: !(matchup.awayScore > 0) },
  ]).sort((a, b) => b.points - a.points).slice(0, 3).map((team, index) => ({
    ...team,
    place: index + 1,
    color: index === 0 ? "text-amber-300" : index === 1 ? "text-slate-300" : "text-orange-300",
    order: `order-${index + 1}${index === 0 ? " -mt-5" : ""}`,
  }))
  return <section className="rounded-2xl border border-[#16233b] bg-[#0d1424] px-3 pb-3 pt-2">
    <div className="mx-auto w-fit rounded-full border border-[#294463] bg-[#102642] px-3 py-1 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#19ffff]">🏆 Week {week} Report</div>
    <div className="mt-5 flex items-end justify-center gap-2">
      {teams.map((team) => <div key={team.place} className={cn("flex w-1/3 flex-col items-center text-center", team.order)}>
        <div className={cn("mb-1 flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 border-current bg-[#172338] text-xs font-black", team.color)}>#{team.place}</div>
        <div className="flex size-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-[#294463] bg-[#1b2842] text-lg">🏒</div>
        <p className="mt-2 w-full truncate text-xs font-black">{team.team}</p>
        <p className="truncate text-xs text-[#6d86ab]">{team.owner}</p>
        <p className={cn("mt-1 text-sm font-black tabular-nums", team.color)}>{team.points.toFixed(2)}</p>
        {team.projected && <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5e7090]">projected</p>}
      </div>)}
    </div>
  </section>
}

function MatchupsSection({ week, matchups, teamName, teamLogo, onSelect, onWeekChange }: { week: number; matchups: DisplayMatchup[]; teamName: string; teamLogo: string; onSelect: (matchup: MatchupSummary) => void; onWeekChange?: (week: number) => void }) {
  return <section>
    <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between"><h2 className="text-lg font-black">Matchups</h2><SwipeSurface zone="week" onSwipeLeft={() => onWeekChange?.(week + 1)} onSwipeRight={() => onWeekChange?.(Math.max(1, week - 1))} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#19ffff]"><button type="button" onClick={() => onWeekChange?.(Math.max(1, week - 1))} aria-label="Previous league week" className="rounded p-1 hover:bg-[#172338]"><ChevronLeft className="size-4" /></button><span>Week {week}</span><button type="button" onClick={() => onWeekChange?.(week + 1)} aria-label="Next league week" className="rounded p-1 hover:bg-[#172338]"><ChevronRight className="size-4" /></button></SwipeSurface></div>
    <div className="space-y-2">{matchups.map((matchup) => {
      const homeWin = winProbability(matchup)
      const homeResult = matchup.status === "Scheduled" ? undefined : matchup.homeScore === matchup.awayScore ? "TIE" : matchup.homeScore > matchup.awayScore ? matchup.status === "Final" ? "WIN" : "LEAD" : matchup.status === "Final" ? "LOSS" : "TRAIL"
      const awayResult = matchup.status === "Scheduled" ? undefined : matchup.awayScore === matchup.homeScore ? "TIE" : matchup.awayScore > matchup.homeScore ? matchup.status === "Final" ? "WIN" : "LEAD" : matchup.status === "Final" ? "LOSS" : "TRAIL"
      return <button key={matchup.id} type="button" onClick={() => onSelect(matchup)} className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-[#16233b] bg-[#0d1424] p-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-[#111c2e]">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_36px_1fr] items-center gap-2">
          <TeamMatchup team={matchup.homeTeam} logo={matchup.homeTeam === teamName ? teamLogo : undefined} owner={matchup.homeOwner} record={matchup.homeRecord} result={homeResult} score={matchup.homeScore} projected={matchup.projectedHome} win={homeWin} align="left" />
          <div className="flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-[#294463] bg-[#102642] text-xs font-black text-[#8ba0c7]">VS</div>
          <TeamMatchup team={matchup.awayTeam} logo={matchup.awayTeam === teamName ? teamLogo : undefined} owner={matchup.awayOwner} record={matchup.awayRecord} result={awayResult} score={matchup.awayScore} projected={matchup.projectedAway} win={100 - homeWin} align="right" />
        </div>
      </button>
    })}</div>
  </section>
}

function TeamMatchup({ team, logo, owner, record, result, score, projected, win, align }: { team: string; logo?: string; owner: string; record: string; result?: string; score: number; projected?: number; win: number; align: "left" | "right" }) {
  return <div className={cn("min-w-0", align === "right" && "text-right")}><div className={cn("flex items-center gap-2", align === "right" && "flex-row-reverse")}><div className="flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[#172338]">{logo ? <img src={logo} alt="" className="size-full object-cover" /> : "🏒"}</div><p className="truncate text-xs font-black">{team}</p></div><p className="mt-1 truncate text-xs text-[#6d86ab]">{owner} · {record}{result ? ` · ${result}` : ""}</p><span className={cn("mt-1 inline-block rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-black", win >= 50 ? "bg-emerald-400/10 text-emerald-300" : "bg-rose-400/10 text-rose-300")}>{win}% WIN</span><p className="mt-1 text-lg font-black tabular-nums">{score.toFixed(2)}</p><p className="text-xs text-[#5e7090]">{projected === undefined && !result ? "projection unavailable" : `proj. ${(projected ?? score).toFixed(2)}`}</p></div>
}

function StandingsSection({ standings, results, teamName, playoffMode, onToggle, onDetails, onTrade }: { standings: StandingRow[]; results: MatchupResult[]; teamName: string; playoffMode: boolean; onToggle: () => void; onDetails: () => void; onTrade?: (team: StandingRow) => void }) {
  return <section><div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between"><div className="flex items-center gap-2"><h2 className="text-lg font-black">Standings</h2><button type="button" onClick={onDetails} className="text-xs font-bold text-[#19ffff]">Details &gt;</button></div><button type="button" onClick={onToggle} className="rounded-full border border-[#294463] bg-[#102642] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-black text-[#19ffff]">☲ {playoffMode ? "STAND." : "PLAYOFF"}</button></div>{playoffMode ? <PlayoffBracket standings={standings} results={results} /> : <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-[#16233b] bg-[#0d1424]"><div className="grid grid-cols-[32px_1fr_58px_50px_50px] gap-1 border-b border-[#16233b] px-2 py-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5e7090]"><span>Rank</span><span>Name</span><span>Waiver</span><span className="text-right">PF</span><span className="text-right">PA</span></div>{standings.map((row) => <div key={`${row.team}-${row.owner}`} className={cn("grid grid-cols-[32px_1fr_58px_50px_50px] items-center gap-1 border-b border-[#111929] px-2 py-2 last:border-0", row.team === teamName && "border-l-2 border-l-[#19ffff] bg-[#0c2231]")}><div><b className="text-xs">{row.rank}</b><span className={cn("block text-xs font-bold", row.delta?.startsWith("+") ? "text-emerald-300" : "text-rose-300")}>{row.delta ? `${row.delta.startsWith("+") ? "▲" : "▼"} ${row.delta.replace("-", "")}` : "—"}</span></div><button type="button" onClick={() => onTrade?.(row)} className="min-w-0 text-left"><p className="truncate text-xs font-black">{row.team}</p><p className="truncate text-xs text-[#6d86ab]">{row.owner} · {row.wins}-{row.losses}{row.streak && <> · <span className={row.streak.endsWith("W") ? "text-emerald-300" : "text-rose-300"}>{row.streak}</span></>}</p></button><span className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-300">${row.faabRemaining} <span className="text-[#6d86ab]">(6)</span></span><span className="text-right text-xs tabular-nums">{row.pointsFor.toFixed(1)}</span><span className="text-right text-xs tabular-nums">{row.pointsAgainst.toFixed(1)}</span></div>)}</div>}</section>
}

function PlayoffBracket({ standings, results }: { standings: StandingRow[]; results: MatchupResult[] }) {
  const bracket = buildPlayoffBracket({ standings, results, currentWeek: getCurrentFantasyWeek() })
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#16233b] bg-[#0d1424] p-3">
      <p className="text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">{bracket.live ? "Seeds locked from the standings entering week 15. A tie goes to the higher seed." : "Projected from the current standings. Seeds lock when week 15 starts."}</p>
      <div className="mt-3 space-y-4">
        {bracket.rounds.map((round) => (
          <section key={round.title}>
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#5e7090]">{round.title}</h3>
            <div className="mt-2 space-y-2">
              {round.games.map((game) => <BracketGameCard key={game.id} game={game} />)}
            </div>
          </section>
        ))}
      </div>
      <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-[#6d86ab]">Seeds 7–12 keep playing. That consolation bracket is separate from this one.</p>
    </div>
  )
}

function BracketGameCard({ game }: { game: BracketGame }) {
  if (game.status === "Bye") {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-[#294463] bg-[#102642] px-3 py-2">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <p className="min-w-0 truncate text-sm font-bold text-white">{game.home.label}</p>
          <p className="shrink-0 text-xs font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">Bye</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }
  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-[#294463] bg-[#102642] px-3 py-2">
      <BracketSideRow side={game.home} status={game.status} />
      <BracketSideRow side={game.away} status={game.status} />
      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#5e7090]">{game.status === "Final" ? "Final" : game.status === "Live" ? "Live" : "Scheduled"}</p>
    </div>
  )
}

function BracketSideRow({ side, status }: { side: BracketGame["away"]; status: BracketGame["status"] }) {
  if (!side) return null
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-0.5">
      <p className={cn("min-w-0 truncate text-sm font-bold", side.winner ? "text-white" : status === "Final" ? "text-[#5e7090]" : "text-white")}>{side.label}</p>
      <p className={cn("shrink-0 text-sm font-black tabular-nums", side.winner ? "text-[#19ffff]" : "text-[#8ba0c7]")}>{side.points == null ? "" : side.points.toFixed(2)}</p>
    </div>
  )
}

function ActivitySection({ activities, roster, filter, onFilter, onViewAll, onSelectPlayer }: { activities: ActivityItem[]; roster: Player[]; filter: ActivityFilter; onFilter: () => void; onViewAll: () => void; onSelectPlayer?: (player: Player) => void }) {
  return <section><div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between"><h2 className="text-lg font-black">Activity</h2><button type="button" onClick={onViewAll} className="text-xs font-bold text-[#19ffff]">View all</button></div><div className="space-y-2">{activities.map((item) => <ActivityCard key={item.id} item={item} roster={roster} onSelectPlayer={onSelectPlayer} />)}</div><button type="button" onClick={onFilter} className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]"><Filter className="size-3" /> {filter === "ALL" ? "Filter activity" : filter}</button></section>
}

function ActivityCard({ item, roster, onSelectPlayer }: { item: ActivityItem; roster: Player[]; onSelectPlayer?: (player: Player) => void }) {
  const player = roster.find((candidate) => candidate.name === item.player)
  return <div className="rounded-xl border border-[#16233b] bg-[#0d1424] p-3"><div className="flex items-center justify-between"><p className="text-xs font-black">{item.owner}</p><span className={cn("rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-black", item.action === "DROP" ? "bg-rose-400/10 text-rose-300" : item.action === "TRADE" ? "bg-amber-400/10 text-amber-300" : "bg-emerald-400/10 text-emerald-300")}>{item.action === "ADD" ? "FREE AGENCY" : item.action}</span></div><button type="button" disabled={!player} onClick={() => player && onSelectPlayer?.(player)} className="mt-2 flex w-full items-center gap-2 text-left disabled:cursor-default"><span className={cn("flex h-7 min-w-7 items-center justify-center rounded px-1 text-xs font-black text-white", badgeColors[player?.position ?? "D"])}>{player?.position ?? item.detail.split(" ")[0]}</span><PlayerPortrait name={item.player} className="size-7 bg-[#172338]" /><span className="min-w-0 flex-1"><b className="block truncate text-xs">{item.action === "DROP" ? "- " : "+ "}{item.player}</b><small className="text-xs text-[#6d86ab]">{item.detail}</small></span>{item.action === "ADD" && <span className="text-xs font-black text-amber-300">BID $5</span>}</button><p className="mt-2 text-xs text-[#5e7090]">{item.time}</p></div>
}

function MatchupSheet({ week, matchup, roster, players = [], onClose, onSelectPlayer }: { week: number; matchup: MatchupSummary | null; roster: Player[]; players?: MarketPlayer[]; onClose: () => void; onSelectPlayer?: (player: Player) => void }) {
  const open = Boolean(matchup)
  if (!open) return null
  const home = matchup ? getTeamRoster(matchup.homeTeam, roster, players) : []
  const away = matchup ? getTeamRoster(matchup.awayTeam, roster, players) : []
  return <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={(value) => !value && onClose()}><SheetContent side="bottom" className="mx-auto h-[92vh] max-h-[92vh] w-full max-w-[430px] gap-0 overflow-hidden rounded-t-3xl border-[#1a263d] bg-[#070a12] p-0 text-white"><div className="shrink-0 border-b border-[#1a263d] p-4"><div className="flex items-center justify-between"><h2 className="text-lg font-black">Week {week} Matchup</h2><button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="rounded-full bg-[#172338] p-2"><X className="size-4" /></button></div>{matchup && <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-3 items-center text-center"><div><p className="truncate text-xs font-black">{matchup.homeTeam}</p><b className="text-xl">{matchup.homeScore.toFixed(2)}</b><p className="text-xs text-emerald-300">{winProbability(matchup as DisplayMatchup)}% WIN</p></div><span className="text-xs font-black text-[#5e7090]">VS</span><div><p className="truncate text-xs font-black">{matchup.awayTeam}</p><b className="text-xl">{matchup.awayScore.toFixed(2)}</b><p className="text-xs text-emerald-300">{100 - winProbability(matchup as DisplayMatchup)}% WIN</p></div></div>}</div>{matchup && <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain p-3"><p className="mb-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#5e7090]">Starter comparison · 20 slots</p>{starterSlots.map((slot, index) => { const left = home.filter((player) => player.slot === slot)[index % Math.max(home.filter((player) => player.slot === slot).length, 1)]; const right = away.filter((player) => player.slot === slot)[index % Math.max(away.filter((player) => player.slot === slot).length, 1)]; return <div key={`${slot}-${index}`} className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_32px_1fr] items-center gap-2 border-b border-[#111929] py-2"><button type="button" disabled={!left} onClick={() => left && onSelectPlayer?.(left)} className="min-w-0 text-left disabled:opacity-50"><b className="block truncate text-xs">{left?.name ?? "Empty slot"}</b><span className="text-xs text-[#6d86ab]">{left ? `${slot} · ${(left.todayPts ?? left.projPts).toFixed(1)} FPTS` : slot}</span></button><span className={cn("mx-auto flex size-5 items-center justify-center rounded text-xs font-black text-white", badgeColors[slot])}>{slot}</span><button type="button" disabled={!right} onClick={() => right && onSelectPlayer?.(right)} className="min-w-0 text-right disabled:opacity-50"><b className="block truncate text-xs">{right?.name ?? "Empty slot"}</b><span className="text-xs text-[#6d86ab]">{right ? `${slot} · ${(right.todayPts ?? right.projPts).toFixed(1)} FPTS` : slot}</span></button></div> })}</div>}</SheetContent></Sheet>
}

function StandingsSheet({ open, standings, onClose }: { open: boolean; standings: StandingRow[]; onClose: () => void }) {
  if (!open) return null
  return <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={(value) => !value && onClose()}><SheetContent side="bottom" className="mx-auto h-[88vh] max-h-[88vh] w-full max-w-[430px] gap-0 overflow-hidden rounded-t-3xl border-[#1a263d] bg-[#070a12] p-0 text-white"><div className="shrink-0 border-b border-[#1a263d] p-4"><div className="flex items-center justify-between"><h2 className="text-lg font-black">Standings</h2><button type="button" onClick={onClose}><X className="size-5" /></button></div><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#6d86ab]">Extended league details</p></div><div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3">{standings.map((row) => <div key={`${row.team}-${row.owner}`} className="grid grid-cols-[28px_1fr_60px_60px] gap-2 border-b border-[#111929] py-3"><b>{row.rank}</b><div><p className="text-xs font-black">{row.team}</p><p className="text-xs text-[#6d86ab]">{row.owner} · {row.wins}-{row.losses}</p></div><span className="text-right text-xs tabular-nums">PF<br />{row.pointsFor.toFixed(1)}<br /><span className="text-[#6d86ab]">MAX {Math.ceil(row.pointsFor * 1.08)}</span></span><span className="text-right text-xs tabular-nums">PA<br />{row.pointsAgainst.toFixed(1)}<br /><span className="text-amber-300">${row.faabRemaining}</span></span></div>)}</div></SheetContent></Sheet>
}

function TransactionsSheet({ open, activities, filter, onFilter, onClose, roster, onSelectPlayer }: { open: boolean; activities: ActivityItem[]; filter: ActivityFilter; onFilter: () => void; onClose: () => void; roster: Player[]; onSelectPlayer?: (player: Player) => void }) {
  if (!open) return null
  return <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={(value) => !value && onClose()}><SheetContent side="bottom" className="mx-auto h-[88vh] max-h-[88vh] w-full max-w-[430px] gap-0 overflow-hidden rounded-t-3xl border-[#1a263d] bg-[#070a12] p-0 text-white"><div className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between border-b border-[#1a263d] p-4"><h2 className="text-lg font-black">League transactions</h2><div className="flex items-center gap-3"><button type="button" onClick={onFilter} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-black text-[#19ffff]"><SlidersHorizontal className="size-3" /> FILTER</button><button type="button" onClick={onClose}><X className="size-5" /></button></div></div><div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 p-3">{activities.map((item) => <ActivityCard key={item.id} item={item} roster={roster} onSelectPlayer={onSelectPlayer} />)}{activities.length === 0 && <p className="p-5 text-center text-sm text-[#6d86ab]">No transactions match this filter.</p>}</div><div className="shrink-0 border-t border-[#1a263d] p-3 text-xs text-[#6d86ab]">{filter === "ALL" ? "All transaction types" : filter}</div></SheetContent></Sheet>
}

function FilterSheet({ open, filter, onChange, managers, onClose }: { open: boolean; filter: ActivityFilter; onChange: (filter: ActivityFilter) => void; managers: StandingRow[]; onClose: () => void }) {
  if (!open) return null
  return <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={(value) => !value && onClose()}><SheetContent side="bottom" className="mx-auto max-h-[88vh] w-full max-w-[430px] gap-0 rounded-t-3xl border-[#1a263d] bg-[#070a12] p-0 text-white"><div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#1a263d] p-4"><h2 className="text-lg font-black">Filter transactions</h2><button type="button" onClick={onClose}><X className="size-5" /></button></div><div className="space-y-4 p-4"><div><p className="mb-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#5e7090]">Transaction type</p><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">{(["ALL", "TRADE", "ADD", "DROP"] as ActivityFilter[]).map((option) => <button key={option} type="button" onClick={() => { onChange(option); onClose() }} className={cn("rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold", filter === option ? "border-[#19ffff] bg-[#0c2231] text-[#19ffff]" : "border-[#16233b] bg-[#0d1424] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>{option === "ALL" ? "All Types" : option === "ADD" ? "Free Agents" : option === "DROP" ? "Waivers" : "Trades"}</button>)}</div></div><div><p className="mb-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#5e7090]">Managers</p><div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">{managers.map((manager) => <label key={`${manager.team}-${manager.owner}`} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-[#16233b] bg-[#0d1424] p-2 text-xs"><input type="checkbox" defaultChecked className="accent-cyan-400" />{manager.owner}</label>)}</div></div></div></SheetContent></Sheet>
}

import { X } from "lucide-react"
import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { getScheduleForTeam, type ActivityItem, type Player, type WaiverClaim } from "@/lib/hockey-data"
import { TransactionsDrawer } from "@/components/hockey/transactions-drawer"
import { Sheet, SheetContent } from "@/components/ui/sheet"
import type { TeamAction } from "@/components/hockey/team-header"
import { LeagueSettingsPanel } from "@/components/hockey/league-settings-panel"

export function getOrdinal(n: number) {
  const s = ["th", "st", "nd", "rd"]
  const v = n % 100
  return n + (s[(v - 20) % 10] || s[v] || s[0])
}

export function TeamDrawer({
  type,
  roster,
  playerNicknames,
  setNickname,
  teamName,
  setTeamName,
  teamLogo,
  setTeamLogo,
  managerHandle,
  isCommissioner,
  rank,
  faab,
  waiverPriority,
  pendingClaims,
  teamId,
  activities,
  onCancelClaim,
  onSaveSettings,
  onClose,
}: {
  type: Exclude<TeamAction, "trade"> | null
  roster: Player[]
  playerNicknames: Record<string, string>
  setNickname: (id: string, value: string) => void
  teamName: string
  setTeamName: (value: string) => void
  teamLogo: string
  setTeamLogo: (value: string) => void
  managerHandle?: string
  isCommissioner?: boolean
  rank?: number
  faab?: number
  waiverPriority?: number
  pendingClaims: WaiverClaim[]
  teamId?: string
  activities: ActivityItem[]
  onCancelClaim: (claim: WaiverClaim) => void
  onSaveSettings: () => void
  onClose: () => void
}) {
  const [news, setNews] = useState<Array<{ id: string; headline: string; description: string; published: string | null; url: string | null }>>([])
  useEffect(() => {
    if (type !== "news") return
    fetch("/api/news", { cache: "no-store" }).then((response) => response.json()).then((data: { articles?: typeof news }) => setNews(data.articles ?? [])).catch((error) => console.error("Failed to load ESPN news:", error))
  }, [type])
  const title = type === "schedule" ? "Schedule" : type === "team-settings" ? "Team Settings" : type === "settings" ? "League Settings" : "Player News"
  return (
    <>
    <TransactionsDrawer open={type === "transactions"} teamId={teamId} claims={pendingClaims} activities={activities} onOpenChange={(open) => !open && onClose()} onCancel={onCancelClaim} />
    {type && type !== "transactions" && <Sheet open onOpenChange={(open) => !open && onClose()}>
      <SheetContent side="bottom" spring="gentle" className="mx-auto max-h-[82vh] max-w-[430px] overflow-y-auto rounded-t-2xl border-t border-[#1a263d] bg-[#0d1424] p-0 text-white">
        <div className="mx-auto mt-2 h-1 w-10 rounded-full bg-[#5e7090]" />
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#172338] px-4 pb-3 pt-2"><h2 className="text-lg font-black">{title}</h2><button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close drawer" className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#8ba0c7] hover:bg-[#172338]"><X className="size-5" /></button></div>
        {type === "schedule" && <div className="divide-y divide-[#172338]">{getScheduleForTeam(teamName).map((row) => <div key={row.week} className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3"><span className={cn("rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-black", row.week === 8 ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>Wk {row.week}</span><div className="min-w-0 flex-1"><p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-white">{teamName} <span className="text-[#5e7090]">vs</span> {row.opponent}</p><p className="text-xs text-[#5e7090]">{row.opponentOwner}</p></div><div className="text-right">{row.result === "SCHEDULED" ? <span className="text-xs text-[#5e7090]">TBD</span> : <><p className="text-xs tabular-nums text-white">{row.score}</p><span className={cn("text-xs font-black", row.result === "WIN" ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-[#ff2a85]")}>{row.result}</span></>}</div></div>)}</div>}
        {type === "team-settings" && <div className="space-y-4 p-4"><div className="rounded-lg border border-[#172338] bg-[#141e33] p-3"><p className="text-xs font-black uppercase text-[#5e7090]">My Team</p><input value={teamName} onChange={(event) => setTeamName(event.target.value)} className="mt-2 w-full rounded-md border border-[#263858] bg-[#0d1424] px-3 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white outline-none focus:border-[#19ffff]" /><input value={teamLogo} onChange={(event) => setTeamLogo(event.target.value)} placeholder="Team logo URL (optional)" className="mt-2 w-full rounded-md border border-[#263858] bg-[#0d1424] px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white outline-none focus:border-[#19ffff]" /><button type="button" onClick={onSaveSettings} className="mt-3 w-full rounded-full bg-[#19ffff] py-2 text-xs font-black text-[#080c14]">Save Team Settings</button></div><div><p className="mb-2 text-sm font-black text-white">Player Nicknames</p><div className="space-y-2">{roster.map((player) => <label key={player.id} className="block rounded-lg border border-[#172338] bg-[#111c30] p-2.5"><span className="block text-xs font-bold text-white">{player.name}</span><input value={playerNicknames[player.id] ?? ""} onChange={(event) => setNickname(player.id, event.target.value)} placeholder="Enter nickname" className="mt-1 w-full bg-transparent text-xs text-[#8ba0c7] outline-none placeholder:text-[#5e7090]" /></label>)}</div></div></div>}
        {type === "settings" && <LeagueSettingsPanel managerHandle={managerHandle} isCommissioner={isCommissioner} teamName={teamName} rank={rank ?? 0} faab={faab} waiverPriority={waiverPriority} />}
        {type === "news" && <div className="space-y-2 p-4">{news.map((item) => <article key={item.id} className="rounded-lg border border-[#172338] bg-[#111c30] p-3"><p className="text-xs font-black uppercase text-[#5e7090]">ESPN NHL News</p><h3 className="mt-1 text-xs font-bold text-[#19ffff]">{item.headline}</h3><p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[#8ba0c7]">{item.description}</p>{item.url && <a href={item.url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="mt-2 inline-block text-xs font-black text-white underline">Read on ESPN</a>}</article>)}</div>}
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>}
    </>
  )
}

"use client"

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

function preloadPortraits(urls: string[]) {
  const load = () => {
    urls.forEach((url) => {
      const image = new window.Image()
      image.decoding = "async"
      image.src = url
    })
  }
  if ("requestIdleCallback" in window) {
    window.requestIdleCallback(load, { timeout: 1500 })
  } else {
    setTimeout(load, 250)
  }
}

  }, [])

  // Every player rostered by any of the 12 canonical teams; used to keep them out of the Free Agent list.
  const allLeagueRosterIds = useMemo(() => {

        ids.add(normalizeSearchText(player.name))

    return ids

  const loadActivities = useCallback(async () => {

    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Activity request failed with status ${response.status}`)
    const data = await response.json() as { activities?: ActivityItem[] }
    setActivities(data.activities ?? [])

  useEffect(() => {
