  const loadTradeOffers = useCallback(async () => {
    const leagueId = initialData.leagueId
    if (!leagueId || !initialData.teamId) return
    const response = await fetch(`/api/trades?leagueId=${encodeURIComponent(leagueId)}`, { cache: "no-store" })
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Trade offers request failed with status ${response.status}`)
    type TradeApiPlayer = { id: number; name: string; position: "C" | "LW" | "RW" | "D" | "G"; teamAbbrev: string; injuryStatus: PlayerStatus; headshotUrl: string | null; nhlGamesPlayed: number }
    type TradeApiAsset = {
      fromTeamId: string
      toTeamId: string
      assetType: "PLAYER" | "PICK" | "FAAB"
      player: TradeApiPlayer | null
      draftPick: { id: string; season: number; round: number } | null
      faabAmount: number | null
    }
    type TradeApiOffer = {
      id: string
      status: "PENDING" | "ACCEPTED" | "PROCESSED" | "REJECTED" | "CANCELLED"
      createdAt: string
      proposingTeamId: string
      receivingTeamId: string
      proposingTeam: { name: string; manager: { name: string; handle: string } }
      receivingTeam: { name: string; manager: { name: string; handle: string } }
      assets: TradeApiAsset[]
    }
    const data = await response.json() as { offers?: TradeApiOffer[]; picks?: Array<{ id: string; season: number; round: number; currentTeamId: string }>; teams?: Array<{ id: string; name: string }> }
    setLeagueDraftPicks(data.picks ?? [])
    setLeagueTeams(data.teams ?? [])
    const playerForAsset = (player: TradeApiPlayer | null, fromTeamId: string): Player | null => {
      if (!player) return null
      const existingRosterPlayer = rosterRef.current.find((candidate) => candidate.nhlId === player.id || candidate.name === player.name)
      if (existingRosterPlayer) return existingRosterPlayer
      const existingMarketPlayer = allDynastyPlayersRef.current.find((candidate) => candidate.nhlId === player.id || candidate.name === player.name)
      return existingMarketPlayer ? {
        ...existingMarketPlayer,
        id: `nhl-${player.id}`,
        nhlId: player.id,
        slot: "BN" as const,
        opponent: "—",
        gameTime: "—",
        status: player.injuryStatus ?? null,
        todayPts: null,
        projPts: existingMarketPlayer.projection,
      } : {
        id: `nhl-${player.id}`,
        nhlId: player.id,
        name: player.name,
        position: player.position,
        slot: "BN",
        team: player.teamAbbrev,
        opponent: "—",
        gameTime: "—",
        status: player.injuryStatus ?? null,
        todayPts: null,
        projPts: 0,
      }
    }
    const mapAssets = (assets: TradeApiAsset[]) => ({
      players: assets.filter((asset) => asset.assetType === "PLAYER").map((asset) => playerForAsset(asset.player, asset.fromTeamId)).filter((player): player is Player => player !== null),
      picks: assets.filter((asset) => asset.assetType === "PICK" && asset.draftPick).map((asset) => `${asset.draftPick!.season} ${getOrdinal(asset.draftPick!.round)} Round`),
      faab: assets.filter((asset) => asset.assetType === "FAAB").reduce((sum, asset) => sum + (asset.faabAmount ?? 0), 0),
    })
    setTradeOffers((data.offers ?? []).map((offer) => {
      const isIncoming = offer.receivingTeamId === initialData.teamId
      const incomingAssets = mapAssets(offer.assets.filter((asset) => asset.fromTeamId !== initialData.teamId))
      const outgoingAssets = mapAssets(offer.assets.filter((asset) => asset.fromTeamId === initialData.teamId))
      return {
        id: offer.id,
        senderName: offer.proposingTeam.manager.name,
        senderTeam: offer.proposingTeam.name,
        receiverName: offer.receivingTeam.manager.name,
        receiverTeam: offer.receivingTeam.name,
        sendingAssets: isIncoming ? incomingAssets : outgoingAssets,
        receivingAssets: isIncoming ? outgoingAssets : incomingAssets,
        status: offer.status === "PENDING" ? "ACTIVE" : offer.status === "PROCESSED" ? "ACCEPTED" : offer.status === "REJECTED" ? "REJECTED" : "ACCEPTED",
        timestamp: new Date(offer.createdAt).toLocaleString(),
        isIncoming,
      }
    }))
  }, [initialData.leagueId, initialData.teamId])

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadTradeOffers().catch((error: unknown) => console.error("Failed to load trade offers:", error))
  }, [loadTradeOffers])

  async function saveTeamSettings() {
    if (!initialData.teamId) {
      setToast("Team settings are unavailable until your team is connected to the database.")
      window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000)
      return
    }
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/teams/settings", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ teamId: initialData.teamId, name: teamName, logoUrl: teamLogo }),
      })
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Team settings request failed with status ${response.status}`)
      const updated = await response.json() as { name: string; logoUrl: string | null }
      setTeamName(updated.name)
      setTeamLogo(updated.logoUrl ?? "")
      setToast("Team settings saved.")
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      console.error("Failed to save team settings", error)
      setToast("Could not save team settings.")
    }
    window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000)
  }

  function handleRosterMove(playerId: string, destSlot: Player["slot"], targetPlayerId?: string) {
    const visibleRoster = lineupRef.current.length ? lineupRef.current : roster
    const source = visibleRoster.find((player) => player.id === playerId) ?? roster.find((player) => player.id === playerId)
    const target = targetPlayerId ? visibleRoster.find((player) => player.id === targetPlayerId) ?? roster.find((player) => player.id === targetPlayerId) : undefined
    if (!source) return
    if (weekView?.frozen) {
      setToast("This week's lineup is locked. Switch to a later week to slot players from a trade.")
      window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000)
      return
    }
    const benchCount = visibleRoster.filter((player) => player.slot === "BN" && player.id !== source.id && player.id !== target?.id).length
    const targetLanding = target ? displacedLandingSlot(source.slot, target.position, benchCount < benchCapacity) : null
    if (target && !targetLanding) {
      setToast(`${target.name} (${target.position}) cannot play ${source.slot}, and the bench is full`)
      window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000)
      return
    }
    const sourceNext = target ? target.slot : destSlot
    const previousRoster = roster
    const previousWeekView = weekView
    // Optimistic update; rolled back below if the server rejects the move.
    const sourceNhl = Number(source.nhlId)
    const targetNhl = target?.nhlId ? Number(target.nhlId) : undefined
    setRoster((current) => current.map((player) => {
      if (target && targetLanding && player.id === target.id) return { ...player, slot: targetLanding as Player["slot"] }
      if (player.id === source.id) return { ...player, slot: sourceNext }
      return player
    }))
    setWeekView((current) => {
      if (!current || current.frozen) return current
      return {
        ...current,
        assignments: current.assignments.map((entry) => {
          if (entry.teamName !== teamName) return entry
          if (targetNhl !== undefined && targetLanding && entry.nhlId === targetNhl) return { ...entry, slot: targetLanding }
          if (entry.nhlId === sourceNhl) return { ...entry, slot: sourceNext }
          return entry
        }),
      }
    })
    const slotLabel = (slot: string) => slot === "BN" ? "the bench" : slot === "IR" ? "IR" : slot === "TAXI" ? "the taxi squad" : `Starting ${slot}`
    const message = target
      ? targetLanding === source.slot
        ? `Swapped ${source.name} with ${target.name}`
        : `${source.name} moved to ${slotLabel(sourceNext)}. ${target.name} moved to ${slotLabel(targetLanding ?? "BN")}`
      : `${source.name} moved to ${slotLabel(destSlot)}`
    setToast(message)
    if (initialData.teamId) {
      const playerNumId = Number(playerId.replace("nhl-", ""))
      const targetNumId = target ? Number(target.id.replace("nhl-", "")) : undefined
      void fetch("/api/roster/move", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ teamId: initialData.teamId, playerId: playerNumId, targetSlot: target ? target.slot : destSlot, week, ...(targetNumId && Number.isInteger(targetNumId) ? { targetPlayerId: targetNumId } : {}) }),
      }).then(async (response) => {
        if (response.ok) return
        const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({})) as { error?: string }
        throw new Error(data.error ?? `Move failed (${response.status})`)
      }).catch((error: unknown) => {
        console.error("Roster move failed to persist:", error)
        setRoster(previousRoster)
        setWeekView(previousWeekView)
        setToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Roster move failed")
        window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000)
      })
    }
    window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000)
  }
  function submitClaim(claim: WaiverClaim) {
    setPendingClaims((current) => [...current, claim])
    setUserFaab((current) => current - claim.bidAmount)
    setToast(`${claim.playerToAdd.name} has been added to your waivers`)
    window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000)
  }

  function cancelClaim(claim: WaiverClaim) {
    setPendingClaims((current) => current.filter((item) => item.id !== claim.id))
    setUserFaab((current) => current + claim.bidAmount)
  }

  function toggleTradeBlock(player: PlayerDialogTarget) {
    if (!player.playerId) return
    const existing = tradeBlock.find((entry) => entry.playerId === player.playerId)
    if (existing) {
      setTradeBlock((current) => current.filter((entry) => entry.playerId !== player.playerId))
      setToast(`${player.name} removed from your trade block`)
    } else {
      setTradeBlock((current) => [...current, { playerId: player.playerId!, teamName: teamName, note: "Looking for: Top 4 D or 2027 1st" }])
      setToast(`${player.name} added to your trade block`)
    }

    window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000)
  }

  function handleInitiateTradeWithPlayer(player: PlayerDialogTarget) {
    const partner = tradePartners.find((candidate) =>
      candidate.players.some((candidatePlayer) => candidatePlayer.id === player.playerId) ||
      candidate.name === player.ownerName ||
      candidate.players.some((candidatePlayer) => candidatePlayer.team === player.team),
    )
    if (!partner || !player.playerId) return
    setSelectedPlayer(null)
    setCounterTrade(null)
    setPrefilledTrade({ partnerId: partner.id, offering: [], receiving: [player.playerId] })
    setTradeBuilderOpen(true)
  }

  function handleLeagueTrade(team: (typeof standings)[number]) {
    const partner = tradePartners.find((candidate) => candidate.name === team.team)
    if (!partner) {
      setToast(`${team.team} is not available for trading right now`)
      window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000)
      return
    }
    setCounterTrade(null)
    setPrefilledTrade({ partnerId: partner.id, offering: [], receiving: [] })
    setTradeBuilderOpen(true)
  }

  function handleLeaguePlayer(player: Player) {
    selectCanonicalPlayer(player)
  }

    async function handleAcceptTrade(tradeId: string) {
      const offer = tradeOffers.find((trade) => trade.id === tradeId)
      if (!offer) return
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/trades", {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ tradeOfferId: tradeId, action: "ACCEPT" }),
        })
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Trade acceptance failed with status ${response.status}`)
        const added = offer.sendingAssets.players[0]?.name ?? "Players"
        await loadActivities()
        setToast(`Trade accepted! ${added} added to your roster.`)
        window.location.reload()
      } catch (error: unknown) {
        console.error("Failed to accept trade:", error)
        setToast("Could not accept trade.")
        window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000)
      }
    }

    async function handleDeclineTrade(tradeId: string) {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/trades", {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ tradeOfferId: tradeId, action: "REJECT" }),
        })
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Trade rejection failed with status ${response.status}`)
        await Promise.all([loadTradeOffers(), loadActivities()])
        setToast("Trade offer declined.")
        window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000)
      } catch (error: unknown) {
        console.error("Failed to decline trade:", error)
        setToast("Could not decline trade.")
        window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000)
      }
    }

    function handleCounterTrade(offer: LeagueTradeOffer) {
      const partner = tradePartners.find((candidate) => candidate.name === (offer.isIncoming ? offer.senderTeam : offer.receiverTeam))
      if (!partner) return
      setCounterTrade({
        offer,
        partnerId: partner.id,
        offering: offer.receivingAssets.players.map((player) => player.id),
        receiving: offer.sendingAssets.players.map((player) => player.id),
      })
      setTradeBuilderOpen(true)
    }

    async function handleSendTrade(trade: TradeProposal) {
      if (!initialData.teamId) return
      const toAsset = (asset: TradeAsset, fromTeamId: string, toTeamId: string) => ({
        fromTeamId,
        toTeamId,
        assetType: asset.kind === "player" ? "PLAYER" as const : "PICK" as const,
        ...(asset.kind === "player"
          ? { playerId: Number(asset.player.nhlId ?? asset.player.id.replace("nhl-", "")) }
          : { draftPickId: asset.pick.id }),
      })
      const assets = [
        ...trade.offering.map((asset) => toAsset(asset, initialData.teamId!, trade.to.id)),
        ...trade.receiving.map((asset) => toAsset(asset, trade.to.id, initialData.teamId!)),
        ...(trade.faabFrom && trade.faabFrom > 0 ? [{ fromTeamId: initialData.teamId!, toTeamId: trade.to.id, assetType: "FAAB" as const, faabAmount: trade.faabFrom }] : []),
        ...(trade.faabTo && trade.faabTo > 0 ? [{ fromTeamId: trade.to.id, toTeamId: initialData.teamId!, assetType: "FAAB" as const, faabAmount: trade.faabTo }] : []),
      ]
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/trades", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ leagueId: initialData.leagueId ?? "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", proposingTeamId: initialData.teamId, receivingTeamId: trade.to.id, assets }),
        })
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Trade proposal failed with status ${response.status}`)
        await Promise.all([loadTradeOffers(), loadActivities()])
        setCounterTrade(null)
        setTradeBuilderOpen(false)
        setToast(`Trade proposal sent to ${trade.to.name}`)
        window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000)
      } catch (error: unknown) {
        console.error("Failed to send trade:", error)
        setToast("Could not send trade proposal.")
        window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000)
      }
    }

  const formatPickLabel = (pick: string) => {
    const match = pick.match(/^(\d{4})\s+(\d+)(?:st|nd|rd|th)?(?:\s+Rd)?$/)
    return match ? `${match[1]} ${getOrdinal(Number(match[2]))} Round` : pick
  }
  const userTradeTeam: TradeTeam = { id: initialData.teamId ?? "team", name: teamName, abbreviation: teamName.slice(0, 3).toUpperCase(), players: roster, faabAvailable: userFaab, draftPicks: initialData.draftPickAssets ?? draftPicks.map((pick, index) => ({ id: `pick-${index}`, label: `${formatPickLabel(pick)} (${teamName.slice(0, 3).toUpperCase()})`, detail: "Future dynasty pick" })) }
  // Pass the full player database so partner players resolve to real `nhl-<id>` identifiers for trade proposals.
  const tradePartners: TradeTeam[] = useMemo(() => leagueTeams.filter((team) => team.id !== initialData.teamId).map((team) => ({
    id: team.id,
    name: team.name,
    abbreviation: team.name.slice(0, 3).toUpperCase(),
    players: getTeamRoster(team.name, roster, allDynastyPlayers),
    faabAvailable: team.faabBalance ?? standings.find((row) => row.team === team.name)?.faabRemaining ?? 100,
    draftPicks: leagueDraftPicks.filter((pick) => pick.currentTeamId === team.id).map((pick) => ({ id: pick.id, label: `${pick.season} ${getOrdinal(pick.round)} Round (${team.name.slice(0, 3).toUpperCase()})`, detail: "Rookie pick" })),
  })), [allDynastyPlayers, initialData.teamId, leagueDraftPicks, leagueTeams, roster, standings])

  const lineupRef = useRef(roster)
  const lineupRoster = useMemo(
    () => applyWeekLineup(teamName, roster, allDynastyPlayers, weekView?.assignments ?? null, weekView != null),
    [allDynastyPlayers, roster, teamName, weekView],
  )
  lineupRef.current = lineupRoster
  const { rosterForDisplay, startersCount, bench, taxi, ir, orderedStarters } = useMemo(() => {
    const playersByNhlId = new Map(allDynastyPlayers.map((player) => [Number(player.nhlId), player]))
    const playersByName = new Map(allDynastyPlayers.map((player) => [normalizeSearchText(player.name), player]))
    const display = lineupRoster.map((player) => {
      const databasePlayer = (player.nhlId ? playersByNhlId.get(Number(player.nhlId)) : undefined) ?? playersByName.get(normalizeSearchText(player.name))
      return databasePlayer ? {
        ...player,
        nhlGamesPlayed: databasePlayer.nhlGamesPlayed,
        gamesPlayed: databasePlayer.nhlGamesPlayed,
        status: databasePlayer.injuryStatus ?? null,
      } : player
    })
    return {
      rosterForDisplay: display,
      startersCount: display.filter((p) => isStarterSlot(p.slot)).length,
      bench: display.filter((p) => p.slot === "BN"),
      taxi: display.filter((p) => p.slot === "TAXI"),
      ir: display.filter((p) => p.slot === "IR"),
      orderedStarters: startingSlots.flatMap((group) => {
        const players = display.filter((p) => p.slot === group.slot)
        const emptyCount = Math.max(0, group.capacity - players.length)
        return [
          ...players.map((p) => ({ player: p as Player | null, slot: group.slot })),
          ...Array.from({ length: emptyCount }, () => ({ player: null as Player | null, slot: group.slot })),
        ]
      }),
    }
  }, [allDynastyPlayers, lineupRoster, startingSlots])

  // Stable handler identities for memoized children (PlayerItem, PlayersMarketView, MatchupPanel).
  const onEditRosterSlot = useStableCallback((player: Player | null, fallbackSlot: string) => {
    setEditingPlayer(player)
    setEditingSlot(player || !isStarterSlot(fallbackSlot) ? null : fallbackSlot)
  })
  const onMoveStable = useStableCallback((playerId: string, destSlot: Player["slot"], targetPlayerId?: string) => handleRosterMove(playerId, destSlot, targetPlayerId))
  const onAcceptTradeStable = useStableCallback((tradeId: string) => handleAcceptTrade(tradeId))
  const onDeclineTradeStable = useStableCallback((tradeId: string) => handleDeclineTrade(tradeId))
  const onCounterTradeStable = useStableCallback((offer: LeagueTradeOffer) => handleCounterTrade(offer))
  const onInitiateTradeStable = useStableCallback((player: PlayerDialogTarget) => handleInitiateTradeWithPlayer(player))
  const onOpenTradeBuilderStable = useStableCallback(() => { setCounterTrade(null); setPrefilledTrade(null); setTradeBuilderOpen(true) })
  const mainTabs: MainTab[] = ["MATCH", "TEAM", "PLAYERS", "LEAGUE"]
  const activeTabIndex = mainTabs.indexOf(activeTab)
  const tabProgress = useMotionValue(activeTabIndex)
  const underlineX = useTransform(tabProgress, (value) => `${value * 100}%`)
  const shiftWeek = (step: number) => setWeek((current) => Math.max(1, current + step))
  const renderRosterRow = (player: Player) => (
    <PlayerItem key={player.id} player={player} fallbackSlot={player.slot} onEdit={onEditRosterSlot} onSelect={selectCanonicalPlayer} nickname={playerNicknames[player.id]} />
  )

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen justify-center bg-black font-sans antialiased">
      <main className="relative flex min-h-0 h-dvh w-full max-w-[430px] flex-col overflow-hidden border-x border-[#121927] bg-[#070a12] shadow-2xl">
        
        {/* Sleeper League Header */}
        <header className="flex items-center justify-between bg-[#070a12] px-3.5 pt-3 pb-2">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setDmOpen(true)} aria-label="Open direct messages" className="relative rounded-full p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-[#172338] hover:text-white"><MessageSquare className="size-5" />{hasUnreadMessages && <span className="absolute -right-1 -top-1 flex size-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#f43f5e] text-xs font-black text-white">!</span>}</button>
            <div className="flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-[#22314d] bg-[#162033] text-xs">🏒</div>
            <h1 className="truncate text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-white">JOHN SCOTT DYNASTY</h1>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setTeamDrawer("settings")} aria-label="League & Team Settings" className="p-1 text-zinc-400 transition hover:text-white"><Settings className="size-5" /></button>
        </header>

        {/* 4 Core Tabs */}
        <nav className="border-b border-[#141d2f] bg-[#070a12]">
          <div className="relative mx-3 flex">
            {mainTabs.map((tab) => {
              const active = activeTab === tab
              return (
                <button
                  key={tab}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab)}
                  className={cn(
                    "relative flex-1 py-2.5 text-center text-xs font-black tracking-widest transition-colors",
                    active ? "text-[#19ffff]" : "text-[#5e7090] hover:text-zinc-300"
                  )}
                >
                  {tab}
                </button>
              )
            })}
            <motion.span
              aria-hidden="true"
              className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-[3px] w-1/4 rounded-full bg-[#19ffff] shadow-[0_0_8px_#19ffff]"
              style={{ x: underlineX }}
            />
          </div>
        </nav>

        {/* Dynamic Body */}
        <SwipePager
          zone="tab"
          fill
          activeIndex={activeTabIndex}
          itemCount={mainTabs.length}
          onIndexChange={(index) => {
            const next = mainTabs[index]
            if (next) setActiveTab(next)
          }}
          onProgressChange={tabProgress}
          className="relative z-0 min-h-0 min-w-0 flex-1 pointer-events-auto"
        >
          <div className="h-full min-h-0 w-full shrink-0 overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain" aria-hidden={activeTab !== "MATCH"} inert={activeTab !== "MATCH"}>
            <MatchupPanel matchupResults={initialData.matchupResults} roster={lineupRoster} players={allDynastyPlayers} teamName={teamName} playerNicknames={playerNicknames} week={week} weekLineup={weekView} selectedMatchupId={selectedMatchupId} onMatchupChange={setSelectedMatchupId} onLiveSummary={handleLiveSummary} onWeekChange={setWeek} slotCapacities={slotCapacities} onMove={onMoveStable} onSelectPlayer={selectCanonicalPlayer} />
          </div>

          <div className="h-full min-h-0 w-full shrink-0 overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain" aria-hidden={activeTab !== "TEAM"} inert={activeTab !== "TEAM"}>
            <div className="flex flex-col pb-16">
              <TeamHeader teamName={teamName} logoUrl={teamLogo} standing={standings.find((row) => row.team === teamName)} rank={standings.findIndex((row) => row.team === teamName) + 1} pendingClaims={pendingClaims.length} faabBalance={userFaab} onAction={(action) => {
                if (action === "trade") {
                  setTradeMode(true)
                  setActiveTab("PLAYERS")
                } else setTeamDrawer(action)
              }} />
              <LineupAlerts roster={roster} capacities={slotCapacities} irSlots={initialData.league?.irSlots ?? 1} lock={initialData.lineupLock} />
              {/* Starters Subheader */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#101726] bg-[#070a12] px-3.5 pt-3 pb-2">
                <button type="button" className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-black text-white uppercase tracking-tight">
                  <span>Starters ({startersCount})</span>
                </button>
                <SwipeSurface zone="week" onSwipeLeft={() => shiftWeek(1)} onSwipeRight={() => shiftWeek(-1)} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-[#19ffff]">
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => shiftWeek(-1)} aria-label="Previous team week" className="rounded p-1 hover:bg-[#172338]">
                    <ChevronLeft className="size-3.5" />
                  </button>
                  <span>Week {week}</span>
                  {weekView?.frozen && <span className="ml-1 text-xs font-black uppercase text-[#5e7090]">Locked</span>}
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => shiftWeek(1)} aria-label="Next team week" className="rounded p-1 hover:bg-[#172338]">
                    <ChevronRight className="size-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </SwipeSurface>
              </div>
              {weekView?.frozen ? (
                <p className="border-b border-[#101726] bg-[#070a12] px-3.5 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[#8ba0c7]">This week is locked. Switch to a later week to slot players from a trade.</p>
              ) : week > (initialData.lineupLock?.week ?? week) ? (
                <p className="border-b border-[#101726] bg-[#070a12] px-3.5 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-[#8ba0c7]">Week {week} lineup. Players from a trade can be moved here before this week locks.</p>
              ) : null}

              {/* Starters Rows */}
              {orderedStarters.map(({ player, slot }, idx) => player ? renderRosterRow(player) : (
                <PlayerItem
                  key={`empty-${slot}-${idx}`}
                  player={null}
                  fallbackSlot={slot}
                  onEdit={onEditRosterSlot}
                  onSelect={selectCanonicalPlayer}
                />
              ))}

              {/* Bench */}
              <div className="border-b border-[#101726] bg-[#070a12] px-3.5 pt-4 pb-2 text-xs font-black text-white uppercase tracking-tight">
                Bench ({bench.length})
              </div>
              {bench.map((player) => renderRosterRow(player))}

              {/* Injured Reserve */}
              <div className="border-b border-[#101726] bg-[#070a12] px-3.5 pt-4 pb-2 text-xs font-black text-white uppercase tracking-tight">
                Injured Reserve
              </div>
              {ir.length > 0 ? (
                ir.map((player) => renderRosterRow(player))
              ) : (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 border-b border-[#0f1726] px-3.5 py-2">
                  <span className={cn("flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[5px] text-xs font-black uppercase", slotBadgeColors.IR)}>IR</span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#45546d]">Empty</span>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Taxi Squad */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#101726] bg-[#070a12] px-3.5 pt-4 pb-2 text-xs font-black text-white uppercase tracking-tight">
                <span>Taxi Squad</span>
                <span className="text-xs text-amber-400 font-bold">&lt; {initialData.league?.taxiMaxGames ?? TAXI_MAX_NHL_GAMES} NHL GP</span>
              </div>
              {taxi.map((player) => (
                <div key={player.id} className={cn("flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#0f1726] bg-[#070a12] px-3.5 py-2", ((player.nhlGamesPlayed ?? 0) >= (initialData.league?.taxiMaxGames ?? TAXI_MAX_NHL_GAMES)) ? "bg-rose-500/10" : "")}>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditingPlayer(player)} className={cn("flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[5px] text-xs font-black uppercase", slotBadgeColors.TAXI)}>
                      TX
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => selectCanonicalPlayer(player)} className="flex min-h-11 min-w-0 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2.5 text-left">
                      <PlayerPortrait player={player} name={player.name} className="size-8" />
                      <div>
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-white">{player.name}</p>
                      {playerNicknames[player.id] && <p className="text-xs italic text-[#5e7090]">{playerNicknames[player.id]}</p>}
                      <p className="text-xs text-[#5e7090]">{player.team} • {player.nhlGamesPlayed ?? "—"} NHL GP</p>
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-black text-white tabular-nums">0.00</span>
                </div>
              ))}

              {/* Future Draft Picks */}
              <div className="px-3.5 pt-5 pb-2 text-xs font-black text-white uppercase tracking-tight">Draft Picks</div>
              <div className="flex flex-col px-3.5">
                {draftPicks.map((pick, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="py-2 border-b border-[#0f1726] text-xs font-bold text-[#7d8fa9]">{formatPickLabel(pick)} ({initialData.managerHandle ?? teamName} Std)</div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Watermark */}
              <div className="mt-8 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-600 opacity-60">
                <span>⚡</span>
                <span className="text-xs font-black tracking-widest uppercase">sleeper</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="h-full min-h-0 w-full shrink-0 overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain" aria-hidden={activeTab !== "PLAYERS"} inert={activeTab !== "PLAYERS"}>
            <PlayersMarketView teamName={teamName} roster={roster} players={allDynastyPlayers} allLeagueRosterIds={allLeagueRosterIds} tradeBlock={tradeBlock} tradeOffers={tradeOffers} onAcceptTrade={onAcceptTradeStable} onDeclineTrade={onDeclineTradeStable} onCounterTrade={onCounterTradeStable} onInitiateTrade={onInitiateTradeStable} onSelect={selectCanonicalPlayer} onClaim={setClaimPlayer} onOpenTradeBuilder={onOpenTradeBuilderStable} activeTradeFilter={activeTradeFilter} setActiveTradeFilter={setActiveTradeFilter} tradeMode={tradeMode} />
          </div>
          <div className="flex h-full min-h-0 w-full shrink-0 flex-col overflow-hidden" aria-hidden={activeTab !== "LEAGUE"} inert={activeTab !== "LEAGUE"}>
            <LeagueFeed matchupResults={initialData.matchupResults} week={week} teamName={teamName} teamLogo={teamLogo} isCommissioner={initialData.isCommissioner} onWeekChange={setWeek} onSelectMatchup={(matchupId) => { setSelectedMatchupId(matchupId); setActiveTab("MATCH") }} liveMatchups={liveMatchups} standings={standings} activities={activities} roster={roster} players={allDynastyPlayers} onTrade={handleLeagueTrade} onSelectPlayer={handleLeaguePlayer} onSettings={() => setTeamDrawer("settings")} />
          </div>
        </SwipePager>

        <div className="absolute inset-x-3 bottom-[max(0.5rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] z-20">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setChatOpen(true)} aria-label="Open league chat" className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-[#1e2d47] bg-[#0c1424]/95 px-3.5 py-2 text-left text-xs shadow-lg backdrop-blur transition hover:border-[#19ffff]/50">
            <MessageSquare className="size-3.5 shrink-0 text-[#19ffff]" />
            <span className="truncate text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]"><b className="text-white">Chat:</b> {chatPreview}</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <LeagueChatDrawer
          open={chatOpen}
          onOpenChange={setChatOpen}
          leagueId={initialData.leagueId}
          latestPreview={chatPreview}
          onLatestMessage={(message) => setChatPreview(message)}
        />

        {/* Active Modals */}
        <PlayerDetailDialog player={selectedPlayer} scheduleGames={scheduleGames} open={selectedPlayer !== null} tradeBlockActive={selectedPlayer?.playerId ? tradeBlock.some((entry) => entry.playerId === selectedPlayer.playerId) : false} onToggleTradeBlock={toggleTradeBlock} onInitiateTrade={handleInitiateTradeWithPlayer} onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setSelectedPlayer(null)} onSelectPlayer={setSelectedPlayer} onClaim={(target) => {
          setSelectedPlayer(null)
          if (target.marketPlayer) setClaimPlayer(target.marketPlayer)
        }} />
        <TradeBuilderDialog open={tradeBuilderOpen} onOpenChange={(open) => { setTradeBuilderOpen(open); if (!open) { setCounterTrade(null); setPrefilledTrade(null) } }} team={userTradeTeam} partners={tradePartners} initialPartnerId={counterTrade?.partnerId ?? prefilledTrade?.partnerId} initialOffering={counterTrade?.offering ?? prefilledTrade?.offering} initialReceiving={counterTrade?.receiving ?? prefilledTrade?.receiving} onPlayerClick={(player) => setSelectedPlayer({ ...player, owned: roster.some((rosterPlayer) => rosterPlayer.id === player.id), playerId: player.id })} onSendTrade={handleSendTrade} />
        <LineupSlotDialog player={editingPlayer} emptySlot={editingSlot as Extract<Player["slot"], "C" | "W" | "F" | "D" | "G"> | null} roster={lineupRoster} capacities={slotCapacities} irSlots={initialData.league?.irSlots ?? 1} benchCapacity={benchCapacity} open={editingPlayer !== null || editingSlot !== null} onOpenChange={(open) => { if (!open) { setEditingPlayer(null); setEditingSlot(null) } }} onMove={handleRosterMove} />
        <DirectMessagesDialog open={dmOpen} onOpenChange={setDmOpen} onUnreadChange={setHasUnreadMessages} onTrade={(conversation) => { const partner = standings.find((team) => team.team === conversation.teamName); if (partner) { setDmOpen(false); handleLeagueTrade(partner) } }} />
        <TeamDrawer
          type={teamDrawer}
          rank={standings.findIndex((row) => row.team === teamName) + 1}
          faab={userFaab}
          waiverPriority={initialData.waiverPriority}
          roster={roster}
          playerNicknames={playerNicknames}
          setNickname={(id, value) => setPlayerNicknames((current) => ({ ...current, [id]: value }))}
          onClose={() => setTeamDrawer(null)}
          teamName={teamName}
          setTeamName={setTeamName}
          teamLogo={teamLogo}
          setTeamLogo={setTeamLogo}
          managerHandle={initialData.managerHandle}
          isCommissioner={initialData.isCommissioner}
          pendingClaims={pendingClaims}
          teamId={initialData.teamId}
          activities={activities}
          onCancelClaim={cancelClaim}
          onSaveSettings={saveTeamSettings}
        />
        <WaiverClaimDialog player={claimPlayer} roster={roster} rosterSize={rosterSize} userFaab={userFaab} teamName={teamName} teamId={initialData.teamId} weekLocked={initialData.lineupLock?.locked === true && initialData.lineupLock.mode !== "DAILY"} open={claimPlayer !== null} onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setClaimPlayer(null)} onConfirm={submitClaim} />
        {toast && <div className="absolute inset-x-4 top-3 z-[60] flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-[#19ffff]/50 bg-[#10283a] px-4 py-3 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-lg"><Check className="size-4 text-[#19ffff]" />{toast}</div>}
      </main>
    </div>
  )
}

import type { MatchupSummary } from "@/lib/hockey-data"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

function initials(name: string) {
  const words = name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
  if (words.length === 0) return "?"
  if (words.length === 1) return words[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()
  return `${words[0][0] ?? ""}${words[1][0] ?? ""}`.toUpperCase()
}

function gamesLeftLabel(count: number) {
  return count === 1 ? "1 game left" : `${count} games left`
}

function TeamSide({
  align,
  name,
  record,
  score,
  winPct,
  gamesLeft,
  winning,
  active,
}: {
  align: "left" | "right"
  name: string
  record: string
  score: number
  winPct: number
  gamesLeft: number
  winning: boolean
  active: boolean
}) {
  const favorite = winPct >= 50
  return (
    <div className={cn("min-w-0", align === "right" && "text-right")}>
      <div className={cn("flex items-center gap-2", align === "right" && "flex-row-reverse")}>
        <div aria-hidden="true" className="flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#172338] text-[11px] font-black text-white">
          {initials(name)}
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className={cn("truncate text-sm font-bold", winning ? "text-white" : "text-zinc-400")}>{name}</p>
          <p className="truncate text-[12px] text-zinc-500">{record}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p className={cn("mt-2 font-black tabular-nums leading-8", active ? "text-2xl" : "text-[1.5rem]", winning ? "text-white" : "text-zinc-300")}>
        {score.toFixed(2)}
      </p>
      <span className={cn("mt-1 inline-flex rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold", favorite ? "bg-emerald-400/15 text-emerald-300" : "bg-rose-400/15 text-rose-300")}>
        {winPct}%
      </span>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[12px] text-[#8ba0c7]">{gamesLeftLabel(gamesLeft)}</p>
    </div>
  )
}

export function MatchupBanner({
  summary,
  projectedHome,
  projectedAway,
  week = 1,
  homeGamesLeft,
  awayGamesLeft,
  active = true,
}: {
  summary: MatchupSummary
  projectedHome: number
  projectedAway: number
  week?: number
  homeGamesLeft: number
  awayGamesLeft: number
  active?: boolean
}) {
  const totalProjection = projectedHome + projectedAway
  const homeWinPct = totalProjection === 0 ? 50 : Math.round((projectedHome / totalProjection) * 100)
  const awayWinPct = 100 - homeWinPct
  const homeWinning = summary.homeScore >= summary.awayScore
  const isFinal = summary.status === "Final"

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col rounded-2xl border border-[#183047] bg-[#0b1c2d] p-3.5">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <span className="text-[13px] font-bold text-[#aeb4ff]">Week {week}</span>
        <span className={isFinal ? "rounded-full bg-zinc-800 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-400" : "flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#2b6b54]/30 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[#64dbad]"}>
          {!isFinal && <span className="size-1.5 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-lime-400" aria-hidden="true" />}
          {summary.status}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto_minmax(0,1fr)] items-start gap-2">
        <TeamSide align="left" name={summary.homeTeam} record={summary.homeRecord} score={summary.homeScore} winPct={homeWinPct} gamesLeft={homeGamesLeft} winning={homeWinning} active={active} />
        <span className="pt-8 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500">vs</span>
        <TeamSide align="right" name={summary.awayTeam} record={summary.awayRecord} score={summary.awayScore} winPct={awayWinPct} gamesLeft={awayGamesLeft} winning={!homeWinning} active={active} />
      </div>

      <p className="mt-3 text-center text-[13px] text-[#5e7090]">
        proj {projectedHome.toFixed(1)} – {projectedAway.toFixed(1)}
        <span className="sr-only">{`Projected split: ${homeWinPct}% ${summary.homeTeam}, ${awayWinPct}% ${summary.awayTeam}`}</span>
      </p>
    </div>
  )
}

"use client"

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react"
import { X } from "lucide-react"

const positionColor: Record<string, string> = {
  C: "text-[#60a5fa]",
  LW: "text-[#2dd4bf]",
  RW: "text-[#2dd4bf]",
  W: "text-[#2dd4bf]",
  F: "text-[#c4b5fd]",
  D: "text-[#fbbf24]",
  G: "text-[#38bdf8]",
}

export interface PlayerDialogTarget {
  name: string
  position: Player["position"]
  team: string
  opponent: string
  status: PlayerStatus
  todayPts: number | null
  projPts: number
  marketPlayer?: MarketPlayer
  profile?: PlayerProfile
  currentSeasonStats?: Record<string, number>
  gameLog?: PlayerGameLog[]
  historicalSeasons?: PlayerSeasonSummary[]
  schedule?: PlayerSchedule
  owned?: boolean
  playerId?: string
  ownerName?: string
  tradeBlockNote?: string
}

type PlayerNews = { id: string; headline: string; description: string; published: string | null; url: string | null }
type TeamStats = {
  team: string
  record: string
  points: number
  pointPct: number
  goalsForPerGame: number
  goalsAgainstPerGame: number
  offenseRank: number
  defenseRank: number
  powerPlay: number | null
  penaltyKill: number | null
}
type Tab = "summary" | "log" | "team" | "history" | "news"
type Detail = ReturnType<typeof getPlayerDetail>

const tabs: Tab[] = ["summary", "log", "team", "history", "news"]
const tabLabel: Record<Tab, string> = { summary: "Summary", log: "Log", team: "Team", history: "History", news: "News" }

export function PlayerDetailDialog({
  player, open, onOpenChange, onClaim,
  tradeBlockActive, onToggleTradeBlock, onInitiateTrade,
  scheduleGames = [],
}: {
  player: PlayerDialogTarget | null
  open: boolean
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void
  onClaim?: (player: PlayerDialogTarget) => void
  onSelectPlayer?: (player: PlayerDialogTarget) => void
  tradeBlockActive?: boolean
  onToggleTradeBlock?: (player: PlayerDialogTarget) => void
  onInitiateTrade?: (player: PlayerDialogTarget) => void
  scheduleGames?: NhlScheduleGame[]
}) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>("summary")
  const [news, setNews] = useState<PlayerNews[]>([])
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!player || !open) return
    fetch(`/api/news?player=${encodeURIComponent(player.name)}`, { cache: "no-store" })
      .then((response) => response.json())
      .then((data: { articles?: PlayerNews[] }) => setNews(data.articles ?? []))
      .catch((error) => console.error(`Failed to load ESPN news for ${player.name}:`, error))
  }, [open, player])
  const detail = useMemo(() => player ? getPlayerDetail(player, scheduleGames) : null, [player, scheduleGames])
  if (!open || !player || !detail) return null

  const goalie = player.position === "G"
  const weekPoints = player.schedule?.weekFantasyPoints
  const action = player.owned
    ? (onInitiateTrade ? { label: "Trade", run: () => { onOpenChange(false); onInitiateTrade(player) } } : null)
    : player.marketPlayer && onClaim
      ? { label: player.marketPlayer.waiver === "FA" ? "Add" : "Claim", run: () => { onOpenChange(false); onClaim(player) } }
      : onInitiateTrade
        ? { label: "Trade", run: () => { onOpenChange(false); onInitiateTrade(player) } }
        : null
  const shiftTab = (step: number) => {
    const next = tabs.indexOf(tab) + step
    if (next >= 0 && next < tabs.length) setTab(tabs[next])
  }

  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={(value) => { if (!value) { setTab("summary"); onOpenChange(false) } }}>
      <SheetContent side="bottom" spring="gentle" className="mx-auto flex h-[92vh] max-h-[92vh] max-w-[430px] flex-col rounded-t-3xl border-t border-[#1a263d] bg-[#070a12] p-0 text-white outline-none">
        <div className="mx-auto mt-2 h-1 w-10 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-[#2a3548]" />
        <header className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between px-2 py-1">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)} aria-label="Close player" className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#8ba0c7] active:bg-[#172338]">
            <X className="size-5" />
          </button>
          {player.owned && onToggleTradeBlock && (
            <button type="button" onClick={() => onToggleTradeBlock(player)} className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold", tradeBlockActive ? "bg-[#19ffff]/15 text-[#19ffff]" : "text-[#8ba0c7]")}>
              {tradeBlockActive ? "On block" : "Trade block"}
            </button>
          )}
        </header>

        <section className="shrink-0 px-4 pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="size-16 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[#172338]">
              <img src={getPlayerPhoto(player.marketPlayer ?? player)} alt="" className="size-full scale-125 object-cover object-[50%_15%]" onError={(event) => { event.currentTarget.style.display = "none" }} />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <h1 className="truncate text-[22px] font-black leading-tight">{player.name}</h1>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-[13px] text-[#8ba0c7]">
                <span className={positionColor[player.position]}>{player.position}</span>
                {" · "}{player.team}
                {player.status ? <span className="text-[#ff2a85]"> · {player.status}</span> : null}
              </p>
              {player.schedule && <p className="mt-0.5 text-[13px] text-[#c5d0e0]">{player.schedule.opponent} · {player.schedule.day} {player.schedule.time}</p>}
              {player.ownerName && !player.owned && <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-[#8ba0c7]">{player.ownerName}</p>}
            </div>
            <div className="text-right">
              <p className="text-[28px] font-black leading-none tabular-nums text-white">{weekPoints != null ? weekPoints.toFixed(1) : "—"}</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#5e7090]">This week</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          {player.tradeBlockNote && !player.owned && <p className="mt-3 text-center text-xs font-bold text-amber-200">On the trade block · {player.tradeBlockNote}</p>}
        </section>

        <nav className="flex shrink-0 border-b border-[#172338]" aria-label="Player sections">
          {tabs.map((item) => (
            <button key={item} type="button" onClick={() => setTab(item)} className={cn("relative flex-1 py-3 text-[13px] font-bold", tab === item ? "text-white" : "text-[#5e7090]")}>
              {tabLabel[item]}
              {tab === item && <span className="absolute inset-x-4 bottom-0 h-0.5 rounded-full bg-[#19ffff]" />}
            </button>
          ))}
        </nav>

        <SwipeSurface zone="player-tabs" onSwipeLeft={() => shiftTab(1)} onSwipeRight={() => shiftTab(-1)} className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="px-4 py-4">
            {tab === "summary" && <SummaryTab detail={detail} goalie={goalie} />}
            {tab === "log" && <GameLogTab detail={detail} goalie={goalie} />}
            {tab === "team" && <TeamTab player={player} />}
            {tab === "history" && <HistoryTab detail={detail} goalie={goalie} />}
            {tab === "news" && <NewsTab news={news} />}
          </div>
        </SwipeSurface>

        {action && (
          <div className="shrink-0 border-t border-[#172338] bg-[#070a12] px-4 pb-[max(0.75rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] pt-3">
            <button type="button" onClick={action.run} className="h-12 w-full rounded-full bg-[#19ffff] text-sm font-black text-[#080c14] active:scale-[0.98]">
              {action.label}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  )
}

function Stat({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string | number }) {
  return (
    <div className="min-w-0 text-center">
      <p className="text-base font-black tabular-nums text-white">{value}</p>
      <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#5e7090]">{label}</p>
    </div>
  )
}

function SummaryTab({ detail, goalie }: { detail: Detail; goalie: boolean }) {
  const totals = detail.seasonTotals
  const game = detail.gameLog[0]
  const season = goalie
    ? [["GP", totals.gp], ["W", totals.wins], ["SV", totals.saves], ["GA", totals.ga], ["SO", totals.shutouts], ["FPTS", totals.fpts]]
    : [["GP", totals.gp], ["G", totals.g], ["A", totals.a], ["PTS", totals.pts], ["SOG", totals.sog], ["HIT", totals.hits], ["BLK", totals.blk], ["+/-", totals.plusMinus]]
  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#5e7090]">Season</p>
        <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-4 gap-y-4">
          {season.map(([label, value]) => <Stat key={String(label)} label={String(label)} value={value ?? "—"} />)}
        </div>
        <p className="mt-4 text-center text-[13px] text-[#8ba0c7]">{totals.fpts} FPTS · {totals.fptsPerGame} per game</p>
      </div>
      {game && game.result !== "Did not play" && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-[#172338] pt-4">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#5e7090]">Last game</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold text-white">{game.opp}</p>
            <p className="text-[13px] text-[#8ba0c7]">{game.date} · {goalie ? `${game.decision ?? "—"} · ${game.saves} SV · ${game.ga} GA` : `${game.g} G · ${game.a} A · ${game.sog} SOG`}</p>
          </div>
          <p className="text-2xl font-black tabular-nums text-[#19ffff]">{game.fpts}</p>
        </div>
      )}
      <p className="border-t border-[#172338] pt-4 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-[#8ba0c7]">
        {detail.bio.age !== "—" ? `Age ${detail.bio.age}` : "Age —"}
        {" · "}{detail.bio.heightWeight}
        {" · "}{detail.bio.experience}
        {detail.bio.draftShort !== "—" ? ` · Draft ${detail.bio.draftShort}` : ""}
      </p>
    </div>
  )
}

function GameLogTab({ detail, goalie }: { detail: Detail; goalie: boolean }) {
  if (detail.gameLog.length === 0) return <p className="text-sm text-[#8ba0c7]">No games logged this season.</p>
  return (
    <ul className="divide-y divide-[#172338]">
      {detail.gameLog.map((game, index) => {
        const missed = game.result === "Did not play"
        const line = missed ? "Did not play" : goalie
          ? `${game.decision ?? "—"} · ${game.saves} SV · ${game.ga} GA · ${game.toi}`
          : `${game.g} G · ${game.a} A · ${game.sog} SOG · ${game.hits} HIT · ${game.blk} BLK`
        return (
          <li key={`${game.date}-${game.opp}-${index}`} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-3">
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-white">{game.opp}</p>
              <p className="truncate text-[13px] text-[#8ba0c7]">{game.date} · {line}</p>
            </div>
            <p className={cn("text-lg font-black tabular-nums", missed ? "text-[#5e7090]" : "text-[#19ffff]")}>{missed ? "—" : game.fpts}</p>
          </li>
        )
      })}
    </ul>
  )
}

function TeamTab({ player }: { player: PlayerDialogTarget }) {
  const [teamStats, setTeamStats] = useState<TeamStats | null>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    fetch(`/api/team-stats?team=${encodeURIComponent(player.team)}`, { cache: "no-store" })
      .then((response) => response.json())
      .then((data: TeamStats) => setTeamStats(data))
      .catch((error) => console.error(`Failed to load team stats for ${player.team}:`, error))
  }, [player.team])
  const rate = (value: number | null) => value == null ? "—" : `${value}%`
  const metrics: Array<[string, string]> = [
    ["Record", teamStats?.record ?? "—"],
    ["Points", teamStats ? String(teamStats.points) : "—"],
    ["GF / game", teamStats ? teamStats.goalsForPerGame.toFixed(2) : "—"],
    ["GA / game", teamStats ? teamStats.goalsAgainstPerGame.toFixed(2) : "—"],
    ["Offense", teamStats ? `#${teamStats.offenseRank}` : "—"],
    ["Defense", teamStats ? `#${teamStats.defenseRank}` : "—"],
    ["Power play", rate(teamStats?.powerPlay ?? null)],
    ["Penalty kill", rate(teamStats?.penaltyKill ?? null)],
  ]
  return (
    <div>
      <p className="text-lg font-black">{player.team}</p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[13px] text-[#8ba0c7]">{teamStats ? `${(teamStats.pointPct * 100).toFixed(1)} point %` : "Loading team stats"}</p>
      <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-4">
        {metrics.map(([label, value]) => <Stat key={label} label={label} value={value} />)}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function HistoryTab({ detail, goalie }: { detail: Detail; goalie: boolean }) {
  if (detail.pastSeasons.length === 0) return <p className="text-sm text-[#8ba0c7]">No earlier NHL seasons are synced.</p>
  return (
    <ul className="divide-y divide-[#172338]">
      {detail.pastSeasons.map((season) => (
        <li key={season.season} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-3">
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-white">{season.season} · {season.team}</p>
            <p className="text-[13px] text-[#8ba0c7]">
              {goalie ? `${season.gp} GP · ${season.wins} W · ${season.saves} SV · ${season.ga} GA` : `${season.gp} GP · ${season.g} G · ${season.a} A · ${season.pts} PTS`}
            </p>
          </div>
          <p className="text-lg font-black tabular-nums text-[#19ffff]">{season.fpts}</p>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  )
}

function NewsTab({ news }: { news: PlayerNews[] }) {
  if (news.length === 0) return <p className="text-sm text-[#8ba0c7]">No recent news for this player.</p>
  return (
    <ul className="space-y-4">
      {news.map((item) => (
        <li key={item.id} className="border-b border-[#172338] pb-4">
          <p className="text-[13px] font-bold leading-snug text-white">{item.headline}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 line-clamp-3 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-[#8ba0c7]">{item.description}</p>
          {item.url && <a href={item.url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="mt-2 inline-block text-[13px] font-bold text-[#19ffff]">Read</a>}
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  )
}

<file path="components/hockey/players-market-view.tsx">
import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { ArrowLeftRight, Award, Check, Plus, Search } from "lucide-react"
import { Sheet, SheetContent } from "@/components/ui/sheet"
import { type MarketPlayer, type Player, type TradeBlockEntry, type LeagueTradeOffer } from "@/lib/hockey-data"
import { type PlayerDialogTarget } from "@/components/hockey/player-detail-dialog"
import type { PlayerGridSettings } from "@/components/hockey/player-grid-dialog"
import { getPlayerStatsForHorizon, getProjectedFPTS, getSyncedPlayerFPTS, normalizeSearchText } from "@/lib/hockey-calculators"
import { PlayersSubTabView } from "@/components/hockey/players-sub-tab-view"

type PositionFilter = "ALL" | "C" | "W" | "F" | "D" | "G"
type SkaterSort = "FPTS" | "G" | "A" | "PTS" | "SOG" | "HIT" | "BLK"
type GoalieSort = "FPTS" | "W" | "SV" | "SV%" | "GAA" | "SO"
type MarketSort = SkaterSort | GoalieSort
const skaterSortOptions: SkaterSort[] = ["FPTS", "G", "A", "PTS", "SOG", "HIT", "BLK"]
const goalieSortOptions: GoalieSort[] = ["FPTS", "W", "SV", "SV%", "GAA", "SO"]
function matchesPosition(playerPos: string, filter: PositionFilter): boolean {
  if (filter === "ALL") return true
  if (filter === "C") return playerPos === "C"
  if (filter === "W") return ["W", "LW", "RW"].includes(playerPos)
  if (filter === "F") return ["C", "W", "LW", "RW", "F"].includes(playerPos)
  if (filter === "D") return ["D", "LD", "RD"].includes(playerPos)
  if (filter === "G") return playerPos === "G"
  return false
}
type HorizonMode = "stats" | "projections"
type HockeyHorizon = "Last 7 Days" | "Last 14 Days" | "Last 30 Days" | "Season Totals" | "Season Avg / Per Game" | "This Week" | "Next 14 Days" | "Rest of Season (ROS)"
function marketStat(player: MarketPlayer, stat: "gp" | "goals" | "assists" | "sog" | "hits" | "blocks" | "wins" | "saves" | "goalsAgainst" | "shutouts" | "savePct" | "plusMinus" | "ppp", horizon?: string): number {
  const stats = getPlayerStatsForHorizon(player, horizon)
  if (stat === "gp") return stats.gp
  if (stat === "wins") return "wins" in stats ? stats.wins : 0
  if (stat === "saves") return "saves" in stats ? stats.saves : 0
  if (stat === "goalsAgainst") return "goalsAgainst" in stats ? stats.goalsAgainst : 0
  if (stat === "shutouts") return "shutouts" in stats ? stats.shutouts : 0
  if (stat === "savePct") return "savePct" in stats ? stats.savePct ?? 0 : 0
  if (stat === "goals") return "goals" in stats ? stats.goals ?? 0 : 0
  if (stat === "assists") return "assists" in stats ? stats.assists ?? 0 : 0
  if (stat === "sog") return "sog" in stats ? stats.sog ?? 0 : 0
  if (stat === "hits") return "hits" in stats ? stats.hits ?? 0 : 0
  if (stat === "blocks") return "blocks" in stats ? stats.blocks ?? 0 : 0
  if (stat === "ppp") return "ppp" in stats ? stats.ppp ?? 0 : 0
  return player.currentSeasonStats?.plusMinus ?? 0
}
export const PlayersMarketView = React.memo(function PlayersMarketView({ teamName, roster, players: dynastyPlayers, allLeagueRosterIds, tradeBlock, tradeOffers, onAcceptTrade, onDeclineTrade, onCounterTrade, onInitiateTrade, onSelect, onClaim, onOpenTradeBuilder, activeTradeFilter, setActiveTradeFilter, tradeMode = false }: { teamName: string; roster: Player[]; players: MarketPlayer[]; allLeagueRosterIds?: Set<number | string>; tradeBlock: TradeBlockEntry[]; tradeOffers: LeagueTradeOffer[]; onAcceptTrade: (tradeId: string) => void; onDeclineTrade: (tradeId: string) => void; onCounterTrade: (trade: LeagueTradeOffer) => void; onInitiateTrade: (player: PlayerDialogTarget) => void; onSelect: (player: PlayerDialogTarget) => void; onClaim: (player: MarketPlayer) => void; onOpenTradeBuilder: () => void; activeTradeFilter: "ALL" | "ACTIVE" | "ACCEPTED" | "REJECTED"; setActiveTradeFilter: (filter: "ALL" | "ACTIVE" | "ACCEPTED" | "REJECTED") => void; tradeMode?: boolean }) {
  const [subTab, setSubTab] = useState<"search" | "available" | "leaders" | "trade">(tradeMode ? "trade" : "available")
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<PositionFilter>("ALL")
  const [availability, setAvailability] = useState<"ALL" | "FA" | "W">("ALL")
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<PlayerGridSettings>({ viewType: "Projections", period: "This Week", year: "2026" })
  const [horizonMode, setHorizonMode] = useState<HorizonMode>("projections")
  const [horizon, setHorizon] = useState<HockeyHorizon>("This Week")
  const [filtersOpen, setFiltersOpen] = useState(false)
  const [availableSort, setAvailableSort] = useState<MarketSort>("FPTS")
  const [visibleCount, setVisibleCount] = useState(50)
  const isGoalieFilter = filter === "G"
  const currentSortOptions = isGoalieFilter ? goalieSortOptions : skaterSortOptions
  const handlePositionChange = (pos: PositionFilter) => {
    setFilter(pos)
    if (pos === "G" && !goalieSortOptions.includes(availableSort as GoalieSort)) setAvailableSort("FPTS")
    else if (pos !== "G" && !skaterSortOptions.includes(availableSort as SkaterSort)) setAvailableSort("FPTS")
  }
  const players = useMemo(() => [...dynastyPlayers]
    .filter((p) => {
      // Rostered players (any of the 12 teams) are never Free Agents.
      const playerId = p.nhlId ? Number(p.nhlId) : p.name
      if (allLeagueRosterIds?.has(playerId) || allLeagueRosterIds?.has(p.name) || allLeagueRosterIds?.has(normalizeSearchText(p.name))) return false
      const availabilityMatch = availability === "ALL" ? true : availability === "FA" ? p.waiver === "FA" : p.waiver !== "FA"
      return matchesPosition(p.position, filter) && availabilityMatch
    })
    // Decorate-sort-undecorate: compute the sort stat once per player instead of on every comparison.
    .map((player) => {
      const getStat = (player: MarketPlayer, sort: MarketSort) => {
        const statsHorizon = settings.viewType === "Stats" ? horizon : undefined
        const perGame = statsHorizon === "Season Avg / Per Game"
        const gamesPlayed = () => Math.max(1, marketStat(player, "gp", statsHorizon))
        const counting = (stat: "goals" | "assists" | "sog" | "hits" | "blocks" | "wins" | "saves" | "shutouts") => {
          const value = marketStat(player, stat, statsHorizon)
          return perGame ? value / gamesPlayed() : value
        }
        if (sort === "FPTS") return settings.viewType === "Stats" ? getSyncedPlayerFPTS(player, statsHorizon) : (horizon === "This Week" && player.schedule ? player.schedule.weekProjectedFantasyPoints : getProjectedFPTS(player, horizon === "Next 14 Days" ? 7 : 28))
        if (sort === "G") return counting("goals")
        if (sort === "A") return counting("assists")
        if (sort === "PTS") return counting("goals") + counting("assists")
        if (sort === "SOG") return counting("sog")
        if (sort === "HIT") return counting("hits")
        if (sort === "BLK") return counting("blocks")
        if (sort === "W") return counting("wins")
        if (sort === "SV") return counting("saves")
        if (sort === "SV%") return marketStat(player, "savePct", statsHorizon)
        if (sort === "SO") return counting("shutouts")
        if (sort === "GAA") {
          const gp = marketStat(player, "gp", statsHorizon)
          return gp > 0 ? -(marketStat(player, "goalsAgainst", statsHorizon) / gp) : -99
        }
        return 0
      }
      return { player, value: getStat(player, availableSort) }
    })
    .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value)
    .map((entry) => entry.player), [allLeagueRosterIds, availability, availableSort, dynastyPlayers, filter, horizon, settings.viewType])
  const selectPlayer = (p: MarketPlayer) => onSelect({ name: p.name, position: p.position, team: p.team, opponent: p.schedule?.opponent ?? "—", status: p.injuryStatus ?? null, todayPts: p.fpts, projPts: horizonMode === "projections" ? getProjectedFPTS(p, horizon === "This Week" ? 3.5 : horizon === "Next 14 Days" ? 7 : 28) : p.fpts, marketPlayer: p })
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-4 border-b border-[#141e33] px-1 py-2 text-[#5e7090]">
        {[{ id: "search" as const, label: "Search", Icon: Search }, { id: "available" as const, label: "Available", Icon: Check }, { id: "leaders" as const, label: "Leaders", Icon: Award }, { id: "trade" as const, label: "Trade", Icon: ArrowLeftRight }].map(({ id, label, Icon }) => <button key={label} type="button" onClick={() => setSubTab(id)} className={cn("relative flex w-full cursor-pointer flex-col items-center gap-1 py-1 text-xs font-bold", subTab === id && "text-[#19ffff]")}>{subTab === id && <span className="absolute inset-x-3 -bottom-2 h-0.5 rounded-full bg-[#19ffff]" />}<Icon className="size-4" />{label}</button>)}
      </div>
      {subTab !== "available" ? <PlayersSubTabView teamName={teamName} tab={subTab} roster={roster} players={dynastyPlayers} tradeBlock={tradeBlock} tradeOffers={tradeOffers} onAcceptTrade={onAcceptTrade} onDeclineTrade={onDeclineTrade} onCounterTrade={onCounterTrade} onInitiateTrade={onInitiateTrade} horizonMode={horizonMode} horizon={horizon} onHorizonChange={(mode, next) => { setHorizonMode(mode); setHorizon(next); setSettings({ ...settings, viewType: mode === "stats" ? "Stats" : "Projections", period: next }) }} onSelect={onSelect} onClaim={onClaim} onOpenTradeBuilder={onOpenTradeBuilder} activeTradeFilter={activeTradeFilter} setActiveTradeFilter={setActiveTradeFilter} /> : <>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#111929] px-3 py-3">
        <h2 className="text-base font-black text-white">{tradeMode ? "Trade Center" : "Available"}</h2>
        <button type="button" aria-label="Filters" onClick={() => setFiltersOpen(true)} className="rounded-full bg-[#172338] px-3 py-1.5 text-[13px] font-bold text-white">{filter === "ALL" ? "All" : filter} · {availableSort}</button>
      </div>
      <ul>
        {players.slice(0, visibleCount).map((p) => {
          const points = settings.viewType === "Stats"
            ? getSyncedPlayerFPTS(p, horizon)
            : horizon === "This Week" && p.schedule ? p.schedule.weekProjectedFantasyPoints : getProjectedFPTS(p, horizon === "Next 14 Days" ? 7 : 28)
          return (
            <li key={p.nhlId ? `nhl-${p.nhlId}` : p.name} className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-[#172338] px-3 py-3">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => selectPlayer(p)} className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-3 text-left">
                <span className={cn("flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-xs font-black", p.position === "G" ? "bg-sky-500 text-white" : p.position === "D" ? "bg-amber-600 text-white" : p.position === "C" ? "bg-blue-600 text-white" : "bg-teal-600 text-white")}>{p.position}</span>
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="block truncate text-sm font-bold text-white">{p.name}</span>
                  <span className="block truncate text-[13px] text-[#8ba0c7]">{p.team} · {p.schedule?.opponent ?? "—"}{p.injuryStatus ? ` · ${p.injuryStatus}` : ""}</span>
                </span>
                <span className={cn("shrink-0 text-[13px] font-bold", p.waiver === "FA" ? "text-emerald-300" : "text-amber-300")}>{p.waiver === "FA" ? "FA" : "W"}</span>
                <span className="w-12 text-right text-base font-black tabular-nums text-white">{points.toFixed(1)}</span>
              </button>
              <button type="button" aria-label={`Add or claim ${p.name}`} onClick={() => onClaim(p)} className="flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]"><Plus className="size-4" /></button>
            </li>
          )
        })}
      </ul>
      <p className="px-3 pt-3 text-center text-[13px] text-[#5e7090]">Showing {Math.min(visibleCount, players.length)} of {players.length} players</p>
      {players.length > visibleCount && <button type="button" onClick={() => setVisibleCount((count) => count + 50)} className="mx-auto my-3 block rounded-full border border-[#19ffff]/50 px-5 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-[#19ffff]">Show 50 more</button>}
      <Sheet open={filtersOpen} onOpenChange={setFiltersOpen}>
        <SheetContent side="bottom" spring="snappy" className="mx-auto max-h-[80vh] max-w-[430px] overflow-y-auto rounded-t-3xl border-t border-[#1a263d] bg-[#070a12] p-4 text-white">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-black">Filters</h2>
          <p className="mt-4 text-[13px] font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">Position</p>
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">{(["ALL", "C", "W", "F", "D", "G"] as PositionFilter[]).map((pos) => <button key={pos} type="button" data-testid={`position-filter-${pos}`} onClick={() => handlePositionChange(pos)} className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold", filter === pos ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>{pos}</button>)}</div>
          <p className="mt-4 text-[13px] font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">Availability</p>
          <div className="mt-2 flex gap-2">{(["ALL", "FA", "W"] as const).map((value) => <button key={value} type="button" onClick={() => setAvailability(value)} className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold", availability === value ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>{value === "ALL" ? "All" : value === "FA" ? "Free agents" : "Waivers"}</button>)}</div>
          <p className="mt-4 text-[13px] font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">Sort</p>
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">{currentSortOptions.map((value) => <button key={value} type="button" onClick={() => setAvailableSort(value)} className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold", availableSort === value ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>{value}</button>)}</div>
          <p className="mt-4 text-[13px] font-bold text-[#8ba0c7]">Window</p>
          <div className="mt-2 flex gap-2">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => { setHorizonMode("stats"); setHorizon("Last 14 Days"); setSettings({ ...settings, viewType: "Stats", period: "Last 14 Days" }) }} className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold", horizonMode === "stats" ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>Stats</button>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => { setHorizonMode("projections"); setHorizon("This Week"); setSettings({ ...settings, viewType: "Projections", period: "This Week" }) }} className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold", horizonMode === "projections" ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>Projections</button>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">{(horizonMode === "stats" ? ["Last 7 Days", "Last 14 Days", "Last 30 Days", "Season Totals", "Season Avg / Per Game"] : ["This Week", "Next 14 Days", "Rest of Season (ROS)"]).map((option) => <button key={option} type="button" onClick={() => { const next = option as HockeyHorizon; setHorizon(next); setSettings({ ...settings, period: next }) }} className={cn("rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold", horizon === option ? "bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "bg-[#172338] text-[#8ba0c7]")}>{option}</button>)}</div>
        </SheetContent>
      </Sheet>
      </>}
    </div>
  )
})
