<file path="components/hockey/waiver-claim-dialog.tsx">
"use client"

import { useMemo, useState } from "react"
import { AlertTriangle, Check, ChevronLeft, X } from "lucide-react"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Sheet, SheetContent } from "@/components/ui/sheet"
import { DEFAULT_ROSTER_SIZE, isStarterSlot, type MarketPlayer, type Player, type WaiverClaim } from "@/lib/hockey-data"
import { PlayerPortrait } from "@/components/hockey/player-portrait"

const colors: Record<string, string> = {
  C: "bg-[#1d4ed8] text-white",
  W: "bg-[#0d9488] text-white",
  LW: "bg-[#0d9488] text-white",
  RW: "bg-[#0d9488] text-white",
  F: "bg-[#7c3aed] text-white",
  D: "bg-[#b45309] text-white",
  G: "bg-[#0284c7] text-white",
  BN: "bg-[#1e293b] text-[#cbd5e1]",
  TAXI: "bg-[#451a03] text-[#f59e0b]",
  IR: "bg-[#4c0519] text-[#f43f5e]",
}

function WaiverTiming({ weekLocked }: { weekLocked: boolean }) {
  return (
    <p className="mt-3 text-left text-xs leading-relaxed text-[#8ba0c7]">
      {weekLocked
        ? "This week is locked. This add is for next week's lineup. Waivers run Monday at midnight, after the final game."
        : "Waivers run Monday at midnight, after the final game of the week. The player joins your bench then and can be started next week."}
    </p>
  )
}

function DropRow({ player, selected, onSelect }: { player: Player; selected: boolean; onSelect: () => void }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onSelect}
      className={cn(
        "flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center gap-2.5 border-b border-[#172338] px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-[#0f1828]/80",
        selected && "bg-[#0c2231]"
      )}
    >
      <span
        className={cn(
          "flex size-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border",
          selected ? "border-[#19ffff] bg-[#19ffff] text-[#080c14]" : "border-[#5e7090]"
        )}
      >
        {selected && <Check className="size-3" />}
      </span>
      <span
        className={cn(
          "flex h-7 min-w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md px-1 text-xs font-black",
          colors[player.slot] || colors[player.position] || "bg-[#1e293b] text-white"
        )}
      >
        {player.slot}
      </span>
      <PlayerPortrait player={player} name={player.name} className="size-7 bg-[#1b2842]" />
      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <span className="block truncate text-xs font-bold text-white">{player.name}</span>
        <span className="block text-xs text-[#5e7090]">{player.team} · {player.opponent}</span>
      </span>
      <span className="text-xs font-black tabular-nums text-white">
        {(player.schedule?.weekProjectedFantasyPoints ?? player.projPts).toFixed(1)}
      </span>
    </button>
  )
}

export function WaiverClaimDialog({
  player,
  roster,
  userFaab,
  teamName,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  onConfirm,
  teamId,
  rosterSize = DEFAULT_ROSTER_SIZE,
  weekLocked = false,
}: {
  player: MarketPlayer | null
  roster: Player[]
  userFaab: number
  teamName: string
  open: boolean
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void
  onConfirm: (claim: WaiverClaim) => void
  teamId?: string
  /** League roster capacity; drops are optional only while the roster is below this. */
  rosterSize?: number
  /** True once the current Monday–Sunday week has locked. The add still lands next week. */
  weekLocked?: boolean
}) {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<1 | 2>(1)
  const [bid, setBid] = useState(0)
  const [dropId, setDropId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)

  const dropGroups = useMemo(
    () => ({
      STARTERS: roster.filter((p) => isStarterSlot(p.slot)),
      BENCH: roster.filter((p) => p.slot === "BN"),
      "TAXI SQUAD": roster.filter((p) => p.slot === "TAXI"),
    }),
    [roster]
  )

  const dropped = roster.find((p) => p.id === dropId)
  const openSpots = Math.max(0, rosterSize - roster.length)
  const rosterFull = openSpots === 0

  if (!open || !player) return null

  const close = () => {
    setStep(1)
    setDropId(null)
    setBid(0)
    setError(null)
    setSubmitting(false)
    onOpenChange(false)
  }

  const confirm = () => {
    // A drop is only mandatory when the roster is full; open bench spots allow a pure add.
    if (rosterFull && !dropped) {
      setError("Your roster is full. Select a player to drop.")
      return
    }
    const localClaim: WaiverClaim = {
      id: `claim-${Date.now()}`,
      playerToAdd: player,
      playerToDrop: dropped ?? null,
      bidAmount: bid,
      status: "pending",
      runTime: "Monday midnight",
    }
    if (teamId && player.nhlId) {
      setSubmitting(true)
      setError(null)
      void fetch("/api/waivers", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ teamId, playerToAddId: player.nhlId, playerToDropId: dropped?.nhlId ?? null, bidAmount: bid }),
      }).then(async (response) => {
        const data = await response.json() as { error?: string; claim?: { id?: string } }
        if (!response.ok || !data.claim) throw new Error(data.error ?? "Could not submit waiver claim")
        onConfirm({ ...localClaim, id: data.claim.id ?? localClaim.id })
        close()
      }).catch((caught: unknown) => {
        console.error("Could not submit waiver claim", caught)
        setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "Could not submit waiver claim")
        setSubmitting(false)
      })
      return
    }
    onConfirm(localClaim)
    close()
  }

  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={(value) => !value && close()}>
      <SheetContent
        side="bottom"
        spring="snappy"
        className="mx-auto flex h-[90vh] max-h-[90vh] max-w-[430px] flex-col rounded-t-3xl border-t border-[#1a263d] bg-[#070a12] p-0 text-white outline-none"
      >
        <div className="mx-auto mt-2 h-1 w-10 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-[#5e7090]" />

        {step === 1 ? (
          <>
            <header className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between border-b border-[#172338] px-4 py-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="flex size-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#1b2842]">🏒</span>
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-sm font-black">+ ADD {player.name}</h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[#5e7090]">
                    {player.position} · {player.team} · {teamName}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button type="button" onClick={close} aria-label="Close">
                <X className="size-5 text-[#8ba0c7]" />
              </button>
            </header>

            <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain">
            <section className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
              <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-[#5e7090]">Bid Amount</p>
              <div className="mx-auto mt-2 flex w-32 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-[#263858] bg-[#101829] px-2">
                <span className="text-xl font-black text-[#19ffff]">$</span>
                <input
                  aria-label="Bid amount"
                  type="number"
                  min={0}
                  max={userFaab}
                  value={bid}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setBid(Math.max(0, Math.min(userFaab, Number(e.target.value) || 0)))
                  }
                  className="w-20 bg-transparent py-2 text-center text-2xl font-black text-white outline-none"
                />
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-[#5e7090]">${userFaab} remaining</p>
              <WaiverTiming weekLocked={weekLocked} />
            </section>

            <div className="mx-3 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-400/30 bg-amber-400/10 p-3 text-xs text-amber-200">
              <AlertTriangle className="size-4 shrink-0" />
              {rosterFull ? "Your roster is full, please select a player to drop" : `${openSpots} open roster spot${openSpots === 1 ? "" : "s"} available - dropping a player is optional`}
            </div>

            <div className="px-3 pb-3">
              {!rosterFull && <button type="button" onClick={() => { setDropId(null); setStep(2) }} className="mb-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/10 px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-xs font-bold text-emerald-300">+ Do not drop any player ({openSpots} open roster spot{openSpots === 1 ? "" : "s"})</button>}
              <p className="mt-4 px-1 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5e7090]">
                Select Player to Drop
              </p>
              {Object.entries(dropGroups).map(([group, players]) => (
                <div key={group}>
                  <p className="mt-3 px-1 text-xs font-black text-[#8ba0c7]">{group}</p>
                  {players.map((candidate) => (
                    <DropRow
                      key={candidate.id}
                      player={candidate}
                      selected={dropId === candidate.id}
                      onSelect={() => setDropId(candidate.id)}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            </div>

            <div className="shrink-0 border-t border-[#1a263d] bg-[#070a12] p-4">
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={rosterFull && !dropped}
                onClick={() => setStep(2)}
                className="h-12 w-full cursor-pointer rounded-full bg-[#19ffff] text-sm font-black text-[#080c14] transition-all duration-150 hover:brightness-110 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                Next
              </button>
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <header className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between border-b border-[#172338] px-4 py-3">
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-lg font-black">Confirm Transaction</h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-[#5e7090]">Add player to your roster</p>
              </div>
              <button type="button" onClick={close} aria-label="Close">
                <X className="size-5 text-[#8ba0c7]" />
              </button>
            </header>

            <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain p-4">
              <span className="rounded bg-[#19ffff]/15 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-black text-[#19ffff]">
                {player.waiver === "FA" ? "FREE AGENCY" : "WAIVERS"}
              </span>

              <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-[#1b2b46] bg-[#121c2e] p-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-black text-[#19ffff]">+ ADD</span>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-bold text-white">{player.name}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-[#5e7090]">
                      {player.position} · {player.team}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <ChevronLeft className="size-4 rotate-180 text-[#5e7090]" />

                  <div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-black text-[#ff2a85]">- DROP</span>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-bold text-white">{dropped?.name ?? "None (Keep open roster spot)"}</p>
                    {dropped && <p className="text-xs text-[#5e7090]">{dropped.position} · {dropped.team}</p>}
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-right">
                    <p className="text-xs font-black text-[#5e7090]">BID</p>
                    <p className="text-lg font-black text-white">${bid}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <WaiverTiming weekLocked={weekLocked} />
              {error && <p role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-lg border border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-500/10 p-3 text-xs font-bold text-rose-300">{error}</p>}
            </div>
            <div className="shrink-0 border-t border-[#1a263d] bg-[#070a12] p-4">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={confirm}
                disabled={submitting}
                className="h-12 w-full cursor-pointer rounded-full bg-[#19ffff] text-sm font-black text-[#080c14] transition-all duration-150 hover:brightness-110 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                Confirm
              </button>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  )
}

<file path="components/hockey/lineup-slot-dialog.tsx">
"use client"

import { Shield, X } from "lucide-react"
import { Sheet, SheetContent } from "@/components/ui/sheet"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { DEFAULT_SLOT_CAPACITIES, TAXI_MAX_NHL_GAMES, type Player, type StarterSlot } from "@/lib/hockey-data"
import { DEFAULT_BENCH_CAPACITY, displacedLandingSlot } from "@/lib/roster-eligibility"
import { PlayerPortrait } from "@/components/hockey/player-portrait"

type StartingSlot = StarterSlot

const slotColors: Record<StartingSlot | "BN" | "TAXI" | "IR", string> = {
  C: "bg-[#3b4cca] text-white",
  W: "bg-[#0d9488] text-white",
  F: "bg-[#7c3aed] text-white",
  D: "bg-[#b45309] text-white",
  G: "bg-[#0284c7] text-white",
  BN: "bg-[#1a253b] text-[#8ba0c7]",
  TAXI: "bg-[#1a253b] text-[#8ba0c7]",
  IR: "bg-[#3b1824] text-[#ff2a85]",
}

function eligibleStartingSlots(player: Player): StartingSlot[] {
  if (player.position === "C") return ["C", "F"]
  if (player.position === "LW" || player.position === "RW") return ["W", "F"]
  return [player.position]
}

function isInjured(player: Player): boolean {
  return player.status === "IR" || player.status === "O" || player.status === "DTD"
}

function isTaxiEligible(player: Player): boolean {
  return !isInjured(player) && player.nhlGamesPlayed != null && player.nhlGamesPlayed < TAXI_MAX_NHL_GAMES
}

function eligibleTargets(player: Player | null, roster: Player[], capacities: Record<StartingSlot, number>, emptySlot?: StartingSlot, irSlots = 1, benchCapacity = DEFAULT_BENCH_CAPACITY): Array<{ slot: Player["slot"]; label: string; target?: Player; detail?: string }> {
  const slots: Array<{ slot: Player["slot"]; label: string; target?: Player; detail?: string }> = []
  if (emptySlot) {
    return roster
      .filter((candidate) => candidate.slot === "BN" && eligibleStartingSlots(candidate).includes(emptySlot))
      .map((candidate) => ({ slot: emptySlot, label: "Empty starting slot", target: candidate }))
  }
  if (player && isInjured(player)) {
    // Pure IR: only players whose status is IR may take an IR slot (DTD / O are not eligible).
    if (player.status === "IR" && player.slot !== "IR") {
      const irOccupants = roster.filter((candidate) => candidate.slot === "IR" && candidate.id !== player.id)
      if (irOccupants.length < irSlots) slots.push({ slot: "IR", label: "Injured Reserve" })
      else irOccupants.forEach((target) => {
        const benchCount = roster.filter((candidate) => candidate.slot === "BN" && candidate.id !== player.id).length
        const landing = displacedLandingSlot(player.slot, target.position, benchCount < benchCapacity)
        if (!landing) return
        slots.push({ slot: "IR", label: landing === player.slot ? "Swap IR player" : "Moves to bench", target, detail: landing === "BN" ? "Moves to the bench" : undefined })
      })
    }
    if (player.slot !== "BN") slots.push({ slot: "BN", label: "Bench player" })
  } else if (player?.slot === "BN" || player?.slot === "TAXI" || player?.slot === "IR") {
    eligibleStartingSlots(player).forEach((slot) => {
      const occupants = roster.filter((candidate) => candidate.slot === slot && candidate.id !== player.id)
      if (occupants.length) {
        occupants.forEach((target) => slots.push({ slot, label: "Swap starter", target }))
      }
      if (occupants.length < capacities[slot]) {
        slots.push({ slot, label: "Starting slot" })
      }
    })
  } else if (player) {
    eligibleStartingSlots(player).forEach((slot) => {
      roster.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== player.id && candidate.slot === slot).forEach((target) => {
        slots.push({ slot, label: "Starting slot", target })
      })
      if (roster.filter((candidate) => candidate.slot === slot).length < capacities[slot]) slots.push({ slot, label: "Empty starting slot" })
    })
    roster
      .filter((candidate) => candidate.slot === "BN" && eligibleStartingSlots(candidate).some((slot) => eligibleStartingSlots(player).includes(slot)))
      .forEach((target) => {
        const destination = eligibleStartingSlots(player).find((slot) => eligibleStartingSlots(target).includes(slot))
        if (destination) slots.push({ slot: destination, label: "Bench player", target })
      })
  }
  if (player && isTaxiEligible(player) && player.slot !== "TAXI") slots.push({ slot: "TAXI", label: "Taxi Squad" })
  return slots.filter((option, index, all) => all.findIndex((candidate) => candidate.slot === option.slot && candidate.target?.id === option.target?.id) === index)
}

function PlayerAvatar({ player }: { player: Player }) {
  return <PlayerPortrait player={player} name={player.name} className="size-10 border border-[#24375b] bg-[#1b2842]" />
}

export function LineupSlotDialog({
  player,
  emptySlot,
  roster,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  onMove,
  teamId,
  capacities = DEFAULT_SLOT_CAPACITIES,
  irSlots = 1,
  benchCapacity = DEFAULT_BENCH_CAPACITY,
}: {
  player: Player | null
  emptySlot?: StartingSlot | null
  roster: Player[]
  open: boolean
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void
  onMove: (playerId: string, destSlot: Player["slot"], targetPlayerId?: string) => void
  teamId?: string
  capacities?: Record<StartingSlot, number>
  irSlots?: number
  benchCapacity?: number
}) {
  if (!open || (!player && !emptySlot)) return null
  const targets = eligibleTargets(player, roster, capacities, emptySlot ?? undefined, irSlots, benchCapacity)
  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <SheetContent side="bottom" spring="snappy" className="mx-auto max-w-[430px] rounded-t-2xl border-t border-[#1a263d] bg-[#0d1424] p-0 text-white">
        <div className="mx-auto mt-2 h-1 w-10 rounded-full bg-[#5e7090]" />
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 pb-3 pt-2">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5e7090]">1/1 Choose player to swap</p>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-black text-white">{player ? "Swap Player" : `Fill ${emptySlot} Slot`}</h2>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)} aria-label="Close swap player drawer" className="rounded-full p-2 text-[#8ba0c7] hover:bg-[#172338]"><X className="size-5" /></button>
        </div>

        <div className="mx-3 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-[#1e2f4f] bg-[#141e33] p-3">
          <span className={cn("flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-xs font-black", slotColors[player?.slot ?? emptySlot ?? "BN"])}>{player?.slot ?? emptySlot}</span>
          {player ? <PlayerAvatar player={player} /> : <div className="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-dashed border-[#34476a] text-[#5e7090]">+</div>}
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <p className="truncate text-sm font-black text-white">{player?.name ?? `Empty ${emptySlot} starter`}</p>
            <p className="truncate text-xs text-[#5e7090]">{player ? <>{player.team} · {player.opponent}{player.status && <span className="ml-1 font-black text-rose-300">{player.status}</span>}</> : "Select an eligible bench player"}</p>
          </div>
          {player && <span className="text-sm font-black tabular-nums text-white">proj {(player.schedule?.weekProjectedFantasyPoints ?? player.projPts).toFixed(1)}</span>}
        </div>

        <div className="max-h-[45vh] overflow-y-auto px-3 pb-5">
          <p className="px-1 py-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5e7090]">Eligible swap targets</p>
          {targets.map((option, index) => (
            <button key={`${option.slot}-${option.target?.id ?? index}`} type="button" onClick={() => {
              const movedPlayer = player ?? option.target
              if (!movedPlayer) return
              if (teamId && movedPlayer.nhlId) {
                void fetch("/api/roster/move", {
                  method: "POST",
                  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                  body: JSON.stringify({ teamId, playerId: movedPlayer.nhlId, targetSlot: option.slot }),
                }).then((response) => {
                  if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Could not update roster placement")
                  onMove(movedPlayer.id, option.slot, option.target?.id)
                  onOpenChange(false)
                }).catch((error: unknown) => console.error("Could not update roster placement", error))
                return
              }
              onMove(movedPlayer.id, option.slot, option.target?.id)
              onOpenChange(false)
            }} className="mb-1 flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-[#172338] bg-[#111c30] p-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-[#172338]">
              <span className={cn("flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-xs font-black", slotColors[option.slot as keyof typeof slotColors])}>{option.slot}</span>
              {option.target ? <><PlayerAvatar player={option.target} /><span className="min-w-0 flex-1"><b className="block truncate text-sm text-white">{option.target.name}</b><small className="text-xs text-[#5e7090]">{option.target.team} · {option.target.opponent}{option.detail ? ` · ${option.detail}` : ""}{option.target.status && <span className="ml-1 font-black text-rose-300">{option.target.status}</span>}</small></span><span className="text-xs font-black text-white">proj {(option.target.schedule?.weekProjectedFantasyPoints ?? option.target.projPts).toFixed(1)}</span></> : <span className="flex-1 text-sm font-bold text-white">{option.label}</span>}
            </button>
          ))}
          {!targets.length && <p className="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-[#34476a] px-3 py-5 text-center text-xs text-[#5e7090]">No eligible swap targets</p>}
        </div>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  )
}

import { getLeague, getLeagueStandings } from "@/lib/db/leagues"
import { getTeamDraftPickInventory } from "@/lib/db/picks"
import { getTeamRoster } from "@/lib/db/rosters"
import { initialDashboardData } from "@/lib/dashboard-data"
import { getLockSummary } from "@/lib/services/lineup-locks"
import { getCurrentFantasyWeek, getFantasyWeekDates } from "@/lib/season-calendar"
import { getPlayerSchedule, type NhlScheduleGame, type Player, type PlayerGameLog } from "@/lib/hockey-data"
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"
import { formatActivity } from "@/lib/activity-format"
import { getManagerSession } from "@/lib/auth-session"
import { PinGate, type PinGateTeam } from "@/components/auth/pin-gate"
import DashboardClient from "./dashboard-client"

function getOrdinal(n: number) {
  const s = ["th", "st", "nd", "rd"]
  const v = n % 100
  return n + (s[(v - 20) % 10] || s[v] || s[0])
}

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"

export default async function Page() {
  try {
    const league = await getLeague("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001")
    if (!league) return <DashboardClient initialData={initialDashboardData} />

    const gateTeams: PinGateTeam[] = league.teams.map((candidate) => ({
      id: candidate.id,
      name: candidate.name,
      managerId: candidate.manager.id,
      managerName: candidate.manager.name,
      managerHandle: candidate.manager.handle,
      isCommissioner: candidate.manager.isCommissioner,
      avatarUrl: candidate.manager.avatarUrl,
    }))
    const session = await getManagerSession()
    const team = session
      ? league.teams.find((candidate) => candidate.id === session?.teamId && candidate.managerId === session?.managerId)
      : undefined
    if (!team) return <PinGate teams={gateTeams} />

    const [rosterSlots, leagueStandings, pickInventory, activityRecords, allRosterSlots, matchupRows, lockSummary] = await Promise.all([
      getTeamRoster(team.id),
      getLeagueStandings(league.id, league.currentSeason),
      getTeamDraftPickInventory(team.id),
      prisma.activityLog.findMany({
        where: { leagueId: league.id },
        include: { team: { select: { name: true, manager: { select: { name: true, handle: true } } } } },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
        take: 20,
      }),
      prisma.rosterSlot.findMany({ where: { team: { leagueId: league.id } }, select: { playerId: true, slot: true, team: { select: { name: true } } } }),
      prisma.matchup.findMany({
        where: { leagueId: league.id, season: league.currentSeason, week: { lte: getCurrentFantasyWeek(league.currentSeason) } },
        select: { week: true, homeScore: true, awayScore: true, isFinal: true, homeTeam: { select: { name: true } }, awayTeam: { select: { name: true } } },
        orderBy: { week: "asc" },
      }),
      getLockSummary(league.currentSeason, league.lineupLockMode),
    ])
    const leagueRosters: Record<string, Array<{ nhlId: number; slot: string }>> = {}
    for (const entry of allRosterSlots) (leagueRosters[entry.team.name] ??= []).push({ nhlId: entry.playerId, slot: entry.slot })
    const { dates: fantasyWeekDates } = getFantasyWeekDates(getCurrentFantasyWeek(), league.currentSeason)
    const scheduleRecords = await prisma.nhlGame.findMany({
      where: { gameDate: { in: fantasyWeekDates } },
      orderBy: { startTimeUTC: "asc" },
    })
    const rosterPlayerIds = rosterSlots.map((slot) => slot.player.id)
    const playerGameStats = await prisma.playerGameStat.findMany({
      where: {
        playerId: { in: rosterPlayerIds },
        gameId: { in: scheduleRecords.map((game) => game.id) },
      },
    })
    const scheduleGames: NhlScheduleGame[] = scheduleRecords.map((game) => ({
      id: game.id,
      date: game.gameDate,
      day: new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { weekday: "short", timeZone: "UTC" }).format(new Date(`${game.gameDate}T12:00:00Z`)),
      gameState: game.gameState,
      startTimeUTC: game.startTimeUTC.toISOString(),
      awayTeam: { abbrev: game.awayTeamAbbrev, score: game.awayScore },
      homeTeam: { abbrev: game.homeTeamAbbrev, score: game.homeScore },
    }))
    const logsByPlayer = new Map<number, PlayerGameLog[]>()
    const gamesById = new Map(scheduleRecords.map((game) => [game.id, game]))
    const weekPointsByPlayer = new Map<number, number>()
    for (const stat of playerGameStats) {
      const game = gamesById.get(stat.gameId)
      if (!game) continue
      weekPointsByPlayer.set(stat.playerId, (weekPointsByPlayer.get(stat.playerId) ?? 0) + stat.fantasyPoints)
        const logs = logsByPlayer.get(stat.playerId) ?? []
        logs.push({
          gameId: game.id,
          gameDate: game.gameDate,
          goals: stat.goals,
          assists: stat.assists,
          shots: stat.shots,
          hits: stat.hits,
          blocks: stat.blocks,
          pim: stat.pim,
          points: stat.goals + stat.assists,
          plusMinus: stat.plusMinus,
          powerPlayPoints: stat.powerPlayPoints,
          shorthandedGoals: stat.shorthandedGoals,
          gameWinningGoals: stat.gameWinningGoals,
          toi: stat.toi,
          decision: stat.decision,
          shotsAgainst: stat.shotsAgainst,
          goalsAgainst: stat.goalsAgainst,
          savePctg: stat.savePct,
          shutouts: stat.shutouts,
          saves: stat.saves,
          fantasyPoints: stat.fantasyPoints,
        })
        logsByPlayer.set(stat.playerId, logs)
    }

    const fantasyWeek = getCurrentFantasyWeek()
    const roster: Player[] = rosterSlots.map((slot) => {
      const status = slot.player.injuryStatus === "HEALTHY" ? null : slot.player.injuryStatus
      const playerLogs = logsByPlayer.get(slot.player.id) ?? []
      const calculatedSchedule = getPlayerSchedule(slot.player.teamAbbrev, scheduleGames, playerLogs, slot.player.position, undefined, 0, fantasyWeek)
      const schedule = calculatedSchedule ?? {
        week: fantasyWeek,
        day: "—",
        date: fantasyWeekDates[0],
        time: "—",
        status: "Scheduled" as const,
        opponent: "—",
        home: false,
        weekFantasyPoints: 0,
        weekProjectedFantasyPoints: 0,
        weekGamesPlayed: 0,
        weekGamesScheduled: 0,
        todayFantasyPoints: null,
        isToday: false,
      }
      schedule.weekFantasyPoints = Number((weekPointsByPlayer.get(slot.player.id) ?? 0).toFixed(1))
      schedule.weekGamesPlayed = playerLogs.filter((game) => game.gameDate >= fantasyWeekDates[0] && game.gameDate <= fantasyWeekDates[fantasyWeekDates.length - 1]).length
      return {
        id: `nhl-${slot.player.id}`,
        nhlId: slot.player.id,
        name: slot.player.name,
        position: slot.player.position,
        slot: slot.slot === "IR_PLUS" ? "IR" : slot.slot,
        team: slot.player.teamAbbrev,
        opponent: schedule?.opponent ?? "—",
        gameTime: schedule ? `${schedule.day} ${schedule.time}` : "—",
        status,
        todayPts: schedule.todayFantasyPoints,
        projPts: schedule.weekProjectedFantasyPoints,
        schedule,
        gameLog: playerLogs,
        nhlGamesPlayed: slot.player.nhlGamesPlayed,
        headshot: slot.player.headshotUrl ?? undefined,
      }
    })

    return (
      <DashboardClient
        initialData={{
          ...initialDashboardData,
          leagueId: league.id,
          teamId: team.id,
          managerHandle: team.manager.handle,
          isCommissioner: session?.isCommissioner ?? false,
          teamName: team.name,
          teamLogo: team.logoUrl ?? undefined,
          userFaab: team.faabBalance,
          waiverPriority: team.waiverPriority,
          leagueRosters,
          matchupResults: matchupRows.map((row) => ({ week: row.week, homeTeam: row.homeTeam.name, awayTeam: row.awayTeam.name, homeScore: Number(row.homeScore ?? 0), awayScore: Number(row.awayScore ?? 0), isFinal: row.isFinal })),
          lineupLock: { mode: lockSummary.mode, locked: lockSummary.locked, week: lockSummary.week, firstGameAt: lockSummary.firstGameAt, weekEndDate: lockSummary.weekEndDate },
          roster,
          standings: leagueStandings?.map((row, index) => ({
            rank: index + 1,
            delta: null,
            team: row.team.name,
            owner: `@${row.team.manager.handle}`,
            wins: row.wins,
            losses: row.losses,
            pointsFor: row.pointsFor,
            pointsAgainst: row.pointsAgainst,
            faabRemaining: row.team.faabBalance,
            streak: row.streak,
          })) ?? initialDashboardData.standings,
          activities: activityRecords.map(formatActivity),
          league: {
            rosterPositions: (league.rosterPositions as Record<string, number> | null) ?? undefined,
            scoringSettings: (league.scoringSettings as Record<string, unknown>) ?? undefined,
            waiverSettings: (league.waiverSettings as Record<string, unknown> | null) ?? undefined,
            tradeSettings: (league.tradeSettings as Record<string, unknown> | null) ?? undefined,
            draftSettings: (league.draftSettings as Record<string, unknown> | null) ?? undefined,
            rosterSize: league.rosterSize,
            taxiSlots: league.taxiSlots,
            taxiMaxGames: league.taxiMaxGames,
            irSlots: league.irSlots,
            lineupLockMode: league.lineupLockMode === "DAILY" ? "DAILY" : "WEEKLY",
            currentWeek: league.currentWeek,
          },
          draftPicks: pickInventory.owned.map((pick) => `${pick.season} ${getOrdinal(pick.round)} Round`),
          draftPickAssets: pickInventory.owned.map((pick) => ({
            id: pick.id,
            label: `${pick.season} ${getOrdinal(pick.round)} Round`,
            detail: `Originally owned by ${pick.originalTeam.name}`,
          })),
        }}
      />
    )
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    console.error("Database dashboard hydration failed; using placeholder data", error)
    return <DashboardClient initialData={initialDashboardData} />
  }
}
</file>

<file path="components/hockey/matchup-panel.tsx">
"use client"

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { ChevronDown, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import {
  applyWeekLineup,
  DEFAULT_SLOT_CAPACITIES,
  STARTER_SLOTS,
  getTeamRoster,
  getWeekActualPoints,
  getWeekMatchups,
  getWeekProjectedPoints,
  isStarterSlot,
  type LiveMatchupSummary,
  type MatchupPlayer,
  type MarketPlayer,
  type MatchupSummary,
  type Player,
  type StarterSlot,
} from "@/lib/hockey-data"
import type { MatchupResult } from "@/lib/dashboard-data"
import { SwipePager, SwipeSurface } from "@/components/hockey/swipe-gestures"
import { LineupSlotDialog } from "@/components/hockey/lineup-slot-dialog"
import { MatchupBanner } from "@/components/hockey/matchup-banner"
import { PlayerRow } from "@/components/hockey/player-row"

type ReserveSlot = "BN" | "TAXI" | "IR"
/** A selected lineup player; `ownerName` is set when the player belongs to the opposing team. */
export type LineupPlayerSelection = Player & { ownerName?: string }

const slotColors: Record<StarterSlot, string> = {
  C: "bg-[#3b4cca]",
  W: "bg-[#0d9488]",
  F: "bg-[#7c3aed]",
  D: "bg-[#b45309]",
  G: "bg-[#0284c7]",
}
const statusStyles: Record<string, string> = {
  IR: "bg-[#3b1824] text-[#ff2a85]",
  TAXI: "bg-[#1a253b] text-[#5e7090]",
  O: "bg-[#3b1824] text-[#ff2a85]",
  DTD: "bg-amber-400/15 text-amber-300",
}

export function getYetToPlayText(teamRoster: Player[]): string {
  const counts: Record<StarterSlot, number> = { C: 0, W: 0, F: 0, D: 0, G: 0 }
  teamRoster
    .filter((player) => isStarterSlot(player.slot))
    .filter((player) => player.gameState !== "Final" && player.status !== "O" && player.status !== "IR")
    .forEach((player) => {
      counts[player.slot as StarterSlot] += 1
    })
  const parts = STARTER_SLOTS.filter((slot) => counts[slot] > 0).map((slot) => `${counts[slot]} ${slot}`)
  return `yet to play: ${parts.length ? parts.join(", ") : "none"}`
}

type WeekLineup = { frozen: boolean; assignments: Array<{ teamName: string; nhlId: number; slot: string }> } | null

function buildMatchupCard(
  summary: MatchupSummary,
  teamName: string,
  roster: Player[],
  players: MarketPlayer[] | undefined,
  week: number,
  weekLineup: WeekLineup,
  matchupResults: MatchupResult[],
) {
  const flip = summary.awayTeam === teamName
  const market = players ?? []
  const assignments = weekLineup?.assignments ?? null
  const frozen = weekLineup != null
  const trueHomeRoster = applyWeekLineup(summary.homeTeam, getTeamRoster(summary.homeTeam, roster, market), market, assignments, frozen)
  const trueAwayRoster = applyWeekLineup(summary.awayTeam, getTeamRoster(summary.awayTeam, roster, market), market, assignments, frozen)
  const starters = (list: Player[]) => list.filter((player) => isStarterSlot(player.slot))
  const expected = (list: Player[]) => starters(list).reduce((sum, player) => sum + (getWeekProjectedPoints(player, week) ?? 0), 0)
  const actual = (list: Player[]) => starters(list).reduce((sum, player) => sum + getWeekActualPoints(player, week), 0)
  const gamesLeft = (list: Player[]) => starters(list).filter((player) => player.gameState !== "Final").length
  const finalResult = matchupResults.find((result) => result.week === week && result.isFinal && result.homeTeam === summary.homeTeam && result.awayTeam === summary.awayTeam)
  const trueHomeScore = finalResult ? finalResult.homeScore : actual(trueHomeRoster)
  const trueAwayScore = finalResult ? finalResult.awayScore : actual(trueAwayRoster)
  const trueProjectedHome = expected(trueHomeRoster)
  const trueProjectedAway = expected(trueAwayRoster)
  const trueHomeGamesLeft = gamesLeft(trueHomeRoster)
  const trueAwayGamesLeft = gamesLeft(trueAwayRoster)
  const display = flip
    ? {
        ...summary,
        homeTeam: summary.awayTeam,
        homeOwner: summary.awayOwner,
        homeRecord: summary.awayRecord,
        homeScore: summary.awayScore,
        awayTeam: summary.homeTeam,
        awayOwner: summary.homeOwner,
        awayRecord: summary.homeRecord,
        awayScore: summary.homeScore,
      }
    : summary
  const status = finalResult ? "Final" : summary.status
  return {
    id: summary.id,
    isUserMatchup: summary.homeTeam === teamName || summary.awayTeam === teamName,
    homeRoster: flip ? trueAwayRoster : trueHomeRoster,
    awayRoster: flip ? trueHomeRoster : trueAwayRoster,
    banner: {
      ...display,
      homeScore: flip ? trueAwayScore : trueHomeScore,
      awayScore: flip ? trueHomeScore : trueAwayScore,
      status,
    },
    projectedHome: flip ? trueProjectedAway : trueProjectedHome,
    projectedAway: flip ? trueProjectedHome : trueProjectedAway,
    homeGamesLeft: flip ? trueAwayGamesLeft : trueHomeGamesLeft,
    awayGamesLeft: flip ? trueHomeGamesLeft : trueAwayGamesLeft,
    live: {
      ...summary,
      homeScore: trueHomeScore,
      awayScore: trueAwayScore,
      status,
      projectedHome: trueProjectedHome,
      projectedAway: trueProjectedAway,
    },
  }
}

function emptyPlayer(slot: StarterSlot): MatchupPlayer {
  return {
    name: "",
    position: slot === "W" || slot === "F" ? "C" : slot,
    team: "",
    opponent: "",
    status: null,
    todayPts: null,
    projPts: 0,
    empty: true,
  }
}

const PlayerSide = React.memo(function PlayerSide({
  player,
  align,
  onSelect,
  nickname,
}: {
  player: MatchupPlayer
  align: "left" | "right"
  onSelect: (player: MatchupPlayer) => void
  nickname?: string
}) {
  if (player.empty) {
    return <div className={cn("min-w-0 text-xs text-[#5e7090]", align === "left" ? "text-right" : "text-left")}>Empty slot</div>
  }
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      data-testid={align === "right" ? "away-player" : "home-player"}
      onClick={() => onSelect(player)}
      className={cn("w-full min-w-0 rounded-md px-1 py-1 hover:bg-[#101a2e]", align === "left" ? "text-right" : "text-left")}
    >
      <div className={cn("flex items-center gap-1.5", align === "left" ? "justify-end" : "justify-start")}>
        {align === "left" && player.status && <span className={cn("rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs font-black", statusStyles[player.status])}>{player.status}</span>}
        <span className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-white">{player.name}</span>
        {align === "right" && player.status && <span className={cn("rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs font-black", statusStyles[player.status])}>{player.status}</span>}
      </div>
      {nickname && <p className="truncate text-xs italic text-[#5e7090]">{nickname}</p>}
      <p className="truncate text-xs text-[#5e7090]">
        {player.schedule
          ? align === "left"
            ? `${player.schedule.day} ${player.schedule.time} · ${player.schedule.opponent} · ${player.team}`
            : `${player.team} · ${player.schedule.opponent} · ${player.schedule.day} ${player.schedule.time}`
          : "No game this week"}
      </p>
    </button>
  )
})

/** Points actually scored this week. Unplayed games, missing schedules and other-week schedules are always 0.0. */
export function getActualPoints(player: MatchupPlayer | Player | null, week?: number): string {
  if (!player) return "—"
  return getWeekActualPoints(player, week).toFixed(1)
}

/** Weekly projection, shown separately from actual points. */
export function getProjectedPoints(player: MatchupPlayer | Player | null, week?: number): string {
  if (!player) return "—"
  const projected = getWeekProjectedPoints(player, week)
  return projected === null ? "—" : projected.toFixed(1)
}

const Score = React.memo(function Score({ player, align, week }: { player: MatchupPlayer; align: "left" | "right"; week: number }) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("w-full shrink-0", align === "left" ? "pr-2 text-right" : "pl-2 text-left")}>
      <p className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums text-white">{player.empty ? "—" : getActualPoints(player, week)}</p>
      <p className="text-xs leading-tight text-[#5e7090]">
        <span className="block">proj</span>
        <span className="block tabular-nums">{player.empty ? "—" : getProjectedPoints(player, week)}</span>
      </p>
    </div>
  )
})

const PlayerStats = React.memo(function PlayerStats({ player, align }: { player: MatchupPlayer; align: "left" | "right" }) {
  const game = player.gameLog?.find((entry) => entry.gameDate === player.schedule?.date) ?? player.gameLog?.[0]
  const current = player.currentSeasonStats
  const stats = player.position === "G"
    ? [
        game?.decision === "W" || (!game && (current?.wins ?? 0) > 0) ? `${game ? "W" : current?.wins} W` : null,
        game ? game.shotsAgainst - game.goalsAgainst > 0 ? `${game.shotsAgainst - game.goalsAgainst} SV` : null : (current?.saves ?? 0) > 0 ? `${current?.saves} SV` : null,
        game ? game.goalsAgainst > 0 ? `${game.goalsAgainst} GA` : null : (current?.goalsAgainst ?? 0) > 0 ? `${current?.goalsAgainst} GA` : null,
        game ? game.shutouts > 0 ? `${game.shutouts} SO` : null : (current?.shutouts ?? 0) > 0 ? `${current?.shutouts} SO` : null,
      ].filter(Boolean).join(", ")
    : [
        game ? game.goals > 0 ? `${game.goals} G` : null : (current?.goals ?? 0) > 0 ? `${current?.goals} G` : null,
        game ? game.assists > 0 ? `${game.assists} A` : null : (current?.assists ?? 0) > 0 ? `${current?.assists} A` : null,
        game ? game.shots > 0 ? `${game.shots} SOG` : null : (current?.shots ?? 0) > 0 ? `${current?.shots} SOG` : null,
        game ? game.hits > 0 ? `${game.hits} HIT` : null : (current?.hits ?? 0) > 0 ? `${current?.hits} HIT` : null,
        game ? game.blocks > 0 ? `${game.blocks} BLK` : null : (current?.blocks ?? 0) > 0 ? `${current?.blocks} BLK` : null,
        game ? game.gameWinningGoals > 0 ? `${game.gameWinningGoals} GWG` : null : (current?.gameWinningGoals ?? 0) > 0 ? `${current?.gameWinningGoals} GWG` : null,
      ].filter(Boolean).join(", ")
  return (
    <p className={cn("truncate text-xs text-[#5e7090]", align === "left" ? "text-right" : "text-left")}>
      {stats || "No game stats"}
    </p>
  )
})

const Reserves = React.memo(function Reserves({
  homeRoster,
  awayRoster,
  teamName,
  opponentName,
  onEdit,
  onSelectHome,
  onSelectAway,
}: {
  homeRoster: Player[]
  awayRoster: Player[]
  teamName: string
  opponentName: string
  onEdit: (player: Player) => void
  onSelectHome: (player: Player) => void
  onSelectAway: (player: Player) => void
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(true)
  const groups: Array<{ slot: ReserveSlot; label: string }> = [
    { slot: "BN", label: "Bench" },
    { slot: "TAXI", label: "Taxi Squad" },
    { slot: "IR", label: "Injured Reserve" },
  ]
  return (
    <section className="overflow-hidden border-y border-[#111929] bg-[#080c14]">
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)} aria-expanded={open} className="flex w-full items-center justify-between border-b border-[#111929] px-3 py-3 text-left">
        <span><b className="block text-sm text-white">Bench & Reserves</b><small className="text-xs text-[#5e7090]">BN · TAXI · IR</small></span>
        <ChevronDown className={cn("size-5 text-[#5e7090] transition-transform", open && "rotate-180")} />
      </button>
      {open && (
        <>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 border-b border-[#111929] px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#5e7090]"><span>{teamName}</span><span className="text-right">{opponentName}</span></div>
          {groups.map(({ slot, label }) => {
            const home = homeRoster.filter((player) => player.slot === slot)
            const away = awayRoster.filter((player) => player.slot === slot)
            return (
              <div key={slot} className="grid grid-cols-2 border-b border-[#111929] last:border-0">
                <div className="border-r border-[#111929]">
                  <p className="px-3 py-2 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5e7090]">{label}</p>
                  {home.length ? home.map((player) => <PlayerRow key={player.id} player={player} onSelect={onSelectHome} onEditSlot={() => onEdit(player)} />) : <p className="px-3 pb-3 text-xs text-[#5e7090]">Empty</p>}
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="px-3 py-2 text-right text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5e7090]">{label}</p>
                  {away.length ? away.map((player) => <PlayerRow key={player.id} player={player} onSelect={onSelectAway} />) : <p className="px-3 pb-3 text-right text-xs text-[#5e7090]">Empty</p>}
                </div>
              </div>
            )
          })}
        </>
      )}
    </section>
  )
})

export const MatchupPanel = React.memo(function MatchupPanel({
  roster,
  players,
  teamName,
  playerNicknames,
  slotCapacities = DEFAULT_SLOT_CAPACITIES,
  onMove,
  onSelectPlayer,
  onEditSlot,
  week,
  onWeekChange,
  selectedMatchupId: controlledMatchupId,
  onMatchupChange,
  onLiveSummary,
  matchupResults = [],
  weekLineup = null,
}: {
  roster: Player[]
  players?: MarketPlayer[]
  teamName: string
  playerNicknames: Record<string, string>
  slotCapacities?: Record<StarterSlot, number>
  onMove: (playerId: string, destSlot: Player["slot"], targetPlayerId?: string) => void
  onSelectPlayer?: (player: LineupPlayerSelection) => void
  onEditSlot?: (player: Player) => void
  week: number
  onWeekChange: (week: number) => void
  selectedMatchupId?: string
  onMatchupChange?: (matchupId: string) => void
  onLiveSummary?: (summary: LiveMatchupSummary) => void
  matchupResults?: MatchupResult[]
  weekLineup?: { frozen: boolean; assignments: Array<{ teamName: string; nhlId: number; slot: string }> } | null
}) {
  const weekSchedule = useMemo(() => getWeekMatchups(week), [week])
  const userMatchup = useMemo(
    () => weekSchedule.find((matchup) => matchup.homeTeam === teamName || matchup.awayTeam === teamName) ?? weekSchedule[0],
    [weekSchedule, teamName],
  )
  const [localMatchupId, setLocalMatchupId] = useState(userMatchup.id)
  // A controlled id from a different week must never be rendered: fall back to the user's matchup.
  const selectedMatchupId = controlledMatchupId && weekSchedule.some((matchup) => matchup.id === controlledMatchupId)
    ? controlledMatchupId
    : controlledMatchupId === undefined && weekSchedule.some((matchup) => matchup.id === localMatchupId)
      ? localMatchupId
      : userMatchup.id
  const [editingPlayer, setEditingPlayer] = useState<Player | null>(null)

  const setSelectedMatchupId = useCallback((id: string) => {
    if (controlledMatchupId === undefined) setLocalMatchupId(id)
    onMatchupChange?.(id)
  }, [controlledMatchupId, onMatchupChange])

  // Snap back to the user's own matchup when the week changes (but not on first mount,
  // so a matchup chosen from the league feed is preserved).
  const previousWeek = useRef(week)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (previousWeek.current === week) return
    previousWeek.current = week
    setSelectedMatchupId(userMatchup.id)
  }, [week, userMatchup.id, setSelectedMatchupId])

  const matchupIndex = Math.max(0, weekSchedule.findIndex((matchup) => matchup.id === selectedMatchupId))
  const cards = useMemo(
    () => weekSchedule.map((summary) => buildMatchupCard(summary, teamName, roster, players, week, weekLineup, matchupResults)),
    [matchupResults, players, roster, teamName, week, weekLineup, weekSchedule],
  )
  const card = cards[matchupIndex] ?? cards[0]
  const homeRoster = card?.homeRoster ?? []
  const awayRoster = card?.awayRoster ?? []
  const isUserMatchup = card?.isUserMatchup ?? false

  const rows = useMemo(() => STARTER_SLOTS.flatMap((slot) => {
    const homePlayers = homeRoster.filter((player) => player.slot === slot)
    const awayPlayers = awayRoster.filter((player) => player.slot === slot)
    return Array.from({ length: slotCapacities[slot] ?? 0 }, (_, index) => ({
      slot,
      home: (homePlayers[index] ?? emptyPlayer(slot)) as MatchupPlayer,
      away: (awayPlayers[index] ?? emptyPlayer(slot)) as MatchupPlayer,
      homeSource: homePlayers[index] as Player | undefined,
      awaySource: awayPlayers[index] as Player | undefined,
    }))
  }), [awayRoster, homeRoster, slotCapacities])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!card) return
    onLiveSummary?.(card.live)
  }, [card, onLiveSummary])

  const selectMatchup = useCallback((index: number) => {
    const matchup = weekSchedule[index]
    if (matchup) setSelectedMatchupId(matchup.id)
  }, [setSelectedMatchupId, weekSchedule])
  const previousMatchup = () => selectMatchup((matchupIndex === 0 ? weekSchedule.length : matchupIndex) - 1)
  const nextMatchup = () => selectMatchup((matchupIndex + 1) % weekSchedule.length)

  const selectHome = useCallback((player: Player) => onSelectPlayer?.(player), [onSelectPlayer])
  const selectAway = useCallback((player: Player) => onSelectPlayer?.({ ...player, ownerName: card?.banner.awayTeam }), [card?.banner.awayTeam, onSelectPlayer])
  const startEdit = useCallback((player: Player) => {
    if (!isUserMatchup) return
    if (onEditSlot) onEditSlot(player)
    else setEditingPlayer(player)
  }, [isUserMatchup, onEditSlot])
  const noopEdit = useCallback(() => undefined, [])

  if (!card) return null

  return (
    <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3 pb-16">
      <SwipePager zone="matchup" activeIndex={matchupIndex} itemCount={weekSchedule.length} onIndexChange={selectMatchup} peekPx={14} gapPx={10} className="min-w-0 px-3">
        {cards.map((entry, index) => (
          <div key={entry.id} aria-hidden={index === matchupIndex ? undefined : true} className="h-full">
            <MatchupBanner summary={entry.banner} projectedHome={entry.projectedHome} projectedAway={entry.projectedAway} week={week} homeGamesLeft={entry.homeGamesLeft} awayGamesLeft={entry.awayGamesLeft} active={index === matchupIndex} />
          </div>
        ))}
      </SwipePager>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 px-3 text-[11px] font-semibold leading-snug text-[#8ba0c7]">
        <p className="min-w-0">{getYetToPlayText(homeRoster)}</p>
        <p className="min-w-0 text-right">{getYetToPlayText(awayRoster)}</p>
      </div>
      <div data-swipe-ignore="true" className="flex touch-pan-x items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto px-3 pb-1" aria-label="League matchups">
        <button type="button" onClick={previousMatchup} aria-label="Previous matchup" className="shrink-0 text-[#5e7090]"><ChevronLeft className="size-4" /></button>
        {weekSchedule.map((matchup, index) => (
          <button key={matchup.id} type="button" onClick={() => selectMatchup(index)} aria-label={`Matchup ${index + 1}: ${matchup.homeTeam} vs ${matchup.awayTeam}`} className={cn("flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2 py-1 text-xs font-black", matchup.id === selectedMatchupId ? "border-[#19ffff] bg-[#19ffff]/10 text-[#19ffff]" : "border-[#172338] bg-[#0d1424] text-[#5e7090]")}>
            <span className="flex size-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#172338] text-xs">{matchup.homeTeam.slice(0, 1)}</span>
            <span>vs</span>
            <span className="flex size-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#3b1824] text-xs">{matchup.awayTeam.slice(0, 1)}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
        <button type="button" onClick={nextMatchup} aria-label="Next matchup" className="shrink-0 text-[#5e7090]"><ChevronRight className="size-4" /></button>
      </div>
      <section className="overflow-hidden border-y border-[#111929] bg-[#080c14]">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#111929] px-3 py-3">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-white">Starters ({rows.filter((row) => !row.home.empty).length}) <ChevronDown className="inline size-3.5 text-[#5e7090]" /></h2>
          <SwipeSurface zone="week" onSwipeLeft={() => onWeekChange(week + 1)} onSwipeRight={() => onWeekChange(Math.max(1, week - 1))} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-[#19ffff]">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => onWeekChange(Math.max(1, week - 1))} aria-label="Previous scoring week" className="rounded p-1 hover:bg-[#172338]">
              <ChevronLeft className="size-3.5" />
            </button>
            <span>Week {week}</span>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => onWeekChange(week + 1)} aria-label="Next scoring week" className="rounded p-1 hover:bg-[#172338]">
              <ChevronRight className="size-3.5" />
            </button>
          </SwipeSurface>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 border-b border-[#111929] px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#5e7090]"><span className="min-w-0 truncate text-left">{card.banner.homeTeam}</span><span className="min-w-0 truncate text-right">{card.banner.awayTeam}</span></div>
        {rows.map((row, index) => (
          <div key={`${row.slot}-${index}`} className="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_44px_34px_44px_minmax(0,1fr)] items-center border-b border-[#111929] bg-[#0d1424] px-2 py-2 last:border-0 hover:bg-[#101a2e]">
            <div className="min-w-0 text-right">
              <PlayerSide
                player={row.home}
                align="left"
                onSelect={() => row.homeSource && selectHome(row.homeSource)}
                nickname={row.homeSource ? playerNicknames[row.homeSource.id] : undefined}
              />
              {!row.home.empty && <PlayerStats player={row.home} align="left" />}
            </div>
            <Score player={row.home} align="left" week={week} />
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={row.home.empty || !isUserMatchup}
              onClick={() => row.homeSource && startEdit(row.homeSource)}
              className={cn("flex h-7 min-w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md px-1 text-xs font-black text-white", slotColors[row.slot], (row.home.empty || !isUserMatchup) && "cursor-default opacity-40")}
            >{row.slot}</button>
            <Score player={row.away} align="right" week={week} />
            <div className="min-w-0 text-left">
              <PlayerSide
                player={row.away}
                align="right"
                onSelect={() => row.awaySource && selectAway(row.awaySource)}
              />
              {!row.away.empty && <PlayerStats player={row.away} align="right" />}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </section>
      <Reserves homeRoster={homeRoster} awayRoster={awayRoster} teamName={card.banner.homeTeam} opponentName={card.banner.awayTeam} onEdit={isUserMatchup ? startEdit : noopEdit} onSelectHome={selectHome} onSelectAway={selectAway} />

      <LineupSlotDialog player={editingPlayer} roster={roster} capacities={slotCapacities} open={editingPlayer !== null} onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setEditingPlayer(null)} onMove={(playerId, destSlot, targetPlayerId) => { onMove(playerId, destSlot, targetPlayerId); setEditingPlayer(null) }} />
    </div>
  )
})
</file>

<file path="lib/hockey-data.ts">
import { DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING, scoreCountingLine } from "@/lib/scoring"
import { getFantasyWeekDates, getCurrentFantasyWeek } from "./season-calendar"

export type PlayerStatus = "IR" | "TAXI" | "O" | "DTD" | null
export type RosterSlot = "C" | "W" | "F" | "D" | "G" | "BN" | "TAXI" | "IR"
/** Taxi squad eligibility: a player must have played fewer than this many NHL games. */
export const TAXI_MAX_NHL_GAMES = 50
/** Total roster capacity used for waiver/drop rules (open bench spot while below this). */
export const DEFAULT_ROSTER_SIZE = 27

export type StarterSlot = "C" | "W" | "F" | "D" | "G"
export const STARTER_SLOTS: readonly StarterSlot[] = ["C", "W", "F", "D", "G"]
export const DEFAULT_SLOT_CAPACITIES: Record<StarterSlot, number> = { C: 3, W: 6, F: 3, D: 6, G: 2 }
export function isStarterSlot(slot: string): slot is StarterSlot {
  return (STARTER_SLOTS as readonly string[]).includes(slot)
}

export interface PlayerPortraitSource {
  name?: string
  nhlId?: number
  headshot?: string
}

export interface PlayerSchedule {
  /** Fantasy week this schedule's weekly totals were computed for. */
  week?: number
  day: string
  date: string
  time: string
  status: "Scheduled" | "Live" | "Final"
  opponent: string
  home: boolean
  score?: string
  weekFantasyPoints: number
  weekProjectedFantasyPoints: number
  /** Games this player has already logged during the fantasy week. */
  weekGamesPlayed: number
  /** Games the player's team has on the NHL schedule during the fantasy week. */
  weekGamesScheduled: number
  todayFantasyPoints: number | null
  isToday: boolean
}

export interface NhlScheduleGame {
  id: number
  date: string
  day: string
  gameState: string
  startTimeUTC: string
  awayTeam: { abbrev: string; score?: number | null }
  homeTeam: { abbrev: string; score?: number | null }
}

export function getPlayerSchedule(team: string, games: NhlScheduleGame[], gameLog: PlayerGameLog[] = [], position: Player["position"] = "C", seasonStats?: Record<string, number>, fallbackProjection = 0, fantasyWeek = getCurrentFantasyWeek()): PlayerSchedule | undefined {
  const teamGames = games.filter((game) => game.awayTeam.abbrev === team || game.homeTeam.abbrev === team)
  const today = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", { timeZone: "America/New_York" }).format(new Date())
  const currentNhlGame = teamGames.find((game) => game.date === today)
  const teamGame = currentNhlGame ?? teamGames.find((game) => game.date > today) ?? teamGames.at(-1)
  if (!teamGame) return undefined
  const home = teamGame.homeTeam.abbrev === team
  const status = teamGame.gameState === "LIVE" ? "Live" : ["FINAL", "OFF"].includes(teamGame.gameState) ? "Final" : "Scheduled"
  const day = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { weekday: "short", timeZone: "America/New_York" }).format(new Date(teamGame.startTimeUTC)).toUpperCase()
  const time = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", timeZone: "America/New_York" }).format(new Date(teamGame.startTimeUTC))
  const { startDate, endDate } = getFantasyWeekDates(fantasyWeek)
  const weekTeamGames = teamGames.filter((game) => {
    return game.date >= startDate && game.date <= endDate
  })
  const weekGames = gameLog.filter((game) => {
    return game.gameDate >= startDate && game.gameDate <= endDate
  })
  const calculateGame = (game: PlayerGameLog) => pointsForGameLog(game, position)
  const weekFantasyPoints = weekGames.reduce((total, game) => total + calculateGame(game), 0)
  const sumLog = (key: keyof PlayerGameLog) => gameLog.reduce((total, game) => total + (Number(game[key]) || 0), 0)
  const statTotal = (key: string, logKey: keyof PlayerGameLog) => seasonStats?.[key] ?? sumLog(logKey)
  const goalieWins = seasonStats?.wins ?? gameLog.filter((game) => game.decision === "W").length
  const goalieOtLosses = typeof seasonStats?.otLosses === "number"
    ? seasonStats.otLosses
    : gameLog.filter((game) => game.decision === "OT" || game.decision === "OTL").length
  const goalieSaves = seasonStats?.saves ?? gameLog.reduce((total, game) => total + loggedSaves(game), 0)
  const goalieGoalsAgainst = seasonStats?.goalsAgainst ?? sumLog("goalsAgainst")
  const goalieSavePct = seasonStats?.savePct ?? (sumLog("shotsAgainst") > 0 ? goalieSaves / sumLog("shotsAgainst") : 0)
  const gamesPlayed = Math.max(1, seasonStats?.gamesPlayed ?? gameLog.length)
  const seasonAverageGamePoints = position === "G"
    ? calculateGoalieFPTS({
        gp: 1,
        wins: goalieWins / gamesPlayed,
        otLosses: goalieOtLosses / gamesPlayed,
        saves: goalieSaves / gamesPlayed,
        goalsAgainst: goalieGoalsAgainst / gamesPlayed,
        shutouts: statTotal("shutouts", "shutouts") / gamesPlayed,
        savePct: goalieSavePct,
        goals: statTotal("goals", "goals") / gamesPlayed,
        assists: statTotal("assists", "assists") / gamesPlayed,
        sog: statTotal("shots", "shots") / gamesPlayed,
        hits: statTotal("hits", "hits") / gamesPlayed,
        blocks: statTotal("blocks", "blocks") / gamesPlayed,
        ppp: statTotal("powerPlayPoints", "powerPlayPoints") / gamesPlayed,
        shg: statTotal("shorthandedGoals", "shorthandedGoals") / gamesPlayed,
        gwg: statTotal("gameWinningGoals", "gameWinningGoals") / gamesPlayed,
        plusMinus: statTotal("plusMinus", "plusMinus") / gamesPlayed,
      })
    : calculateSkaterFPTS({
        gp: 1,
        goals: statTotal("goals", "goals") / gamesPlayed,
        assists: statTotal("assists", "assists") / gamesPlayed,
        sog: statTotal("shots", "shots") / gamesPlayed,
        hits: statTotal("hits", "hits") / gamesPlayed,
        blocks: statTotal("blocks", "blocks") / gamesPlayed,
        ppp: statTotal("powerPlayPoints", "powerPlayPoints") / gamesPlayed,
        shg: statTotal("shorthandedGoals", "shorthandedGoals") / gamesPlayed,
        gwg: statTotal("gameWinningGoals", "gameWinningGoals") / gamesPlayed,
        plusMinus: statTotal("plusMinus", "plusMinus") / gamesPlayed,
      })
  const recentGames = gameLog
    .filter((game) => game.gameDate <= today)
    .sort((a, b) => b.gameDate.localeCompare(a.gameDate))
    .slice(0, 10)
  const recentAverageGamePoints = recentGames.length
    ? recentGames.reduce((total, game) => total + calculateGame(game), 0) / recentGames.length
    : seasonAverageGamePoints
  const statisticalAverage = seasonAverageGamePoints > 0 || recentAverageGamePoints > 0
    ? seasonAverageGamePoints * 0.7 + recentAverageGamePoints * 0.3
    : fallbackProjection
  const blendedAverageGamePoints = statisticalAverage > 0 ? statisticalAverage : fallbackProjection
  const completedWeekDates = new Set(weekGames.map((game) => game.gameDate))
  const remainingWeekGames = weekTeamGames.filter((game) => game.date > today || (game.date === today && !completedWeekDates.has(game.date))).length
  // With no stats at all, `fallbackProjection` is a whole-week placeholder (not a per-game rate).
  const hasStatistics = statisticalAverage > 0
  const weekProjection = hasStatistics
    ? weekFantasyPoints + blendedAverageGamePoints * remainingWeekGames
    : weekFantasyPoints + fallbackProjection * (weekTeamGames.length > 0 ? remainingWeekGames / weekTeamGames.length : 0)
  const todayGame = gameLog.find((game) => game.gameDate === today)
  const teamScore = home ? teamGame.homeTeam.score : teamGame.awayTeam.score
  const opponentScore = home ? teamGame.awayTeam.score : teamGame.homeTeam.score
  return {
    week: fantasyWeek,
    day,
    date: teamGame.date,
    time,
    status,
    opponent: `${home ? "vs" : "@"} ${home ? teamGame.awayTeam.abbrev : teamGame.homeTeam.abbrev}`,
    home,
    score: teamScore != null && opponentScore != null ? `${teamScore}-${opponentScore}` : undefined,
    weekFantasyPoints: Number(weekFantasyPoints.toFixed(1)),
    weekProjectedFantasyPoints: Number(weekProjection.toFixed(1)),
    weekGamesPlayed: weekGames.length,
    weekGamesScheduled: weekTeamGames.length,
    todayFantasyPoints: todayGame ? Number(calculateGame(todayGame).toFixed(1)) : null,
    isToday: currentNhlGame !== undefined,
  }
}

export function getPlayerPhoto(playerOrName?: string | PlayerPortraitSource): string {
  if (!playerOrName) return ""

  if (typeof playerOrName === "object" && playerOrName.headshot) {
    return playerOrName.headshot
  }

  if (typeof playerOrName === "object" && playerOrName.nhlId) {
    return `https://assets.nhle.com/mugs/nhl/latest/${playerOrName.nhlId}.png`
  }

  const name = typeof playerOrName === "string" ? playerOrName : playerOrName.name
  return name ? `/api/headshot?name=${encodeURIComponent(name)}` : ""
}

export interface SkaterStats {
  gp: number
  goals: number
  assists: number
  sog: number
  hits: number
  blocks: number
  ppp?: number
  shg?: number
  gwg?: number
  plusMinus?: number
}

export interface GoalieStats {
  gp: number
  wins: number
  saves: number
  goalsAgainst: number
  shutouts: number
  savePct?: number
  otLosses?: number
  goals?: number
  assists?: number
  sog?: number
  hits?: number
  blocks?: number
  ppp?: number
  shg?: number
  gwg?: number
  plusMinus?: number
}

function displayFpts(total: number): number {
  return Number(total.toFixed(1))
}

export function calculateSkaterFPTS(s: SkaterStats): number {
  return displayFpts(scoreCountingLine({
    goals: s.goals,
    assists: s.assists,
    shots: s.sog,
    hits: s.hits,
    blocks: s.blocks,
    plusMinus: s.plusMinus,
    powerPlayPoints: s.ppp,
    shorthandedGoals: s.shg,
    gameWinningGoals: s.gwg,
  }, DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING))
}

export function calculateGoalieFPTS(g: GoalieStats): number {
  return displayFpts(scoreCountingLine({
    goals: g.goals,
    assists: g.assists,
    shots: g.sog,
    hits: g.hits,
    blocks: g.blocks,
    plusMinus: g.plusMinus,
    powerPlayPoints: g.ppp,
    shorthandedGoals: g.shg,
    gameWinningGoals: g.gwg,
    wins: g.wins,
    overtimeLosses: g.otLosses,
    saves: g.saves,
    goalsAgainst: g.goalsAgainst,
    shutouts: g.shutouts,
  }, DEFAULT_LEAGUE_SCORING))
}

function loggedSaves(game: PlayerGameLog): number {
  return typeof game.saves === "number" && Number.isFinite(game.saves) ? game.saves : game.shotsAgainst - game.goalsAgainst
}

function pointsForGameLog(game: PlayerGameLog, position: Player["position"]): number {
  if (typeof game.fantasyPoints === "number" && Number.isFinite(game.fantasyPoints)) return game.fantasyPoints
  if (position === "G") {
    return calculateGoalieFPTS({
      gp: 1,
      wins: game.decision === "W" ? 1 : 0,
      otLosses: game.decision === "OT" || game.decision === "OTL" ? 1 : 0,
      saves: loggedSaves(game),
      goalsAgainst: game.goalsAgainst,
      shutouts: game.shutouts,
      savePct: game.savePctg ?? 0,
      goals: game.goals,
      assists: game.assists,
      sog: game.shots,
      hits: game.hits,
      blocks: game.blocks,
      ppp: game.powerPlayPoints,
      shg: game.shorthandedGoals,
      gwg: game.gameWinningGoals,
      plusMinus: game.plusMinus,
    })
  }
  return calculateSkaterFPTS({
    gp: 1,
    goals: game.goals,
    assists: game.assists,
    sog: game.shots,
    hits: game.hits,
    blocks: game.blocks,
    ppp: game.powerPlayPoints,
    shg: game.shorthandedGoals,
    gwg: game.gameWinningGoals,
    plusMinus: game.plusMinus,
  })
}

export function createPlayerSeasonStats(player: Pick<Player, "id" | "name" | "position">): SkaterStats | GoalieStats {
  const seed = [...player.id].reduce((total, character) => total + character.charCodeAt(0), 0)
  if (player.position === "G") {
    const gp = 17 + seed % 7
    const wins = 9 + seed % 8
    const shutouts = 2 + seed % 3
    const saves = 420 + seed % 145
    return { gp, wins, saves, goalsAgainst: Math.round(saves * 0.085), shutouts, savePct: Number((0.91 + (seed % 18) / 1000).toFixed(3)) }
  }
  const defense = player.position === "D"
  const gp = 21 + seed % 5
  const goals = (defense ? 3 : 8) + seed % (defense ? 6 : 9)
  const assists = (defense ? 14 : 12) + seed % 14
  const sog = (defense ? 40 : 50) + seed % (defense ? 31 : 46)
  const hits = (defense ? 25 : 20) + seed % 26
  const blocks = (defense ? 30 : 10) + seed % 26
  return { gp, goals, assists, sog, hits, blocks, ppp: 2 + seed % 8, shg: seed % 2, gwg: 1 + seed % 3 }
}

export function calculatePlayerFPTS(player: Pick<Player, "position" | "stats">): number {
  const stats = player.stats ?? createPlayerSeasonStats({ id: "generated", name: "Generated Player", position: player.position })
  return player.position === "G" ? calculateGoalieFPTS(stats as GoalieStats) : calculateSkaterFPTS(stats as SkaterStats)
}

function createTeamRoster(teamName: string, names: string[]): Player[] {
  const teamCode = {
    "Toronto Titans": "TOR",
    "Vancouver Voyagers": "VAN",
    "Calgary Comets": "CGY",
    "Ottawa Outlaws": "OTT",
    "Team WisconsinVVB": "EDM",
    "Detroit Motors": "DET",
    "Boston Blades": "BOS",
    "Colorado Summit": "COL",
    "Florida Waves": "FLA",
    "Daejon Love's Team": "MIN",
    "Tampa Bay Bolts": "TBL",
  }[teamName] ?? "NHL"
  return names.map((name, index) => {
    const slotInfo = starterSlots[index]
    return {
      id: `${teamCode.toLowerCase()}-${index + 1}`,
      name,
      position: slotInfo.position,
      slot: slotInfo.slot,
      team: teamCode,
      opponent: index % 2 === 0 ? "vs MTL" : "@ MTL",
      gameTime: "7:00 PM",
      status: null,
      todayPts: null,
      projPts: 0,
      gameState: "Pre-game",
      timeRemaining: 60,
    }
  })
}

const dedicatedTeamRosters: Record<string, Player[]> = Object.fromEntries(
  Object.entries(teamStarterNames).map(([teamName, names]) => [teamName, createTeamRoster(teamName, names)]),
)

export type LeagueRosterEntry = { nhlId: number; slot: string }
const leagueContext: { userTeamName: string; rosters: Record<string, LeagueRosterEntry[]> } = { userTeamName: "Montreal Monarchs", rosters: {} }

/**
 * Registers the authoritative (database) rosters for every team so opponent lineups, free-agent
 * filtering and trade partners all agree. Called once per render of the dashboard with server data.
 */
export function setLeagueContext(userTeamName: string, rosters: Record<string, LeagueRosterEntry[]> | undefined) {
  leagueContext.userTeamName = userTeamName
  leagueContext.rosters = rosters ?? {}
}

function playerFromMarket(entry: LeagueRosterEntry, market: MarketPlayer): Player {
  const slot = (entry.slot === "IR_PLUS" ? "IR" : entry.slot) as RosterSlot
  return {
    id: `nhl-${entry.nhlId}`,
    nhlId: entry.nhlId,
    name: market.name,
    position: market.position,
    slot,
    team: market.team,
    opponent: market.schedule?.opponent ?? "—",
    gameTime: market.schedule ? `${market.schedule.day} ${market.schedule.time}` : "—",
    status: market.injuryStatus ?? null,
    todayPts: market.schedule?.todayFantasyPoints ?? null,
    projPts: market.projection,
    headshot: market.headshot,
    profile: market.profile,
    currentSeasonStats: market.currentSeasonStats,
    gameLog: market.gameLog,
    historicalSeasons: market.historicalSeasons,
    schedule: market.schedule,
    injuryStatus: market.injuryStatus,
  }
}

/** Replaces a team's live roster with the frozen week snapshot. Unfrozen weeks keep the live roster. */
export function applyWeekLineup(
  teamName: string,
  live: Player[],
  market: MarketPlayer[],
  assignments: Array<{ teamName: string; nhlId: number; slot: string }> | null,
  frozen: boolean,
): Player[] {
  if (!frozen || !assignments) return live
  const mine = assignments.filter((entry) => entry.teamName === teamName)
  const liveById = new Map(live.filter((player) => player.nhlId).map((player) => [Number(player.nhlId), player]))
  const marketById = new Map(market.filter((player) => player.nhlId).map((player) => [Number(player.nhlId), player]))
  return mine.flatMap((entry) => {
    const existing = liveById.get(entry.nhlId)
    if (existing) return [{ ...existing, slot: entry.slot as Player["slot"] }]
    const listed = marketById.get(entry.nhlId)
    if (!listed) return []
    const built = playerFromMarket({ nhlId: entry.nhlId, slot: entry.slot }, listed)
    return [{ ...built, slot: entry.slot as Player["slot"] }]
  })
}

export function getTeamRoster(teamName: string, userRoster: Player[], databasePlayers: MarketPlayer[] = []): Player[] {
  if (teamName === leagueContext.userTeamName) return userRoster
  const dbEntries = leagueContext.rosters[teamName]
  if (dbEntries && databasePlayers.length > 0) {
    const byId = new Map(databasePlayers.filter((player) => player.nhlId).map((player) => [Number(player.nhlId), player]))
    return dbEntries.flatMap((entry) => {
      const market = byId.get(entry.nhlId)
      return market ? [playerFromMarket(entry, market)] : []
    })
  }
  if (dbEntries && databasePlayers.length === 0) return []
  const ownedNames = new Set(userRoster.map((player) => player.name.toLowerCase()))
  return (dedicatedTeamRosters[teamName] ?? []).filter((player) => !ownedNames.has(player.name.toLowerCase())).map((player) => {
    const databasePlayer = databasePlayers.find((candidate) => candidate.name.toLowerCase() === player.name.toLowerCase())
    if (!databasePlayer) return player
    return {
      ...player,
      // Use the canonical `nhl-<id>` identifier so trades/waivers hit real database players.
      id: databasePlayer.nhlId ? `nhl-${databasePlayer.nhlId}` : player.id,
      team: databasePlayer.team,
      nhlId: databasePlayer.nhlId,
      headshot: databasePlayer.headshot,
      profile: databasePlayer.profile,
      currentSeasonStats: databasePlayer.currentSeasonStats,
      gameLog: databasePlayer.gameLog,
      historicalSeasons: databasePlayer.historicalSeasons,
      schedule: databasePlayer.schedule,
      opponent: databasePlayer.schedule?.opponent ?? player.opponent,
      projPts: databasePlayer.projection,
      todayPts: databasePlayer.schedule?.todayFantasyPoints ?? null,
      status: databasePlayer.injuryStatus ?? null,
      injuryStatus: databasePlayer.injuryStatus ?? null,
    }
  })
}

export interface MatchupSummary {
  id: string
  homeTeam: string
  homeOwner: string
  homeRecord: string
  homeScore: number
  awayTeam: string
  awayOwner: string
  awayRecord: string
  awayScore: number
  status: string
  totalMinutes: number
}

export type LiveMatchupSummary = MatchupSummary & {
  projectedHome: number
  projectedAway: number
}

const canonicalTeams = [
  { team: "Montreal Monarchs", owner: "@commissioner" },
  { team: "Toronto Titans", owner: "@danick504" },
  { team: "Vancouver Voyagers", owner: "@alexr" },
  { team: "Colorado Summit", owner: "@morgan" },
  { team: "Florida Waves", owner: "@jamie" },
  { team: "Detroit Motors", owner: "@riley" },
  { team: "Boston Blades", owner: "@taylor" },
  { team: "Ottawa Outlaws", owner: "@priya" },
  { team: "Tampa Bay Bolts", owner: "@drew" },
  { team: "Calgary Comets", owner: "@casey" },
  { team: "Team WisconsinVVB", owner: "@WisconsinVVB" },
  { team: "Daejon Love's Team", owner: "@Melchior1" },
] as const

/** Returns the six canonical league matchups for a regular-season week. */
export function getMatchupsForWeek(week: number): MatchupSummary[] {
  const safeWeek = Math.min(24, Math.max(1, Math.floor(week)))
  const round = (safeWeek - 1) % 11
  const secondHalf = safeWeek > 12
  const rotated = [canonicalTeams[0], ...canonicalTeams.slice(1).map((_, index) => canonicalTeams[1 + ((index + round) % 11)])]
  return Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, index) => {
    const first = rotated[index]
    const second = rotated[11 - index]
    const home = secondHalf ? second : first
    const away = secondHalf ? first : second
    return {
      id: `w${safeWeek}-m${index + 1}`,
      homeTeam: home.team,
      homeOwner: home.owner,
      homeRecord: "0-0",
      homeScore: 0,
      awayTeam: away.team,
      awayOwner: away.owner,
      awayRecord: "0-0",
      awayScore: 0,
      status: "Scheduled",
      totalMinutes: 180,
    }
  })
}

export const weekMatchups = getMatchupsForWeek(1)
export const getWeekMatchups = getMatchupsForWeek

export interface ScheduleRow {
  week: number
  opponent: string
  opponentOwner: string
  score: string
  result: "WIN" | "LOSS" | "SCHEDULED"
}

export function getScheduleForTeam(teamName: string): ScheduleRow[] {
  return Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, index) => {
    const matchup = getMatchupsForWeek(index + 1).find((candidate) => candidate.homeTeam === teamName || candidate.awayTeam === teamName)
    if (!matchup) {
      return { week: index + 1, opponent: "—", opponentOwner: "—", score: "—", result: "SCHEDULED" }
    }
    const home = matchup.homeTeam === teamName
    return {
      week: index + 1,
      opponent: home ? matchup.awayTeam : matchup.homeTeam,
      opponentOwner: home ? matchup.awayOwner : matchup.homeOwner,
      score: "—",
      result: "SCHEDULED",
    }
  })
}

export const teamSchedule = getScheduleForTeam("Montreal Monarchs")

/** Lightweight lineup-row player, derived from `Player` so the two shapes cannot drift apart. */
export type MatchupPlayer = Pick<Player, "name" | "position" | "team" | "opponent" | "status" | "todayPts" | "projPts" | "schedule" | "gameLog" | "currentSeasonStats"> & {
  empty?: boolean
}

type WeeklyScoringSource = { schedule?: PlayerSchedule | null } | null | undefined

/**
 * Fantasy points actually scored in `week`. Never falls back to projections:
 * unplayed games, missing schedules, or a schedule computed for another week all yield 0.
 */
export function getWeekActualPoints(player: WeeklyScoringSource, week?: number): number {
  const schedule = player?.schedule
  if (!schedule) return 0
  if (week !== undefined && schedule.week !== undefined && schedule.week !== week) return 0
  if (schedule.weekGamesPlayed === 0) return 0
  return schedule.weekFantasyPoints ?? 0
}

/** Projected fantasy points for `week`, or null when no projection exists for that week. */
export function getWeekProjectedPoints(player: (WeeklyScoringSource & { projPts?: number }), week?: number): number | null {
  const schedule = player?.schedule
  if (!schedule) return player?.projPts ?? null
  if (week !== undefined && schedule.week !== undefined && schedule.week !== week) return null
  return schedule.weekProjectedFantasyPoints ?? player?.projPts ?? null
}
